zh: 是； 有，存在； 做，成为； 发生
en: used with a present participle to form the  continuous 4  tenses of verbs
ex1_en: Don’t disturb me while I’m working.
ex1_zh: 我工作的时候不要打扰我。
remmethod: be(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to join two words, phrases etc referring to things that are related in some way
ex1_en: He’s gone to get some fish and chips.
ex1_zh: 他去买炸鱼薯条了。
remmethod: and(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to show what a part belongs to or comes from
ex1_en: the back of the house
ex1_zh: 房子的后部
remmethod: of(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 按照（表示方式）；从事于；在…之内
en: used with the name of a container, place, or area to say where someone or something is
ex1_en: There’s some sugar in the cupboard.
ex1_zh: 碗橱里有一些糖。
remmethod: in(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 有； 进行， 从事； 享受， 经受； 使， 让； 必须， 不得不
en: used with past participles to form perfect tenses
ex1_en: Our guests have arrived.
ex1_zh: 我们的客人到了。
remmethod: have(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: [指无生命的东西、动物、植物]它；这；那
en: used to refer to a thing, animal, situation, idea etc that has already been mentioned or is already known about
ex1_en: ‘Where’s your office?’ ‘It’s on the third floor.’
ex1_zh: “你的办公室在哪儿？”“在三楼。”
remmethod: it(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: He deliberated with them over that question.
ex1_zh: 他和他们商量了那个问题。
remmethod: that(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 为，为了；因为；给；对于；至于；适合于
en: used to say who is intended to get or use something, or where something is intended to be used
ex1_en: I’ve got a present for you.
ex1_zh: 我有件礼物送给你。
remmethod: for(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to refer to a person or group of people when speaking or writing to them
ex1_en: Hi, Kelly. How are you?
ex1_zh: 嗨，凯利，你好吗？
remmethod: you(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
ex1_en: ‘Where’s Paul?’ ‘He’s gone to the cinema.’
ex1_zh: “保罗在哪儿？”“他去看电影了。”
remmethod: he(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to say that two or more people or things are together in the same place
ex1_en: I saw Bob in town with his girlfriend.
ex1_zh: 我看到鲍勃与他的女朋友一起在镇上。
remmethod: with(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 向前地；作用中，行动中；继续着
ex1_en: I wanted to punch him on the nose.
ex1_zh: 我真想一拳打到他鼻子上。
remmethod: on(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: [did-done] 做， 从事； 实行， 进行； 尽力； 可用； 制作； 算出， 解答
en: used instead of repeating a verb that has already been used
ex1_en: ‘Will Kay come?’ ‘She may do.’
ex1_zh: “凯来吗？” “或许吧。”
remmethod: do(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: to express an idea, feeling, thought etc using words
ex1_en: ‘I’m so tired,’ she said.
ex1_zh: “我太累了。”她说。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 讲；说明

zh: 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；达；因为；朝；忙于
en: used to say what event or activity someone is taking part in
ex1_en: I met my wife at a disco.
ex1_zh: 我在迪斯科舞会上认识了我的妻子。
remmethod: at(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to connect two statements or phrases when the second one adds something different or seems surprising after the first one
ex1_en: It’s an old car, but it’s very reliable.
ex1_zh: 这是一辆旧车，但是性能非常可靠。
remmethod: but(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 我们（主格）；笔者，本人（作者或演讲人使用）；朕，寡人
en: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people
ex1_en: ‘Did you go into the supermarket?’ ‘No, we didn’t.’
ex1_zh: “你们进超级市场了吗？”“我们没有进去。”
remmethod: we(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: That should be his mother.
ex1_zh: 那大概是他的母亲。
remmethod: his(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to make a word, statement, or question negative
ex1_en: Most of the stores do not open until 10 am.
ex1_zh: 大多数商店要到上午10点才开始营业。
remmethod: not(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 通过；被；依据；经由；在附近；在……之前
en: used especially with a  passive  verb to say who or what does something or makes something happen
ex1_en: I was attacked by a dog.
ex1_zh: 我被一条狗袭击。
remmethod: by(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 她（主格）；它（用来指雌性动物或国家、船舶、地球、月亮等）
en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
ex1_en: You could always ask Beth – she’s got plenty of money.
ex1_zh: 你总是可以去问贝丝——她有很多钱。
remmethod: she(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used between two words or phrases to show that either of two things is possible, or used before the last in a list of possibilities or choices
ex1_en: Shall we go out to the cinema or stay at home?
ex1_zh: 我们是出去看电影还是待在家里？
remmethod: or(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 因为；随着；虽然；依照；当…时
en: while or when
ex1_en: I saw Peter as I was getting off the bus.
ex1_zh: 我下公共汽车的时候看见了彼得。
remmethod: as(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to ask for information or for someone’s opinion
ex1_en: What are you doing?
ex1_zh: 你在做什么？
remmethod: what(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: to move in a particular way, or to do something as you are moving
ex1_en: The plate went crashing to the floor.
ex1_zh: 盘子哗啦一声掉在地板上。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 走；去；运转；趋于；尝试

ex1_en: They talked her round to their position.
ex1_zh: 他们说服她同意他们的看法。
remmethod: their(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used with the verbs ‘see’, ‘hear’, ‘feel’, ‘taste’, and ‘smell’, and with verbs connected with thinking, to mean that someone sees something, hears something etc
ex1_en: Here they are – I can see their car.
ex1_zh: 他们来了——我看到他们的汽车了。
remmethod: can(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: [got-gotten/got] 获得， 弄到； 收到； 变得； 拿来； 理解， 听到； 到达
en: to receive something that someone gives you or sends you
ex1_en: She got loads of presents.
ex1_zh: 她收到了许多礼物。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 获得；使得

zh: （表条件）如果；即使；是否；（表假设）假如
en: used when talking about something that might happen or be true, or might have happened
ex1_en: We’ll stay at home if it rains.
ex1_zh: 如果下雨，我们就待在家里。
remmethod: if(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 她（she的宾格）；她的（she的所有格）；她（指某个国家；一艘船）
en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
ex1_en: Jane? I don’t really know her.
ex1_zh: 简？我不太认识她。
remmethod: her(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: You shouldn’t be sitting here by yourself, all alone.
ex1_zh: 你不应该一个人孤零零地坐在这儿。
remmethod: all(全部) → 全部的；全部

ex1_en: All my friends do not smoke.
ex1_zh: 我的朋友并不全都吸烟。
remmethod: my(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: concerning or relating to a particular subject
ex1_en: a book about politics
ex1_zh: 一本有关政治的书
remmethod: a(在) + bout(边界；范围) → 关于；大约；周围

zh: 将，会，要〔用于构成将来时〕
en: used to make future tenses
ex1_en: A meeting will be held next Tuesday at 3 p.m.
ex1_zh: 下星期二下午3点将召开一个会议。
remmethod: will(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: towards a higher place or position
ex1_en: We walked slowly up the hill.
ex1_zh: 我们慢慢地爬上山。
remmethod: up(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to mean someone or something of a type that has already been mentioned or is known about
ex1_en: ‘Have you got a camera?’ ‘No.’ ‘You should buy one’ (= buy a camera ).
ex1_zh: “你有照相机吗？”“没有。”“你应该买一架。”
remmethod: one(一) → 一；一个人

zh: 时间；时代；次数；节拍；倍数
en: the thing that is measured in minutes, hours, days, years etc using clocks
ex1_en: Einstein changed the way we think about space and time.
ex1_zh: 爱因斯坦改变了我们的时空概念。
remmethod: time(时间；划分) → 时间；次数

en: used to refer back to an idea, action, quality, situation etc that has just been mentioned
ex1_en: The troops will not advance until ordered to do so .
ex1_zh: 在接到命令之前，部队不会前进。
remmethod: so(功能词，无词根拆分)
which(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: used to refer to two or more people or things that have already been mentioned or are already known about
ex1_en: Has anyone seen my keys? I can’t find them anywhere.
ex1_zh: 有人见到我的钥匙吗？我哪儿都找不到。
remmethod: them(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 一些；某个；大约；相当多的
ex1_en: I’ve just made a pot of coffee. Would you like some?
ex1_zh: 我刚煮了一壶咖啡，你想喝点吗？
remmethod: some(自身词根) → 一些

en: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself
ex1_en: Stop, you’re hurting me.
ex1_zh: 住手，你弄疼我了。
remmethod: me(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: [took-taken] 带， 携带； 需要， 花费； 拿， 取得； 接受； 吃， 喝， 服(药
en: to move or go with someone or something from one place to another
ex1_en: Would you mind taking Susie home ?
ex1_zh: 请你带苏茜回家好吗？
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 拿；取；占据

zh: 出现；在外；出局；出声地；不流行地
en: not inside a building
ex1_en: Many of the homeless have been sleeping out for years.
ex1_zh: 许多无家可归者常年露宿街头。
remmethod: out(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 到…里；深入…之中；成为…状况；进入到…之内
en: to the inside or inner part of a container, place, area etc
ex1_en: Come into the office.
ex1_zh: 到办公室里来。
remmethod: into(功能词，无词根拆分)

zh: 只是，仅仅；刚才，刚刚；正好，恰好；实在；刚要
en: exactly
ex1_en: A good strong cup of coffee is just what I need right now.
ex1_zh: 我现在正需要喝一杯浓浓的咖啡。
remmethod: 伸张正义(just)， 势在必(must)行

en: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is already known about
ex1_en: Are you in love with him?
ex1_zh: 你爱上他了吗？
remmethod: him(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: You should keep in with your colleagues.
ex1_zh: 你应当与你的同事友好相处。
remmethod: your(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: I could do it, he mused.
ex1_zh: 我能做这件事，他沉思着。
remmethod: could(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: You use now to refer to the present time, often in contrast to a time in the past or the future
ex1_en: She's a widow now.
ex1_zh: 她现在是一个寡妇。
remmethod: now(现在) → 现在；目前

en: to enjoy something or think that it is nice or good
ex1_en: I like your jacket.
ex1_zh: 我喜欢你这件上衣。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 喜欢；像

en: You use other to refer to an additional thing or person of the same type as one that has been mentioned or is known about
ex1_en: They were just like any other young couple.
ex1_zh: 他们那时就和其他任何年轻夫妇一样。
remmethod: other(另外) → 其他的

en: used to ask or talk about the way in which something happens or is done
ex1_en: How do you spell your name?
ex1_zh: 你的名字怎么拼写？
remmethod: how(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: He emphasized its importance to me.
ex1_zh: 他向我强调它的重要性。
remmethod: its(功能词，无词根拆分)

ex1_en: They partook of our triumph.
ex1_zh: 他们分享我们的胜利。
remmethod: our(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: in groups of two people or things
ex1_en: I’d like you to line up in twos, please.
ex1_zh: 请你们两个一组排好队。
remmethod: two(二) → 二；两个

en: having a particular quality to a greater degree
ex1_en: You’ll have to be more careful next time.
ex1_zh: 你下次要更小心一点。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 更多；更大程度地

en: to have a desire for something
ex1_en: I really want a drink.
ex1_zh: 我很想喝一杯。
remmethod: want(缺乏；渴望) → 需要；缺少

zh: 方法；道路；方向；行业；习惯
en: a method that you use to do or achieve something
ex1_en: There are several different ways we can tackle this problem.
ex1_zh: 我们可以用几种不同的方法处理这个问题。
remmethod: way(路；移动) → 道路；方法

zh: 看；期待；注意；面向；看上去像
en: to turn your eyes towards something, so that you can see it
ex1_en: We sneaked out while Jessie’s mom wasn’t looking.
ex1_zh: 我们趁杰茜的妈妈没有看到，偷偷地溜了出去。
remmethod: 看(look)书(book)百遍， 其义自现

en: before doing anything else, or before anything else happens
ex1_en: I’ll join you in a minute but I need to make a phone call first.
ex1_zh: 我一会儿就来，但是我得先打个电话。
remmethod: fir(前；先) + st(最) → 第一；首先

zh: 新的，新鲜的；更新的；初见的
en: recently made, built, invented, written, designed etc
ex1_en: the city’s new hospital
ex1_zh: 市里新建的医院
remmethod: new(新) → 新的

en: used to give a negative reply to a question, offer, or request
ex1_en: ‘Are you Italian?’ ‘No, I’m Spanish.’
ex1_zh: “你是意大利人吗？”“不，我是西班牙人。”
remmethod: no(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: an adult male human
ex1_en: There were two men and a woman in the car.
ex1_zh: 车上有两男一女。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 人；男人；人类

zh: 发现，找到 〔一直在寻找之物〕
en: to discover, see, or get something that you have been searching for
ex1_en: I can’t find the car keys.
ex1_zh: 我找不到汽车钥匙。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 找到；发现

en: in this place
ex1_en: What are you doing here?
ex1_zh: 你们在这里干什么？
remmethod: 这里(here) 那里(there)， 到处都是

en: an idea, action, feeling, or fact that someone thinks, does, says, or talks about, or that happens
ex1_en: People say things they don’t mean when they are angry.
ex1_zh: 人生气时就会口不择言。
remmethod: thing(集会；事务) → 事情；东西

zh: [gave-given] 给予， 赠送； 供给， 提供； 做出， 发出
en: to let someone have something as a present, or to provide something for someone
ex1_en: Researchers were given a £10,000 grant to continue their work.
ex1_zh: 研究人员得到一万英镑的经费以继续他们的研究。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 给；产生；让步；举办；授予；弹性

zh: 好； 妥善地， 有利地； 令人满意地； 完全地； 充分地， 足够地； 很， 相当
en: in a successful or satisfactory way
ex1_en: Did you sleep well?
ex1_zh: 你睡得好吗？
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 好；井；涌出

en: not more than a particular number, age etc
ex1_en: Naomi was only 17 when she got married.
ex1_zh: 娜奥米结婚时才17岁。
remmethod: one(一) + ly(…地) → 唯一地 → 只；仅仅

zh: [told-told] 讲， 告诉； 吩咐， 命令； 说明， 显示； 分辨， 区分
en: if someone tells you something, they communicate information, a story, their feelings etc to you
ex1_en: I’ll tell you all about it when I get back.
ex1_zh: 我回来再告诉你这一切。
remmethod: 个子高(tall)的人， 说话(tell)嗓门大

zh: [数] 偶数的；平坦的；相等的
en: flat and level, with no parts that are higher than other parts
ex1_en: The floor must be completely even before we lay the tiles.
ex1_zh: 地面必须完全平整后才能铺地砖。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 甚至；平坦的；偶数的

zh: 后面；背部；靠背；足球等的后卫；书报等的末尾
en: the part of something that is furthest from the front
ex1_en: a T-shirt with a picture of a snake on the back
ex1_zh: 后背印了一条蛇的T恤衫
remmethod: back(自身词根) → 后面；背部；支持；后退

ex1_en: We should be prepared for any contingency.
ex1_zh: 我们应该对任何应急情况有所准备。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 任何的；丝毫

zh: 好的；优良的；愉快的；虔诚的
en: of a high standard or quality
ex1_en: a good hotel
ex1_zh: 一家不错的宾馆
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 好的；好处；善行

en: into one side or end of an entrance, passage, hole etc and out of the other side or end
ex1_en: She smiled at him as he walked through the door.
ex1_zh: 他从门口进来时，她朝他笑了。
remmethod: th+rough(粗略的， 大致的)→从头到尾粗略浏览→从头到尾； 穿过

en: used by the person speaking or writing to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people
ex1_en: Please help us.
ex1_zh: 请帮助我们。
remmethod: us(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: someone who is not yet an adult
ex1_en: The hotel is ideal for families with young children.
ex1_zh: 这家宾馆对带小孩的家庭再合适不过。
remmethod: child(自身词根) → 儿童；孩子

en: to or towards a lower place or position
ex1_en: David bent down to tie his shoelace.
ex1_zh: 戴维弯腰系鞋带。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 向下；绒毛

zh: 可以，能够；可能，也许；祝，愿；会，能
ex1_en: I may be late, so don’t wait for me.
ex1_zh: 我可能会迟到，所以别等我。
remmethod: may(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: After is also an adverb
ex1_en: Tomorrow. Or the day after.
ex1_zh: 明天。或者后天。
remmethod: af(离开) + ter(更远) → 在…之后；后来

ex1_en: What should I do? Should I trust him?
ex1_zh: 我该怎么办？我应该相信他吗？
remmethod: should(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: to say or shout something loudly so that someone can hear you
ex1_en: I heard someone calling in the distance.
ex1_zh: 我听到远处有人在叫。
remmethod: call(自身词根) → 呼叫；拜访；要求

en: in or to a particular house, city etc
ex1_en: You really should come over and see our new house.
ex1_zh: 你真的该过来看看我们的新房子。
remmethod: over(功能词，无词根拆分)

en: up to a particular point in time and continuing at that moment
ex1_en: I still haven’t finished painting the spare room.
ex1_zh: 我还没粉刷完那间空房间。
remmethod: 好莱坞科幻电影《地球停转之日》(The Day the Earth Stood Still)

zh: 试图，努力；试验；审判；考验
en: to take action in order to do something that you may not be able to do
ex1_en: Let’s have a rest and then we’ll try again.
ex1_zh: 我们休息一下，然后再试。
remmethod: try(挑选；试验) → 尝试；审判

zh: 末尾，最后；上个；鞋楦（做鞋的模型）
en: happening or existing at the end, with no others after
ex1_en: I didn’t read the last chapter of the book.
ex1_zh: 我没有看这本书的最后一章。

zh: 鼻子；嗅觉；突出的部分；探问

ex1_zh: 有人一拳打在他的鼻子上。
remmethod: nose(鼻) → 鼻子；嗅觉

en: the place where something is or where something happens, and the general environment

en: to start something, usually something big or important

en: a set of papers, records etc that contain information about a particular person or subject
ex1_en: We will keep your details on file (= store them for later use ) .

ex1_zh: 他母亲病得很重。

remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 广告

en: to use arguments to protect something or someone from criticism, or to prove that something is right
ex1_en: She was always defending her husband in front of their daughter.
ex1_zh: 她在女儿面前总是为丈夫辩解。
remmethod: de(使没有)+fend(打击)→使不受打击→防御；防护

en: something that is very different from something else
ex1_en: The sauce is quite sweet, so add dried thyme as a contrast.

ex1_zh: 她醒来时，阳光泻入窗内。

en: used by the person speaking to show that they and one or more other people are affected by their own action

ex1_zh: 这房间能坐80个人左右。

ex1_zh: 乡村的庄园

ex1_en: Food was often scarce in the winter.
ex1_zh: 冬季常常粮食短缺。
remmethod: scar(伤疤) ＋ ce → 有伤疤 → 不完整的 → 缺乏的

en: a situation in which an army or the police surround a place and try to gain control of it or force someone to come out of it
ex1_en: The siege lasted almost four months.
ex1_zh: 这次封锁历时近四个月。
remmethod: 参见besiege(v. 围攻)

en: a situation that seems strange because it involves two ideas or qualities that are very different
ex1_en: It’s a paradox that in such a rich country there can be so much poverty.
ex1_zh: 在如此富有的国家却有这么多的贫穷现象，真是矛盾。
remmethod: para(类似) + dox(观点) → 两边的观点都类似 → 似乎矛盾而正确的说法

en: existing or accepted in a particular place or at a particular time
ex1_en: The prevailing mood of public opinion remained hostile.
ex1_zh: 公众仍普遍持敌对情绪。
remmethod: 来自prevail(vi. 流行， 盛行)

en: to cook food on a metal frame over a fire outdoors
ex1_en: barbecued chicken
ex1_zh: 〔用烤架烧的〕烤鸡
remmethod: barb(倒钩)+ecue→用倒钩挂上肉烤→烤肉野餐

en: existing everywhere
ex1_en: the pervasive influence of television
ex1_zh: 电视无所不在的影响
remmethod: 来自pervade(vt. 弥漫， 遍及)

en: clearly known, seen, or stated
ex1_en: It’s impossible for me to give you a definite answer.
ex1_zh: 我不可能给你明确的答复。
remmethod: 来自define(v. 下定义)
tags: cet4 cet6 ky toefl ielts gre

en: to be in charge of a formal event, organization, ceremony etc
ex1_en: I shall be pleased to preside at your meetings.
ex1_zh: 我很高兴主持你们的会议。
remmethod: pre(前面) ＋ sid(坐) ＋ e → 坐在前面 → 主持， 主管

en: to treat a person or group differently from another in an unfair way
ex1_en: He is incapable of discriminating between a good idea and a terrible one.
ex1_zh: 他没能力在一个好主意和一个坏主意之间进行区分。
remmethod: dis(离开)+crimin(分开)+ate(使)→使分开→区别， 辨别

en: someone who changes writing into a different language
ex1_en: The author discovered that the translator had foisted several passages into his book.
ex1_zh: 作者发现翻译者偷偷在他的原著中插入了几段文章。
remmethod: translat(e)(翻译) + or(表人/物) → 译者；翻译器

zh: 商标， 牌号； 特征， 标记
en: a special name, sign, or word that is marked on a product to show that it is made by a particular company, that cannot be used by any other company
ex1_en: The striped T-shirt became the comedian’s trademark.
ex1_zh: 条纹T恤衫成了这位喜剧演员的标记。
remmethod: trade(商业)+mark(标志)→商标

en: to take the place or position of something or someone
ex1_en: Coal has been displaced by natural gas as a major source of energy.
ex1_zh: 作为一种主要能源，煤的地位已为天然气所取代。
remmethod: dis(消失掉) + place(放置) → 放走 → 转移

en: related to land that is owned or controlled by a particular country
ex1_en: a territorial dispute
ex1_zh: 领土争端
remmethod: 来自territory (n. 领土)

en: a complete list of things that you can look at, buy, or use, for example in a library or at an art show
ex1_en: a mail order catalog
ex1_zh: 邮购商品目录
remmethod: cata(下面)+log(说)→下面要说的话→目录

en: an area of low flat ground that is always wet and soft
ex1_en: Cows were grazing on the marshes.
ex1_zh: 牛群在湿地上吃草。
remmethod: 和march (vi. 行军) 一起记， 红军长征 (long march) 过沼泽地 (marsh)

zh: 地极的， 近地极的； 磁极的； 正好相反的， 截然对立的
en: close to or relating to the North Pole or the South Pole
ex1_en: As our climate warms up, the polar ice caps will begin to melt.
ex1_zh: 随着地球气候逐渐变暖，极地的冰冠将开始融化。
remmethod: 来自pole(n. 地极； 磁极)

zh: 单独的， 独自的； 单个的， 唯一的； 孤独的， 隐居的
en: used to emphasize that there is only one of something
ex1_en: the solitary goal of the match
ex1_zh: 这场比赛的唯一入球
remmethod: solit(单独) + ary → 孤独的

en: official documents, reports etc that are used to prove that something is true or correct
ex1_en: Applicants must provide supporting documentation .
ex1_zh: 申请人必须提供证明文件。
remmethod: document(文件；证明) + ation(名词后缀) → 文件编制；证明文件

en: a young dog
ex1_en: a six-month-old puppy
ex1_zh: 一只六个月大的小狗
remmethod: pup(幼犬) + p + y(小称) → 小狗

zh: 大幅度下降，暴跌；突然倒下
en: to fall or lean against something because you are not strong enough to stand
ex1_en: Sales slumped by 20% last year.
ex1_zh: 去年销售额骤减 20%。
remmethod: sl + ump(看作jump跳下) → 突然跳下 → 暴跌

en: the part of something that is left after everything else has gone or been dealt with
ex1_en: The remainder must be paid by the end of June.
ex1_zh: 剩余款项必须在6月底之前支付。
remmethod: 来自remain(vi. 保留)

en: the act of saying that something is illegal
ex1_en: the prohibition of the sale of firearms
ex1_zh: 枪支的禁售
remmethod: 来自prohibit (禁止) + ion → 禁止， 阻止

en: to think someone or something is unpleasant and not like them
ex1_en: Why do you dislike her so much?
ex1_zh: 你为什么那么讨厌她？
remmethod: dis(不)+like(喜欢) →不喜欢

en: a small piece of metal, cloth, or plastic with a picture or words on it, worn to show rank, membership of a group, support for a political idea etc
ex1_en: We were each handed a badge with our name on it.
ex1_zh: 我们每个人都拿到一个徽章，上面有我们的名字。
remmethod: 身缠绷带(bandage)， 胸前佩章(badge)

en: (of a contract, an agreement etc.) not valid or legal
ex1_en: The agreement was declared void.
ex1_zh: 该协议已宣布无效。
remmethod: 避免(avoid)空虚(void)

en: in some religions, a perfect place where people are believed to go after they die, if they have led good lives
ex1_en: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
ex1_zh: 《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。
remmethod: Paradise Lost 《失乐园》(弥尔顿著)

en: animals from the sea that you can eat, for example fish and  shellfish
ex1_en: a seafood restaurant
ex1_zh: 海鲜餐馆
remmethod: sea(海) + food(食物) → 海产食品；海味

en: a very hard grey rock, often used in building
ex1_en: He was very skilled at pointing down the blocks of granite.
ex1_zh: 他善于把花岗岩石凿平。
remmethod: gran(=grain颗粒) + ite → 颗粒状石头 → 花岗岩， 花岗石

en: if the weather erodes rock or soil, or if rock or soil erodes, its surface is gradually destroyed
ex1_en: The cliffs are being constantly eroded by heavy seas.
ex1_zh: 悬崖正不断受到汹涌海浪的侵蚀。
remmethod: e(去掉) + rod(咬) + e → 咬掉 → 侵蚀， 腐蚀

zh: [hummed-hummed, humming] 哼曲子； 发出嗡嗡声； 忙碌， 充满活力
en: to sing a tune by making a continuous sound with your lips closed
ex1_en: He began to hum a tune.
ex1_zh: 他开始哼唱一支曲子。
remmethod: “哼” → 哼(曲子)

en: produced by combining different artificial substances, rather than being naturally produced
ex1_en: synthetic chemicals
ex1_zh: 合成化学品
remmethod: syn(共同) ＋ thetic(看作thesis， 论题) → 将论题放到一起 → 综合的， 合成的

en: to stop someone from doing something, often by using physical force
ex1_en: Renwick restrained a feeling of annoyance.
ex1_zh: 伦威克忍住了不悦的情绪。
remmethod: re ＋ strain(拉紧) → 重新拉紧 → 阻止， 抑制
tags: cet4 cet6 ky toefl ielts gre

en: a thick sticky sweet liquid, eaten on top of or mixed with other foods
ex1_en: ice cream and maple syrup
ex1_zh: 枫糖浆冰激凌
remmethod: sy + rup(看做cup， 杯) → 一杯一杯地喝糖浆 → 糖浆

zh: 资格；条件；限制；赋予资格
en: if you have a qualification, you have passed an examination or course to show you have a particular level of skill or knowledge in a subject
ex1_en: He left school without any qualifications.
ex1_zh: 他离校时没有拿到任何文凭。
remmethod: 来自qualify〔v. (使)具有资格， 限定〕

en: a hot or cold drink
ex1_en: alcoholic beverages
ex1_zh: 含酒精的饮料
remmethod: bever(喝) + age → 喝的东西 → 饮料

en: When a movie or show premieres or is premiered, it is shown to an audience for the first time
ex1_en: The documentary premiered at the Jerusalem Film Festival.
ex1_zh: 那部记录片在耶路撒冷电影节上首映。
remmethod: 来自premier(adj. 首要的； 最早的)

en: to copy the way someone speaks or behaves, especially in order to make people laugh
ex1_en: He could mimic all the teachers’ accents.
ex1_zh: 他能模仿所有老师的口音。
remmethod: mimi(音似： 秘密) + c → 偷偷摸摸地模仿 → 模仿

en: completely
ex1_en: a wholly satisfactory solution
ex1_zh: 完全令人满意的解决办法
remmethod: whol(整体) + ly(副词后缀) → 整个；全部

en: bullets, shells (  shell  ) etc that are fired from guns
ex1_en: He had only seven rounds of ammunition for the revolver.
ex1_zh: 他只有7发左轮手枪的弹药。
remmethod: am(表加强) ＋ mun(服务) ＋ ition → 为战争服务 → 弹药， 军火

en: work such as writing letters or reports, which must be done but is not very interesting
ex1_en: Police work involves so much paperwork these days.
ex1_zh: 如今当警察也要做这么多文书工作。
remmethod: paper(文件)+work(工作)→文书工作

zh: 刺穿， 刺破， 穿透； 穿孔， 打眼
en: to make a small hole in or through something, using an object with a sharp point
ex1_en: Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
ex1_zh: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。
remmethod: r从一片(piece)中穿过(pierce)

zh: 杂交产生的；混合的，合成的
en: Hybrid is also an adjective
remmethod: hybrid(自身词根) → 杂种；混合物

en: to let someone have or do whatever they want, even if it is bad for them
ex1_en: His mother spoiled him, indulging his every whim.
ex1_zh: 他母亲对他纵容娇惯，百依百顺。
remmethod: 一打就急 → 放纵

zh: 害虫；有害之物；讨厌的人
en: a small animal or insect that destroys crops or food supplies
ex1_en: a chemical used in pest control
ex1_zh: 用于防治虫害的一种化学品
remmethod: “拍死它”→见到害虫就拍死它→害虫

en: intended to be used or accepted for a short time only, until something or someone final can be made or found
ex1_en: an interim report
ex1_zh: 中期报告
remmethod: inter(在…之间)+im→间歇； 过渡期间

en: a wide open area of fairly flat land in North America which is covered in grass or wheat
ex1_en: About 160 species of rare birds live in the swamps and prairie there.
ex1_zh: 大约有160种珍稀鸟类栖息在这里的沼泽地和大草原上。
remmethod: pr + air(空气) + ie → 大草原上空气好 → 大草原

en: relating to the Earth’s atmosphere
ex1_en: atmospheric pressure
ex1_zh: 大气压力
remmethod: atmo(气) + spher(球) + ic(形容词后缀) → 大气的

zh: 通勤者, 每日往返上班者
en: someone who travels a long distance to work every day
remmethod: com(共同) + mut(改变) + er(表人) → 往返改变地点的人 → 通勤者

en: to move with a sudden quick movement, or to make something move in this way
ex1_en: His tongue flicked across his lips.
ex1_zh: 他的舌头在双唇间快速移动。
remmethod: fli(看做fly， 飞) + ck → 轻拍翅膀， 展翅高飞 → 轻拍

zh: 连续的， 顺序排列的
en: arranged or happening one after the other in the correct order
ex1_en: Keep the questions in the same serial order .
ex1_zh: 让这些问题保持原来的顺序。
remmethod: 连续剧(serial)就是以某个主题为系列(series)的电视剧

en: an extremely small person, who will never grow to a normal size because of a physical problem; a person suffering from dwarfism
ex1_en: a dwarf conifer
ex1_zh: 矮生针叶树
remmethod: 战争(war)使战败国在战胜国面前相形见绌(dwarf)

en: a sweet juicy fruit that has a round base and is thinner near the top, or the tree that produces this fruit
ex1_en: I took this apple for a pear until I tasted it.
ex1_zh: 我误将这个苹果当作梨子，直到我尝了才知道。
remmethod: pear(梨) → 梨；梨树

en: to be even better or greater than someone or something else
ex1_en: He had surpassed all our expectations .
ex1_zh: 他超越了我们所有的预期。
remmethod: sur(超过) ＋ pass(通过) → 超过

en: without limits in space or time
ex1_en: The universe is infinite.
ex1_zh: 宇宙是无限的。
remmethod: in(无) ＋ fin(结束) ＋ ite(…的) → 没有结尾的 → 无限的

en: information that is passed from one person to another about other people’s behaviour and private lives, often including unkind or untrue remarks
ex1_en: What’s the latest gossip ?
ex1_zh: 最近有些什么传闻？
remmethod: go(进行) ＋ s ＋ sip(吸吮) → 流言蜚语能吸干人的精力 → 传播流言蜚语

zh: 反驳；否定；与…矛盾；与…抵触
en: to disagree with something, especially by saying that the opposite is true
ex1_en: Deborah opened her mouth to contradict, but closed it again.
ex1_zh: 黛博拉张口想要反驳，但又把嘴闭上了。
remmethod: contra(反对) ＋ dict(说话， 断言) → 说反对的话 → 反驳
tags: gk cet6 ky toefl ielts gre

en: having large strong muscles
ex1_en: She was fast and strong, with a slender, muscular body.
ex1_zh: 她动作敏捷，身体强壮，身材苗条，肌肉结实。
remmethod: 来自muscul(e)(n. 肌肉)

zh: 乘公交车上下班，经常乘车往返于两地
ex1_en: Baldry’s 20-year prison sentence was commuted to three years.
ex1_zh: 鲍德里二十年的刑期被减至三年。
remmethod: com(共同)+mut(改变)+e→在两地间改变→经常乘车往返于两地

en: related to or limited by time
ex1_en: the temporal character of human existence
ex1_zh: 人生的短促
remmethod: tempor(时间) + al → 时间的

en: involving two groups or nations
remmethod: bi(双， 两) + later(侧面， 边) + al(形容词后缀) → 双边的

en: to force yourself to be brave and do something you are afraid of doing
ex1_en: He finally plucked up enough courage to ask her out.
ex1_zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 勇气

en: relating to the Moon or to travel to the Moon
ex1_en: studies of the lunar surface
ex1_zh: 对月球表面的研究
remmethod: lun(月亮)+ar→月亮的
tags: cet4 cet6 ky toefl ielts gre

en: a difference between two amounts, details, reports etc that should be the same
ex1_en: A modification of the common-origin theory accounts for the density discrepancy .
ex1_zh: 关于共同起源的理论，有一种改进的论点解释了密度的不符。
remmethod: dis(分开)+crep(破裂)+ancy→矛盾出现， 关系破裂→矛盾

en: complete – used especially to emphasize that something is very bad, or that a feeling is very strong
ex1_en: That’s utter nonsense!
ex1_zh: 真是一派胡言！
remmethod: 小男孩突然发出声音 (utter) 说要吃黄油 (butter)

en: an intermediate stage in a process of development is between two other stages
ex1_en: an intermediate stage during which the disease is dormant
ex1_zh: 疾病处于潜伏状态的中期
remmethod: inter(在…之间) + medi(中间) + ate → 中间的

en: death
ex1_en: the mystery surrounding Elena’s untimely demise
ex1_zh: 埃琳娜猝然早逝之谜
remmethod: de + mise (看作miss， 送出， 抛弃) → 送了性命 → 死亡

en: to improve the quality of something, especially by adding things to it
ex1_en: Add fertilizer to enrich the soil.
ex1_zh: 施上肥料使土壤肥沃。
remmethod: en(使…) ＋ rich(富有的) → 使富有

en: a regularly repeated tune, often with many words sung on one note, especially used for religious prayers
ex1_en: protesters chanting anti-government slogans
ex1_zh: 反复呼喊反政府口号的抗议者
remmethod: “唱它”→唱； 圣歌

ex1_en: The captain dived his submarine deep to escape from the destroyers.
ex1_zh: 海军上校使他的潜艇深深下潜以逃避驱逐艇。
remmethod: sub (在下面) + marine (海洋) → 在海洋下面 → 水下的， 海底的

zh: 压倒性地, 不可抵抗地
remmethod: over(超过) + whelm(淹没) + ing(表状态) + ly(副词后缀) → 势不可挡地

zh: 比预期时间早的； 不成熟的， 仓促的
en: happening before the natural or proper time
ex1_en: his premature death due to cancer
ex1_zh: 他因癌症而早逝
remmethod: pre(预先) + mature(成熟的) → 还没成熟的 → 早熟的， 过早的

en: to praise something or someone in order to persuade people that they are important or worth a lot
ex1_en: his much touted musical
ex1_zh: 他那出备受推崇的音乐剧
remmethod: t + out(在外面) → 去外面兜售商品 → 兜售

en: a round hole in the ground made by something that has fallen on it or by an explosion
ex1_en: craters on the moon’s surface
ex1_zh: 月球表面的坑
remmethod: crat(碗) + er(名词后缀) → 碗状凹陷 → 弹坑

en: the development and use of minerals, forests, oil etc for business or industry
remmethod: ex(出) + ploit(折叠；利用) + ation(名词后缀) → 开发；开采

en: someone who wears funny clothes, a red nose, bright make-up on their face etc, and does silly things to make people laugh, especially at a circus
ex1_en: The performance of the clown kept the public rolling about.
ex1_zh: 小丑的表演使观众笑得前仰后合。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 小丑

en: a long narrow hole dug at the side of a field, road etc to hold or remove unwanted water
ex1_en: Both vehicles ended up in a ditch.
ex1_zh: 两辆车都掉进了沟里。
remmethod: 和pitch(vt. 投， 掷)一起记

en: bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and can be cut into slices

ex1_zh: 一条面包

zh: 垫子；起缓解作用之物；（猪等的）臀肉；银行储蓄
en: a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put on a chair or the floor to make it more comfortable
ex1_en: a velvet cushion
ex1_zh: 天鹅绒垫子
remmethod: “苦行”→苦行僧盘腿在垫子上打坐→垫子

en: the time when day is just starting to become night
ex1_en: romantic walks along the beach at twilight
ex1_zh: 黄昏时分浪漫的海边漫步
remmethod: twi(二；半) + light(光) → 半明半暗 → 黎明，黄昏

en: the time, usually between the ages of 12 and 18, when a young person is developing into an adult
ex1_en: Some young people suddenly become self-conscious and tongue-tied in early adolescence.
ex1_zh: 一些年青人在青春期早期突然变得害羞结舌。

en: to understand something that is complicated or difficult
ex1_en: She cannot comprehend the extent of the disaster.
ex1_zh: 她无法理解这场灾难的严重程度。
remmethod: com(完全)+prehend(抓住)→完全抓住要领→理解

en: to throw out or away
ex1_en: Chinese vases are disposed around the gallery.
ex1_zh: 中国花瓶摆放在展馆四周。

en: to unfasten the lock on a door, box etc
ex1_en: to unlock the door
ex1_zh: 打开门锁

ex1_en: It was moving fast like a squirrel, but it was as loud as a bear.

ex1_zh: 非常古老的建筑物
remmethod: antiqu(=antique古代的) + ity → 古代

ex1_en: You can’t make generalizations about what men and women are like.
ex1_zh: 男人什么样，女人什么样，不能一概而论。
remmethod: 来自generalize(v. 概括； 使…一般化)

en: a very small green plant that grows in a thick soft furry mass on wet soil, trees, or rocks
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 苔藓

en: to move into a comfortable position, pressing your head or body against someone or against something soft
ex1_en: Sarah lay there peacefully, the child nestling by her side.
ex1_zh: 萨拉安静地躺在那儿，孩子偎依在她身边。
remmethod: nest (鸟窝) + le → 像鸟一样安顿 → 舒适地安顿下来

en: a small thin piece that is torn or cut roughly from something
ex1_en: Cut the cabbage into fine long shreds.
ex1_zh: 把这棵卷心菜切成细长条。
remmethod: 精明的(shrewd)人连小碎纸片(shred)也不会随便丢

en: a machine for making air or water hotter
ex1_en: Did you turn the heater off?
ex1_zh: 你关掉加热器了吗？
remmethod: heat(加热) + er(表物) → 加热器

zh: 干部会议；核心会议；党团会议
en: a meeting of the members of a political party to choose people to represent them in a larger meeting, election etc
ex1_en: the chairman of the Congressional Black Caucus
ex1_zh: 国会黑人议员同盟的主席
remmethod: 源自Caucus， 波士顿政党会议俱乐部 (18世纪60年代)

en: A refreshing bath or drink makes you feel energetic or cool again after you have been tired or hot
ex1_en: Herbs have been used for centuries to make refreshing drinks.
ex1_zh: 草药用于调制清凉饮料已有几百年的历史了。
remmethod: 来自refresh(vt. 使精神振作)

en: an illness that is not very serious
ex1_en: minor ailments
ex1_zh: 小恙
remmethod: ail(痛苦) + ment(名词后缀) → 小病

en: when someone does something, or something happens, that affects your private life or activities in an unwanted way
ex1_en: the unwelcome intrusion of the press
ex1_zh: 不受欢迎的新闻界的侵扰
remmethod: in(向内) ＋ trus(刺) ＋ ion → 向内刺 → 闯入

en: having many different uses
ex1_en: The potato is an extremely versatile vegetable.
ex1_zh: 马铃薯是一种用途极广的蔬菜。
remmethod: vers(旋转) ＋ at ＋ ile(易于…的) → 容易转换角色的 → 多面手 → 多才多艺的； 有多用途的

en: a large group of soldiers consisting of several companies (  company  )
ex1_en: Ten hours later Anthony was ordered to return to his battalion.
ex1_zh: 10小时之后安东尼被命令回营。
remmethod: battal (看作battle， 战争) + ion → 军营， 军队

ex1_en: In semiconductor receivers transistors take the place of vacuum tubes.
ex1_zh: 在半导体收音机中晶体管代替了真空管。
remmethod: semi(半)+conductor(导体)→半导体

en: a person, thing, or situation that annoys you or causes problems
ex1_en: He could be a bit of a nuisance when he was drunk.
ex1_zh: 他喝醉时会是一个有点令人讨厌的人。
remmethod: 讨厌的人(nuisance)说什么都是废话(nonsense)

zh: 晕眩的；使人头晕的；昏乱的；心不在焉的；愚蠢的
en: feeling unable to stand steadily, for example because you are looking down from a high place or because you are ill
ex1_en: The heat and the champagne made him feel dizzy .
ex1_zh: 高温和香槟酒使他感到眩晕。
remmethod: di(二) ＋ zz(打鼾声) ＋ y → 室友打鼾， 让人失眠 → 眩晕的

en: to make a series of long low sounds, especially a long distance away from you
ex1_en: We could hear thunder rumbling in the distance.
ex1_zh: 我们听见远处雷声隆隆。
remmethod: rumbl(隆隆声) + e → 隆隆声；低沉地说

zh: 多汁的；利润多的；生动的
en: containing a lot of juice
ex1_en: a juicy lemon
ex1_zh: 多汁的柠檬
remmethod: juic(汁) + y(形容词后缀) → 多汁的

en: done deliberately and usually intended to cause harm
ex1_en: I did trip him, but it wasn’t intentional.
ex1_zh: 我的确把他绊倒了，但不是故意的。
remmethod: 来自intention (n. 意图， 目的)

en: (of animals, especially dogs) to make a low sound in the throat, usually as a sign of anger
ex1_en: The dog growled at me.
ex1_zh: 那狗冲着我低声吼叫。
remmethod: gr + owl(猫头鹰) → 猫头鹰叫 → 咆哮， 吼叫

zh: 纯净， 纯洁， 纯正
en: the quality or state of being pure
ex1_en: the purity of tap water
ex1_zh: 自来水的纯净度
remmethod: pur(干净的) + ity(名词后缀) → 纯度； 纯洁

en: to repeat a statement or opinion in order to make your meaning as clear as possible
ex1_en: Let me reiterate the most important points.
ex1_zh: 我来把最重要的几点重申一遍。
remmethod: re(反复) + iter (重申) + ate → 重申， 反复地说

en: having a strong rhythm
ex1_en: the rhythmic thud of the bass drum
ex1_zh: 低音鼓有节奏的咚咚声
remmethod: 来自rhythm(n. 节奏)

en: someone or something that protects one thing or person from being harmed by another
ex1_en: Keep savings as a buffer against unexpected cash needs.
ex1_zh: 备有存款来作为急需现金时的缓冲。
remmethod: 来自buff(v. 缓冲， 减震)

en: permanent
ex1_en: the perpetual snows of the mountaintops
ex1_zh: 山顶的终年积雪
remmethod: per(贯穿)+pet(追求)+ual→自始至终追求的→永久的， 永恒的

en: made to be used for a short time only when nothing better is available
ex1_en: The refugees slept in makeshift tents at the side of the road.
ex1_zh: 逃难者睡在路边临时搭建的帐篷里。
remmethod: make(做) + shift(替换) → 临时做来替换 → 权宜之计；凑合

zh: 隐藏处；树丛；蔽覆羽翮基部的羽毛
en: a group of thick bushes where animals can hide
ex1_en: covert operations
ex1_zh: 秘密行动
remmethod: cover(遮盖) + t → 盖住的 → 秘密的

en: one of several parts of someone’s character, a situation etc
ex1_en: The issues are complex and multi-faceted.
ex1_zh: 这些问题很复杂，涉及诸多方面。
remmethod: 实际 (fact) 方面 (facet)

en: to reduce the size of your army, navy etc, and the number of your weapons
ex1_en: Getting the rebels to disarm will not be easy.
ex1_zh: 要让叛乱分子解除武装并非易事。
remmethod: dis(除去) + arm(武器) → 除去某人的武器 → 使缴械

ex1_en: No slipper is allowed in the laboratory.
ex1_zh: 不应在实验室穿著拖鞋。
remmethod: 穿着拖鞋(slipper) 容易滑倒(slip)

en: when someone thinks or worries about something a lot, with the result that they do not pay attention to other things
ex1_en: Karouzos's poetry shows a profound preoccupation with the Orthodox Church.
ex1_zh: 卡鲁佐斯的诗歌表现出对东正教的深切关注。
remmethod: 来自preoccup(y)(vt. 使忧心忡忡)

en: a short test that a teacher gives to a class
ex1_en: a biology quiz
ex1_zh: 生物测验
remmethod: 他最终放弃(quit)了智力竞赛(quiz)

ex1_en: They are all perforated by openings of their own, but few line up, meaning passersby are faced with an assortment of opaque surfaces.
ex1_zh: 它们都是由自己的洞口穿孔，很少排列起来，意味着路人面对着各式各样的不透明表面。
remmethod: as(向) + sort(种类) + ment(名词后缀) → 分类；混合物

zh: 妨碍， 阻碍， 阻止
en: to make it difficult for someone or something to move forward or make progress
ex1_en: Storms at sea impeded our progress.
ex1_zh: 海上风暴阻碍了我们的航程。
remmethod: im(进入) + pede(脚) → 插足 → 妨碍

en: if a feeling, pain, sound etc subsides, it gradually becomes less and then stops
ex1_en: Simon waited until the laughter subsided.
ex1_zh: 西蒙一直等到笑声平息下来。
remmethod: sub(下面) + side(坐) → 坐下去 → 下陷

en: having very little food or money
ex1_en: a needy family
ex1_zh: 贫困家庭
remmethod: need(需要) + y(…的) → 什么都需要的 → 贫穷的

en: the industry that designs and builds aircraft and space vehicles
ex1_en: employment in the aerospace industry
ex1_zh: 航空航天工业的工作
remmethod: aero(空气) + space(太空) → 宇宙空间

en: to suggest a possible explanation that has not yet been proved to be true
ex1_en: To explain this, they hypothesize that galaxies must contain a great deal of missing matter which cannot be detected.
ex1_zh: 为了解释这一点，他们假定银河系一定包含了大量无法探测到的不明物质。
remmethod: hypo(在…下面) + thes(放) + ize → 放在下面， 还不作为正式的 → 假定， 假设

en: one of the coloured parts of a flower that are shaped like leaves
ex1_en: rose petals
ex1_zh: 玫瑰花瓣
remmethod: pet(追求) + al(名词后缀) → 追求阳光的部分 → 花瓣

en: a substance produced by your body to fight disease
ex1_en: Such women carry antibodies which make their blood more likely to clot during pregnancy.
ex1_zh: 这样的女性携带在孕期使她们的血液更可能凝结的抗体。
remmethod: anti(对抗的) + body(体) → 抗体

en: (of land or soil) not good enough for plants to grow on it
ex1_en: Thousands of years ago the surface was barren desert.
ex1_zh: 很久很久以前，地面还是一片荒漠。
remmethod: “巴人” → 巴山蜀水 → 贫瘠的， 荒芜的

en: a piece of metal fastened to a door, lid etc that allows it to swing open and shut
ex1_en: The top swung open on well-oiled hinges.
ex1_zh: 盖子在上好油的折叶上一下子弹开了。
remmethod: “很紧” → 铰链很紧， 转不动 → 铰链

en: relating to the sky or heaven
remmethod: cel(天空) + est + ial → 天体的

en: If you are at the forefront of a campaign or other activity, you have a leading and influential position in it
ex1_en: They have been at the forefront of the campaign for political change.
ex1_zh: 他们一直处于政治变革运动的前沿。
remmethod: fore(前面) + front(前面) → 前面的前面 → 最前沿

en: to hold your hands, teeth etc together tightly, usually because you feel angry or determined
ex1_en: Jody was pacing the sidelines, her fists clenched.
ex1_zh: 乔迪在球场的边线上紧握着拳头来回踱步。
remmethod: clench(自身词根) → 牢牢抓住；钉紧；敲弯的钉头

en: a list of the times at which buses, trains, planes etc arrive and leave
ex1_en: The timetable was hopelessly optimistic.
ex1_zh: 这个时间表过于乐观。
remmethod: time(时间) + table(表) → 时间表

en: ordinary and not interesting or exciting
ex1_en: Initially, the work was pretty mundane.
ex1_zh: 刚开始，这工作非常乏味。
remmethod: mund(世界) + ane → 现世的， 世俗的

en: sensible and careful, especially by trying to avoid unnecessary risks
ex1_en: prudent house buyers
ex1_zh: 谨慎的购房者
remmethod: 词根记忆: prud(小心) + ent → 小心算计 → 谨慎的

en: a unanimous decision, vote, agreement etc is one in which all the people involved agree
ex1_en: It was decided by a unanimous vote that the school should close.
ex1_zh: 关闭学校是大家一致通过的决定。
remmethod: un(看作uni， 一个) ＋ anim(生命， 精神) ＋ ous → 大家都是一种精神 → 全体一致的

en: in order to make sure that something will not happen
ex1_en: She turned away from the window lest anyone see them.
ex1_zh: 她转身离开窗边，免得有人看见他们。
remmethod: lest(自身词根) → 以免

en: a  pub  where you can also stay the night
ex1_en: Murphy’s Tavern
ex1_zh: 墨菲酒馆
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 酒馆

en: a large  evergreen  tree with leaves shaped like needles
ex1_en: The yacht is built of cedar strip planking.
ex1_zh: 这艘游艇用雪松木板材制成。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 雪松

en: to cut lines on a metal plate, piece of glass, stone etc to form a picture or words
ex1_en: A laser is used to etch a pattern in the smooth surface of the disc.
ex1_zh: 激光器用于在光盘的光滑表面刻录图案。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 蚀刻

en: something that continues or follows something else that has happened before, without a stop or change
ex1_en: It's the coalition forces who are to blame for the continuation of the war.
ex1_zh: 是联军应对战争的持续负责。
remmethod: 来自continue(v. 继续)

en: someone who has just started to do or learn something
ex1_en: an absolute beginner
ex1_zh: 不折不扣的初学者
remmethod: begin(开始) + (n)er(表人) → 开始的人 → 初学者；新手

en: a kind of corn that swells and bursts open when heated, and is usually eaten warm with salt or sugar as a  snack
ex1_en: Now, do you fancy some popcorn?
ex1_zh: 现在，你想来些爆米花吗？
remmethod: pop(流行的)+corn(玉米)→流行的玉米， 大家都爱吃→爆米花

en: to put dirty or oily marks on something
ex1_en: smeared windows
ex1_zh: 脏了的窗户
remmethod: 遭到诽谤(smear)， 发誓(swear)要报复

en: to murder an important person
ex1_en: a plot to assassinate the President
ex1_zh: 刺杀总统的阴谋
remmethod: 来自assassin (n. 暗杀者)

zh: 无价值的；不值钱的；卑微的
en: something that is worthless has no value, importance, or use
ex1_en: The house was full of worthless junk.
ex1_zh: 这房子里堆满了没有用的东西。
remmethod: worth(价值) + less(无；没有) → 无价值的

en: the ability to understand things and to think intelligently
ex1_en: He combined a formidable intellect with a talent for speaking.
ex1_zh: 他不但智力超群，而且口才出众。
remmethod: intel(在…之间) ＋ lect(选择) → 能在很多事物中做出选择的能力 → 智力
tremendous(巨大的；可怕的) + ly(副词后缀) → 非常地；惊人地

en: a sentence or phrase from a book, speech etc which you repeat in a speech or piece of writing because it is interesting or amusing
ex1_en: The following quotation is taken from a nineteenth century travel diary.
ex1_zh: 下文引自19世纪的一篇旅行日记。
remmethod: 来自quote(vt. 引用)

en: to fill something or someone with a particular feeling or quality
ex1_en: Many of the girls seemed to be infused with excitement on seeing the snow.
ex1_zh: 许多女孩子似乎一看到雪心里就充满了兴奋。
remmethod: in(进入) + fuse(流) → 流进去 → 灌输

zh: 搜索；用耙子耙；掠过，擦过
en: to move a rake across a surface in order to make the soil level, gather dead leaves etc
ex1_en: The searchlight raked the open ground around the prison.
ex1_zh: 探照灯在监狱周围的空地上来回扫射。
remmethod: rake(自身词根) → 耙子；斜度

en: if liquid trickles somewhere, it flows slowly in drops or in a thin stream
ex1_en: A tear trickled down the old man's cheek.
ex1_zh: 一滴泪水顺着老人的面颊流了下来。
remmethod: trick(滴) + le(反复) → 滴流

en: to fill something with air or gas so it becomes larger, or to become filled with air or gas
ex1_en: It took us half an hour to inflate the dinghy.
ex1_zh: 我们用了半小时给橡皮筏充好气。
remmethod: in(进入) + flate(气) → 让气进去 → 充气

en: a smooth red-brown nut that you can eat
ex1_en: roast chestnuts
ex1_zh: 炒栗子
remmethod: chest(胸部) + nut(坚果) → 栗子；栗树；栗色

zh: 多风的，有风的；腹胀的；吹牛的
en: if it is windy, there is a lot of wind
ex1_en: It’s too windy for a picnic.
ex1_zh: 风太大，不适合野餐。
remmethod: wind(风)+y(…的)→多风的

en: continuing or existing for a long time, or happening again and again
ex1_en: Lack of resources has been a perennial problem since the beginning.
ex1_zh: 财力不足从最初起就一直是个问题。
remmethod: per(全部) + enn(年) + ial → 全年的； 永久的

en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing. You can also say that two things overlap.
ex1_en: When the bag is folded, the bottom overlaps one side.
ex1_zh: 把包折叠起来时，其底部与一边就重合了。
remmethod: over(在…之上) + lap(大腿) → 把一条腿放在另一条腿上 → (使)部分重叠

en: the amount of time that someone or something lives
ex1_en: The ancient Chinese claimed that garlic promoted longevity.
ex1_zh: 中国古人说蒜能延寿。
remmethod: long(长的) + ev(时间) + ity → 活得时间长 → 长寿

en: to think about something for a long time
ex1_en: He mused on how different his life would have been, had he not met Louisa.
ex1_zh: 他默默地想，如果没有遇到路易莎，他的人生会有多么不同。
remmethod: 来自Muse(希腊神话中的缪斯女神)

en: the person who is guilty of a crime or doing something wrong
ex1_en: Police finally managed to catch the culprit.
ex1_zh: 警察终于抓住了罪犯。
remmethod: 犯罪(sin)的人被称为罪犯(culprit)

en: without enough money to pay what you owe
ex1_en: The firm went bankrupt before the building work was completed.
ex1_zh: 建筑工程尚未竣工，公司就破产了。
remmethod: bank(银行)+rupt(断裂)→在银行里的资金链断裂了→破产的

zh: 不规则, 异常的人或物
en: If something is an anomaly, it is different from what is usual or expected
ex1_en: The space shuttle had stopped transmitting data, a very serious anomaly for the mission.
ex1_zh: 这架航天飞机已经停止了传输数据，这是这次任务中一个十分严重的反常现象。
remmethod: a(不) + nomal(看作normal正常的) + y → 不正常 → 反常

ex1_en: Note that you must use the same variant of this option for all compiler runs related to the same project.
ex1_zh: 注意，对于所有运行的与同一个项目相关的编译器，必须使用这个选项的相同变体。
remmethod: vari(改变) + ant → 变体； 不同的

zh: 理智地, 与智力(或思维)有关地
remmethod: intel(在…之间) + lect(选择；读) + ual(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 在事物间辨别 → 理智地

en: too small or unimportant to consider or worry about
ex1_en: You realize that your problems are insignificant in comparison.
ex1_zh: 要知道，你的问题相对来说微不足道。
remmethod: in (无) + significant (有意义的， 重要的) → 无关紧要的， 无意义的

en: to go past a moving vehicle or person because you are going faster than them and want to get in front of them
ex1_en: He pulled out to overtake the van.
ex1_zh: 他把车驶出所在车道想超过那辆小货车。
remmethod: over ＋ take → 追上， 超过

en: a family relationship
ex1_en: the ties of kinship
ex1_zh: 亲属关系
remmethod: kin(亲属) + ship(表性质、 状态， 名词后缀) → 血缘关系， 亲属关系

en: to hide something in a secret place, especially weapons
ex1_en: a large arms cache
ex1_zh: 隐藏的大批武器
remmethod: c + ache (痛) → 将痛藏于心； 发音和cash (现金) 一样， 把现金藏起来

zh: 拉链；活力，精力；尖啸声，撕裂声；一种程序压缩的档案文件格式
en: two lines of small metal or plastic pieces that slide together to fasten a piece of clothing
ex1_en: The zip on my skirt had broken.
ex1_zh: 我裙子上的拉链坏了。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 拉链；活力

ex1_en: A second excavation, in 1985, lasted a year and was cut short for technical reasons.
ex1_zh: 第二次挖掘是在1985年，因为技术原因持续了一年就突然停止了。
remmethod: ex(出) + cav(洞) + ation → 从洞里挖出来 → 挖掘

zh: 代理；代用品；遗嘱检验法官
en: a person or thing that takes the place of someone or something else
ex1_en: Arms control should not be made into a surrogate for peace.
ex1_zh: 军备控制不应变成和平的替代物。
remmethod: sur (外) + rog (要求) + ate (使) → 要求将代理者排除在外 → 代理者

en: relating to the connection between two things, where one causes the other to happen or exist
ex1_en: Rawlins stresses that it is impossible to prove a causal link between the drug and the deaths.
ex1_zh: 罗林斯强调说证实毒品与死亡之间的因果关系是不可能的。
remmethod: 来自cause(n. 原因)

en: a tool for cutting paper, cloth etc, made of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle, with holes for your finger and thumb
ex1_en: a pair of scissors
ex1_zh: 一把剪刀
remmethod: sciss(分开)+ors→能把物品分开的东西→剪刀， 剪子

en: always wanting more food, money, power, possessions etc than you need

ex1_zh: 他向她保证会谨慎行事。
remmethod: 小心谨慎 (discreet) 地认出 (discern)

en: a small smooth stone found especially on a beach or on the bottom of a river
ex1_en: The beach was covered with smooth white pebbles.
ex1_zh: 海滩上布满了光滑的白色卵石。
remmethod: 和rubble(n. 瓦砾， 碎石)一起记

en: deliberately not obeying people in authority or rules of behaviour
ex1_en: rebellious teenagers
ex1_zh: 叛逆的青少年
remmethod: 来自rebell (反叛) + ious → 反叛的

en: a shelf that you keep books on, or a piece of furniture used for holding books
ex1_en: She dusted all the books on the bookshelf.
ex1_zh: 她把书架上所有书上的灰尘都掸干净。
remmethod: book(书) + shelf(架) → 书架

zh: 分歧的,分开的, 偏离的
en: Divergent things are different from each other
ex1_en: Two people who have divergent views on this question are George Watt and Bob Marr.
ex1_zh: 在这个问题上意见相左的两个人是乔治·瓦特和鲍勃·马尔。
remmethod: di(二) + verg(倾斜) + ent → 向两边倾斜的 → 发散的

ex1_en: He pushed open the front door, which swung inward with a groan.
ex1_zh: 他推开前门，门呀的一声向里开了。
remmethod: in(向内)+ward(表方向)→向内

en: to have an argument
ex1_en: I wish you two would stop quarreling.
ex1_zh: 我希望你们两个别再吵了。
remmethod: quarrel(争吵；抱怨) → 吵架；争论

en: a gas that you cannot see or smell, which can be burned to give heat
ex1_en: Methane is one of the principal gases contributing to the greenhouse effect.
ex1_zh: 甲烷是造成温室效应的主要气体之一。
remmethod: meth(与“酒；木精”相关) + ane(烷烃后缀) → 甲烷；沼气

en: something said or written that mentions a subject, person etc indirectly
ex1_en: This last point was understood to be an allusion to the long-standing hostility between the two leaders.
ex1_zh: 这最后一点曾被理解为对这两位领导人之间长久敌意的一种影射。
remmethod: 来自allude(v. 暗指， 间接提到)

zh: 时尚, 一时流行的狂热
en: something that people like or do for a short time, or that is fashionable for a short time
ex1_en: Interest in organic food is not a fad, it’s here to stay.
ex1_zh: 对有机食品的兴趣不是一时的风尚，它是长久的喜好。
remmethod: 和fade(v. 褪色)一起记

zh: 同种类的， 同性质的， 有相同特征的
en: Homogeneous is used to describe a group or thing which has members or parts that are all the same
ex1_en: The unemployed are not a homogeneous group.
ex1_zh: 失业者并不都是同一类人。
remmethod: homo(同类的) ＋ gene(基因) ＋ ous → 同种类的

en: if something repels you, it is so unpleasant that you do not want to be near it, or it makes you feel ill
ex1_en: The smell repelled him.
ex1_zh: 这气味让他反感。
remmethod: re(向后) + pel(推) → 向后推 → 击退； 排斥

en: to accept or forgive behaviour that most people think is morally wrong
ex1_en: I cannot condone the use of violence under any circumstances.
ex1_zh: 我不能原谅在任何情况下使用暴力。
remmethod: con(完全) + don(给予) + e → 完全给予 → 宽恕， 赦免

en: violent, dangerous, and frightening
ex1_en: a ferocious, hungry lion
ex1_zh: 一头凶猛的饿狮
remmethod: feroc (凶猛) + ious → 凶猛的

en: to improve a building or area so that it returns to the good condition it was in before
ex1_en: A lot of the older houses have now been rehabilitated.
ex1_zh: 很多老房子现在都进行了修葺。
remmethod: re(再， 又) + hab(拥有) + ilit + ate → 重新拥有 → 使恢复原状， 修复

en: someone whose job is to receive or pay out money in a shop
ex1_en: Do you have any experience as a cashier?
ex1_zh: 你是否有出纳员的工作经验？
remmethod: cash(现金) + ier(表人) → 管现金的人 → 出纳员

en: a natural ability to do something very well
ex1_en: Jo has a flair for languages.
ex1_zh: 乔有语言天赋。
remmethod: 和fair(adj. 公正的； 美丽的)一起记

en: a bright shine on a surface
ex1_en: This gel will add gloss to even the dullest hair.
ex1_zh: 用了这种发胶，即使最干枯的头发也会增添光泽。
remmethod: 可能来自glow(v. 闪光)； 注意不要和gross(a. 总的， 粗略的) 相混

en: relating to or caused by  earthquakes
ex1_en: increased seismic activity
ex1_zh: 越来越频繁的地震活动
remmethod: seism(震动) + ic → 地震的， 地震引起的

en: a number that is too large to be calculated
ex1_en: In the equation below, as E goes to zero, n approaches infinity.
ex1_zh: 在下面的方程式中，E趋向于零时，n接近无穷大。
remmethod: in(不) + fin(界限) + ity(名词后缀) → 无限

en: not true or real, although someone is trying to make you think it is
ex1_en: bogus insurance claims
ex1_zh: 虚报的保险索赔
remmethod: 来自一种叫“Bogus”的机器， 用于制造伪钞

ex1_en: The next day, we drove inland.
ex1_zh: 第二天，我们乘车开往内陆。
remmethod: in(里面) + land(陆地) → 在里面的陆地 → 内陆

en: a woman who is frigid does not like having sex
ex1_en: The guard looked at us with a frigid stare.
ex1_zh: 守卫冷冷地盯着我们。
remmethod: 这么冷的 (frigid) 天， 水果 (fruit) 都冻坏了

en: a greater distance, or beyond a particular place
ex1_en: They walked a little further.
ex1_zh: 他们又往前走了一点。
remmethod: fur(向前；更远) + ther(比较级后缀) → 更远的；更进一步地

zh: 旅程，路线； 旅行日程
en: An itinerary is a plan of a trip, including the route and the places that you will visit
ex1_en: The next place on our itinerary was Sedona.
ex1_zh: 我们旅行计划的下一站是塞多纳。
remmethod: it(走) + iner(里面) + ary(名词后缀) → 在里面走 → 路线

en: demanding firmly and repeatedly that something should happen
ex1_en: She was insistent that they should all meet for dinner.
ex1_zh: 她坚持要大家聚在一起吃晚餐。
remmethod: insist(坚持) + ent(形容词后缀) → 坚持的

en: using money, time, goods etc carefully and without wasting any
ex1_en: A small car is more economical to run.
ex1_zh: 开小型汽车比较省油。
remmethod: eco(家) + nom(管理) + ical → 管理家庭开支的 → 节俭的， 节约的

zh: 坚定不移的， 坚决的； 固执的
en: determined not to change your opinion or a decision that you have made
ex1_en: She begged me to change my mind, but I remained adamant .
ex1_zh: 她求我改变主意，但我坚决不肯。
remmethod: adam(亚当) + ant(蚂蚁) → 亚当和蚂蚁都很固执 → 固执的

en: if a liquid gushes, it flows or pours out quickly and in large quantities
ex1_en: Piping-hot water gushed out.
ex1_zh: 滚烫的水涌了出来。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根，拟声) → 涌出

zh: 泛滥成灾 v超过, 泛滥

ex1_en: cost overruns of £2 billion
ex1_zh: 20亿英镑的超额费用
remmethod: 来自词组run over(泛滥)

ex1_zh: 这个国家拥有煤炭、铁矿石、石灰石、菱镁矿、石墨、铜、锌、铅和贵金属等矿脉。
remmethod: graph(写； 图) + ite → 用来写字、 画画的东西 → 石墨

en: the act of forcing someone to leave a place
ex1_en: The headmaster threatened the boys with expulsion.
ex1_zh: 校长警告这几名男生说要开除他们。
remmethod: ex(出) + puls(推) + ion → 推出去 → 驱逐

en: a temporary wall or fence across a road, door etc that prevents people from going through
ex1_en: The fans were kept back behind barricades.
ex1_zh: 歌迷们被拦在路障后面。

ex1_zh: 生态学家们认为用消毒剂处理污水的好处是值得怀疑的。
remmethod: eco(生态；家) + log(学科) + ist(表人) → 生态学者

en: an area of low wet muddy ground, sometimes containing bushes or grasses

ex1_zh: 你的车会陷进泥沼的。

ex1_en: He was engaged in subversive activities .
ex1_zh: 他参与了颠覆活动。

ex1_zh: 公司从他的补偿金中扣除了这笔款项。

ex1_en: The storm caused landslides and flooding in Savona.
ex1_zh: 暴风雨引发了萨沃纳的山崩和水灾。

ex1_zh: 贝克抗辩说他的审判受到了负面宣传的影响。

ex1_zh: 她吃惊地看着他。

en: not having courage or confidence

ex1_zh: 毒瘾在我们家依然是个有些忌讳的话题。

en: a formal meeting in which people who know a lot about a particular subject have discussions about it

en: to sleep lightly for a short time
ex1_en: Grandad was dozing in his chair.
ex1_zh: 爷爷在椅子上打瞌睡。

en: something that you do to achieve something or deal with a situation, or the act of doing it

en: the part of a nut or seed inside the shell, or the part inside the stone of some fruits

en: a situation in which you have a lot of problems that seem to be caused by bad luck

en: a smooth way of moving that looks natural, relaxed, and attractive

en: a quality or an idea that a word makes you think of that is more than its basic meaning

en: a stream or river that flows into a larger river

ex1_zh: 该政府被指责政务不公开、缺乏民主。

ex1_zh: 对跑车的酷爱

en: the study of the rocks, soil etc that make up the Earth, and of the way they have changed since the Earth was formed

ex1_zh: 他曾是佐治亚大学的地质学客座教授。
remmethod: geo(地) ＋ logy(学科) → 地质学

remmethod: 从月亮(moon)那得到恩惠(boon)

ex1_zh: 生活对我来说简直没什么意义。

ex1_zh: 你能不能帮我把这条裙子改长？

ex1_zh: 卢克坐在飞行员的正后方和他交谈。

ex1_zh: 一位叔叔慷慨解囊，出钱供她上音乐课。
remmethod: bene(好) + vol(意志) + ent → 好意的 → 善心的， 仁心的

en: a piece of information or story that someone has invented in order to deceive people

remmethod: fabric(制作) + ation(名词后缀) → 制作；捏造

en: not afraid of anything

ex1_zh: 他们没有对来宫殿的游客作一个记录，不过这个地方非常受欢迎的。

en: a small steep  waterfall  that is one of several together

ex1_zh: 烟火散开像一片五彩缤纷的瀑布。

en: for as long as it is possible to know what is likely to happen

ex1_zh: 这种局面在可预见的将来可能还会持续下去。

en: careful to do everything that it is your job or duty to do

ex1_zh: 恐龙热兴起于19世纪晚期。
remmethod: man(狂热) + ia(表病， 名词后缀) → 躁狂； 狂热

en: if a very bright light dazzles you, it stops you from seeing properly for a short time
ex1_en: a deer dazzled by the headlights
ex1_zh: 被车头灯光照得目眩的鹿
remmethod: 爵士乐(jazz)使人倾倒(dazzle)

en: if a price or an amount skyrockets, it greatly increases very quickly
ex1_en: The trade deficit has skyrocketed.
ex1_zh: 贸易逆差已经急剧增长。
remmethod: sky(天空) ＋ rocket(火箭) → 火箭冲向天空， 突然升高 → 突升

en: to praise someone or something publicly
ex1_en: His work was acclaimed by art critics.
ex1_zh: 他的作品得到艺术评论家的推崇。
remmethod: ac (加强) + claim (大叫) → 大声叫 → 欢呼

en: words and expressions used in a particular profession or by a particular group of people, which are difficult for other people to understand – often used to show disapproval
ex1_en: Keep it simple and avoid the use of jargon.
ex1_zh: 简单点，避免使用术语。
remmethod: jar(大罐) + go(走) + (o)n(在…上) → “大罐走在上面” 这句话很像一句暗语 → 术语， 行话

zh: 平息， 抚慰； 姑息
en: to make someone less angry or stop them from attacking you by giving them what they want
ex1_en: They attempted to appease international opposition by promising to hold talks.
ex1_zh: 他们答应举行会谈，试图以此平息国际上的反对声音。
remmethod: ap(表加强) ＋ pease(看作peace， 和平) → 使和平 → 平息， 抚慰

en: happening or done for no good reason or with no purpose
ex1_en: Her death seemed such a senseless waste of life.
ex1_zh: 她的死真是无谓地浪费生命。
remmethod: sense(感觉；意义) + less(无) → 无意义的；愚蠢的

en: one of the long thin parts of a sea creature such as an  octopus  which it uses for holding things
ex1_en: Free speech is being gradually eroded year after year by new tentacles of government control.
ex1_zh: 言论自由正被政府控制的新触角逐渐侵蚀。
remmethod: tent(感觉) + acle(表物， 名词后缀) → 用于感知的东西 → 触角

en: a state in which you behave as if you were asleep but are still able to hear and understand what is said to you
ex1_en: The old man was in a trance, thinking of his past life.
ex1_zh: 这位老人回想着自己过去的生活， 神情恍惚。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 恍惚；出神

en: the state of not being known or remembered
ex1_en: Now, on the eve of the bicentenary of the independence movements, he sets out to rescue San Martín from his relative obscurity.
ex1_zh: 今天，在那场独立运动二百周年纪念前夕，他再度出手以挽救相对默默无闻的圣·马丁。
remmethod: 来自obscure(a. 朦胧的， 模糊的)

en: when a country or place develops a lot of industry
ex1_en: And, at this point, traces of industrialization can only be found in sediments in Europe.
ex1_zh: 而在这一点上，工业化的痕迹只在欧洲的沉积物中找到。
remmethod: 来自industrialize(v. 使工业化)

en: involving a lot of strength and effort
remmethod: ard(高的) + uous(多…的) → 很高的， 难以攀登的 → 费力的， 艰巨的

en: in a way that protects something from being stolen or lost
ex1_en: Customers can now buy products securely over the Internet.
ex1_zh: 如今顾客可以安全放心地在网上购物了。
remmethod: secure(安全的) + ly(副词后缀) → 安全地；无疑地

en: wood that has been cut or collected in order to be burned in a fire
ex1_en: Young Geoffrey made money by chopping and selling firewood.
ex1_zh: 年轻的杰弗里靠砍柴卖柴挣钱。
remmethod: fire(火) + wood(木) → 烧火用的木头 → 柴火；木柴

en: the practice of teaching or the study of teaching
ex1_en: I’ve learned as much about teaching from learning about marketing as I have from studying pedagogy – maybe more.
ex1_zh: 我从销售上学到的有关教育的东西和我研究教育学时候学到的一样多——可能更多。
remmethod: ped(儿童) ＋ agog(引导) ＋ y → 引导儿童之学 → 教育学

zh: 温和的,适度的,有节制的
en: behaviour that is temperate is calm and sensible
ex1_en: The Nile Valley keeps a temperate climate throughout the year.
ex1_zh: 尼罗河流域全年气候温和。
remmethod: temper(节制) + ate → 有节制的 → 温和的

en: likely to make you healthy
ex1_en: healthful mountain air
ex1_zh: 有利于健康的山区空气
remmethod: health(健康) + ful(充满…的) → 有益健康的

en: when you do something very quietly, slowly or secretly, so that no one notices you
ex1_en: Cats rely on stealth to catch their prey.
ex1_zh: 猫科动物靠偷袭捕捉猎物。
remmethod: 来自steal(v. 偷)

en: An aberration is an incident or way of behaving that is not typical
ex1_en: It became very clear that the incident was not just an aberration; it was not just a single incident.
ex1_zh: 已经很明确这次事件并不仅仅是一次失常，也不只是一个单独的事件。
remmethod: ab + err(错误) + ation → 错误的行为 → 越轨

en: Something that is ornamental is attractive and decorative
ex1_en: ornamental gardens
ex1_zh: 装饰性花园
remmethod: 来自ornament (v. / n. 装饰， 修饰)

en: a tree that grows in nor-thern countries and has short leaves shaped like needles
ex1_en: Trees such as spruce, pine, and oak have been planted.
ex1_zh: 像云杉、松树和橡树之类的树已经种了。
remmethod: spruce(整洁的；云杉) → 整洁的；云杉

zh: 成为…的缩影； 摘要， 概括， 缩写
ex1_en: This building epitomizes the spirit of the nineteenth century.
ex1_zh: 这栋建筑体现了19世纪的时代精神。
remmethod: epi(在…后) + tom(看作tome， 一卷书) + ize → 写在一卷书后面的话 → 概括

zh: 基础， 根基； 基岩
en: the basic ideas, features, or facts on which something is based
ex1_en: Marriage and children are the bedrock of family life.
ex1_zh: 婚姻和子女是家庭生活的基础。
remmethod: bed(底) + rock(岩石) → 基岩；基础，根基

en: the large flat areas of land in the north of Russia, Canada etc, where it is very cold and there are no trees
ex1_en: Frozen dog dirt stipples the tundra of the golf course.
ex1_zh: 冻成冰块的狗屎点缀着高尔夫球场的苔原。
remmethod: t + undra(看做under， 在…之下) → 在冰雪覆盖之下 → 冻土地带

en: a continuous attack on a place by big guns and bombs
ex1_en: The bombardment continued for a terrible nine hours.
ex1_zh: 轰炸可怕地持续了九个小时。
remmethod: bombard(炮击) + ment(名词后缀) → 炮击；轰击

zh: [地质] 海侵；犯罪；违反；逸出
remmethod: 来自transgress(v. 越轨； 违背)

en: to shine with a light that is not very bright
ex1_en: a weak glimmering light
ex1_zh: 微弱的闪光
remmethod: 闪光 (glimmer) 很耀眼 (glitter)

en: showing that something is definitely true
ex1_en: Her attorneys claim there is no conclusive evidence that any murders took place.
ex1_zh: 她的律师们声称没有任何发生过谋杀的确凿证据。
remmethod: 来自conclude(v. 结束)

en: a terrible and unexpected event that causes a lot of damage or suffering
ex1_en: It will be a calamity for farmers if the crops fail again.
ex1_zh: 如果再次歉收，将会给农民带来灾难。
remmethod: calam(=destruction破坏) + ity → 大灾祸

en: extremely thorough and complete
ex1_en: an exhaustive investigation
ex1_zh: 彻底的调查
remmethod: 听完教授详尽的 (exhaustive) 论述后， 他筋疲力尽 (exhausted)

en: a tower with a powerful flashing light that guides ships away from danger
ex1_en: Hundreds of moths flew against the lighthouse windows.
ex1_zh: 数以千计的飞蛾扑向灯塔的窗子。
remmethod: light(光) + house(房屋) → 灯塔

en: the impressive and attractive quality that sth has
ex1_en: the sheer majesty of St Peter's in Rome
ex1_zh: 罗马圣彼得大教堂的雄伟庄严
remmethod: maj(看作major， 较多的) ＋ est(存在) ＋ y → 现存的大多数皇宫都很雄伟 → 雄伟

en: A cyclical process is one in which a series of events happens again and again in the same order
remmethod: 来自cycle(n. 循环)

en: relating to something that has just been mentioned
ex1_en: States differ in standards for products and the labelling thereof.
ex1_zh: 各州的产品标准不同，标签的标注也不同。
remmethod: there(那里) + of(的) → 它的；由此

en: arranged together in a pleasing way so that each part goes well with the others
ex1_en: The decor is a harmonious blend of traditional and modern.
ex1_zh: 这种装饰风格是传统与现代的和谐统一。
remmethod: 不损害 (harm) 公共利益是和谐 (harmonious) 社会的表现

en: a piece of equipment consisting of two or more blades that spin around, which makes an aircraft or ship move
remmethod: 来自propel(v. 推进， 驱使)

en: a piece of furniture with shelves to hold books
ex1_en: I have a bookcase in the room.
ex1_zh: 我有一个书架在房间里。
remmethod: book(书)+case(容器)→装书的容器→书柜， 书架

en: greater than what seems reasonable or appropriate
ex1_en: excessively high prices
ex1_zh: 过高的价格
remmethod: ex(超出) + cess(走) + ive(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 走出界限地 → 过分地；过度地

en: a sudden short period when someone, especially a child, behaves very angrily and unreasonably
ex1_en: children’s temper tantrums
ex1_zh: 小孩子的脾气发作
remmethod: “太蠢” → 大庭广众之下发脾气， 真是蠢 → 发脾气， 发怒

en: a written statement by a political party, saying what they believe in and what they intend to do
ex1_en: the Labour Party’s election manifesto
ex1_zh: 工党的竞选宣言
remmethod: 来自manifest(vt. 表明)

en: high up in the air
ex1_en: But in the stratosphere they can stay aloft for years, spread by fast winds known as jets, meaning the threat is global.
ex1_zh: 但在平流层，它们可以在高处停留数年，高速的风对其进行传播，这意味着全球都受到了威胁。
remmethod: a + loft(阁楼) → 空中楼阁 → 在空中

en: to surprise someone very much
ex1_en: Her reply astonished me.
ex1_zh: 她的回答让我大吃一惊。
remmethod: a(一个) ＋ ston(看作stone， 石头) ＋ ish(使…) → 一石激起千层浪， 怎不叫人惊讶 → 使惊讶

en: irreversible damage, change etc is so serious or so great that you cannot change something back to how it was before
ex1_en: Fossil fuels have caused irreversible damage to the environment.
ex1_zh: 矿物燃料已对环境造成了不可挽回的破坏。
remmethod: ir(不) + reversible(可改变的) → 不可改变的

en: someone who carried messages from a ruler in the past
ex1_en: a bowl of daffodils, the first bright heralds of spring
ex1_zh: 一盆水仙花，春天的第一个鲜明的预兆
remmethod: her(她) + ald(看作old， 老的) → 她带来老人的告诫 → 信使

zh: 平静的， 安静的； 温和的， 文静的
en: a placid person does not often get angry or upset and does not usually mind doing what other people want them to
ex1_en: a large, placid baby
ex1_zh: 一个胖胖的、安静的婴儿
remmethod: plac(平静的) + id → 平静的， 安静的

en: something that does not happen at regular intervals
ex1_en: a slight irregularity in his heartbeat
ex1_zh: 他略微的心律不齐
remmethod: ir(不) + regular(规则的) + ity(名词) → 不规则
west(西) + ward(朝向) → 向西的；向西

zh: 孔，穴；（照相机，望远镜等的）光圈，孔径；缝隙
en: a small hole or space in something
ex1_en: Through the aperture he could see daylight.
ex1_zh: 通过这个孔隙他能看到日光。
remmethod: aper ( = open， 开) + ture → 开个口 → 孔

en: to not do or have something pleasant or enjoyable
ex1_en: I had to forgo lunch.
ex1_zh: 我只得放弃午餐。
remmethod: for(往， 向) + go(走) → 走向他处， 放弃了目前所在地 → 放弃

ex1_en: I think everyone has something from their past that they're worried might adversely affect how they raise their children.
ex1_zh: 我想每个人都会担心自己过去的某些事可能会对他们如何培养孩子产生不利的影响。
remmethod: ad(向) + vers(转) + e + ly(副词后缀) → 转向不利地 → 不利地

en: an infectious disease that is like a very bad cold
ex1_en: All the medical workers in the region helped to put down the influenza epidemic.
ex1_zh: 这个地区的所有医务工作者参加了消灭流行性感冒的工作。
remmethod: 记住它的简写形式flu

zh: 撤销， 撤回； 取消， 废除
en: to officially state that a law, decision, or agreement is no longer effective
ex1_en: Their work permits have been revoked.
ex1_zh: 他们的工作许可证被吊销了。
remmethod: re(回) + vok(呼喊) + e → 叫回 → 撤销， 撤回

zh: 山顶， 顶峰； 鼎盛时期； 小尖塔
en: the most successful, powerful, exciting etc part of something
ex1_en: the pinnacle of academic achievement
ex1_zh: 学术成就的顶峰
remmethod: pinna(顶点) + cle → 山顶， 顶峰

en: to bring sb/sth under control, especially by using force
ex1_en: Senior government officials admit they have not been able to subdue the rebels.
ex1_zh: 高级政府官员们承认他们还没能制服反叛者们。
remmethod: sub(在下面) + due(＝duce引导) → 引到下面 → 征服

en: turning in a circle around a fixed point, like a wheel
ex1_en: the rotary movement of the helicopter blades
ex1_zh: 直升机螺旋桨叶的转动
remmethod: rot(腐烂) ＋ ary → 流水不腐， 户枢不蠹 → 转动的

en: a long metal stick with a weight at the bottom that swings regularly from side to side to control the working of a clock
ex1_en: The political pendulum has swung in favour of the liberals.
ex1_zh: 政治的钟摆已经摆向了自由派。
remmethod: pend(悬挂) ＋ ulum → 钟摆

en: erroneous ideas or information are wrong and based on facts that are not correct
ex1_en: His economic predictions are based on some erroneous assumptions.
ex1_zh: 他的经济预测是基于错误假设之上的。
remmethod: 来自error(n. 错误)

en: to make something more beautiful by adding decorations to it
ex1_en: The boat was embellished with carvings in red and blue.
ex1_zh: 这艘船饰有红、蓝雕刻。
remmethod: em(使…) + bell(美丽的) + ish → 使变美丽 → 装饰； 渲染

zh: 第十二的，第十二个的；十二分之一的
ex1_en: He poled his twelfth home run in the sixth inning.
ex1_zh: 在第六回合他打出了他的第十二次本垒打。
remmethod: twelf(十二) + th(第…；…分之一) → 第十二的；十二分之一

ex1_en: During dry place, keep within the new air circulation, avoid rain and insolate, also can use some detergent to remove odor.
ex1_zh: 在晾置期间，要保持新居内空气的流通，避免雨淋及曝晒，还可采用一些去除气味的清洁剂。
remmethod: de(去掉) + terg(擦) + ent → 擦掉(脏)东西 → 清洁的

zh: 令人高兴的， 使人兴奋的
en: making you feel happy, excited, and full of energy
ex1_en: an exhilarating experience
ex1_zh: 刺激的经历
remmethod: 来自exhilarate(vt. 使高兴， 使愉快)； ex(表加强) + hilar(欢快的) + ate(使…) → 使非常欢快 → 使高兴， 使愉快

en: to keep biting something hard
ex1_en: Dexter gnawed his pen thoughtfully.
ex1_zh: 德克斯特若有所思地咬着钢笔。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 咬；啃；折磨

zh: 过度的，过分的；不适当的；未到期的
en: more than is reasonable, suitable, or necessary
ex1_en: De Gaulle felt that America had undue influence in Europe.
ex1_zh: 戴高乐感到美国在欧洲影响力过大。
remmethod: un(表否定) + due(适当的) → 不适当的

en: An atheist is a person who believes that there is no God. Compare .
ex1_en: I was an atheist at the time.
ex1_zh: 那个时候我是一个无神论者。
remmethod: a(无) + the(神) + ist(表人) → 无神论者

zh: 腾出, 空出,离(职),退(位)
en: to leave a job or position so that it is available for someone else to do
ex1_en: Clay will vacate the position on June 19.
ex1_zh: 克莱将于6月19日离职。
remmethod: vac(空的) + ate → 腾出， 空出

en: a sudden feeling of fear
ex1_en: You gave me such a fright creeping up on me like that!
ex1_zh: 你这样不声不响地过来，吓了我一跳！
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 惊吓；惊骇

en: to hate someone or something very much
ex1_en: He loathes their politics.
ex1_zh: 他讨厌他们那一套政治。
remmethod: l (看作leave) + oath (誓言) + e → 违背誓言， 终遭憎恶 → 厌恶， 憎恶

zh: 激怒， 刺激； 挑衅， 挑拨
en: an action or event that makes someone angry or upset, or is intended to do this
ex1_en: He was accused of deliberate provocation .
ex1_zh: 他被指责故意挑衅。
remmethod: 来自provoke(vt. 激怒)

en: all the animals living in a particular area or period in history
remmethod: 来自Faunus(潘纳斯， 罗马神话中的动物之神)

zh: 鞘， 外壳； 套； 护皮； 紧身连衣裙
en: a cover for the blade of a knife or sword
ex1_en: His sword was back in its sheath.
ex1_zh: 他的剑插回了剑鞘。
remmethod: sheath(套；鞘) → 鞘；护套

en: the meat of a calf(= a young cow )
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 小牛肉

zh: 钱袋， 皮夹； 财政状况， 财力
en: the amount of money that you have, or your ability to pay for things
ex1_en: The aim was to provide a car for every age and pocketbook .
ex1_zh: 目标是为每个年龄层和收入层的人士提供汽车。
remmethod: pocket(口袋) + book(书) → 钱袋，皮夹

en: the front part of a woman’s chest
ex1_en: She cradled the child to her bosom.
ex1_zh: 她把那孩子抱入怀中。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 胸；胸怀；内心

en: to lose a right, position, possession etc or have it taken away from you because you have broken a law or rule
ex1_en: By being absent from the trial, he forfeited the right to appeal.
ex1_zh: 因缺席审判，他丧失了上诉权。
remmethod: for(因为) + feit(看作词根fect， 做) → 因为做错事， 所以被处罚 → 罚款

en: a momentous event, change, or decision is very important because it will have a great influence on the future
ex1_en: a momentous decision
ex1_zh: 重大决定
remmethod: moment(瞬间) + ous(形容词后缀) → 瞬间就能产生影响的 → 重大的

ex1_en: A micrometer is one thousandth of one millimeter.
ex1_zh: 一微米是一毫米的千分之一。
remmethod: milli(毫， 千分之一)+metre(米)→毫米

en: to explode or to make something explode
ex1_en: France is expected to detonate its first nuclear device in the next few days.
ex1_zh: 预计法国将在未来几天内引爆它的第一个核装置。
remmethod: de + ton(声音， 雷声) + ate → 雷声四散 → (使)爆炸

en: to attract someone very much, and hold their attention
ex1_en: I was captivated by her brilliant mind.
ex1_zh: 我为她的聪慧所迷。
remmethod: captiv(e)(俘虏) + ate → 使成为漂亮的俘虔来迷惑敌人 → 迷惑

en: an intelligent African animal that is like a large monkey without a tail
ex1_en: So when you go from head to toe, you're seeing a mosaic creature that is neither chimpanzee, nor is it human.
ex1_zh: 所以从头到脚，让人看到的是一个在黑猩猩和人类之间模棱两可的生物，这就是始祖地人猿。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 黑猩猩

zh: 紧张的；费力的；奋发的；艰苦的；热烈的
en: needing a lot of effort or strength
ex1_en: a strenuous climb
ex1_zh: 艰难的攀登
remmethod: stren(看作strength， 力量)+uous→用力量的→费力的
ap+pall (看作pale， 苍白的)→吓得脸煞白→使惊骇

en: to prove the truth of something that someone has said, claimed etc
ex1_en: Katzen offered little evidence to substantiate his claims .
ex1_zh: 卡曾拿不出什么证据来证明他的说法。
remmethod: 来自substant (事实； 物质) + iate → 用事实来证明 → 证实
