zh: 制止， 镇压； 缓解， 减轻
en: to end a situation in which people are behaving violently or protesting, especially by using force
ex1_en: ‘Jerry?’ she called, trying to quell the panic inside her.
ex1_zh: “杰里？”她叫道，试图减轻内心的惊慌。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 镇压

en: difficult or impossible to reach
ex1_en: In winter, the villages are inaccessible by road.
ex1_zh: 冬天时，进入这些村子的路很难走。
remmethod: in(不) + accessible(易达到的) → 难达到的， 不可及的

en: to make someone very angry
ex1_en: Many readers were enraged by his article.
ex1_zh: 许多读者被他的文章激怒了。
remmethod: en(进入) + rage(狂怒) → 进入狂怒 → 激怒

en: a place to stay
ex1_en: It’s £90 a week for board and lodging (= meals and a room ).
ex1_zh: 食宿费每周90英镑。
remmethod: lodg(寄宿) + ing(名词后缀) → 寄宿；住所

en: the force that keeps an object in the same position or keeps it moving until it is moved or stopped by another force
ex1_en: Inertia carried the plane onto the ground.
ex1_zh: 飞机靠惯性着陆。
remmethod: 来自inert(a. 惰性的)， in(不) + ert(动) → 静止的 → 惰性的

zh: 过剩的；失业的，被解雇的
en: if you are redundant, your employer no longer has a job for you
ex1_en: Seventy factory workers were made redundant in the resulting cuts.
ex1_zh: 在继而发生的裁员中，70名工厂工人被解雇。
remmethod: red(=re再， 又) + und(波动) + ant(形容词后缀) → 反复波动， 反复出现 → 多余的

en: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place, often secretly
ex1_en: plans for a secret rendezvous
ex1_zh: 秘密约会的计划
remmethod: rendez(呈现) + vous(你们) → 使你们到场 → 集合点

zh: 打着折扣说,有意轻描淡写
ex1_en: The press have tended to understate the extent of the problem.
ex1_zh: 媒体想淡化问题的严重程度。
remmethod: under (不够) + state (说话) → 话有意说的不多 → 有意轻描淡写

en: a long narrow weapon that is fired under the surface of the sea and explodes when it hits something
ex1_en: His ship was blown up by a torpedo.
ex1_zh: 他的船被一枚鱼雷炸毁了。
remmethod: torpedo(自身词根) → 鱼雷；水雷

en: a magazine, especially one about a serious or technical subject
ex1_en: The walls would be lined with books and periodicals.
ex1_zh: 沿这几面墙将排放书籍和期刊。
remmethod: 来自periodic (a. 周期的)

en: if something, especially something bad or unpleasant, recurs, it happens again
ex1_en: There is a danger that the disease may recur.
ex1_zh: 这种病有复发的危险。
remmethod: re(重新)+cur(进行)→再发生， 重现

zh: 毛皮的， 盖着毛皮的
en: covered with fur or short threads
ex1_en: furry kittens
ex1_zh: 毛茸茸的小猫
remmethod: furr(毛皮) + y(形容词后缀) → 毛皮的

en: too unusual or strange to be explained or understood
ex1_en: inexplicable behaviour
ex1_zh: 费解的行为
remmethod: in (不) + explicable (可以解释的) → 无法解释的 → 无法说明的

zh: 懒散的； 不严格的， 马虎的
en: not strict or careful enough about standards of behaviour, work, safety etc
ex1_en: One of the problem areas is lax security for airport personnel.
ex1_zh: 其中一个问题是对机场人员的安全措施不严格。
remmethod: 本身为词根， 意为“松的”

zh: 艰难地进行， 费力地做
ex1_en: a life of toil
ex1_zh: 辛劳的一生
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 辛苦；苦工；罗网

en: to treat a group of people unfairly or cruelly, and prevent them from having the same rights that other people in society have
ex1_en: native tribes oppressed by the authorities
ex1_zh: 受到当局压迫的土著部落
remmethod: op(向) + press(压) → 压下去 → 压迫

en: a short book that gives information or instructions about something
ex1_en: the Fiction Writer’s Handbook
ex1_zh: 《小说写作手册》
remmethod: hand(手) + book(书) → 手册

en: to cover an area with a large amount of water
ex1_en: The tidal wave inundated vast areas of cropland.
ex1_zh: 海啸淹没了大片农田。
remmethod: in(进入) + und(波浪) + ate → 卷入波浪 → 淹没， 泛滥

en: if someone represses upsetting feelings, memories etc, they do not allow themselves to express or think about them
ex1_en: He had long ago repressed the painful memories of his childhood.
ex1_zh: 他长久压抑着儿时的痛苦记忆。
remmethod: re(向后) + press(压) → 向后压 → 克制； 镇压

en: money paid by a defeated country after a war, for all the deaths, damage etc it has caused
ex1_en: The government agreed to pay reparations to victims.
ex1_zh: 政府同意向受害者支付赔款。
remmethod: repara (看作repair，  修理) + tion (表示名词) → 修理

zh: 辛辣的；刺激性的；刺鼻的；苦痛的；尖刻的
en: having a strong taste or smell
ex1_en: He expressed some fairly pungent criticisms.
ex1_zh: 他提出了一针见血的批评。
remmethod: pung(刺) ＋ ent → 尖锐的， 尖刻的

en: to suggest that something might have happened or be true
ex1_en: He dismissed arguments postulating differing standards for human rights in different cultures and regions.
ex1_zh: 他无法接受的是假定人权标准在不同文化和地区有所不同。
remmethod: post(放) + ul + ate → 放出问题 → 假定， 假设

en: saying things that are the opposite of what you mean, in order to make an unkind joke or to show that you are annoyed
ex1_en: Was she being sarcastic?
ex1_zh: 她是在嘲讽吗？
remmethod: sarc(肉) + astic(形容词后缀) → 讽刺的

ex1_en: Every transistor has at least three electrodes.
ex1_zh: 每个晶体管至少有三个电极。
remmethod: trans(变换) ＋ ist ＋ or(表人或物) → 晶体管将信号变换为图像或声音 → 晶体管

en: a series of three plays, books etc that are about the same people or subject
ex1_en: part 2 of a trilogy
ex1_zh: 三部曲的第二部
remmethod: tri(三) + logy(说话， 作品) → 三部曲

zh: 全景,全景画,全景摄影,全景照片[装置]
en: an impressive view of a wide area of land
ex1_en: Horton looked out over a panorama of fertile valleys and gentle hills.
ex1_zh: 霍顿眺望着那一片肥沃山谷和平缓山脉的景象。
remmethod: pan(全部)+orama(看)→全部看得到→全景

ex1_en: The rumours will do untold damage to his reputation.
ex1_zh: 这些谣言会给他的名声造成无法估计的损害。
remmethod: un(未) + told(讲述) → 数不清的，无数的

en: the state of being a famous performer
ex1_en: his rapid rise to stardom
ex1_zh: 他的迅速走红
remmethod: star(明星) + dom(状态；领域) → 明星身份；明星界

en: pleasantly calm, quiet, and peaceful
ex1_en: a small tranquil village
ex1_zh: 宁静的小村庄
remmethod: tran(=trans表加强) + qui(安静， 平和) + l → 完全安静、 平和的 → 安静的， 平静的

zh: 替罪羊，替人顶罪者；替身
en: someone who is blamed for something bad that happens, even if it is not their fault
ex1_en: I don't think I deserve to be made the scapegoat for a couple of bad results.
ex1_zh: 我认为我不该为出现的一些不良后果充当替罪羊。
remmethod: scape(看作escape逃跑) + goat(羊) → 替罪羊

en: the science of describing an area of land, or making maps of it
ex1_en: The topography of the river's basin has changed significantly since the floods.
ex1_zh: 洪水过后，这条河的流域地形已经明显改变了。
remmethod: topo (地方) + graph (写； 图) + y → 地形

en: a transparent block of glass that breaks up white light into different colours
ex1_en: Light is refracted when passed through a prism.
ex1_zh: 光通过棱镜时产生折射。
remmethod: prism(自身词根) → 棱镜；棱柱

en: a  gym
ex1_en: I have found a new gymnasium.
ex1_zh: 我找到一个新的健身房。
remmethod: 该词源自希腊语gymnasion(赤身训练)， 古希腊运动员训练时要求赤身裸体， 据说这样能使全身最大限度地自由活动。

en: You can refer to a successful and famous female opera singer as a diva
ex1_en: opera diva Jessye Norman
ex1_zh: 著名歌剧女歌唱家杰茜·诺曼
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 歌剧中的首席女主角

en: an animal that lives in water, has a shell, and can be eaten as food, for example  crab s  ,  lobster s  , and  oyster s
ex1_en: Fish and shellfish are the specialties.
ex1_zh: 鱼和甲壳类水生动物是特产。
remmethod: shell(壳) + fish(鱼) → 甲壳类动物

zh: 古怪的；异想天开的；反复无常的
en: unusual or strange and often amusing
ex1_en: He has a wonderful whimsical sense of humour.
ex1_zh: 他怪异的幽默感令人惊叹。
remmethod: whimsy(怪念头；反复无常) + ical(形容词后缀) → 反复无常的；古怪的

zh: 畏缩, 弹回 vi退却, 畏缩
en: Recoil is also a noun
ex1_en: We recoil in horror from the thought of subjecting someone to extreme pain.
ex1_zh: 想到要让一个人经受极度的痛苦，我们就会恐惧地退缩。
remmethod: re(向后) + coil(卷， 盘绕) → 卷回去 → 弹回

en: not interrupted or moved
ex1_en: At last I was able to work undisturbed.
ex1_zh: 我终于可以安安静静地工作了。
remmethod: un(未) + disturb(打扰) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未受干扰的

en: given free to people
ex1_en: There was a complimentary bottle of champagne in the hotel room.
ex1_zh: 酒店客房里有一瓶免费赠送的香槟。
remmethod: compliment(称赞；致意) + ary(形容词后缀) → 称赞的；赠送的

en: very unkind and cruel, and deliberately behaving in a way that is likely to upset or hurt someone
ex1_en: a malicious girl
ex1_zh: 恶毒的女孩
remmethod: 来自malice(n. 恶意)

en: able to understand situations or behaviour very well and very quickly, especially so that you can get an advantage for yourself
ex1_en: an astute politician
ex1_zh: 机敏的政治家
remmethod: 来自拉丁文astus(灵活)

zh: 不受影响的；自然的；真挚的；不矫揉造作的
en: not changed or influenced by something
ex1_en: her easy unaffected manner
ex1_zh: 她那从容而自然的举止
remmethod: un (不) + affected (做作的) → 不矫揉造作的

en: if someone prowls, they move around an area slowly and quietly, especially because they are involved in a criminal activity or because they are looking for something
ex1_en: gangs of teenagers prowling the streets
ex1_zh: 在大街上鬼鬼祟祟四处游荡的少年团伙
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 巡游

en: a small part or amount of something that remains when most of it no longer exists
ex1_en: We represent the last vestige of what made this nation great – hard work.
ex1_zh: 我们代表了曾经使这个国家伟大的仅存的品质–勤奋。
remmethod: 背心 (vest) 上留下了口红的痕迹 (vestige)

en: a small model of a person or animal used as a decoration
ex1_en: Michelle and her mother once gave me a figurine of a beautiful black child sitting in a wheelchair.
ex1_zh: 米歇尔和她的母亲曾经送给我一座小雕像，是一个坐在轮椅上的漂亮黑人小孩。
remmethod: 来自figure(n. 雕像)

en: to be afraid and show it by shaking a little bit or moving back slightly
ex1_en: The very words make many of us quail.
ex1_zh: 这几个字眼让我们中的很多人都感到畏缩。
remmethod: 原意为“鹌鹑”， 鹌鹑胆子较小， 所以就有了“恐惧”的意思

zh: 估价； 估量； 评价， 评定
en: to officially judge how successful, effective, or valuable something is
ex1_en: Greenpeace has been invited to appraise the environmental costs of such an operation.
ex1_zh: 绿色和平组织已受邀评估这样一次行动对环境的影响。
remmethod: ap (加强) + praise (价值， 赞扬) → 给予高的价值 → 评价

en: If something is discernible, you can see it or recognize that it exists
ex1_en: Far away the outline of the island is just discernible.
ex1_zh: 远远的，那岛的轮廓依稀可见。
remmethod: discern(洞悉， 辨别) + ible(可…的) → 可识别的， 可辨的
en (用…做…) + trench (沟) → 用沟做掩护 → 以壕沟防护

en: extracurricular activities are not part of the course that a student is doing at a school or college
ex1_en: Each child had participated in extracurricular activities at school.
ex1_zh: 每个孩子都参加了学校的课外活动。
remmethod: extra(额外的) + curricular(课程的) → 课外的

zh: 维护；证明…无辜；证明…正确
en: to prove that someone who was blamed for something is in fact not guilty
ex1_en: The charges are false, and we are sure we will be vindicated in court.
ex1_zh: 指控不实，我们确信法庭会证明我们是无辜的。
remmethod: vin(=force 力量) + dic(说) + ate → 使有力地说 → 证明…正确

en: to take too much of a drug at one time, so that it harms you or kills you
ex1_en: He'd overdosed on heroin.
ex1_zh: 他过量吸食了海洛因。
remmethod: over (过多) + dose (剂量) → 剂量过多 → 配药量过多

en: a lot of noise or angry protest about something
ex1_en: The announcement caused uproar in the crowd.
ex1_zh: 公告在人群中引起了一阵骚动。
remmethod: up(向上)+roar(吼叫) → 喧嚣； 骚动

en: happy and enjoying yourself
ex1_en: Everybody was in a very relaxed and jolly mood.
ex1_zh: 大家的心情都非常轻松愉快。
remmethod: jol(冬季节日) + ly → 有关节日的 → 快乐的

ex1_en: This candor is even evident in the human rights plan.
ex1_zh: 甚至在人权计划中，这种坦率也是很明显的。
remmethod: cand(白) + or(表状态) → 坦白

en: a news programme on radio or television
ex1_en: Radio and television anchors usually appear on more than one newscast per day.
ex1_zh: 广播电视的主播通常要在每天的新闻节目中多次出现。
remmethod: news(新闻) + cast(播送) → 新闻广播

en: an amount of food or drink that you put into your mouth at one time
ex1_en: Michael told his story between mouthfuls.
ex1_zh: 迈克尔边吃边讲他的故事。
remmethod: mouth(口) + ful(满…的量) → 一口，满口

en: the bar connecting two wheels on a car or other vehicle
ex1_en: the front/rear axle
ex1_zh: 前 / 后车轴
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 轮轴；车轴

zh: 小冲突，小规模战斗；小争论
en: a fight between small groups of soldiers, ships etc, especially one that happens away from the main part of a battle – used in news reports
ex1_en: Border skirmishes between India and Pakistan were common.
ex1_zh: 印巴边境的小冲突曾经是常有的事。
remmethod: skir(看作skirt， 裙子)+mish(看作famish， 饥饿) → 女人会为了裙子而起冲突， 为了穿漂亮的裙子宁可饿肚子 → 小冲突

ex1_en: So, how to balance accuracy and fluency in spoken English?
ex1_zh: 所以，英语口语的准确与流利，如何才能平衡起来呢？
remmethod: flu(流动) ＋ ency → 话从口中流出 → 流利

en: to make all the things of one particular type the same as each other
ex1_en: Attempts to standardize English spelling have never been successful.
ex1_zh: 统一英语拼写的尝试从未成功过。
remmethod: 来自standard(n. 标准)

en: a situation, condition etc that is close to or similar to a particular one, usually a good one
ex1_en: She was trying to get her thoughts back into some semblance of order .
ex1_zh: 她想稍微理出个头绪来。
remmethod: sembl (相像) + ance → 外表相似 → 伪装

en: full of something
ex1_en: The harbour was replete with boats.
ex1_zh: 港口里满是船只。
remmethod: re(重新) + plete(满) → 重新装满 → 充满的

en: a place where one road, track etc joins another
ex1_en: the junction of Abbot Road and Mill Street
ex1_zh: 阿伯特路与米尔街的交叉口
remmethod: junct(连接) ＋ ion → 联结点

en: existing at the beginning of time or the beginning of the Earth
ex1_en: the primordial seas
ex1_zh: 原始海洋
remmethod: prim(第一) + ord(顺序) + ial → 处于第一顺序的 → 主要的

en: to make a big mistake, especially because you have been careless or stupid
ex1_en: They blundered badly when they gave him the job.
ex1_zh: 他们犯了大错，让他做这份工作。
remmethod: 犯了大错 (blunder)， 打雷 (thunder) 天被赶出了门

zh: 分配， 配给， 拨给
en: to use a particular amount of time for something, or give a particular share of money, space etc to someone or something
ex1_en: The seats are allotted to the candidates who have won the most votes.
ex1_zh: 这些席位被分配给了赢得了最多选票的候选人。
remmethod: all(所有的) + ot → 所有人都有份 → 分配， 配给， 拨给

en: a plant that grows in the sea
ex1_en: So the next time you see a chunk of seaweed ... notice the beauty of it, yes.
ex1_zh: 所以下次你碰见一大片海藻时，要毫不犹豫的欣赏它的美。
remmethod: sea(海水)+weed(杂草)→海水里像草一样的东西→海草， 海藻

en: a thorny bush, plant etc has thorns
remmethod: 来自thorn(n. 刺)

en: to cover or surround something completely
ex1_en: When nuclear fuel is manufactured it is encased in metal cans.
ex1_zh: 核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。
remmethod: en(进入) + case(容器) → 被装入容器中 → 装入， 包住

en: When you pare something, or pare part of it off or away, you cut off its skin or its outer layer
ex1_en: Pare the brown skin from the meat with a very sharp knife.
ex1_zh: 用一把非常锋利的刀削掉肉上褐色的皮。
remmethod: 和pear (n. 梨) 一起记， 削 (pare) 梨 (pear)

en: a floor covering made from strong shiny material
remmethod: lin(亚麻) + ole(油) + um(名词后缀) → 亚麻油制品 → 油布；油毯

en: food that is nutritious is full of the natural substances that your body needs to stay healthy or to grow properly
ex1_en: Wholemeal bread is more nutritious than white bread.
ex1_zh: 全麦面包比白面包更有营养。
remmethod: 来自nutrition(n. 营养)

ex1_en: "We went into a market and established a kiosk in that market out of a butcher's shop," Kalanda says.
ex1_zh: 卡兰达说，“由于一家肉店，我们进入这个市场，在那个市场我们建立了一个公用电话亭”
remmethod: 亭子 (kiosk) 里浸 (soak) 了水 → 亭子

zh: 增加； 增量； 定期的加薪
en: a regular increase in the amount of money someone is paid
ex1_en: a salary of £18,000, with annual increments of 2.5%
ex1_zh: 工资为18,000英镑，每年上涨2.5%
remmethod: in(进入) + cre(生长) + ment → 使生长 → 增加

ex1_en: a heterogeneous collection of buildings
ex1_zh: 风格各异的一组建筑
remmethod: hetero(其他的； 相异的) + gene(产生， 基因) + ous → 异类的

en: to become less strong or decrease
ex1_en: We waited for the storm to abate.
ex1_zh: 我们等风暴减弱。
remmethod: a(表加强) + bate(减弱， 减少) → 减轻

en: a word used to emphasize a description of someone or something
ex1_en: The area is a veritable paradise for those who love walking and swimming.
ex1_zh: 这个地区对于喜欢散步和游泳的人来说简直就是天堂。
remmethod: veri(真实的) + table → 确实的

en: money given by the government in Britain to people who are unemployed
ex1_en: The number claiming dole went up by 3,500.
ex1_zh: 申请领取救济金者增加了3,500人。
remmethod: dol(悲伤；给予) + e → 施舍；悲哀

zh: 使移居国外；流放，放逐；使放弃国籍
ex1_en: The expatriate vote could help determine who wins in November.
ex1_zh: 侨居者们的投票有助于决定谁在11月获胜。
remmethod: ex(出) + patri(父亲) + ate → 离开自己的父亲 → 移居国外

zh: 初期的；开始存在的，发生中的
en: coming into existence or starting to develop
ex1_en: the country’s nascent democracy
ex1_zh: 该国新生的民主
remmethod: nasc(出生) + ent → 刚出生的 → 初生的

en: to make someone extremely angry
ex1_en: Her actions infuriated her mother.
ex1_zh: 她的举动使她母亲极为生气。
remmethod: in(进入) + furi(=fury狂怒) + ate → 进入狂怒 → 使恼怒， 激怒

en: someone whose job is to connect or repair electrical wires or equipment
ex1_en: The electrician refitted my old radio set.

en: to establish political control over an area or over another country, and send your citizens there to settle

ex1_zh: 轮演剧目剧团

en: used to emphasize that something is certainly true

ex1_zh: 埃菲尔铁塔无疑是巴黎最为人熟知的地标之一。

en: to use the knowledge and information you have in order to understand something or form an opinion about it

en: the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post

en: not limited by anyone or anything

en: to obtain something, especially something that is difficult to get
ex1_en: It remained very difficult to procure food, fuel, and other daily necessities.
ex1_zh: 当时仍然很难获得食品、燃料和其他日用必需品。

zh: 蒙住；裹住；抑制；发低沉的声音
en: to cover yourself or another person with something thick and warm

en: a feeling of doubt or fear about what might happen or about whether something is right

en: If something or someone typifies a situation or type of thing or person, they have all the usual characteristics of it and are a typical example of it
ex1_en: These two buildings typify the rich extremes of local architecture.
ex1_zh: 这两座建筑物代表着当地建筑风格的迥异。
remmethod: typ (看作type， 典型) + ify (使…) → 作为典型 → 代表

en: the beginning or origin of something
ex1_en: Could that be the genesis?
ex1_zh: 那有可能是起源吗？
remmethod: gene(产生， 基因) + sis → 创始； 大写Genesis专指《圣经》中的《创世纪》

en: a lucky or successful situation where people can make a lot of money
ex1_en: 2008 was a bonanza year for the oil industry.
ex1_zh: 2008年是石油业兴旺发达的一年。
remmethod: 美国有一部电影叫做《大淘金》 (BONANZA) → 淘金的地方当然是富矿带了

zh: 使附于, 粘贴 n[语]词缀
remmethod: af + fix(固定) → 固定上去 → 黏上， 贴上

zh: 无形的，触摸不到的；难以理解的
en: an intangible quality or feeling is difficult to describe exactly
ex1_en: The island has an intangible quality of holiness.
ex1_zh: 该岛屿有一种难以形容的神圣感。
remmethod: in (不) + tangible (可触摸的) → 不可触摸的 → 感觉不到的

en: not leaning to one side or the other but exactly vertical
ex1_en: a perpendicular line
ex1_zh: 垂直线
remmethod: per(自始至终) + pend(挂) + icular → 自始至终挂着 → 垂直的

en: a raised part on the back of a  camel
ex1_en: Camels rebuild fat stores in their hump.
ex1_zh: 骆驼在自己的驼峰内重新贮备脂肪。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 驼峰；小丘

ex1_en: But they can definitely determine how they plan to grow as more people move in, and also how they want to rehabilitate areas that need regeneration.
ex1_zh: 但它们确实可以决定怎样在更多的人迁移进来的同时计划它们的增长，以及它们希望怎样修复需要重建的区域。
remmethod: re(再) + gener(产生) + ation(名词) → 新生，更新

en: having the shape of an ellipse
ex1_en: Kepler published his discovery of the elliptical orbits of planets in 1609. 1609
ex1_zh: 年开普勒公布他的发现，认为行星轨道为椭圆形。
remmethod: 来自ellipse(n. 椭圆(形))

en: a small brush that you use for cleaning your teeth
ex1_en: How do you choose your toothbrush?
ex1_zh: 你是如何选择你的牙刷的？
remmethod: tooth(牙) + brush(刷) → 牙刷

en: the gradual destruction of metal by the effect of water, chemicals etc or a substance such as rust produced by this process
ex1_en: They are sprayed with oil to prevent corrosion.
ex1_zh: 它们被喷了油以防腐蚀。
remmethod: 来自corrode(v. 腐蚀， 侵蚀)； cor(表加强) + rod(咬) + e → 用力咬掉 → 腐蚀， 侵蚀

en: if you retract something that you said or agreed, you say that you did not mean it
ex1_en: He confessed to the murder but later retracted his statement.
ex1_zh: 他承认谋杀，但后来又翻供了。
remmethod: re(往后) + tract(拉) → 往后拉 → 收回； 缩回

zh: 无活动的， 惰性的； 不活泼的， 迟钝的
en: not producing a chemical reaction when combined with other substances
ex1_en: inert gases
ex1_zh: 惰性气体
remmethod: in(不) + ert(工作) → 不工作的 → 无活动的， 惰性的

en: an animal that looks like a horse but has black and white lines all over its body
ex1_en: The neck of the zebra was nipped by a lion.
ex1_zh: 狮子咬断了那头斑马的脖子。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 斑马

zh: 混杂, 搞乱 n混乱
en: to mix things together in an untidy way, without any order
ex1_en: The photographs were all jumbled up.
ex1_zh: 照片乱七八糟地堆在一起。
remmethod: jum(看做jump， 跳) + ble → 上蹿下跳， 群魔乱舞 → 混杂

zh: 恶作剧的， 顽皮的， 淘气的； 恶意的
en: someone who is mischievous likes to have fun, especially by playing tricks on people or doing things to annoy or embarrass them
ex1_en: Their sons are noisy and mischievous.
ex1_zh: 他们的几个儿子又吵又淘气。
remmethod: 来自mischief(n. 恶作剧， 淘气； 恶意)

ex1_en: Never copy foreign things blindly or mechanically.
ex1_zh: 不要盲目地或机械地照搬外国的东西。
remmethod: mechan(机械) + ical(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 机械地；无意识地

en: a mixture of different types of the same thing which produces an interesting or unusual effect
ex1_en: the 400 metres individual medley
ex1_zh: 400米个人混合泳比赛
remmethod: medl(混合) + ey → 混合 → 混合物；集成曲

en: the quality of being or looking the same as all other members of a group
ex1_en: There seems to be no uniformity among the various systems.
ex1_zh: 各系统之间似乎没有统一性。
remmethod: 来自uniform(a. 统一的)

en: if one type of person or thing predominates in a group or area, there are more of this type than any other
ex1_en: Pine trees predominate in this area of forest.
ex1_zh: 这片林区以松树居多。
remmethod: pre(在…前面) + dominate(统治) → 处于统治地位 → 统治， 支配， 占优势

ex1_en: Performance testing to gauge the scalability and responsiveness of new services should always be part of the plan.
ex1_zh: 性能测试用于测定新服务的可伸缩性和响应能力，应当是计划的一部分。
remmethod: responsive(有反应的；同情的) + ness(表性质) → 响应能力；有同情心

en: bigger, better, or worse than anything else
ex1_en: an achievement unparalleled in sporting history
ex1_zh: 体育史上空前的成就
remmethod: 来自parallel(a. 平行的)

en: musical instruments such as drums, bells etc which you play by hitting them
ex1_en: Tonight we have Paul Duke on percussion (= playing a percussion instrument ) .
ex1_zh: 今晚我们请到保罗·杜克先生负责打击乐。
remmethod: per(表加强) + cuss(打) + ion → 用力打的东西 → 打击乐器

en: an event or a situation that is very badly organized or does not happen properly, in a way that is silly and unreasonable
ex1_en: She admitted that the interview had been a complete farce from start to finish.
ex1_zh: 她承认，采访从头到尾完全是一场闹剧。
remmethod: 别小看了滑稽剧(farce)， 有时它也很有批判的力量(force)

en: the process of digesting food
ex1_en: Too much tea is bad for your digestion.
ex1_zh: 喝太多茶会影响消化。
remmethod: 来自digest(v. 消化)

en: to break or burst, or to make something break or burst
ex1_en: The pipe will rupture at its weakest point.
ex1_zh: 管道最薄弱的地方会破裂的。
remmethod: rupt(断裂) + ure → (使)破裂

en: not good at doing something
ex1_en: inept leadership
ex1_zh: 拙劣的领导
remmethod: in(不) + ept(能干的) → 无能的

en: a fashion, game, type of music etc that becomes very popular for a short time
ex1_en: At that time, scooters were the latest craze .
ex1_zh: 那时候，小型摩托车是最新的时尚。
remmethod: craze(狂热；使发狂) → 狂热

en: Urbanization is the process of creating cities or towns in country areas
ex1_en: Much of this, she says, is due to increased urbanization.
ex1_zh: 而这些，主要是由于不断增加的都市化造成的。
remmethod: 来自urbanize(vt. 使都市化； 使文雅)

ex1_en: The paternity of the child is in dispute.
ex1_zh: 这个孩子的生父是谁尚有疑问。
remmethod: pater(父亲) + nity → 父权； 父系

en: behaviour that is deliberately intended to make other people believe you are brave and confident
ex1_en: youthful bravado
ex1_zh: 年轻人的逞强行为
remmethod: 来自bravo (vt. 欢呼； 喝彩)

en: not clear or exact
ex1_en: Teachers find the report’s terminology so indefinite that it is confusing.
ex1_zh: 老师们发现报告的专门用语含义不明确，令人费解。
remmethod: in(不) ＋ definite(明确的) → 不明确的 → 模糊的

en: full of strong feeling and emotion
ex1_en: She appeared on television to make an impassioned plea for help.
ex1_zh: 她在电视上恳切地请求人们帮助。
remmethod: im(进入) + passion(激情) + ed → 投入激情的 → 慷慨激昂的

en: to walk slowly in a relaxed way
ex1_en: An old man came out and ambled over for a chat.
ex1_zh: 一个老人出来，缓步走过去聊天。
remmethod: amble本身就是一个词根=ambul(走路)

en: a person or company who sells goods wholesale
ex1_en: Under state law, bar owners must buy their liquor from wholesalers.
ex1_zh: 依照州法律，酒吧经营者们必须从批发商们那儿购买酒。
remmethod: whole(整体) + sale(卖) + (e)r(表人) → 批发商

en: to disapprove of something very strongly and criticize it severely, especially publicly
ex1_en: The UN deplored the invasion as a ‘violation of international law’.
ex1_zh: 联合国谴责这次入侵 “违反了国际法” 。
remmethod: de(表加强) + plor(流泪， 哭泣) + e → 非常伤心地哭泣 → 悲叹

en: hatred between people or groups of people
ex1_en: There is still much antagonism between environmental groups and the oil companies.
ex1_zh: 环境组织与石油公司之间仍有很多敌意。
remmethod: ant (看作anti， 相反) + agon (打斗， 比赛) + ism (状态) → 对打 → 对抗； 敌对

en: auxiliary workers provide additional help for another group of workers
ex1_en: an auxiliary nurse
ex1_zh: 助理护士
remmethod: aux(看作aug， 提高)+iliary→帮助提高的→辅助的
tags: cet4 cet6 ky toefl ielts gre

en: a set of poles and boards that are built into a structure for workers to stand on when they are working on the outside of a building
ex1_en: Workers have erected scaffolding around the base of the tower below the roadway.
ex1_zh: 工人们已经在车行道下的塔基四周竖起了脚手架。
remmethod: scaffold(脚手架) + ing(名词后缀) → 脚手架

en: a threat saying that if someone does not do what you want by a particular time, you will do something to punish them
ex1_en: The club gave him an ultimatum – either he apologized, or he would be expelled from the team.
ex1_zh: 俱乐部给他下了最后通牒——要么道歉，要么等着被开除出队。
remmethod: ultim(最后的) + atum → 最后通牒

en: a bird that kills and eats other animals and can be trained to hunt
ex1_en: Animals representing mythical powers and military might surrounded him—pumas, a wolf, eagles, a falcon, an owl, and rattlesnakes—some buried alive in cages.
ex1_zh: 一些动物作为神和军事的力量的象征置放在他的周围——美洲狮、狼、鹰、隼、猫头鹰、响尾蛇——装在笼子里一起活埋。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 猎鹰

en: behaving in a way that is different from what you claim to believe – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: It would be hypocritical to say I travel at 70 mph simply because that is the law.
ex1_zh: 如果仅仅因为法律规定的时速是70英里我就说自己的行驶时速是70英里，那就太虚伪了。
remmethod: hypo(下；不足) + crit(判断) + ical(形容词后缀) → 在下面评判 → 虚伪的；伪善的

en: a situation in which there are very few of something that people want or need
ex1_en: EXCEPT as Pearl, in the dearth of human playmates, was thrown more upon the visionary throng which she created.
ex1_zh: 只不过是由于缺乏玩伴，她同自己创造出来的幻想中的人群更加接近而己。
remmethod: 物以稀(dearth)为贵(dear)

en: if something bad or unpleasant is rife, it is very common
ex1_en: Violent crime is rife in our inner cities.
ex1_zh: 暴力犯罪在我们的旧城区非常猖獗。
remmethod: 和life(n. 生命)一起记

zh: 忽略的； 疏忽的； 粗心大意的
en: not taking enough care over something that you are responsible for, with the result that serious mistakes are made
ex1_en: Mr Brown was found guilty of negligent driving.
ex1_zh: 布朗先生被判疏忽驾驶罪。
remmethod: neg(不) + lig(选择) + ent → 不选择的 → 忽略的； 疏忽的

ex1_en: What is technically possible and what is ethically appropriate is a matter of heated debate.
ex1_zh: 什么在技术上是可行的与什么在伦理上是适当的，这是一个激烈辩论的问题。
remmethod: ethic(伦理) + al(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 伦理上

ex1_en: There is a willful self-destructiveness in the air here as if America has all the time and money in the world for petty politics.
ex1_zh: 这里的空气里中弥漫着一种故意自我毁灭的气息，为了狭隘的政治，美国好像在全世界有的是金钱和时间。
remmethod: will(意志) + ful(充满…的) → 充满个人意志的 → 任性的；故意的

en: to arrange laws, principles, facts etc in a system
ex1_en: The latest draft of the agreement codifies the panel's decision.
ex1_zh: 该协议的最新草案将专家小组的决定编篡成了法规条款。
remmethod: 来自code(n. 法规)

en: a special type of bottle that you use to keep liquids either hot or cold, for example when travelling
ex1_en: He took out a metal flask from a canvas bag.
ex1_zh: 他从帆布袋里拿出了一个金属水瓶。
remmethod: 和flash(v. 闪光)一起记

zh: 勉强做； 不情愿地给
en: to do or give something very unwillingly
ex1_en: Mr Gillis was not normally a man to bear grudges .
ex1_zh: 吉利斯先生通常不是那种会积怨的人。
remmethod: 无缘无故让人去做苦工(drudge)， 肯定让人心存怨恨(grudge)

en: a list of all the books and articles used in preparing a piece of writing
ex1_en: At the end of this chapter there is a select bibliography of useful books.
ex1_zh: 本章末尾附着有用书籍的精选书目。
remmethod: biblio(书)+graph(写)+y→写书所用的书→参考书目

en: slightly fat in a way that looks healthy and attractive
ex1_en: a chubby six-year-old
ex1_zh: 一个胖乎乎的六岁孩子
remmethod: chub(圆胖) + b + y(形容词后缀) → 丰满的；圆胖的

en: relating to ice and glaciers, or formed by glaciers
ex1_en: a glacial valley
ex1_zh: 冰川谷
remmethod: glaci(冰) + al → 冰河期的

ex1_en: The report galvanized world opinion.
ex1_zh: 这篇报道一出，世界舆论一片哗然。
remmethod: 来自galvanic(adj. 电流的)

en: not leading to a clear decision or result
ex1_en: The evidence against the two men was inconclusive.
ex1_zh: 针对这两个人的不利证据并不令人信服。
remmethod: in(不) + con(加强) + clus(关闭， 停止) + ive(…的) → 不能强行停止的 → 非决定性的， 无结果的

en: An outcast is someone who is not accepted by a group of people or by society
ex1_en: He had always been an outcast, unwanted and alone.
ex1_zh: 他一直是个被排斥的人，无人理睬，孤孤单单。
remmethod: 来自词组cast out 驱逐

en: simple, basic, and important
ex1_en: Love and fear are two of the most elemental human emotions.
ex1_zh: 爱和恐惧是人类最基本的两种情感。
remmethod: element(元素；要素) + al(…的) → 元素的；自然力的

en: having qualities that people expect and admire in a man, such as being brave and strong
ex1_en: a deep manly voice
ex1_zh: 低沉雄浑的嗓音
remmethod: man(男人) + ly(形容词后缀) → 有男子汉气概的，适合男人的

en: The ratification of a treaty or written agreement is the process of ratifying it
ex1_en: We welcome this development and we look forward to early ratification of the treaty by China.
ex1_zh: 我们欢迎这一进展并期望中国早日批准本条约。
remmethod: 来自ratify(v. 正式批准)

en: having a strong pleasant smell
ex1_en: aromatic oils
ex1_zh: 芳香油
remmethod: aroma(芳香, 香味) + tic → 芳香的

ex1_en: I had a slight mishap with one of the glasses.
ex1_zh: 我犯了一个小小的错误，把其中的一个玻璃杯打破了。
remmethod: mis(坏) + hap(运气) → 运气不好 → 不幸， 坏运气

en: happening or existing because of something
ex1_en: She is still trying to get over the attack and the resultant injuries.
ex1_zh: 她仍在努力从袭击以及由此造成的伤害中恢复过来。
remmethod: result(结果) + ant(…的) → 作为结果而发生的

en: to burn and slightly damage a surface by making it too hot; to be slightly burned by heat
ex1_en: I scorched my dress when I was ironing it.
ex1_zh: 我把自己的连衣裙熨焦了。
remmethod: 用火把(torch)烤焦(scorch)

en: If something warps or is warped, it becomes damaged by bending or curving, often because of the effect of heat or water
ex1_en: Left out in the heat of the sun, tapes easily warp or get stuck in their cases.
ex1_zh: 放在太阳底下暴晒后，磁带容易翘曲变形或卡带。
remmethod: 战争(war)扭曲(warp)了人们的心灵

en: not offensive, dangerous, or harmful
ex1_en: an innocuous remark
ex1_zh: 无恶意的话
remmethod: in(无) + noc(伤害) + uous → 无害的

en: helpful and likely to make you successful
ex1_en: He was now in a more advantageous position.
ex1_zh: 他现在的位置更有利。
remmethod: 来自advantage(n. 优势)

en: to persuade someone not to do something
ex1_en: Doctors had tried to dissuade patients from smoking.
ex1_zh: 医生曾试图说服病人不要抽烟。
remmethod: dis(分离) + suad(说服) + e → 说服某人以使其脱离 → 劝阻， 阻止

en: the qualities and character of a particular place and the way these make you feel
ex1_en: The overall ambience of the room is cosy.
ex1_zh: 这个房间的整体氛围是舒适的。
remmethod: ambi(在…周围) + ence → 环境， 气氛

zh: 令人震惊的； 严重损害身体的； 极其有害的
en: causing so much damage or harm that something no longer works or is no longer effective
ex1_en: the crippling effects of war on the economy
ex1_zh: 战争给经济造成的毁灭性影响
remmethod: 来自cripple(vt. 使残废； 严重毁坏)

en: if you are hoarse, or if your voice is hoarse, you speak in a low rough voice, for example because your throat is sore
ex1_en: He was hoarse from laughing.
ex1_zh: 他笑得嗓子都沙哑了。
remmethod: 房 (house) 中传来嘶哑的 (hoarse) 叫声

zh: 立足处（攀登时脚踩的地方）
en: a position from which you can start to make progress and achieve your aims
ex1_en: Businesses are investing millions of dollars to gain a foothold in this new market.
ex1_zh: 商家们正投资数百万美元以求在新市场中赢得立足点。
remmethod: foot(脚) + hold(抓住；支撑) → 脚可踩住的地方 → 立足处

zh: 朝生暮死的, 短暂的
en: existing or popular for only a short time
ex1_en: Fashion is by nature ephemeral.
ex1_zh: 从本质上说，时尚不过是一时的潮流。
remmethod: ep(在) + hemer(天) + al → 历时一天的 → 短暂的

zh: 热心的；强烈的；炽热的；热烈的
en: believing or feeling something very strongly and sincerely
ex1_en: a fervent appeal for peace
ex1_zh: 对和平的强烈呼吁
remmethod: ferv(热) + ent → 热情的 → 热烈的

en: water that has fallen as rain
ex1_en: Farmers say they need less rainwater if they use fertilizer trees.
ex1_zh: 农民们说，如果它们使用肥料树，就只需要很少的雨水。
remmethod: rain(雨) + water(水) → 雨水

en: a type of large tree with broad leaves, or the wood from this tree
ex1_en: It was a good table too, sturdily constructed of elm.
ex1_zh: 这也是一张好桌子，榆木做的，很结实。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → [植]榆树

en: used in the official names of some countries, groups of countries, or parts of countries
remmethod: common(共同的) ＋ wealth(财富) → 财富共有 → 联合体

en: a small brown bird, very common in many parts of the world
ex1_en: The myrtle, dove, sparrow, and swan are sacred to her.
ex1_zh: 桃金娘，鸽子，麻雀和天鹅是她的圣物。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 麻雀；矮小的人

zh: 使重叠， 使叠加； 添加
en: to put one picture, image, or photograph on top of another so that both can be partly seen
ex1_en: The image of a seemingly tiny dancer was superimposed on the image of the table.
ex1_zh: 一个看似很小的舞蹈者的影像被叠加在了那张桌子的影像上。
remmethod: super(在…上面) + impose(强加于) → 强加于上面 → 使重叠， 使叠加

en: to talk or converse intimately
ex1_en: a hippie commune
ex1_zh: 嬉皮士群体
remmethod: com(共同) + mun(服务) + e → 为大家服务 → 群体， 公社

en: someone who is diligent works hard and is careful and thorough
ex1_en: a diligent student
ex1_zh: 勤勉的学生
remmethod: di(=dis分开) + lig(选择) + ent → 一个个地进行选择 → 勤奋的

en: Northward or northwards means toward the north
ex1_en: Tropical storm Marco is pushing northward up Florida's coast.
ex1_zh: 热带风暴“马可”正沿着佛罗里达海岸向北推进。
remmethod: north(北) + ward(向…) → 向北；向北的

zh: 先占；先取；以先买权获得
ex1_en: The law would preempt stronger local rules.
ex1_zh: 该法律将预先制止更强硬的地方性法规。
remmethod: pre(预先) + empt(拿到) → 预先拿到 → 以优先权取得

en: to take the knots out of something, or unfasten something that has been tied
ex1_en: Peter untied his shoelaces.
ex1_zh: 彼得解开鞋带。
remmethod: un(不；相反) + tie(系) → 解开

en: a thick substance that you use to clean your teeth
ex1_en: Shaving supplies, toothpaste, and soap were found inside.
ex1_zh: 在里面找到了剃须用品、牙膏和肥皂。
remmethod: tooth(牙) + paste(糊；膏) → 牙膏

en: able to move quickly and easily
ex1_en: Dogs are surprisingly agile.
ex1_zh: 狗出奇地敏捷。
remmethod: ag(行动， 做) + ile → 敏捷的

en: a trick, especially one which is played on someone to make them look silly
ex1_en: a childish prank
ex1_zh: 孩子气的恶作剧
remmethod: 注意不要和plank(n. 厚木板)相混

en: a metal or wooden container with a handle, used for carrying liquids
ex1_en: a milk pail
ex1_zh: 牛奶桶
remmethod: 桶(pail)上钉钉(nail)

en: food that people or animals need in order to live
ex1_en: Without sustenance, the animals will soon die.
ex1_zh: 没有食物，动物很快就会死亡。
remmethod: sus(在…下面) + ten(支撑) + ance → 在下面支撑 → 维持

en: owing money to someone
ex1_en: the 17 most heavily indebted nations
ex1_zh: 17个负债最重的国家
remmethod: in(进入) + debt(债务) + ed → 欠人情债的 → 感激的， 蒙恩的

zh: 心理分析， 精神分析
en: medical treatment that involves talking to someone about their life, feelings etc in order to find out the hidden causes of their problems
ex1_en: In theory, psychoanalysis is the philosophy of the unconscious mind; in practice it is a means by which mental disorders can be cured.
ex1_zh: 在理论上，精神分析是一门关于无意识心理的哲学；在实践上，它又是一种治愈心理紊乱的方法。
remmethod: psycho(灵魂， 精神) + analysis(分析) → 精神分析

en: happening immediately
ex1_en: modern methods of instantaneous communication
ex1_zh: 现代的即时通信方法
remmethod: 来自instant(adj. 立即的， 即刻的n. 瞬间， 顷刻)

en: very large or great in a surprising or impressive way
ex1_en: the artist’s prodigious output
ex1_zh: 那位艺术家惊人的高产
remmethod: 来自prodigy(n. 惊人的事物)

en: compensatory payments are paid to someone who has been harmed or hurt in some way
ex1_en: She was awarded a large sum in compensatory damages .
ex1_zh: 她得到了一大笔损失赔偿金。
remmethod: com(共同) + pens(称量；支付) + atory(形容词后缀) → 补偿的

en: the distance between the middle and the top or bottom of a wave such as a sound wave
ex1_en: As we fall asleep the amplitude of brain waves slowly becomes greater.
ex1_zh: 进入睡眠状态时，我们的脑电波振幅慢慢变大。
remmethod: ampl(大) + itude → 广度

en: not having the right knowledge, experience, or education to do something
ex1_en: unqualified staff
ex1_zh: 不合格的员工
remmethod: un (不) + qualified (有资格的) → 不合格的

en: if a new idea, product, or method supersedes another one, it becomes used instead because it is more modern or effective
ex1_en: Their map has since been superseded by photographic atlases.
ex1_zh: 他们的地图从此被摄影地图册取代。
remmethod: super(在…之上) + sed(坐) + e → 坐在别人的位置上 → 代替； 取代

zh: 依教规的；权威的；牧师的
remmethod: canon(规范；教规) + ical(形容词后缀) → 规范的

zh: 修剪， 修整； 删除， 削减
en: to cut off some of the branches of a tree or bush to make it grow better
ex1_en: The roses need pruning.
ex1_zh: 玫瑰需要修枝了。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 剪除

zh: （疾病等）（全国、全球i）流行的；普遍的
ex1_en: They feared a new cholera pandemic.
ex1_zh: 他们担心一种新的霍乱流行病。
remmethod: pan (全部) + dem (人民) + ic → 全国人民动起来 → 大范围流行的

en: the ability of something to stretch and go back to its usual length or size
ex1_en: the skin’s natural elasticity
ex1_zh: 皮肤天生的弹性
remmethod: elastic (弹性的) + ity (表示抽象名词) → 弹性

en: Eastward or eastwards means toward the east
ex1_en: A powerful snow storm is moving eastward.
ex1_zh: 一场猛烈的暴风雪正向东转移。
remmethod: east(东) + ward(向) → 向东的；向东

en: the time of the year when it is spring
ex1_en: Flowers bloom in springtime.
ex1_zh: 花在春天开放。
remmethod: spring(春) + time(时节) → 春天；春季

ex1_en: Interference with the normal production of heme or globin leads to anemia.
ex1_zh: 血红素或球蛋白的正常产生收到干扰会导致贫血。
remmethod: an(无) + (a)em(血) + ia → 没血 → 贫血

en: someone whose job is to examine the condition of a building, or to measure and record the details of an area of land
remmethod: survey(测量；检查) + or(表人) → 测量员；检查员

en: A prodigy is someone young who has a great natural ability for something such as music, mathematics, or sports
ex1_en: The Russian tennis prodigy is well on the way to becoming the youngest world champion of all time.
ex1_zh: 这位俄罗斯网球奇才已很有望成为历史上最年轻的世界冠军。
remmethod: pro(向前) + digy(说?) → 预言；奇事 → 奇才

zh: 谜, 难以理解的事物
en: someone or something that is strange and difficult to understand
ex1_en: The neighbours regarded him as something of an enigma.
ex1_zh: 邻居们把他当成谜一样的人。
remmethod: enigm(谜) + a → 谜

en: a pause or stop
ex1_en: He would not agree to a cessation of hostilities.
ex1_zh: 他不会同意敌对状态的停止。
remmethod: cess(走) + ation → 不走的状态 → 中止

zh: 外推； 推断， 推知
en: to use facts about the present or about one thing or group to make a guess about the future or about other things or groups
ex1_en: Extrapolating from his latest findings, he reckons about 80% of these deaths might be attributed to smoking.
ex1_zh: 从他最近的发现推断，他估计大约80%的这类死亡可能归因于吸烟。
remmethod: extra(外面) + pol(放) + ate → 放出想法 → 预测， 推测

en: to involve someone in an argument, a relationship, or a situation that is difficult to escape from
ex1_en: Bureaucracy can entangle applications for months.
ex1_zh: 官僚主义会使申请耽搁数月之久。
remmethod: en + tangle(纠缠， 混乱) → 使卷入

ex1_en: Guests should feel at liberty to avail themselves of your facilities.
ex1_zh: 客人们应可以随意使用你们的设施。
remmethod: “啊-喂！” → 叫人过来帮忙 → 帮助

zh: 非写实的； 程式化的
en: drawn, written, or performed in an artificial style that does not look natural or real, but that is still pleasant to look at
ex1_en: a stylized picture of the sun
ex1_zh: 用非写实手法画的太阳
remmethod: 来自stylize(vt. 使风格化)

en: a pattern sewn onto cloth, or cloth with patterns sewn onto it
ex1_en: The shorts had blue embroidery over the pockets.
ex1_zh: 这条短裤口袋上有蓝色的刺绣。
remmethod: em(使) + broider(刺绣) + y(名词后缀) → 刺绣品

zh: 疯狂的；精神错乱的；愚蠢的
en: If you describe someone's behaviour or ideas as lunatic, you think they are very foolish and possibly dangerous
remmethod: lun(月亮) + atic → 人们认为精神病与月亮的盈亏有关 → 疯子； Luna原指罗马神话中的月亮女神

zh: 急躁的， 易怒的； 易受刺激的； 过敏的
en: getting annoyed quickly or easily
ex1_en: Jo was tired, irritable, and depressed.
ex1_zh: 乔疲惫暴躁，而且情绪低落。
remmethod: irrit(痒) + able → 易怒的， 急躁的

zh: 迷信的， 受迷信思想支配的
en: influenced by superstitions
ex1_en: a superstitious woman
ex1_zh: 一个迷信的女人
remmethod: super(在…之上) + stit(站立) + ious → 站立在他物之上的 → 迷信的； 受迷信思想支配的

zh: 流出物， 废水， 污水
en: liquid waste, especially chemicals or sewage
ex1_en: The effluent from the factory was dumped into the river.
ex1_zh: 那家工厂的污水被排到了河里。
remmethod: ef(出) + flu(流) + ent → 流出来的 → 流出物， 废水， 污水
喝着啤酒(beer)， 为中国队欢呼(cheer)

en: a round lump of flour and fat mixed with water, cooked in boiling liquid and served with meat
ex1_en: chicken and dumplings
ex1_zh: 鸡肉和汤团
remmethod: dump(团块) + ling(小称后缀) → 小面团 → 饺子；汤团

zh: 设计舞蹈动作， 编舞
en: to arrange how dancers should move during a performance
ex1_en: The show is very cleverly choreographed.
ex1_zh: 这个节目的舞蹈动作设计得非常好。
remmethod: chor(跳舞) + eo + graph(写； 图) → 画下跳舞的动作 → 设计舞蹈动作

zh: 说明，解释；展览会，博览会
en: a clear and detailed explanation
ex1_en: a lucid exposition of educational theories
ex1_zh: 对教育理论的清晰阐述
remmethod: ex(出) ＋ pos(放) ＋ ition → 放出来让人看 → 展览会， 博览会

en: the acceptance of something as true
ex1_en: Good studies are needed to lend credence to the notion that genuine progress can be made in this important field.
ex1_zh: 要有优秀的研究才能使人相信在这一重大领域能取得真正的进步。
remmethod: cred(相信) + ence(名词后缀) → 可信性

en: to keep a person or animal apart from others for a period of time in case they are carrying a disease
ex1_en: She was sent home and put in quarantine.
ex1_zh: 她被送回家实施隔离。
remmethod: quarant(四十) ＋ ine → 隔开40天 → 隔离

en: to speak with a lot of pauses and repeated sounds, either because you have a speech problem, or because you are nervous, excited etc
ex1_en: Whenever he was angry, he would begin to stammer slightly.
ex1_zh: 他一生气说话就开始有点结巴。
remmethod: stamm(看作stamp， 邮票) + er → 嘴被贴上了邮票 → 口吃

en: to make remarks or jokes that show you think someone or something is silly or useless
ex1_en: You shouldn’t deride their efforts.
ex1_zh: 你不应该嘲笑他们的努力。
remmethod: 嘲笑 (deride) 别人不会骑 (ride) 车

en: the real facts of a situation rather than ideas about how it might be
ex1_en: doubts about the practicality of your suggestion
ex1_zh: 对于你所提建议的可行性的怀疑
remmethod: practical(实际的) + ity(名词后缀) → 实用性

en: a large shiny black bird
ex1_en: Which waves in every raven tress .
ex1_zh: 美波动在她乌黑的发上。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 大乌鸦

en: a slope or a degree of slope, especially in a road or railway
ex1_en: a steep gradient
ex1_zh: 陡坡
remmethod: gradi(=grad步， 级) + ent → 梯度

en: able to move quickly and easily with light neat movements
ex1_en: nimble fingers
ex1_zh: 灵巧的手指
remmethod: 来自nim (偷窃) + ble → 偷窃需要手脚灵活 → 敏捷的

en: very sour
ex1_en: Some fruit juices taste a bit acidic.
ex1_zh: 有些果汁味道略酸。
remmethod: acid(n. 酸) + ic → 酸的

en: small
ex1_en: a shy diminutive man
ex1_zh: 一个腼腆的矮个子男人
remmethod: di + min (小的) + u + tive (…的) → 小的

en: Sculptural means relating to sculpture
ex1_en: He enjoyed working with clay as a sculptural form.
ex1_zh: 他喜欢用黏土来做雕塑。
remmethod: sculpt(雕刻) + ur(e)(表行为/结果) + al(形容词后缀) → 雕刻的

en: to go at a quick and lively pace
ex1_en: Her expression is one of shock and arousal, and as she continues to read, he continues to spank.
ex1_zh: 玛吉·吉伦哈尔的表情既吃惊又兴奋，她继续读，詹姆斯·斯派德继续拍打。
remmethod: 本词(拟声词根) → 拍击；鞭策前进

en: Overload is also a noun
ex1_en: 57 percent complained of work overload.
ex1_zh: 57%的人抱怨工作负担过重。
remmethod: over(过度) + load(装载) → 使负担太重

en: a young girl, or a woman who is not married
ex1_en: In 1912, the Titanic sank on her maiden voyage.
ex1_zh: 1912年，泰坦尼克号首次航行时沉没。
remmethod: 来自maid(n. 少女)

en: to correct something that is wrong
ex1_en: I did my best to rectify the situation, but the damage was already done.
ex1_zh: 我竭尽全力去挽回局面，但损害已经造成了。
remmethod: rect(直) ＋ ify(使…) → 使…直 → 纠正

en: a large number or great variety of things
ex1_en: It also explains why we use a specific multiplicity in the correspondence.
ex1_zh: 它还解释了我们在通讯中使用特定多重性的原因。
remmethod: 来自multiple(adj. 多种多样的)

zh: 单片电路, 单块集成电路
ex1_en: This monolithic environment for an application eliminated any concern about which clock to use -- because there was only one clock.
ex1_zh: 对于一个应用程序的这个单块集成电路环境消除了使用哪个时钟的问题 —— 因为只有一个时钟。
remmethod: mono(单个的) + lith(石头) + ic → 单块大石头的 → 巨大的

en: a unit for measuring grain and fruit (equal in volume to 8 gallons)
ex1_en: Grains are sold by the bushel.
ex1_zh: 谷物论蒲式耳出售。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 蒲式耳（容量单位）

en: a large building divided into apartments, especially in the poorer areas of a city
remmethod: ten(十) + e + men(人) + t → 十个人住一间屋子 → 廉租公寓

ex1_en: They feared that the publicity surrounding him would detract from their own election campaigns.
ex1_zh: 他们担心围绕他的宣传会有损他们自已的竞选活动。
remmethod: de(向下) + tract(拉) → 向下拉 → 去掉， 减损

ex1_en: If an entry is only sparsely filled in, the results may look more like Figure 8.
ex1_zh: 如果一个条目只填充了稀疏的内容，那么结果看上去就像图 8 那样。
remmethod: spars(散开) + e + ly(副词后缀) → 稀疏地

en: a confusing and difficult problem
ex1_en: the conundrum of our purpose on Earth
ex1_zh: 我们为何目的活在世上这一难题
remmethod: con + und (看作under) + (d) rum (鼓) → 全部蒙在鼓里 → 谜语

en: the ability to imagine what is likely to happen and to consider this when planning for the future
ex1_en: It was an example of the authorities’ lack of foresight .
ex1_zh: 这是当权者缺乏远见的一个例证。
remmethod: fore(预先) + sight(眼光) → 有预见的眼光 → 远见

en: when gas, water etc leaks in or out, or the amount of it that has leaked
ex1_en: a leakage of toxic waste into the sea
ex1_zh: 有毒废物的泄漏入海
remmethod: 来自leak(v. 泄漏)

en: a metal pin used to fasten pieces of metal together
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 铆钉

en: to physically punish someone
ex1_en: ‘You’re a fool,’ she chastised herself.
ex1_zh: “你真傻。”她自责道。
remmethod: 追赶(chase)上小偷进行严惩(chastise)

en: containing or consisting of salt
ex1_en: saline solution
ex1_zh: 盐溶液
remmethod: sal(盐) + ine → 含盐的， 咸的

en: someone who owns or works in a shop that sells food and other things used in the home
ex1_en: The cook and the grocer haggled over the price of eggs.
ex1_zh: 厨师和杂货商为蛋价计较个没完。
remmethod: groc(批发) + er(表人) → 食品商；杂货店

en: unfriendly and deliberately not talking to other people
ex1_en: Beneath that aloof exterior, Gayle is a warm, sympathetic person.
ex1_zh: 在冷漠的外表下，盖尔是个有同情心的热心人。
remmethod: a (…的) + loof (看作roof, 屋顶) → 战争过后， 只剩一个孤零的屋顶 → 孤零的

en: the experience of being made to feel less tired or hot
ex1_en: a place to rest and find refreshment for mind and body
ex1_zh: 休息和恢复身心的场所
remmethod: 来自refresh〔v. (使)精神振作〕

en: the dry outer part of corn, some grains, seeds, nuts etc
ex1_en: How can we remove the husk of the grains?
ex1_zh: 我们怎样去掉谷物的外皮？
remmethod: husk(自身词根) → 皮；外壳

en: to read something, especially in a careful way
ex1_en: She leant forward to peruse the document more closely.
ex1_zh: 她俯身向前，更仔细地读那份文件。
remmethod: per(始终) ＋ us(用) + e → 反复用 → 细读， 精读

en: friendly but quite polite and formal
ex1_en: The talks were conducted in a cordial atmosphere.
ex1_zh: 会谈在友好的气氛中进行。
remmethod: cord(心脏)+ial(…的)→真心待人的→诚恳的

en: a fast method of writing using special signs or shorter forms to represent letters, words, and phrases
ex1_en: a secretary who takes shorthand (= writes in shorthand )
ex1_zh: 会速记的秘书
remmethod: short(短的) + hand(手) → 人手短缺时， 也不影响记录的速度 → 速记

en: (of birds) to move the beak forward quickly and hit or bite sth
ex1_en: birds pecking at breadcrumbs on the pavement
ex1_zh: 在人行道上啄食面包屑的鸟儿
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 啄；小口地吃

en: a small group, society, or place that has the same qualities as a much larger one
ex1_en: In each one of these places you will find a microcosm of molecules which directly impact the look, smell, touch, and sound of everything that you see.
ex1_zh: 在每一个这样的地方，你都可以发现分子的微观世界，它们会直接影响你所见物质的外观、气味、触感和声音。
remmethod: micro(微小的) + cosm(宇宙， 世界) → 微观世界

zh: 香脂油， 药膏； 镇痛剂， 安慰剂
en: an oily liquid with a strong pleasant smell that you rub into your skin, often to reduce pain
ex1_en: lip balm
ex1_zh: 润唇膏
remmethod: 来自balsam(n. 风仙花； 香脂)

en: based on instinct and not involving thought
ex1_en: a mother’s instinctive love
ex1_zh: 母亲本能的爱
remmethod: 来自instinct(n. 本能)

ex1_en: You said in your address that "developing excellence is a slow, painstaking process".
ex1_zh: 你在你的致词中说“发展卓越性是一个缓慢艰苦的过程”。
remmethod: pains(痛苦) + taking(花费…的) → 煞费苦心的

en: grandfather
ex1_en: Grandpa was not yet back from the war.
ex1_zh: 爷爷那时还没从战场归来。
remmethod: grand(隔代的) + pa(爸) → 爷爷；外公

en: to quarrel or fight in a noisy way, especially in a public place
ex1_en: Fans brawled outside the stadium.
ex1_zh: 球迷们在体育馆外面闹事。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 争吵

en: pleased with a situation, especially something you have achieved, so that you stop trying to improve or change things – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: There’s a danger of becoming complacent if you win a few games.
ex1_zh: 赢了几场比赛可能就会变得沾沾自喜。
remmethod: 注意不要和complaisant(adj. 随和的)相混

zh: 秘密的, 含义模糊的
en: having a meaning that is mysterious or not easily understood
ex1_en: He has issued a short, cryptic statement denying the spying charges.
ex1_zh: 他发表了一个简短、令人捉摸不透的声明，否认对他从事间谍活动的指控。
remmethod: crypt(秘密) + ic → 秘密的

en: always doing what you are told to do, or what the law, a rule etc says you must do
ex1_en: an obedient child
ex1_zh: 听话的孩子
remmethod: 来自obey(v. 服从)

en: friendly, welcoming, and generous to visitors
ex1_en: The local people were very kind and hospitable.
ex1_zh: 当地人非常友好热情。
remmethod: 这家主人 (host) 很好客 (hospitable)

en: very bad, unpleasant, or unkind
ex1_en: It was all the fault of that hateful man!
ex1_zh: 都是那个可恶的人造的孽！

ex1_zh: 我全身刺痛，头疼欲裂。

ex1_zh: 为预防马铃薯枯萎病你惟一能做的就是留意你的庄稼。
remmethod: b + light (光) → 植物无光便死亡 → 毁灭

en: A pueblo is a village, especially in the southwestern United States
ex1_en: There are several dozen Indian pueblos near Santa Fe.
ex1_zh: 圣达菲附近有几十个印第安人村庄。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 印第安人村庄

ex1_en: As a result, the research has the potential to change the way a paleontologist views a fossil.
ex1_zh: 现在，研究者们已经拥有了改变一个古生物学家观察化石方式的潜力。
remmethod: 来自paleontology(n. 古生物学)

en: to join metals by melting their edges and pressing them together when they are hot
ex1_en: The new handle will have to be welded on.
ex1_zh: 新的把手得焊上去。
remmethod: wel(看作well， 好)+d(看作do， 做)→焊接工人做得很好→焊接

zh: 兴高采烈的；得意洋洋的
en: extremely happy and excited, especially because of something that has happened or is going to happen
ex1_en: He felt elated and mildly drunk.
ex1_zh: 他感到欢欣鼓舞，而且喝得有点醉了。
remmethod: e + lat(放) + ed → 放出(高兴神态) → 得意洋洋的

en: the activity of travelling in a small boat for pleasure
ex1_en: Let’s go boating on the lake.
ex1_zh: 我们到湖上划船去吧。
remmethod: boat(船) + ing(名词后缀) → 划船

zh: 壮观地, 令人吃惊地
remmethod: spect(看) + acul(表小/工具) + ar(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 值得看的 → 壮观地，令人吃惊地

en: willing to obey or to agree to other people’s wishes and demands
ex1_en: For years I had tried to be a compliant and dutiful wife.
ex1_zh: 多年来我都在努力做一个顺从尽职的妻子。
remmethod: com + pliant(柔顺的) → 顺从的
aggress(攻击；进取) + ive(形容词后缀) + ness(名词后缀) → 进取精神；侵犯

zh: 古怪的；奇异的；异国风格的；偏僻的
en: strange and unusual
ex1_en: outlandish clothes
ex1_zh: 奇装异服
remmethod: out(出) + land(国家) + ish → 从外国来的 → 古怪的

en: If you say that one thing is tantamount to another, more serious thing, you are emphasizing how bad, unacceptable, or unfortunate the first thing is by comparing it to the second thing
ex1_en: What Bracey is saying is tantamount to heresy.
ex1_zh: 布里斯正在说的无异于异端邪说。
remmethod: tant(相等) + a + mount(数量) → 同等的， 相当于

ex1_en: moral inferiority
ex1_zh: 道德低下
remmethod: inferior(下等的) + ity(名词后缀) → 自卑；次等

ex1_en: Moisten the clay if it seems too dry.
ex1_zh: 如果黏土太干，就把它润润湿。
remmethod: 来自moist(adj. 潮湿的)

en: a place where beer is made, or a company that makes beer
ex1_en: The brewery will remain open to the public throughout its ten-year transformation, so the architects wanted to test how a construction site can be used for public activities.
ex1_zh: 啤酒厂在它转型的十年内都将持续对公众开放，所以建筑师希望测试一个施工基地怎样才能用于公共活动。
remmethod: brew(酿造) + ery(场所) → 啤酒厂

ex1_en: A string of scandals is obsessing America.
ex1_zh: 一系列丑闻在困扰着美国。
remmethod: ob(反) + sess(=sit坐) → 坐着不动， 妨碍前进 → 迷住； 使…困扰

en: direct and honest - used in order to show approval
ex1_en: She answered in her usual forthright manner .
ex1_zh: 她以一贯的直率作了回答。
remmethod: forth (向前) + right (对的) → 他坚持向前走， 认为是对的 → 径直的

en: a clear liquid that is painted onto things, especially things made of wood, to protect them, or the hard shiny surface produced by this
ex1_en: The varnish comes in six natural wood shades.
ex1_zh: 这种清漆有6种天然木材的色泽可选。
remmethod: 涂上清漆(varnish)， 这个图案就不容易消失(vanish)了

en: far from the centre of a city, town etc or from a main building
ex1_en: one of the outlying suburbs
ex1_zh: 边远郊区之一
remmethod: out(外) + lying(躺着的) → 躺在外面的 → 边远的

zh: 客观的， 无私的， 公正的； 无兴趣的， 不关心的
en: able to judge a situation fairly because you are not concerned with gaining any personal advantage from it
ex1_en: A lawyer should provide disinterested advice.
ex1_zh: 律师应该提供客观公正的建议。
remmethod: 注意区别uninterested(adj. 不感兴趣的)

en: relating to movement
ex1_en: kinetic energy
ex1_zh: 动能
remmethod: kinet(动) + ic → 运动的

en: to do what someone else wants, or allow something to happen, even though you do not really agree with it
ex1_en: Steve seemed to acquiesce in the decision.
ex1_zh: 斯蒂夫看样子默许了这个决定。
remmethod: ac(表加强) + qui(安静的) + esce → 变得非常安静 → 默许， 默认

zh: 投掷, 毛皮 v剥的皮, 投掷
en: the skin of a dead animal, especially with the fur or hair still on it
remmethod: pelt(本词自身词根) → 投掷；疾行；毛皮

en: very shocking and immoral
ex1_en: a heinous crime
ex1_zh: 滔天罪行
remmethod: he(他) + in + ous(音似： 恶死) → 他在恶死中 → 十恶不赦的

en: If you do someone or something a disservice, you harm them in some way
ex1_en: He said the protesters were doing a disservice to the nation.
ex1_zh: 他表示，抗议者们的行为正对国家造成危害。
remmethod: dis(否定；坏) + serv(服务) + ice(名词后缀) → 伤害，帮倒忙

en: a coat that you wear to protect yourself from rain
ex1_en: He dipped in his raincoat pocket.
ex1_zh: 他把手深深地伸进雨衣口袋里。
remmethod: rain(下雨)+coat(外套)→下雨时穿的外套→雨衣

zh: 培养的器具, 孵卵器
en: a heated container for keeping eggs warm until they hatch(= the young birds are born )
remmethod: in(在内) + cub(躺) + ator(器具/表物) → 孵卵器；保育器

zh: 复仇， 报仇； 向…报仇
en: to do something to hurt or punish someone because they have harmed or offended you
ex1_en: He wanted to avenge his brother’s death.
ex1_zh: 他要为弟弟的死复仇。
remmethod: a(对) + veng(惩戒) + e → 对某人进行惩戒 → 报仇， 复仇， 向(某人)报仇

ex1_en: "This is probably one of the worst storms since 1990," a meteorologist in Seattle said.
ex1_zh: 西雅图气象专家表示，这也许是自1990年以来最严重的暴风雪。
remmethod: meteor(气象) + olog(学科) + ist(表人) → 气象学者

en: a reduction in the value or price of something
ex1_en: the depreciation of the dollar
ex1_zh: 美元的贬值
remmethod: 来自depreciate(v. 贬值)

en: strong string made by twisting together two or more threads or strings
ex1_en: a bundle of papers tied up with twine
ex1_zh: 用双股线捆扎起来的一摞文件
remmethod: 大家应该像双胞胎(twins)一样拧成一股绳(twine)， 齐心协力把这件事做好

zh: 荣誉；荣誉称号授予仪式；连谱号；称赞
en: If someone is given an accolade, something is done or said about them which shows how much people admire them
ex1_en: The Nobel Prize has become the ultimate accolade in the sciences.
ex1_zh: 诺贝尔奖已成为科学界的最高荣誉。
remmethod: ac(附近) + col(脖子) + ade → 挂在脖子附近 → 赞扬

en: A potion is a drink that contains medicine, poison, or something that is supposed to have magic powers
ex1_en: a magic potion
ex1_zh: 魔法药水
remmethod: 可以和portion (一份) 结合起来记

en: a large round pale yellow vegetable that grows under the ground, or the plant that produces it
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 芜菁（甘蓝）

en: not affected or influenced by something and seeming not to notice it
ex1_en: impervious volcanic rock
ex1_zh: 不透水的火山岩
remmethod: im(不) + pervious(渗透的) → 不能渗透的

en: to refuse to accept something or someone, especially because you are too proud
ex1_en: She spurned all offers of help.
ex1_zh: 她骄傲地拒绝一切帮助。
remmethod: 那个人拒绝(spurn)给他的马用马刺(spur)

en: someone you tell your secrets to or who you talk to about personal things
remmethod: con(完全) + fid(相信) + ant(表人， 名词后缀) → 完全相信的人 → 知己， 密友

en: a game played for money or prizes, in which numbers are chosen by chance and called out, and if you have the right numbers on your card, you win
ex1_en: Vera won £20 at bingo.
ex1_zh: 薇拉玩宾戈赢了20英镑。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 宾戈游戏

en: expressing strong personal emotions such as love, in a way that is similar to music in its sounds and  rhythm
ex1_en: Wordsworth was one of the greatest lyric poets of his time.
ex1_zh: 华兹华斯是他那个时代最伟大的抒情诗人之一。
remmethod: ly(看做lying， 躺) + ric → 躺在星空下 → 抒情的

en: someone who believes that governments, laws etc are not necessary
ex1_en: West Berlin always had a large anarchist community.
ex1_zh: 西柏林一直存在一个大的无政府主义群体。
remmethod: an(无) + arch(统治) + ist(表人) → 无政府主义者

en: an insect that lives mainly in Asia and Africa and flies in a very large group, eating and destroying crops
ex1_en: a swarm of locusts
ex1_zh: 一大群蝗虫
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 蝗虫；蚱蜢；蝉

zh: 劝告， 规劝， 告诫
en: If you exhort someone to do something, you try hard to persuade or encourage them to do it
ex1_en: Kennedy exhorted his listeners to turn away from violence.
ex1_zh: 肯尼迪劝告他的听众要远离暴力。
remmethod: ex(表加强) + hort(催促) → 强烈地催促 → 劝告， 规劝， 告诫

en: a philanthropic person or institution gives money and help to people who are poor or in trouble
ex1_en: Some of the best services for the seniors are sponsored by philanthropic organizations.
ex1_zh: 一些一流老人服务机构是由慈善组织资助的。
remmethod: phil(爱) + anthrop(人) + ic → 爱人的 → 慈善的

en: able to float or keep things floating
ex1_en: Cork is very buoyant.
ex1_zh: 软木浮性很好。
remmethod: 来自buoy(n. 浮标)

zh: 赦免；无罪开释；履行；尽职；（债务等的）清偿
remmethod: 原告放弃 (quit) 起诉， 被告被宣判无罪 (acquittal)

en: to make someone realize that something which they thought was true or good is not really true or good
ex1_en: I hate to disillusion you, but I don’t think she’s coming back.
ex1_zh: 我真不愿意让你失望，但我想她是不会回来了。
remmethod: dis(不)＋illusion(幻想) → 不再有幻想 → 使梦想破灭， 使醒悟

zh: 人道主义者, 人文主义者
ex1_en: Vernon said that as he watched the tsunami come ashore, he was unable to divorce the scientist in him from the humanist.
ex1_zh: 弗兰克说，当他观看到海啸逼近的时候，他不能使自己从科学家和人道主义者中脱离出来。
remmethod: human(人) + ist(表人/主义者) → 人道主义者；人文主义者

zh: 教学大纲， 课程提纲
en: a plan that states exactly what students at a school or college should learn in a particular subject
ex1_en: The course syllabus consisted mainly of novels by African-American authors, male and female.
ex1_zh: 该课程的教学大纲主要包括了非裔美国男女作家的小说。
remmethod: syl(一起) + lab(拿) + us → 把(不同的课程)拿到一起 → 教学大纲

en: If you censure someone for something that they have done, you tell them that you strongly disapprove of it
ex1_en: The ethics committee may take a decision to admonish him or to censure him.
ex1_zh: 道德规范委员会可能决定对他进行警告或批评。
remmethod: 检查员 (censor) 趁机责难 (censure)

ex1_en: a perceptive young man
ex1_zh: 一个观察敏锐的年轻人
remmethod: 来自percept (n. 感觉； 感受)

en: dirt, especially a lot of it
ex1_en: a mound of filth and rubbish
ex1_zh: 一堆脏东西和垃圾
remmethod: 和filch(v. 偷)一起记

en: covered with  slime  , or wet and slippery like slime
ex1_en: slimy mud
ex1_zh: 黏糊糊的泥巴
remmethod: slime(黏液) + y(形容词后缀) → 粘糊糊的；泥泞的

en: an insect that has long back legs for jumping and that makes short loud noises
ex1_en: One day a grasshopper came upon an ant at work in a garden.
ex1_zh: 一天， 蚱蜢碰到了一只正在花园里干活的蚂蚁。
remmethod: grass(草地) + hopper(跳跃者) → 草地上的跳跃者 → 蚂蚱

en: the act of making something shorter
ex1_en: There was a lot of condensation on the windows.
ex1_zh: 窗户上有许多水珠。
remmethod: 来自condense(v. 凝结； 精简， 压缩)

zh: 渴望的；沉思的，默想的；引起怀念的；不满足似的
en: thinking sadly about something you would like to have but cannot have, especially something that you used to have in the past
ex1_en: a wistful smile
ex1_zh: 怅然若失的微笑
remmethod: 和wishful (a. 怀有希望的) 一起记

en: the process of spreading things over a wide area or in different directions
ex1_en: the role of birds in the dispersal of seeds
ex1_zh: 鸟类对传播种子的作用
remmethod: di(分开) + spers(散播) + al → 分散开 → 疏散； 散布

en: covered with spots or coloured areas
ex1_en: His red, mottled face showed the effect of too much whisky.
ex1_zh: 他那张红红的、满是斑点的脸表明，他威士忌喝得太多了。
remmethod: “毛头的” → 头发颜色多的 → 有杂色的

zh: 优雅的；轻飘的；缥缈的；超凡的
en: very delicate and light, in a way that does not seem real
ex1_en: ethereal beauty
ex1_zh: 超凡的美丽
remmethod: 来自ether(n. 太空； 苍天)

en: willing to do dangerous things or go to dangerous places – often used humorously
ex1_en: intrepid explorers
ex1_zh: 勇敢的探险家
remmethod: in(不) + trep(害怕) + id → 不害怕的 → 勇敢的， 无畏的

en: neoclassical art or architecture copies the style of ancient Greece or Rome
ex1_en: a palace built in a neoclassical style
ex1_zh: 新古典主义风格的宫殿
remmethod: neo(新) + classical(古典的) → 新古典主义的

en: to gradually take more of someone’s time, possessions, rights etc than you should
ex1_en: The new institutions do not encroach on political power.
ex1_zh: 这些新机构没有侵犯到政治权力。
remmethod: en(进入) + croach(钩) → 钩进去 → 侵占

ex1_en: He struck at one with his knife lashed to the end of an oar and watched the scavenger sliding down into deep water.
ex1_zh: 他用绑在桨的一头的刀子击中了其中的一条，并看着这条食腐动物滑到深海里去了。
remmethod: 来自scavenge(v. 拾荒， 捡破烂； 以腐肉为食)

zh: 谋划， 策划； 设法做到； 设计， 想出
en: to succeed in doing something in spite of difficulties
ex1_en: The lawsuit says oil companies contrived the oil shortage in the 1970s.
ex1_zh: 诉讼中说，是石油公司策划了20世纪70年代的油荒。
remmethod: contri(看作contra， 反) + ve(=vene走) → (和普通人不同)反着走 → 设计， 发明

zh: 呕吐的；不稳定的；催吐的
en: feeling that you are going to vomit
ex1_en: The sea got rougher, and I began to feel queasy.
ex1_zh: 海上风浪更猛了，我开始感到有点恶心想吐。
remmethod: qu (看作quite, 很) + easy (轻松) → 笑一笑， 十年少， 不必忧虑 → 忧虑的

en: to write or print a libel against someone
ex1_en: The newspaper which libelled him had already offered compensation.
ex1_zh: 那家诽谤他的报纸已经提出赔偿。
remmethod: lib(文字) + el → 以文字损害名誉 → (文字)诽谤

en: one of the possible different forms of an atom of a particular  element
remmethod: iso(等， 同) + tope → 同位素

zh: 表现出优越感的；居高临下的
en: behaving as though you think you are better, more intelligent, or more important than other people – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: Professor Hutter’s manner is extremely conde-scending.
ex1_zh: 赫特教授的态度极为傲慢。
remmethod: 来自condescend(v. 屈尊)

ex1_en: Water enters air via evaporation.
ex1_zh: 水通过蒸发进入空气。
remmethod: 来自evaporate(v. 蒸发； 消失)； e(出) + vapor(水汽) + ate(使…) → 使水汽出去 → 蒸发

ex1_en: His wife was sentenced to seven years imprisonment for aiding and abetting him.
ex1_zh: 他的妻子因与他同谋被判决关押七年。
remmethod: a + bet(赌博) → 教唆赌博 → 教唆

en: a male member of the clergy
ex1_en: "Then I need ask no further," said the clergyman, somewhat hastily rising from his chair.
ex1_zh: “这样看来，我就不必多问了，”牧师说着，有点匆忙地从椅子上站起身。
remmethod: clergy(神职人员) + man(人) → 神职人员 → 牧师；教士

en: a piece of equipment that changes the form of something, especially so that it can be more easily used
ex1_en: a converter that allows you to view digital television on your old TV
ex1_zh: 让你可以在旧电视机上收看数字电视的转换器
remmethod: con(加强) + vert(转) + er(表物) → 转炉

ex1_en: a series of grisly murders
ex1_zh: 一连串恐怖的凶杀案
remmethod: g (音似： 赶； 赶快) + ris (看作rise， 起来) + ly → 看到恐怖的东西， 赶紧起身逃跑

en: if something perplexes you, it makes you feel confused and worried because it is difficult to understand
ex1_en: Shea’s symptoms perplexed the doctors.
ex1_zh: 谢伊的症状令医生们困惑。
remmethod: per(假， 坏) ＋ plex(重叠) → 虚假的东西重叠在一起 → 使困惑， 使费解

zh: 大惊小怪的，小题大做的
ex1_en: A lot of small children are fussy eaters (= they dislike many types of food ) .
ex1_zh: 许多小孩子挑食。
remmethod: fuss(大惊小怪) + y(形容词后缀) → 大惊小怪的

en: a central point or pin on which something balances or turns
ex1_en: The pedal had sheared off at the pivot.
ex1_zh: 这个踏板已经在轴处断裂。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 枢轴；支点；中心点

en: to protect a person or animal from a disease by giving them a vaccine
ex1_en: All children should be vaccinated against measles.
ex1_zh: 所有儿童都应该接种麻疹疫苗。
remmethod: 来自vaccine (n. 牛痘苗， 疫苗)

en: the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced
ex1_en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
ex1_zh: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。
remmethod: pro(向前) + nunci(说；宣告) + ation(名词后缀) → 向前说出 → 发音

en: Malaise is a state in which people feel dissatisfied or unhappy but feel unable to change, usually because they do not know what is wrong
ex1_en: He complained of depression, headaches, and malaise.
ex1_zh: 他说他有情绪低落、头痛和不安的症状。
remmethod: “没累死” → 差点没累死 → 不适

en: harmful or poisonous
ex1_en: noxious fumes
ex1_zh: 有毒烟雾
remmethod: nox(毒) + ious → 有毒的

en: the nut of the  oak  tree
ex1_en: First an acorn; then an oak tree forest.
ex1_zh: 先有一颗橡子，然后有了一片橡树森林。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → [植]橡树果, 橡子

zh: 繁重的；麻烦的；负有义务的；负有法律责任的
en: work or a responsibility that is onerous is difficult and worrying or makes you tired
ex1_en: an onerous task
ex1_zh: 艰巨的任务
remmethod: oner(负担) + ous → 负担重的 → 繁重的

ex1_en: As a mother, I agonize over what my children will inherit.
ex1_zh: 作为一个母亲，我对我的孩子们将要继承的东西感到极度痛苦。
remmethod: agon(挣扎) + ize → 苦苦挣扎 → 苦苦思索

en: Something that is detectable can be noticed or discovered
ex1_en: Doctors say the disease is probably inherited but not detectable at birth.
ex1_zh: 医生们说该疾病很可能是遗传的，但在出生时是不可发现的。
remmethod: de(去除；打开) + tect(覆盖) + able(可…的) → 可发现的；可察觉的

zh: 报应；给与惩罚的人；天罚
en: a punishment that is deserved and cannot be avoided
ex1_en: The new mathematics test will become the nemesis of teachers.
ex1_zh: 新的数学测试将会是对老师们的严重惩罚。
remmethod: 来自希腊神话中的复仇女神Nemesis

en: to destroy something or someone completely
ex1_en: Just one of these bombs could annihilate a city the size of New York.
ex1_zh: 这种炸弹只要一颗就能彻底毁灭纽约那么大的一座城市。
remmethod: an(接近) + nihil(无) + ate → 使接近没有 → 消灭

en: demanding a lot of effort, careful work, or skill
ex1_en: She was an exacting woman to work for.
ex1_zh: 她是一位对下属要求严格的女性。
remmethod: exact (强求) + ing (…的) → 强求的 → 苛求的

en: a large bird, the male of which has long blue and green tail feathers that it can lift up and spread out
ex1_en: peacock feathers
ex1_zh: 孔雀翎
remmethod: pea(孔雀) + cock(公鸡) → 孔雀

en: a precocious child shows intelligence or skill at a very young age, or behaves in an adult way – sometimes used to show disapproval in British English
ex1_en: a precocious child who walked and talked early
ex1_zh: 走路和说话都早的早熟儿童
remmethod: pre(预先) + coc(煮) + ious → 提前煮好的 → 早熟的

en: impossible to remove or forget
ex1_en: Her words left an indelible impression on me for years to come.
ex1_zh: 她的话多年来我都难以忘怀。
remmethod: in(不) + de(消失) + li(=liv 石灰) + ble → 用石灰无法去掉的 → 擦拭不掉的

en: a tall African animal with a very long neck and legs and dark spots on its yellow-brown fur
ex1_en: Can I get the mommy giraffe for Christmas?
ex1_zh: 我在圣诞节能得到一个长颈鹿妈妈吗？
remmethod: giraffe(长颈鹿) → 长颈鹿

en: a North American tree with seeds that look like white cotton
remmethod: cotton(棉) + wood(木) → [植]三叶杨

zh: 不知足的, 贪求无厌的
en: always wanting more and more of something
ex1_en: A section of the reading public has an insatiable appetite for dirty stories about the famous.
ex1_zh: 阅读大众中有一部分人对名人的风流韵事的欲望总是无法满足。
remmethod: in(不) + sati(填满) + able → 填不满的 → 不知足的

en: when something becomes entangled in something
remmethod: en(使进入) + tangle(纠缠) + ment(名词后缀) → 纠缠

zh: 不适当；不正确；用词错误；[审计] 不正当行为
en: behaviour or an action that is wrong or unacceptable according to moral, social, or professional standards
ex1_en: Accusations of impropriety were made against the company’s directors.
ex1_zh: 对公司董事不正当的行为提出了指控。
remmethod: im (不) + propriety (适当) → 不适当

en: if a  whale  spouts, it sends out a stream of water from a hole in its head
ex1_en: He replaced the boiler when the last one began to spout flames.
ex1_zh: 原来的锅炉开始喷射火焰之后他便更换了一个。
remmethod: sp(看作speak， 说)+out(出) → 一直不停地说话 → 滔滔不绝地讲

ex1_en: I saw this policy of “purification” up close.
ex1_zh: 我目睹的了“净化”政策的整个过程。
remmethod: 来自purify(v. 净化； 使…纯净)

zh: 图解的； 纲要的； 严谨的
en: showing the main parts of something in a simple way
ex1_en: a schematic diagram of DNA
ex1_zh: 脱氧核糖核酸结构简图
remmethod: 来自schema(n. 图表； 纲要)

zh: 令人震惊的；令人惊骇的
en: so surprising that it is almost impossible to believe
ex1_en: The concert was an astounding success.
ex1_zh: 音乐会出奇地成功。
remmethod: 来自astound (vt. 使惊骇)

en: actions, reactions, decisions etc that are justifiable are acceptable because they are done for good reasons
ex1_en: justifiable anger
ex1_zh: 情有可原的愤怒
remmethod: 来自justify(v. 证明…是正当或合理的)

ex1_en: Then it’s really no more than a means of transportation, it too loses its luster.
ex1_zh: 然后它就仅仅是一个名符其实的交通工具，失去了它的光彩。
remmethod: lus(光) + ter → 光辉

en: Decomposition is the process of decay that takes place when a living thing changes chemically after dying
ex1_en: So no one decomposition is sufficient.
ex1_zh: 因此一种分解是不够的。
remmethod: de(去除；向下) + com(共同) + pos(放置) + ition(名词后缀) → 分解；腐烂

zh: 变温和，变宽厚；减弱；缓和
en: to change your attitude and become less strict or cruel towards someone
ex1_en: At last her father relented and came to visit her.
ex1_zh: 最后她父亲的态度软化，去看了她。
remmethod: re + lent(柔软的) → 心肠软了下来 → 变温和， 变宽厚

en: a sea creature with eight tentacles (= arms )
remmethod: octo(八) + pus(脚) → 长八只脚的鱼 → 章鱼
block(阻塞) + age(名词后缀) → 封锁；妨碍

en: a small young fish that is often packed in flat metal boxes when it is sold as food
ex1_en: commuters packed like sardines on the evening train
ex1_zh: 晚班火车上挤得像沙丁鱼一样的通勤乘客
remmethod: sard(沙丁) + ine(名词后缀) → 沙丁鱼

zh: 顽童, [动物]刺猥, [动物]海胆
ex1_en: The spines of the omnivorous pencil-spined urchin extend outward from its body.
ex1_zh: 这个铅笔状的杂食性海胆的刺从它们的身体里伸出来。
remmethod: “恶惩” → 小孩吓唬吓唬就算了， 可不能恶惩 → 小淘气

en: to happen at exactly the same time, or to arrange for two or more actions to happen at exactly the same time
ex1_en: It was virtually impossible to synchronize our lives so as to take vacations and weekends together.
ex1_zh: 为了一起度假和过周末而要让我们的生活同步几乎是不可能的。
remmethod: syn(相同) + chron(时间) + ize(动词后缀) → 有着相同的时间 → (使)同步， 同时发生

ex1_en: Similar to us, birds learn to sing by mimicking the adults, and the early chirps are akin to a baby's babble.
ex1_zh: 和人类一样，鸟类通过模仿长者学习鸣叫，最开始鸣叫时类似于婴儿的牙牙学语。
remmethod: 婴儿(baby)学说话时， 说得含糊不清(babble)

en: to refuse to do what someone with authority tells you to do, or refuse to obey a rule or law
ex1_en: You disobeyed my orders.
ex1_zh: 你违抗我的命令。
remmethod: dis(不) + obey(服从) → 不服从， 违抗

en: a person or organization that disagrees with an official decision or accepted opinion
ex1_en: Political dissenters were imprisoned.
ex1_zh: 持不同政见者遭到监禁。
remmethod: dis(分离) + sent(想法) + er(表人， 名词后缀) → 没有相同想法的人 → 不同意者

en: to exchange goods, work, or services for other goods or services rather than for money
ex1_en: They have been bartering wheat for cotton and timber.
ex1_zh: 他们一直在用小麦交换棉花和木材。
remmethod: 和banter(v. 打趣)一起记

en: to take someone else’s power, position, job etc when you do not have the right to
ex1_en: There were a couple of attempts to usurp the young king.
ex1_zh: 屡次有人企图篡夺那位年轻国王的王位。
remmethod: us (看作use， 利用) + urp (看作up， 上去) → 用 (阴谋) 上台 → 篡夺

en: to form or join a line of people or vehicles waiting to do something or go somewhere
ex1_en: File not in print queue.
ex1_zh: 文件不在打印队列中。
remmethod: q站在前面， 后面跟着ue ＋ ue， 真是一长队 → 长队

zh: 英式橄榄球；拉格比（英格兰中部的城市）
en: an outdoor game played by two teams with an  oval (= egg-shaped )  ball that you kick or carry
ex1_en: I ghosted his weekly rugby column for the Telegraph.
ex1_zh: 我为他代写《电讯报》每周的橄榄球专栏。
remmethod: 地毯(rug)上有一只镶了红宝石(ruby)的橄榄球(rugby)
con(共同) + vent(来) + ion(名词后缀) + al(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 照惯例

en: doing something that is intended to make someone stop arguing with you
ex1_en: Brooks felt in no mood to be conciliatory.
ex1_zh: 布鲁克斯不想作出和解。
remmethod: 来自conciliate(v. 调和， 安慰)

en: a group of lines in a repeated pattern forming part of a poem
ex1_en: The poem's first stanza tells how the speaker meets a fellow "nobody" — a friend.
ex1_zh: 这首诗的第一段描写诗人如何遇到了另一位“无名小卒”-- 一位朋友。
remmethod: stan(站住)+za → 诗中停顿的地方 → 节， 段

en: someone who leaves their own country to live in another
remmethod: e(出) + migr(迁移) + ant(表人) → 移居外国者；移民

en: failing to achieve what was wanted, especially after a lot of effort
ex1_en: So far, their search has been fruitless.
ex1_zh: 到目前为止，他们的搜寻工作毫无结果。
remmethod: fruit(果实) + less(无) → 不结果实的

ex1_en: We must arouse them to fight for their own emancipation.
ex1_zh: 我们必须使他们行动起来为他们自己的解放而斗争。
remmethod: e(出) ＋ man(手) ＋ cip(抓住) ＋ ation → 把被抓的手放出来 → 解放， 释放

zh: [电子] 放大器，扩大器；扩音器
en: a piece of electrical equipment that makes sound louder
ex1_en: The transistor is an amplifier.
ex1_zh: 晶体管是一个放大器。
remmethod: 来自amplify(v. 放大， 扩大)

en: a voluminous container is very large and can hold a lot of things
ex1_en: a voluminous suitcase
ex1_zh: 一个能装很多东西的手提箱
remmethod: volum(=volume容量) + in + ous → 大量的

ex1_en: Like his father, he hopes to become a naval aviator.
ex1_zh: 与父亲一样，他希望成为海军飞行员。
remmethod: 来自aviate(v. 飞行)

en: a slight idea about something
ex1_en: I had an inkling that she was pregnant.
ex1_zh: 我隐约知道她怀孕了。
remmethod: ink(墨水) + ling(小东西) → 小墨迹 → 暗示

en: having many parts or sides
ex1_en: a multifaceted campaign to reduce teen pregnancy
ex1_zh: 一个涉及多方面的减少少女怀孕的运动
remmethod: multi(多) + facet(面) + ed(形容词后缀) → 多层面的

en: to involve someone or something in a difficult situation
ex1_en: Any hostilities could result in retaliation and further embroil U.N. troops in fighting.
ex1_zh: 任何敌对活动都可能会招致报复，进而使联合国部队卷入战斗中。
remmethod: em (进入…之中) + broil (争吵) → 进入争吵之中 → 使卷入

en: being certain that you are right about something and refusing to change your opinion in any way
ex1_en: her father’s steadfast love for her
ex1_zh: 她父亲对她永不改变的爱
remmethod: stead(=stand站) + fast(稳固的) → 不变的

ex1_en: When he spoke I was expected to reciprocate with some remark of my own.
ex1_zh: 他在说话时，我也应该说点什么回应他。
remmethod: 来自reciproc (al) (相互的) + ate → 互给

ex1_en: Maybe that's the definition of predictability?
ex1_zh: 也许那就是可预测性的定义？
remmethod: predict(预测) + abil(能…的) + ity(名词后缀) → 可预见性

en: dependent on someone or something
ex1_en: These people are not wholly reliant on Western charity.
ex1_zh: 这些人并非完全依赖西方的施舍。
remmethod: 来自rel (y) (依赖) + iant → 信赖的

en: a dark blue chemical substance that is used on wounds to prevent infection. It is a chemical  element  :symbol I
ex1_en: The cut burns from the iodine.
ex1_zh: 伤口因涂了碘酒而疼痛。
remmethod: iod(紫色) + ine(化学名词后缀) → 碘

ex1_en: We can reduce this by avoiding homogeneity in group composition.
ex1_zh: 在群体成分中避免同质化，可以降低这种可能性。
remmethod: homo(同类的) + gene(基因) + ity(表性质) → 具有同种基因 → 同种， 同质

en: to break up soil, remove plants, etc. with a hoe
ex1_en: to hoe the flower beds
ex1_zh: 用锄头给花坛除草松土
remmethod: 用锄头(hoe)挖洞(hole)
propagat(繁殖；传播) + ion(名词后缀) → 繁殖；传播；蔓延

en: very important or basic
ex1_en: Having clean hands is one of the cardinal rules when preparing food.
ex1_zh: 双手洁净是准备食物时的一项最基本要求。
remmethod: card(心脏)+inal→如心脏一般→最重要的

en: sleep
ex1_en: He passed into a deep slumber.
ex1_zh: 他酣然入梦。
remmethod: s + lumber(木材) → 睡得很沉， 像根木头 → 安睡

en: a place in a factory, school etc where meals are provided, usually quite cheaply
ex1_en: Rennie had eaten his supper in the canteen.
ex1_zh: 伦尼已在食堂吃过晚饭。
remmethod: “看停”→小孩一看到小卖部就停下不走了→小卖部

en: a difficult situation or problem, especially one in which you cannot decide what to do
remmethod: “渴望得力” → 处于进退两难的境地， 渴望得到力量 → 进退两难

zh: 倾向一方的, 不平衡的
en: unequal or uneven, especially in an unfair way
ex1_en: a lopsided 8-0 victory
ex1_zh: 8比0一边倒的胜利
remmethod: lop(低重) + side(侧面， 边) + (e)d → 垂向一边的 → 倾向一方的
minim(最小) + al(形容词后缀) + ist(表人) → 最低限要求者

zh: 感觉上的，依感观的；诉诸美感的
en: attractive in a sexual way
ex1_en: full sensuous lips
ex1_zh: 饱满性感的嘴唇
remmethod: sens (感觉) + u + ous (…的) → 感觉的

zh: 丘陵的；陡的；多小山的；多坡的
en: having a lot of hills
ex1_en: The areas where the fighting is taking place are hilly and densely wooded.
ex1_zh: 战斗发生的地区丘陵起伏，树木茂密。
remmethod: hill(山) + y(形容词后缀) → 多小山的；丘陵的

zh: 附加物；下属；[动][解剖] 附器（如植物的枝叶和动物的腿尾）
en: something that is connected to a larger or more important thing
ex1_en: Upon marriage, a woman automatically lost most of her legal rights and became an appendage of her husband.
ex1_zh: 结婚后，妇女自动失去自己大部分的法律权利，成为丈夫的附属品。
remmethod: ap(向) + pend(悬挂) + age(名词后缀) → 悬挂于主体之物 → 附加物；附属肢体

en: an abiding feeling or belief continues for a long time and is not likely to change
ex1_en: Phil has a deep and abiding love for his family.
ex1_zh: 菲尔对家人怀有深厚不渝的爱。
remmethod: 来自abide(v. 停留； 容忍)

zh: 病态的；由病引起的；恐怖的；病变部位的
en: with a strong and unhealthy interest in unpleasant subjects, especially death
ex1_en: The trip was made all the worse by Frankie’s morbid fear of flying.
ex1_zh: 弗朗基对坐飞机有种病态的恐惧，使得旅途变得更加糟糕。
remmethod: morb(病) + id → 病态的

en: a feeling of anxiety or fear about something that is going to happen
ex1_en: With some trepidation, I opened the door.
ex1_zh: 我有些惴惴不安地打开了门。
remmethod: trep(害怕) + id + ation → 恐惧， 惶恐

en: to prevent someone from doing what they have planned or want to do
ex1_en: Investigators have been stymied by uncooperative witnesses.
ex1_zh: 由于目击者不合作，调查人员的工作受阻。
remmethod: 原指高尔夫球中的妨碍球

en: someone who pretends to have certain beliefs or opinions that they do not really have – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: The magazine wrongly suggested he was a liar and a hypocrite.
ex1_zh: 该杂志错误地暗示他是个骗子和伪君子。
remmethod: hypo(在下面) + crit(判断) + e → 在背后下判断 → 伪君子

en: a market or area where there are a lot of small shops, especially in India or the Middle East
ex1_en: Kamal was a vendor in Cairo's open-air bazaar.
ex1_zh: 卡莫尔曾是开罗露天集市的摊贩。
remmethod: 外来词， 原指“东方国家的大集市”， 今天的中国新疆一带仍把集市叫“巴扎”

en: A mason is a person who is skilled at making things or building things with stone or bricks
remmethod: ma(音似： 妈) + son(儿子) → 妈妈不希望儿子成为泥瓦匠 → 泥瓦匠

en: when you care about or help other people, even though this brings no advantage to yourself
ex1_en: Many choose to work in developing countries out of altruism.
ex1_zh: 许多人无私地选择在发展中国家工作。
remmethod: altru(其他) + ism(主义) → 利他主义

en: a type of smooth hard stone that makes a small flame when you hit it with steel
remmethod: f + lint(看做line， 线) → 打火石产生的火光如同一条线 → 打火石

en: to persuade someone to do something bad or violent
ex1_en: He accused union leaders of instigating the disturbances.
ex1_zh: 他指责工会领导人煽动骚乱。
remmethod: in(进入) + stig(=sting刺激) + ate → 刺激起来 → 怂恿， 鼓动， 煽动

en: the period during which something grows and develops
ex1_en: cell maturation
ex1_zh: 细胞的成熟过程
remmethod: matur(成熟) + ation(名词后缀) → 成熟；化脓

zh: 暗示；使逐渐而巧妙地取得；使迂回地潜入
en: to say something which seems to mean something unpleasant without saying it openly, especially suggesting that someone is being dishonest
ex1_en: What are you trying to insinuate?
ex1_zh: 你想暗示什么？
remmethod: in(进入) + sinu(弯曲) + ate → 绕弯说出来 → 暗指

en: done very quickly without much attention to details
ex1_en: Burke cast a cursory glance at the menu, then flapped it shut.
ex1_zh: 伯克粗略瞥了眼菜单，然后啪地合上了。
remmethod: curs(跑) + ory → 匆忙地跑过去 → 草率的

en: If you describe something as glassy, you mean that it is very smooth and shiny, like glass
ex1_en: The water was glassy.
ex1_zh: 水明净如镜。
remmethod: glass(玻璃) + y(形容词后缀) → 象玻璃的

en: a congenital medical condition or disease has affected someone since they were born
ex1_en: congenital abnormalities
ex1_zh: 先天畸形
remmethod: con + gen(产生) + ital → 与生俱来的 → 天生的

en: a perfect example of something, because it has all the most important qualities of things that belong to that type
ex1_en: He came to this country 20 years ago and is the archetype of the successful Asian businessman.
ex1_zh: 他20年前来到这个国家，是成功的亚裔商人的典型。
remmethod: arche (原来) + type (类型) → 原来的类型 → 原型

zh: 接壤的， 毗邻的； 不间断的
en: next to something, or next to each other
ex1_en: America’s 48 contiguous states
ex1_zh: 美国的48个互相毗连的州
remmethod: con(和) + tig(=ting接触) + uous → 相接触的 → 接壤的

en: to show or say that something will happen in the future
ex1_en: The revolution foreshadowed an entirely new social order.
ex1_zh: 这场革命预示着一种全新的社会秩序将要出现。
remmethod: fore (预先) + shadow (影子) → 影子预先到来预示着什么 → 预示

zh: 顺从的；对…负有责任(义务)的
en: willing to accept what someone says or does without arguing
ex1_en: She was always a very amenable child.
ex1_zh: 她一向是个很听话的孩子。
remmethod: a(向) + men(引导) + able(能…的) → 能往某个方面引导的 → 顺从的

en: to decay or make something decay
ex1_en: As the waste materials decompose, they produce methane gas.
ex1_zh: 废物腐烂时会产生沼气。
remmethod: de(否定) + compose(组成) → 腐烂

ex1_en: Dickinsonia, for example, has been interpreted as being a relative of jellyfish, a marine worm, a lichen, or even as a member of a completely extinct kingdom.
ex1_zh: 例如，狄更逊水母，有的说是水母的近亲，有的说是海底蠕虫，有的说是地衣，有的甚至说它属于一个已经完全灭绝的物种。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 青苔，苔藓

en: a list of goods that have been supplied or work that has been done, showing how much you owe for them
ex1_en: We will then send you an invoice for the total course fees.
ex1_zh: 然后我们将寄给你一张全部课程费用的发票。
remmethod: 口头上 (voice)的承诺是不能当发票(invoice)用的

en: if there is a preponderance of people or things of a particular type in a group, there are more of that type than of any other
ex1_en: There is a preponderance of female students in the music department.
ex1_zh: 在音乐系里女学生占大多数。
remmethod: 来自preponderant(a. 占优势的)

zh: 浮躁的；易变的；变幻无常的
en: someone who is fickle is always changing their mind about people or things that they like, so that you cannot depend on them – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: an unpredictable and fickle lover
ex1_zh: 一个捉摸不透、三心二意的情人
remmethod: 和tickle(v. 呵痒)一起记

zh: 可忍受的， 可容忍的； 尚好的， 过得去的
en: a situation that is tolerable is not very good, but you are able to accept it
ex1_en: The apartment is really too small, but it’s tolerable for the time being.
ex1_zh: 这套公寓实在太小，不过暂时还能凑合。
remmethod: 来自tolerate (v. 容忍， 忍受)

en: A hatchery is a place where people control the hatching of eggs, especially fish eggs
ex1_en: Running along the brook, down to the hatchery, what heavenly joy this was when school was over!
ex1_zh: 放学后，有什么比沿着小溪跑到孵卵处更能给人如在天堂般的快乐！
remmethod: hatch(孵化) + ery(场所) → 孵卵所

en: a woman who is a chairperson
ex1_en: Primakov was in Japan meeting with the chairwoman of the Socialist Party there.
ex1_zh: 普里马科夫正在日本和那里的社会党女主席会面。
remmethod: chair(主持；椅子) + woman(女人) → 主持席位的女性 → 女主席

ex1_en: He swam down and retrieved his glasses from the muck and slime at the bottom of the pond.
ex1_zh: 他潜下水去，从池塘底部的烂泥污物中找回了眼镜。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 粘土；粘液

zh: 利他的， 无私心的， 为他人着想的
