en: altruistic behaviour shows that you care about and will help other people, even though this brings no advantage for yourself
ex1_en: Were his motives entirely altruistic?
ex1_zh: 他的动机是完全无私的吗？
remmethod: altru(他人) + ist(表人/主义) + ic(形容词后缀) → 利他的

zh: 犬的；犬齿的；犬科的；似犬的
en: relating to dogs
ex1_en: canine diseases
ex1_zh: 犬类疾病
remmethod: can (犬) + ine → 犬的

en: If you are mournful, you are very sad
ex1_en: He looked mournful, even near to tears.
ex1_zh: 他看上去很悲伤，几乎要掉泪了。
remmethod: mourn(哀悼) + ful(充满…的) → 悲哀的；令人惋惜的

zh: 无定形的；无组织的；[物] 非晶形的
en: having no definite shape or features
ex1_en: an amorphous mass of twisted metal
ex1_zh: 一堆扭曲变形的金属
remmethod: a(无) + morph(形状) + ous → 无固定形状的

en: anger
ex1_en: Their ire was directed mainly at the government.
ex1_zh: 他们的愤怒主要针对该政府。
remmethod: 愤怒(ire)之火(fire)

en: a song that is sung by only one person in an  opera  or  oratorio
ex1_en: It is a scenic art integrating music, performance, literature, aria, and face-painting.
ex1_zh: 这是一个风景艺术集音乐，表演，文学，咏叹调，和画脸。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 独唱曲；咏叹调；唱腔

en: behaviour that is intended to make someone believe something that is not true
ex1_en: an atmosphere of hypocrisy and deceit
ex1_zh: 充满虚伪和欺骗的氛围
remmethod: de + ceit(拿) → 在(底下)拿 → 欺骗

en: friendly and easy to like
ex1_en: The driver was an amiable young man.
ex1_zh: 司机是位友善的年轻人。
remmethod: ami(爱) + able(能…的) → 可爱的

en: to decide not to continue with a plan, idea etc, although you might continue with it at a later time
ex1_en: King County has shelved plans to build a driving range.
ex1_zh: 金郡已搁置了建造一个高尔夫练习场的计划。
remmethod: shelv(架) + e → 置于架子上；搁置

en: the distance or measurement around the outside of a circle or any round shape
remmethod: circum(环绕) + fer(带来) + ence → 带来一圈 → 圆周长
tags: cet4 cet6 ky toefl ielts gre

ex1_en: Maureen was the epitome of sophistication.
ex1_zh: 莫琳曾是老于世故的典型。
remmethod: epi(在…上面) + tom(切) + e → 切下来放在上面 → 摘要， 梗概； 典型

ex1_en: a cordless phone
ex1_zh: 无线电话
remmethod: cord(线) + less(无) → 无线的

en: work that you do to take care of a house, for example washing, cleaning etc
ex1_en: Men are doing more housework nowadays.
ex1_zh: 现今男人正在承担越来越多的家务。
remmethod: house (房子) +work (工作) →家里的工作→家务劳动

en: a main branch on a tree
ex1_en: I rested my fishing rod against a pine bough.
ex1_zh: 我把我的鱼竿靠在松树的一个大树枝上。
remmethod: bough(自身词根) → 大树枝

en: a piece of equipment consisting of a wheel over which a rope or chain is pulled to lift heavy things
ex1_en: a system of ropes and pulleys
ex1_zh: 绳索滑轮系统
remmethod: pull(推) + ey → 滑轮； 滑车

en: a book containing maps, especially of the whole world
ex1_en: The atlas was published by our company.
ex1_zh: 这个地图集是由我们公司出版的。
remmethod: at(在) ＋ las(想成Las Vegas， 拉斯维加斯) → 在拉斯维加斯， 许多人拿着地图集踏上了淘金路 → 地图集

en: a strong board for jumping on or off, used when diving (  dive11  ) or doing  gymnastics
ex1_en: The 1981 budget was the springboard for an economic miracle.
ex1_zh: 1981年的预算造就了一场经济奇迹。
remmethod: spring(跳) + board(板) → 跳板

en: to speak angrily to someone because they have done something wrong
ex1_en: Marion berated Joe for the noise he made.
ex1_zh: 玛丽恩指责乔制造的噪声。
remmethod: be + rate(责骂) → 猛烈责骂

en: to express or show something in a short way
ex1_en: The words of the song neatly encapsulate the mood of the country at that time.
ex1_zh: 这首歌的歌词言简意赅地表现出国家当时的氛围。
remmethod: 来自capsule(n. 胶囊)； en(进入) + capsul(e) + ate (使…)→ 装入胶囊

en: to lie or lean back in a relaxed way
ex1_en: She proceeded to recline on a chaise longue.
ex1_zh: 她开始斜靠在一个躺椅上。
remmethod: re(回) + clin(倾斜) + e → 斜回去 → 斜倚， 躺卧

en: a large brown wild cat from the mountains of western North America and South America
ex1_en: Then Mrs. McAlister grabbed a shovel in the yard and swung it at the cougar.
ex1_zh: 于是阿里斯特太太抓起后院的一把铁锹对着美洲狮挥来挥去。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 美洲狮

zh: 抛射的；抛掷的；供抛射用的；（触角等）能伸出的
ex1_en: The vertical and horizontal motions of a projectile can be treated independently.
ex1_zh: 抛射体的竖直方向和水平方向的运动能够分开来处理。
remmethod: pro(向前) + ject(扔) + ile → 扔向前的东西 → 抛射体

ex1_en: We have full stereo sound, video, 35 mm slides.
ex1_zh: 我们有立体声、视频及35 毫米幻灯片。
remmethod: milli(千分之一) + meter(米) 的缩写 → 毫米

en: the most successful point in the development of something
remmethod: zen (看作ten， 十) + ith → 功力到了十层那真是功夫的顶点了 → 天顶； 顶点

en: unbiased information, opinions, advice etc is fair because the person giving it is not influenced by their own or other people’s opinions
ex1_en: We aim to provide a service that is balanced and unbiased.
ex1_zh: 我们的目标是提供一种公平公正的服务。
remmethod: un(无) + biased(有偏见的) → 公正的， 没有偏见的

zh: 谦逊的；不装腔作势的；不出风头的
en: showing no desire to be noticed or given special treatment
ex1_en: He's a man of few words, very polite and unassuming.
ex1_zh: 他不爱说话，非常有礼貌，也不装腔作势。
remmethod: un (不) + assuming (傲慢的) → 不傲慢的 → 谦逊的

en: someone who traps wild animals, especially for their fur
remmethod: trap(陷阱) + p + er(表人) → 捕兽者

en: If you say that something is a panacea for a set of problems, you mean that it will solve all those problems
ex1_en: Trade is not a panacea for the world's economic or social ills.
ex1_zh: 贸易不是世界经济或社会弊端的万灵丹。
remmethod: pan(全部) + acea(治疗) → 包治百病 → 万灵药

zh: 不能克服的,不能超越的
en: an insurmountable difficulty or problem is too large or difficult to deal with
ex1_en: The language difference proved an insurmountable barrier.
ex1_zh: 语言差异是难以克服的障碍。
remmethod: in(不) + sur(超过) + mount(山) + able(可…的) → 不可越过的 → 不能克服的

en: sand, mud, soil etc that is carried in water and then settles at a bend in a river, an entrance to a port etc
ex1_en: The lake was almost solid with silt and vegetation.
ex1_zh: 这个湖几乎填满了泥沙和植被。
remmethod: 小心别坐上(sit)淤泥(silt)

ex1_en: If he was ill, why didn't anyone do something about his fragility?
ex1_zh: 假如他生病了，为什么没有任何人为他的脆弱做些什么？
remmethod: frag(破碎) + ility(性质) → 脆弱；虚弱

en: the marks used to divide a piece of writing into sentences, phrases etc
ex1_en: He was known for his poor grammar and punctuation.
ex1_zh: 他以很差的语法和标点符号使用而出名。
remmethod: punct(点) + uation(名词后缀) → 标点；标点符号

en: a bitter green-brown liquid formed in the  liver  , which helps you to  digest  fats
ex1_en: He aims his bile at religion, drugs, and politics.
ex1_zh: 他把怒气指向宗教、毒品和政治。
remmethod: bile(自身词根) → 胆汁；愤怒

zh: 不重要的；不合理的；不合逻辑的
en: not important
ex1_en: inconsequential but amusing chatter
ex1_zh: 无谓但有趣的闲扯
remmethod: in(不) + consequential(重要的) → 不重要的

zh: 故态复萌；旧病复发；再度堕落；再陷邪道
en: to become ill again after you have seemed to improve
ex1_en: "I wish I did," said Phil Jordan, relapsing into his usual gloom.
ex1_zh: “我要是做了就好了，”菲尔•乔丹说着，回到平时的忧郁中。
remmethod: re + laps(滑) + e → (身体状况)再次下滑 → 再度恶化

ex1_en: Mold can grow even under refrigeration, and aging cheese is a good example of that.
ex1_zh: 霉菌在冷藏条件下也可以生长，正在成熟的奶酪就是一个很好的例子。
remmethod: re(再) + friger(冷) + ation(名词后缀) → 冷藏；致冷

en: to rub part of your body to make it warm
ex1_en: My shorts were chafing my thighs.
ex1_zh: 我的短裤蹭得我大腿疼。
remmethod: 在cafe中加了一个h(看作hot) → 热咖啡 → 擦热

zh: 重新组成, 重新设立
en: to form an organization or a group again in a different way
ex1_en: The committees will be reconstituted after the election.
ex1_zh: 委员会将在选举后改组。
remmethod: re(再) + con(共同) + stitute(建立) → 重新组成；重新设立

zh: 抨击， 指责； 猛攻； 困扰
en: if you are assailed by unpleasant thoughts or feelings, they worry or upset you
ex1_en: Carla was suddenly assailed by doubts.
ex1_zh: 卡拉突然为各种疑问所困扰。
remmethod: 航行(sail)中一再遇到风浪的猛攻(assail)

en: a large monkey that lives in Africa and South Asia
ex1_en: With the baboon you first reward a hop, then a bigger hop, then an even bigger hop.
ex1_zh: 对狒狒，你先奖励它的小进步，然后是大一点的进步，接着是更大的进步。
remmethod: baboon(狒狒) → 狒狒

en: relating to the sense of hearing, or someone’s ability to understand sounds
ex1_en: an aural stimulus
ex1_zh: 听觉刺激
remmethod: aur (耳； 听) + al (的) → 听觉的

en: an effect caused by hot air in a desert, which makes you think that you can see objects when they are not actually there
ex1_en: Perhaps we are just chasing a mirage.
ex1_zh: 也许我们只是在追逐一个梦。
remmethod: mir(惊奇) + age → 使人惊奇之物 → 海市蜃楼

en: to show or promise something that someone really wants, but then not allow them to have it
remmethod: 来自希腊神话人物Tantalus(坦塔洛斯)， 他因泄露天机而被罚立在近下巴深的水中， 口渴欲饮时水即流失； 头上有果树， 腹饥欲食时果子即消失

en: someone who was a member of your family a long time in the past
ex1_en: I'll come back to the land of my forebears.
ex1_zh: 我将回到祖先的土地。
remmethod: fore(在前) + bear(生育；存在) → 生在前面的 → 祖先；祖宗

en: to burn something so that its outside becomes black
ex1_en: Roast the peppers until the skin begins to char and blister.
ex1_zh: 把这些辣椒烤到表皮发黑起泡为止。
remmethod: 椅子(chair)的一个腿(i)儿被烧焦(char)了

ex1_en: A full-scale debate is under way on what ails the industry.
ex1_zh: 就困扰工业发展的弊端所展开的一次全面讨论正在进行中。
remmethod: 和air(n. 空气)一起记， 多呼吸空气(air)就会少生病(ail)

zh: 微温的，温热的；不太热烈的；不热情的
en: a feeling, reaction etc that is tepid shows a lack of excitement or interest
ex1_en: a tepid response from the audience
ex1_zh: 观众冷淡的反应
remmethod: 水微热 (tepid) ， 不要掀盖子 (lid)

en: to make something narrower or tighter, or to become narrower or tighter
ex1_en: Caffeine constricts the blood vessels in your body.
ex1_zh: 咖啡因会使体内的血管收缩。
remmethod: con + strict(拉紧) → 拉到一起 → 收缩

en: If you say that someone is fattening something such as a business or its profits, you mean that they are increasing the value of the business or its profits, in a way that you disapprove of
ex1_en: They have kept the price of sugar artificially high and so fattened the company's profits.
ex1_zh: 他们一直人为地使糖价居高不下，以此为公司牟利。
remmethod: 来自fat(adj. 胖的)

zh: 革除， 罢免， 废黜
en: to remove a leader or ruler from a position of power
ex1_en: Mr. Ben Bella was deposed in a coup in 1965.
ex1_zh: 本·贝拉先生在1965年的一次政变中被罢免了。
remmethod: de(向下) + pos(放) + e → (将人)向下放 → 革除， 罢免

en: short, with no unnecessary words
ex1_en: Your summary should be as clear and concise as possible.
ex1_zh: 你的总结应该尽可能地明白简洁。
remmethod: con ＋ cis(切掉) ＋ e → 把多余的全部切掉 → 简要的

en: to make someone or something seem small or unimportant
ex1_en: He tends to belittle her efforts.
ex1_zh: 他往往轻视她的努力。
remmethod: be + little(小) → 把(人)看小 → 轻视

en: someone who is zealous does or supports something with great energy
ex1_en: a zealous preacher
ex1_zh: 热心的讲道者
remmethod: 来自zeal(n. 热情， 激情)

en: strange or unusual behaviour
ex1_en: Kate’s mother had a reputation for eccentricity.
ex1_zh: 凯特的母亲是个出了名的怪人。
remmethod: ec(出) + centr(中心) + icity(名词后缀) → 偏心；古怪；离心率

en: someone, especially a child, who is boisterous makes a lot of noise and has a lot of energy
ex1_en: a class of boisterous five-year-olds
ex1_zh: 一班活泼爱动的五岁孩子
remmethod: boister(喧闹) + ous → 喧闹的

en: a small building made for a dog to sleep in
ex1_en: Once you have chosen a kennel, make a booking for your pet.
ex1_zh: 一旦您选定了养狗场，请为您的宠物预约。
remmethod: ken(=can犬) + nel → 狗窝； 注意不要和kernel(n. 核； 核心)相混

en: Feral animals are wild animals that are not owned or controlled by anyone, especially ones that belong to species which are normally owned and kept by people
remmethod: fer(野) + al(形容词后缀) → 野生的；凶猛的

en: to steal large amounts of money or property from somewhere, especially while fighting in a war
ex1_en: The rich provinces of Asia Minor were plundered by the invaders.
ex1_zh: 小亚细亚的富饶地区遭到侵略者的劫掠。
remmethod: pl(看作place， 放) + under(在…下面) → 放在自己下面 → 抢劫

zh: 敌手；[解剖] 对抗肌；[生化] 拮抗物；反协同试剂
en: your opponent in a competition, battle, quarrel etc
ex1_en: Spassky had never previously lost to his antagonist.
ex1_zh: 斯帕斯基以前从未败给过他的敌手。
remmethod: antagon (看作antagonism，  对抗) + ist (…的人) → 对抗的人 → 对手

en: very poor
ex1_en: No where in the article does it mention her financial status. So…what is it that leads everyone to assume she was indigent?
ex1_zh: 在文章中哪也没提及她的财务状况。那么…究竟是什么导致每个人都认为她是贫困的？
remmethod: in(里， 内) + dig(需要； 不足) + ent → 内部缺乏的 → 贫困的， 贫穷的

en: very harmful or evil, often in a way that you do not notice easily
ex1_en: the pernicious effects of poverty
ex1_zh: 贫穷的危害性
remmethod: per(表加强) + nic(伤害) + ious → 带来极大伤害的 → 有害的； 致命的

zh: 使倒转， 使倒置， 使颠倒
en: to put something in the opposite position to the one it was in before, especially by turning it upside down (= the bottom is on the top and the top is on the bottom )
ex1_en: Invert the cake onto a serving plate.
ex1_zh: 把蛋糕倒扣过来放到一个盘子上。
remmethod: in(进入) + vert(转) → (使)倒转， (使)颠倒

en: to go onto some-one’s private land without their permission
ex1_en: He will be prosecuted for trespass.
ex1_zh: 他将因擅闯私地而被起诉。
remmethod: tres(横向) + pass(经过) → 横着经过某人的地盘 → 侵犯

en: strange, unexpected, or unsuitable in a particular situation
ex1_en: The new theatre looks utterly incongruous in its setting.
ex1_zh: 这座新剧院和周围的环境格格不入。
remmethod: in + congruous (全等的， 一致的) → 不一致的 → 不调和的

en: an invented name that a writer, artist etc uses instead of their real name
ex1_en: Both plays were published under the pseudonym of Philip Dayre.
ex1_zh: 两个剧本都是以菲利普·戴尔的笔名发表的。
remmethod: pseudo(假) ＋ nym(名字) → 假名

zh: 交战的；好战的；交战国的
en: a belligerent country is fighting a war against another country
ex1_en: a belligerent attitude
ex1_zh: 敌对的态度
remmethod: bell (战争) + i + ger (发动) + ent (…的) → 喜欢发动战争的 → 好战的

ex1_en: The author enthrall, enthralled the minds of his readers.
ex1_zh: 那位作者于读者着迷。
remmethod: en(使) + thrall(奴隶) → 成为(爱的)奴隶 → 迷住

en: to hang over something or stick out above it
ex1_en: Part of the rock wall overhung the path at one point.
ex1_zh: 部分岩壁悬在了小径一处的上方。
remmethod: over(在上) + hang(悬挂) → 悬垂；屋檐

ex1_en: In the Arab lexicon, the concept of justice means more than democracy.
ex1_zh: 在阿拉伯词典里，公正的概念比民主含义丰富的多。
remmethod: lex(词汇) + icon → 词典

en: to become worse
ex1_en: Inactivity can make your joints stiff, and the bones may begin to degenerate.
ex1_zh: 不活动会使关节僵硬，骨骼因此可能会开始退化。
remmethod: de(向下)+gen(产生)+er+ate(做)→生产质量逐渐变坏→衰退， 堕落

zh: 额外费用，增收费，附加费
en: money that you have to pay in addition to the basic price of something
ex1_en: No person shall prior to leaving the paid area fail or refuse to pay any fare surcharge or other sum leviable in accordance with these by-laws .
ex1_zh: 任何人不得在未付或拒付按照本附例可征收的任何车费、附加费或其它款项情况下离开已付车费区域。
remmethod: sur(超过) + charge(收费) → 额外费

en: relating to ships, boats, or sailing
ex1_en: nautical equipment
ex1_zh: 航海装备
remmethod: naut (船) + ical → 船舶的

en: a sudden feeling of slight pain
ex1_en: I felt a twinge of pain in my back.
ex1_zh: 我觉得背上一阵刺痛。
remmethod: twin(双胞胎)+ge → 据说双胞胎有心理感应， 能感知对方的疼痛 → (生理、 心理上的)剧痛

zh: 外来的， 外在的， 非本质的
en: Extrinsic reasons, forces, or factors exist outside the person or situation they affect
ex1_en: Nowadays there are fewer extrinsic pressures to get married.
ex1_zh: 现在，结婚与否很少受到来自外部的压力。
remmethod: extrin(外部) + sic(形容词后缀) → 外在的

en: to get better again after an illness or injury
ex1_en: We’ve recuperated our losses.
ex1_zh: 我们已挽回损失。
remmethod: re(再次) + cuper(=gain获得) + ate → 再次获得原来的状态 → 复原

en: The conquerors of a country or group of people are the people who have taken complete control of that country or group's land
ex1_en: The people of an oppressed country obey their conquerors because they want to go on living.
ex1_zh: 一个被压迫国家的人民顺从他们的征服者，是因为他们想活下去。
remmethod: con(加强) + quer(寻求；获取) + or(表人) → 征服者

en: if someone or something is pretentious, they try to seem more important, intelligent, or high class than they really are in order to be impressive
ex1_en: a pretentious film
ex1_zh: 矫饰的电影
remmethod: pre(向前) + tent(伸展) + ious → 向前伸展的 → 自负的

en: up to this time
ex1_en: a species of fish hitherto unknown in the West
ex1_zh: 迄今在西方还不为人知的一种鱼
remmethod: hit(打) ＋ her ＋ to → 迄今为止， 他的爱仍未打动她 → 到目前为止， 迄今

en: in large quantities
ex1_en: Melons grow abundantly in this region.
ex1_zh: 这个地区盛产甜瓜。
remmethod: abund(丰富) + ant(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 大量地；丰富地

en: to make someone stop feeling angry
ex1_en: These changes did little to placate the unions.
ex1_zh: 这些变革对于工会没有起到多少安抚作用。
remmethod: 找个地方 (place) 安抚 (placate) 一下受伤的心灵

en: someone who is not trained in a particular subject or type of work, especially when they are being compared with someone who is
ex1_en: To the layman (= laymen in general ) all these plants look pretty similar.
ex1_zh: 对外行的人来说，这些植物看起来都很相似。
remmethod: lay(外行的)+man→外行， 门外汉

zh: 使全神贯注；用大字体书写；正式写成（决议等）；独占；吸引
en: if something engrosses you, it interests you so much that you do not notice anything else
ex1_en: The scene was stunning, and for a time engrossed all our attention.
ex1_zh: 景色非常美丽，一时间把我们都完全吸引住了。
remmethod: en(进入) + gross(总的) → 全部进入状态 → 全神贯注于

en: A Negro is someone with dark skin who comes from Africa or whose ancestors came from Africa
ex1_en: Slavery was “an unqualified evil to the negro, the white man, and the State,” said Abraham Lincoln in the 1850s.
ex1_zh: 奴隶制，“对于黑人、白人与合众国来说都是一种彻底的邪恶，”1850年林肯如此说道。
remmethod: negr(黑) + o(名词后缀) → 黑人

en: approval or agreement from someone who has authority
ex1_en: a nod of assent
ex1_zh: 首肯
remmethod: as(表加强) + sent(感觉) → 强烈地感觉相同 → 同意

en: the movement in a gas or liquid caused by warm gas or liquid rising, and cold gas or liquid sinking
remmethod: con(共同) + vect(搬运) + ion → 一起搬运 → 对流

en: If you say that someone rants, you mean that they talk loudly or angrily, and exaggerate or say foolish things
ex1_en: As the boss began to rant, I stood up and went out.
ex1_zh: 老板开始咆哮时，我站起来走了出去。
remmethod: 别惹蚂蚁 (ant) ， 愤怒的蚂蚁会怒气冲冲地叫嚷 (rant)

zh: 遇热发光的, 白炽的
en: producing a bright light when heated
ex1_en: the invention of the incandescent lamp
ex1_zh: 白炽灯的发明
remmethod: in(使…) ＋ cand(白； 发光) ＋ escent(开始出现…的) → 遇热发光的

ex1_en: the normalization of relations
ex1_zh: 关系的正常化
remmethod: norm(标准) + al(形容词后缀) + iz(e)(使…) + ation(名词后缀) → 标准化

en: a wooden bar used for keeping two animals together, especially cattle, when they are pulling heavy loads
ex1_en: the yoke of imperialism
ex1_zh: 帝国主义的枷锁
remmethod: 听个笑话(joke)， 摆脱束缚(yoke)

en: annoyance and disappointment because something has not happened the way you hoped
ex1_en: To the chagrin of their parents, neither Phil nor Pam went to church anymore.
ex1_zh: 令父母失望的是，菲尔和帕姆都再也不去教堂了。
remmethod: cha(拼音： 茶) + grin(苦笑) → 喝茶苦笑 → 懊恼， 失望

zh: 粗暴的；粗哑的；脾气坏的
en: A gruff voice sounds low and rough
ex1_en: He picked up the phone expecting to hear the chairman's gruff voice.
ex1_zh: 他拿起电话等着听主席那粗哑的声音。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 粗暴的；粗哑的

en: when you visit famous or interesting places, especially as tourists
ex1_en: She swam and sunbathed, went sightseeing and relaxed.
ex1_zh: 她游泳，晒日光浴，观光，放松。
remmethod: sight(景色) + seeing(看) → 看景色 → 观光， 游览

en: to officially end a law, or change a decision or agreement
ex1_en: The governor does not have the authority to rescind the ruling.
ex1_zh: 该州长无权撤销这项裁决。
remmethod: re(反) + scind(=cut砍) → 砍掉 → 废除

zh: 寄生的, 由寄生虫引起的
en: living in or on another plant or animal and getting food from them
ex1_en: parasitic fungi
ex1_zh: 寄生真菌
remmethod: 来自parasite(n. 寄生虫)

zh: 腐蚀的, 蚀坏的 n腐蚀物
en: a corrosive liquid such as an acid can destroy metal, plastic etc
ex1_en: a highly corrosive substance
ex1_zh: 一种腐蚀性很强的物质
remmethod: 来自corrode(v. 侵蚀； 损害)

en: impossible to know about definitely or exactly
ex1_en: a girl of indeterminate age
ex1_zh: 年龄难以确定的女孩
remmethod: in(不) + de(完全) + termin(界限) + ate(形容词后缀) → 不确定的；含混的

en: to walk somewhere slowly and with heavy steps
ex1_en: The walk involved tramping through mud.
ex1_zh: 走这段路要在泥地中跋涉。
remmethod: 流浪者(tramp)随处扎营(camp)

zh: 杂色的；混杂的；五颜六色的
en: You can describe a group of things as a motley collection if you think they seem strange together because they are all very different
ex1_en: I looked at the motley bunch we were sailing with and began to feel uneasy about the trip.
ex1_zh: 我看着船上同行的那些杂七杂八的人，对这次航行担心起来。
remmethod: mot(=mote微粒) + ley → 各种微粒混合 → 混杂的

zh: 丧失的；被剥夺的；失去亲人的
en: If a person or thing is bereft of something, they no longer have it
ex1_en: The place seemed to be utterly bereft of human life.
ex1_zh: 看起来，这地方人迹罕至。
remmethod: be + reft (夺走) → 丧失的； 被剥夺的

ex1_en: It’s a colorful scene - laborers unload noisily, and small groups of women haggle for the pots of crabs and sardines to sell at village markets.
ex1_zh: 在这个热闹的环境中，工人喧闹地卸着船，三五成群的妇女正在为一盆盆螃蟹和沙丁鱼讨价还价，以便在村里的鱼市出售。
remmethod: nois(e)(噪音) + i + ly(副词后缀) → 吵闹地

en: if something shrivels, or if it is shrivelled, it becomes smaller and its surface becomes covered in lines because it is very dry or old
ex1_en: The leaves change colour, then shrivel.
ex1_zh: 树叶变了颜色，然后干枯了。
remmethod: 衣服缩水 (shrink) 起皱纹 (shrivel) 了 → (使) 起皱纹

en: to officially arrange for someone to have something that you own after your death
ex1_en: He bequeathed all his silver to his children.
ex1_zh: 他把所有的银币都留给了他的孩子们。
remmethod: be + quea(说) + th → 说出来把东西留给谁 → 遗赠； 流传

en: false but seeming to be real or true
ex1_en: First impressions can often prove illusory.
ex1_zh: 第一印象往往被证明是不真实的。
remmethod: il(=in) + lus(闹着玩) + ory → 头脑对某事闹着玩 → 虚幻的

zh: 之前, 先(用先发制人的方法)预防, 阻止
en: to prevent something from happening or prevent someone from doing something by doing something first
ex1_en: a measure intended to forestall further attacks
ex1_zh: 意在预先阻止进一步攻击的措施
remmethod: fore(预先) + stall(停止) → 预先停止 → 预防

ex1_en: He elaborately devised a new computer.
ex1_zh: 他精心设计了一台新电脑。
remmethod: e(出) + labor(劳动) + ate(动词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 精心设计地

zh: 偶然的， 任意的； 无计划的， 无秩序的
en: happening or done in a way that is not planned or organized
ex1_en: Educational provision in the country is haphazard.
ex1_zh: 该国提供的教育毫无计划性。
remmethod: hap(运气) + hazard(冒险) → 运气加冒险就获得了成功 → 偶然情况 → 偶然的

en: having two sides that are different in shape
ex1_en: asymmetrical patterns
ex1_zh: 不对称图案
remmethod: a(不) + symmetr(对称) + ical(形容词后缀) → 不对称的

zh: 肮脏的；卑鄙的；利欲熏心的；色彩暗淡的
en: involving immoral or dishonest behaviour
ex1_en: a sordid little room
ex1_zh: 肮脏的小房间
remmethod: “扫地的” → 肮脏的

en: a sign that something is going to happen soon
ex1_en: The November air stung my cheeks, a harbinger of winter.
ex1_zh: 11月的空气刺痛了我的脸颊，这是冬天要来的先兆。
remmethod: harbing(住宿；军队宿营) + er(表人/物) → 先行安排宿营者 → 先驱；预兆

zh: 多余的；不必要的；奢侈的
en: more than is needed or wanted
ex1_en: a modern building with no superfluous decoration
ex1_zh: 一栋没有多余装饰的现代建筑
remmethod: super(过分)+flu(流)+ous→富得流油的→过剩的， 多余的

ex1_en: In this dialog, you can only open an artifact in the editor.
ex1_zh: 在这个对话框中，您只可以在编辑器中打开一个工件。
remmethod: di(a)(穿过；相互) + log(说) → 对话

zh: 以高人一等的态度对待； 光顾； 赞助， 资助
en: to talk to someone in a way which seems friendly but shows that you think they are not as intelligent or do not know as much as you
ex1_en: Don’t patronize me!
ex1_zh: 别对我摆出一副纡尊降贵的样子！
remmethod: 来自patron(n. 赞助人)

zh: 意气相投的,性格相似的
ex1_en: Frank was a very congenial colleague.
ex1_zh: 弗兰克是一位很好相处的同事。
remmethod: con(带着) + gen(出生) + ial → 带着某物一同出生的 → 天生拥有的 → 相宜的

en: If you describe someone as fanatical, you disapprove of them because you consider their behaviour or opinions to be very extreme
ex1_en: He is a fanatical fan of Mozart.
ex1_zh: 他是一名莫扎特音乐的狂热爱好者。
remmethod: fanat(狂热) + ical(形容词后缀) → 狂热的；入迷的

en: a style of singing popular songs with parts for four men, usually without music
ex1_en: a barbershop quartet
ex1_zh: 男声四重唱
remmethod: barber(理发师)+shop(商店)→理发师的店铺→理发店

zh: 和蔼可亲的， 易于交谈的， 友善的
en: friendly and easy to talk to
ex1_en: an affable guy
ex1_zh: 一个平易近人的人
remmethod: 和蔼可亲的(affable) 老人给孩子们讲寓言 (fable) 故事

zh: 有事业心的, 有进取心的
en: having the ability to think of new activities or ideas and make them work
ex1_en: Some enterprising students are designing software.
ex1_zh: 一些有创业精神的学生在设计软件。
remmethod: enterpris(e)(事业；进取) + ing(有…性质的) → 有事业心的；有进取心的

zh: 陈腐的；平庸的；老一套的
en: ordinary and not interesting, because of a lack of new or different ideas
ex1_en: conversations about the most banal subjects
ex1_zh: 最无聊的谈话
remmethod: ban(禁止) + al → 应该禁止的 → 陈腐的

en: an unwieldy object is big, heavy, and difficult to carry or use
ex1_en: unwieldy bureaucracy
ex1_zh: 尾大不掉的官僚机构
remmethod: un(不) + wieldy(支配的， 控制的) → 不可控制的 → 麻烦的

en: someone who is jaded is no longer interested in or excited by something, usually because they have experienced too much of it
ex1_en: The concert should satisfy even the most jaded critic.
ex1_zh: 这场音乐会应该能让最不易打动的评论家都觉得满意。
remmethod: jade(疲惫；厌倦) + (e)d(形容词后缀) → 疲倦不堪的；厌倦的

en: to do something better than someone else or be more successful
ex1_en: We outstripped all our competitors in sales last year.
ex1_zh: 去年我们的销售额超过了所有竞争对手。
remmethod: out(超过) + strip(条， 带) → 最早超出终点线的人就胜出

zh: 地图上没标明的,未知的
en: not marked on any maps
ex1_en: an uncharted island
ex1_zh: 地图上未标明的岛屿
remmethod: un(未) + chart(海图；图表) + ed(形容词后缀) → 海图上未标明的；未知的

en: not the same
ex1_en: His methods were not dissimilar to those used by Freud.
ex1_zh: 他用的方法和弗洛伊德用的没有什么不同。
remmethod: dis(不) + similar(相似的) → 不相似的

zh: 伪造；篡改；歪曲；证明虚假
en: to change figures, records etc so that they contain false information
ex1_en: The file was altered to falsify the evidence.
ex1_zh: 文件被动了手脚，以此伪造证据。
remmethod: fals(假的) + ify → 造假 → 篡改

en: to offend or insult someone, especially by not showing respect
ex1_en: He stepped back, affronted by the question.
ex1_zh: 他觉得这个问题语带冒犯，退后了几步。
remmethod: af + front(前面， 脸面) → 冲着别人的脸 → 冒犯

en: a substance such as oil that you put on surfaces that rub together, especially parts of a machine, in order to make them move smoothly and easily
ex1_en: Its nozzle was smeared with some kind of lubricant.
ex1_zh: 它的喷嘴上涂了种润滑油。
remmethod: lubric(光滑) + ant → 润滑剂

en: provided in addition to what already exists
ex1_en: supplementary information
ex1_zh: 补充信息
remmethod: 来自supplyment (n. 补充， 增补)

en: the sky above a particular country, that is legally controlled by that country
ex1_en: Canadian airspace
ex1_zh: 加拿大领空
remmethod: air(空气；空中) + space(空间) → 空域；领空

en: a large flood, or period when there is a lot of rain
ex1_en: Even so, the data deluge is already starting to transform business, government, science and everyday life (see our special report in this issue).
ex1_zh: 尽管如此，数据洪水正在开始改变商业、政府、科学和人们的日常生活。
remmethod: de + lug(=luv冲洗) + e → 冲掉 → 大洪水

zh: 激烈的；狂暴的；偏激的；患狂犬病的
en: having very extreme and unreasonable opinions
ex1_en: a group of rabid right-wing fanatics
ex1_zh: 一群极端的右翼狂热分子
remmethod: 来自rabies(n. 狂犬病)

en: a place where birds rest and sleep
ex1_en: Something disturbed the bird on its roost.
ex1_zh: 什么东西惊扰了那只栖息的鸟。
remmethod: 鸟巢(roost)是鸟落脚(root)的地方

en: a brick or stone structure built to support a wall
remmethod: but (仅仅) + tress (枝条) → 仅仅只有枝条支持 → 支持

en: a loud unpleasant mixture of sounds
ex1_en: All around was a cacophony of voices.
ex1_zh: 刺耳声响遍四周。
remmethod: caco(坏) + phony(声音) → 声音不好 → 刺耳的声音

en: relating to experiments
ex1_en: data obtained experimentally
ex1_zh: 实验获得的数据
remmethod: experiment(实验) + al(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 实验上

en: to hate something or someone very much
ex1_en: The two men detested each other.
ex1_zh: 两个男人互相厌恶。
remmethod: de + test(考试) → 学生一般都憎恶考试 → 憎恶

en: to explain something that is difficult to understand by providing more information
ex1_en: The full picture has not yet been elucidated.
ex1_zh: 详细情况还没有解释清楚。
remmethod: e + lucid(清晰的) + ate → 弄清晰 → 阐明， 使…清楚

zh: 艺术品鉴赏家；古董收藏家；艺术大师
en: someone who is a very skilful performer, especially in music
ex1_en: violin virtuoso Vanessa Mae
ex1_zh: 小提琴大师陈美
remmethod: virtuo(看作virtue美德) + so → 讲究美德的艺人一般都是演艺精湛的人

ex1_en: Rising diagonally from the ground to the right of Venus is the band of our Milky Way Galaxy.
ex1_zh: 从地面斜对角向金星的右上方，可以看到我们的银河系的光带。
remmethod: di(a)(穿过) + gon(角) + ally(副词后缀) → 穿过角 → 斜对地；对角地

en: If you describe something as burdensome, you mean it is worrying or hard to deal with
ex1_en: The load was too burdensome.
ex1_zh: 负担太繁重了。
remmethod: 来自burden(n. 负担， 重担)

en: hair that grows on a man’s upper lip
ex1_en: He’s shaved off his moustache.
ex1_zh: 他剃去了小胡子。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 小胡子；髭

zh: 斯多葛学派哲学家；禁欲主义者；恬淡寡欲的人，不以苦乐为意的人
en: someone who does not show their emotions and does not complain when bad things happen to them
remmethod: 来自希腊哲学流派Stoic(斯多葛学派)， 主张坚忍克己

ex1_en: Her dog yelped and came to heel.
ex1_zh: 她的狗汪地叫了一声，紧跟了上来。
remmethod: 发出尖叫(yelp)， 寻求帮助(help)

en: great excitement and happiness
ex1_en: The boys gazed up at him in rapture.
ex1_zh: 男孩们欣喜若狂地抬头注视着他。
remmethod: rap(抓；夺) + ture(名词后缀) → 心神被夺走 → 全神贯注；兴高采烈

en: a hard, usually green stone often used to make jewellery
ex1_en: a jade necklace
ex1_zh: 翡翠项链
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 碧玉；翡翠；老马

en: a small shiny orange fish often kept as a pet
ex1_en: I have nine little goldfish .
ex1_zh: 我有九条小金鱼。
remmethod: gold(金) + fish(鱼) → 金鱼

zh: 挣扎，折腾；错乱地做事或说话
en: to have a lot of problems and be likely to fail completely
ex1_en: More and more firms are floundering because of the recession.
ex1_zh: 由于经济衰退，越来越多的公司举步维艰。
remmethod: 他发现 (found) 前方有很多障碍， 他只能困难地往前走 → 困难地往前走

en: a special oven for baking clay pots, bricks etc
ex1_en: They are charring wood in a kiln.
ex1_zh: 他们正在窑内将木头烧成木炭。
remmethod: 煤窑(kiln)倒塌杀死(kill)了许多人

ex1_en: the risks involved in such an audacious operation
ex1_zh: 如此大胆的行动中存在的风险
remmethod: audac(=audax大胆) + ious → 大胆的

en: a tree such as a  pine  or  fir  that has leaves like needles and produces brown  cones  that contain seeds. Most types of conifer keep their leaves in winter.
ex1_en: Red squirrels cut conifer cones from trees and bury them in plant litter on the forest floor.
ex1_zh: 红松鼠会将针叶树上的果实割下来，然后埋在森林地面的落叶中。
remmethod: con(=cone圆锥， 松果) + i + fer(带来) → 带来松果的树 → 针叶树

en: work, especially physical work
ex1_en: The garage charges £30 an hour for labour.
ex1_zh: 汽车修理厂收取每小时30英镑的人工费。
remmethod: 旧时的港口 (harbour) 有很多劳力 (labour)

en: extremely bad, immoral, or cruel
ex1_en: It’s despicable the way he treats those kids.
ex1_zh: 他那样对待那些孩子，真卑鄙。
remmethod: de + spic(看) + able → 不值得看的 → 卑劣的

en: an instrument that measures changes in the air pressure and the weather, or that calculates height above sea level
ex1_en: The barometer is falling (= showing that it will probably rain).
ex1_zh: 气压在下降（表示可能要下雨）。
remmethod: baro(重压) + meter(仪表) → 气压计

en: A snippet of something is a small piece of it
remmethod: snip(剪) + pet(小) → 剪下的小块 → 小片；片段

zh: 封建制度的；领地的；世仇的
en: relating to feudalism
ex1_en: the feudal system
ex1_zh: 封建制度
remmethod: 来自feud(n. 封地)

en: not living
ex1_en: an inanimate object
ex1_zh: 无生命的物体
remmethod: in(无) + anim(生命) + ate → 无生命的

zh: 本国的；地方的；用本地语写成的
ex1_en: He lapsed into the local vernacular (= language spoken in a particular area ).
ex1_zh: 他说着说着就讲起了地方土话。
remmethod: “我奶哭了” → 离乡多年， 我奶奶一听到熟悉的乡音就激动地哭了 → 方言

ex1_en: The best gauge of quake risk is the geologic record.
ex1_zh: 我们最好的测量地震风险的办法是地质记录。
remmethod: geo(地) + log(学科) + ic(形容词后缀) → 地质的

en: frenetic activity is fast and not very organized
ex1_en: She rushes from job to job at a frenetic pace.
ex1_zh: 她发疯似的不停地跳槽。
remmethod: 他烧得 (fever) 厉害， 已经神志不清开始发狂 (frenetic) 了

en: holy or made holy by religious practices
ex1_en: The bones will be buried in hallowed ground.
ex1_zh: 尸骸将被安葬在神圣的土地上。
remmethod: 来自hallow(vt. 使神圣， 把…视作神圣)

en: arranged in a circular shape with bars or lines coming from the centre
ex1_en: radial roads leading out of the city centre
ex1_zh: 从市中心向外辐射的道路
remmethod: radi(光线；辐射) + al(形容词后缀) → 光线的；放射状的

zh: 沼泽，沼泽地；无法脱身的困境
en: an area of soft wet muddy ground
ex1_en: In the rainy season the roads become a quagmire.
ex1_zh: 在雨季，道路变得一片泥泞。
remmethod: quag(沼泽) ＋ mire(泥潭) → quagmire(沼泽地)

ex1_en: That's an antecedent standard. Moral desert.
ex1_zh: 道德应得，那是一个先行标准。
remmethod: ante(在…前面) + ced(走) + ent → 走在前面的 → 先行的

en: to walk, ride etc next to each other, all facing the same way
ex1_en: As the car drew abreast of him, Jack suddenly recognised the driver.
ex1_zh: 那辆车追上来与杰克并行时，他一下子就认出了驾车的人。
remmethod: a + breast(胸) → 胸和胸并排 → 并排

en: someone who is tricked, especially into becoming involved in something illegal
remmethod: “丢谱” → 瞎摆谱， 结果上了当， 丢了面子 → 易上当者

ex1_en: The clouds exhibit thin, wispy light blue forms that contrast with the darkness of space (image upper right).
ex1_zh: 云层稀薄而纤细，并泛着蓝光，和无尽的黑暗太空形成对比（右上部分）。
remmethod: 来自wisp(n. 小把， 小束)

en: to change the sound of your voice
ex1_en: He carefully modulated his voice.
ex1_zh: 他仔细地调节了自己的声音。
remmethod: mod(方式) + ulate → 改变方式 → 调整

en: someone who is dogmatic is completely certain of their beliefs and expects other people to accept them without arguing
ex1_en: Her staff find her bossy and dogmatic.
ex1_zh: 她的员工认为她爱指挥别人而且自以为是。
remmethod: dog (看作dox， 观点) + ma + tic (…的) → 只看自己的观点 → 独断的

en: to treat someone or something without respect or not in a serious way
ex1_en: He’s not a man to be trifled with.
ex1_zh: 他这个人怠慢不得。
remmethod: tri(三) ＋ fle → 分成三份后变得琐碎 → 琐事

en: a method of calculating in which you add a number to itself a particular number of times
ex1_en: There will be simple tests in addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
ex1_zh: 将会有加减乘除的简单测试。
remmethod: multi(多) + plic(折叠；倍) + ation(名词) → 多次加倍 → 乘法

en: a secret agreement that two or more people make in order to do something dishonest
ex1_en: He found no evidence of collusion between record companies and retailers.
ex1_zh: 他找不出唱片公司与零售商互相勾结的证据。
remmethod: col (共同) + lus (玩耍) + ion (名词后缀) → 共谋， 勾结

en: a light plane that flies without an engine
ex1_en: And go for a ride on a glider airplane, because who says planes need motors?
ex1_zh: 她会去坐滑翔机，因为没人说过飞机一定要有发动机吧？
remmethod: glid(滑行) + er(表物) → 滑翔机

en: the sharp curved point of a hook,  arrow  etc that prevents it from being easily pulled out
ex1_en: The barb stung her exactly the way he hoped it would.
ex1_zh: 他的讽刺如期伤到了她。
remmethod: barb原也指倒翘的胡子， 后来胡子一词变为beard

zh: 无情的；麻木的；硬结的；起老茧的
en: not caring that other people are suffering
ex1_en: We were shocked at the callous disregard for human life.
ex1_zh: 我们对这种无视人类生命的冷漠感到震惊。
remmethod: 来自callus(n. 老茧)

en: having the same centre
ex1_en: concentric circles
ex1_zh: 同心圆
remmethod: con(共同) + centr(中心) + ic → 有着共同中心的 → 同心的

en: famous and admired because of what you have achieved
ex1_en: She has had an illustrious career.
ex1_zh: 她已经有了辉煌的事业。
remmethod: il(进入) + lus(光) + tr + ious → 进入光中 → 著名的

en: a document, painting, or piece of paper money that has been copied illegally
ex1_en: The painting was a very clever forgery.
ex1_zh: 这幅画是件很巧妙的赝品。
remmethod: 来自forge(v. 伪造)

en: If someone does something carelessly, they do it without much thought or effort
ex1_en: He carelessly left the door unlocked.
ex1_zh: 他很粗心，没锁上门。
remmethod: care(小心) + less(无) + ly(副词后缀) → 粗心地

en: to start burning; to make a fire start burning
ex1_en: We watched as the fire slowly kindled.
ex1_zh: 我们看着火慢慢地燃烧起来。
remmethod: 点燃(kindle)蜡烛(candle)

zh: 卑鄙的；可怜的；不幸的；（境况）凄惨的，绝望的
ex1_en: an abject apology
ex1_zh: 低声下气的道歉
remmethod: ab(脱离) + ject(抛， 扔) → 被人抛弃的 → 极可怜的

zh: 委任， 授权； 把…归于； 正式认可
ex1_en: This degree programme is fully accredited by the Institution of Electrical Engineers.
ex1_zh: 这个学位课程是经英国电机工程师学会完全认可的。
remmethod: 因为信任 (accredit) 才发给你信用卡 (credit)

zh: 被发现的东西, 收藏的东西
ex1_en: But at the stern of the ship, divers found a trove of gold and silver and high-grade ceramics whose significance is more mysterious.
ex1_zh: 但是潜水人员在船尾部发现了一个由金、银以及高级陶瓷打造的收藏品，这件收藏品的意义更加神秘。
remmethod: 一生中最应收藏的东西 (trove) 是真爱 (true love) → 收藏的东西

en: having low moral standards and being more concerned with pleasure than serious matters
ex1_en: Pop music was condemned as decadent and crude.
ex1_zh: 流行音乐被指责为堕落而又粗俗。
remmethod: de(向下) + cad(掉， 落) + ent → 向下落的 → 堕落的

en: something that is a feature of only one particular place, person, situation etc
ex1_en: The lack of a written constitution is a peculiarity of the British political system.
ex1_zh: 没有一部成文宪法是英国政治制度的一大特点。
remmethod: peculiar(特有) + ity(名词后缀) → 特性；怪癖

en: the process of checking or slightly changing an instrument or tool so that it does something correctly
ex1_en: a calibration error
ex1_zh: 校准误差
remmethod: calibr(校准) + ation(名词后缀) → 标度；刻度

zh: 选举权；投票；参政权；代祷；赞成票
en: the right to vote in national elections
remmethod: suf(=sub 下面) + frag(表示拥护的喧闹声) + e → 选举权

en: to close a business or company and sell the things that belong to it, in order to pay its debts
ex1_en: The stock was sold to liquidate the loan.
ex1_zh: 股票被卖出以偿还贷款。
remmethod: liquid(清澈的) + ate → 弄清 → 清算； 清偿

en: to think that something is likely to happen in the future
ex1_en: The scheme cost a lot more than we had originally envisaged.
ex1_zh: 该计划的花费大大超出了我们最初所预想的数额。
remmethod: en+vis(看)+age→使看得更远→展望， 想象

zh: （要价等）过高的,（性格等）过分的
en: an exorbitant price, amount of money etc is much higher than it should be
ex1_en: Exorbitant housing prices have created an acute shortage of affordable housing for the poor.
ex1_zh: 过高的房价使穷人负担得起的房源严重短缺。
remmethod: ex (出) + orbit (轨道； 常规) + ant → 越轨 → 过度的

en: a type of glove that does not have separate parts for each finger
ex1_en: sheepskin mittens
ex1_zh: 羊皮连指手套
remmethod: mitt(中间；手套) + en(指小后缀) → 连指手套；棒球手套

zh: 节约的， 节俭的； 少量的
en: careful to buy only what is necessary
ex1_en: As children we were taught to be frugal and hard-working.
ex1_zh: 我们小时候被教育要节俭和勤劳。
remmethod: “腐乳过日” → 吃腐乳过日子 → 节约的

en: (of an alcoholic drink) to produce in (a person) a state ranging from euphoria to stupor, usually accompanied by loss of inhibitions and control; make drunk; inebriate
remmethod: in(进入) + toxic(有毒的) + ate → 中毒了 → (使)沉醉

en: If you refer to the mediocrity of something, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better
remmethod: mediocr(中等的) + ity(名词后缀) → 平常；平庸之才

en: not needing oxygen in order to live
ex1_en: anaerobic bacteria
ex1_zh: 厌氧菌
remmethod: an(不， 无) + aero(空气) + bic → 不要空气的 → 厌氧的

zh: 狼吞虎咽的, 贪婪的
en: If you describe a person, or their appetite for something, as voracious, you mean that they want a lot of something
ex1_en: Joseph Smith was a voracious book collector.
ex1_zh: 约瑟夫·史密斯是一个如饥似渴的藏书家。
remmethod: vor(吃)+aci+ous(多…的) → 吃得多的 → 狼吞虎咽的； 贪婪的

en: to escape from a difficult or embarrassing situation, or to help someone escape
ex1_en: It represents a last-ditch attempt by the country to extricate itself from its economic crisis.
ex1_zh: 这是该国摆脱经济危机的最后一搏。
remmethod: ex + tric(小障碍物) + ate → 从小障碍物中出来 → 救出

en: relating to horse-riding
ex1_en: equestrian sports
ex1_zh: 马术运动
remmethod: equ(古意： 马) + estrian(人) → 骑在马上的人 → 骑师

en: to give someone more courage
ex1_en: Emboldened by her smile, he asked her to dance.
ex1_zh: 她的微笑让他鼓起勇气邀请她跳舞。
remmethod: em (使…) + bold (大胆) + en → 使人大胆 → 壮胆

en: old and in bad condition
ex1_en: The buildings were in a decrepit state.
ex1_zh: 这些建筑物破旧不堪。
remmethod: de + crepit(破裂声) → 破旧的

en: the state of being private and away from other people
ex1_en: They enjoyed ten days of peace and seclusion.
ex1_zh: 他们享受了十天与世隔绝的宁静生活。
remmethod: 来自seclus (ive) (隔离) + ion → 隔离， 归隐

en: if there is an inverse relationship between two amounts, one gets bigger at the same rate as the other gets smaller
ex1_en: Clearly, the amount of money people save increases in inverse proportion to the amount they spend.
ex1_zh: 显然，人们储蓄的增加与消费成反比。
remmethod: in(反)+vers(转)+e→反转→倒转的

en: a hard mineral substance that is used in making electronic watches and clocks
ex1_en: quartz crystals
ex1_zh: 石英晶体
remmethod: quart(看作quarter， 一刻钟) ＋ z → 钟表 → 石英钟 → 石英

zh: 橡皮；擦除器；[计] 清除器
en: a small piece of rubber that you use to remove pencil or pen marks from paper
ex1_en: Yes, I have your eraser, too.
ex1_zh: 是的，我还拿了你的橡皮。
remmethod: e(出) + ras(擦) + er(表物) → 擦除器；橡皮

zh: 救济；赔偿；纠正；重新调整
en: to correct something that is wrong or unfair
ex1_en: Little could be done to redress the situation .
ex1_zh: 局势难以挽回。
remmethod: re(重新) + dress(穿衣； 整理) → 重新整理 → 矫正， 修正

zh: 大剪刀, 快速帆船修剪者
en: a special tool with two blades, used for cutting small pieces from something
ex1_en: nail clippers
ex1_zh: 指甲剪
remmethod: clip(剪) + p + er(表物) → 大剪刀；快速帆船；修剪者

ex1_en: evening dresses in opulent fabrics
ex1_zh: 用华丽织物做成的晚礼服
remmethod: opul(财富) + ent → 富裕的

en: not moving at all
ex1_en: She could see a figure sitting immobile, facing the sea.
ex1_zh: 她看到一个人影面朝大海坐着，一动不动。
remmethod: im(不) + mob(动) + ile(形容词后缀) → 不动的 → 稳定的，不变的

en: a bird with a long beak that it uses to make holes in trees
ex1_en: A woodcutter and a woodpecker lived in the forest.
ex1_zh: 森林里居住着一个樵夫和一个啄木鸟。
remmethod: wood(木) + peck(啄) + er(表施动者) → 啄木鸟

en: a quick or secret look at something
ex1_en: "Fourteen minutes," Chris said, taking a peep at his watch.
ex1_zh: “十四分钟，”克里斯瞥了一眼手表说道。
remmethod: 偷看颠倒过来(peep → peep)还是偷看

en: to succeed in dealing with a problem or difficulty
ex1_en: He has had to surmount immense physical disabilities.
ex1_zh: 他不得不克服严重的身体残疾。
remmethod: sur(在…下) + mount(山) → 将山踩在脚下 → 克服， 战胜

en: to prevent someone or something from moving
ex1_en: The broken limb must be immobilized immediately.
ex1_zh: 断肢必须立即加以固定。
remmethod: im(不) + mobil(运动的) + ize(使…) → 使不动
tele(远) + vise(看) → 远距离观看 → 播映

en: an electronic instrument that produces the sounds of various musical instruments
ex1_en: Now he can only communicate through a voice synthesizer.
ex1_zh: 如今他只能通过声音合成器来进行交流。
remmethod: syn(共同) + thes(放置) + izer(器具/者) → 把声音共同放在一起的器具 → 合成器

ex1_en: He had a red woolen muffler round his neck and his skin was rather reddish too.
ex1_zh: 他脖子上围了一个红色的羊毛围巾，他的皮肤也相当的暗红。
remmethod: 来自wool (羊毛)
pauc(少的) + ity → 极小量， 少量

ex1_en: a speech of passionate eloquence
ex1_zh: 激情洋溢的演讲
remmethod: e + loqu(说) + ence → 能说 → 雄辩

en: someone who is irreverent does not show respect for organizations, customs, beliefs etc that most other people respect – often used to show approval
ex1_en: his irreverent sense of humour
ex1_zh: 他失礼的幽默感
remmethod: ir(不) + re(再) + ver(感到敬畏) + ent → 不再感到敬畏的 → 不敬的

en: a dead human body, especially one used for study
ex1_en: Cadavers are used to teach med students surgical skills and anatomy.
ex1_zh: 尸体是教授医学院学生外科手术技术和解剖用的。
remmethod: cad (= fall， 倒下) + aver (看作over) → 生命结束后倒下 → 尸体
本词(自身词根) → 间歇泉；烧水锅炉

zh: 适合的，一致的；全等的；和谐的
en: fitting together well
ex1_en: They want to work in an organization whose values are congruent with their own.
ex1_zh: 他们想在一家与他们自己的价值观相同的组织里工作。
remmethod: con + gru(=gree一致) + ent → 全等的， 一致的

en: to hate a kind of behaviour or way of thinking, especially because you think it is morally wrong
ex1_en: I abhor discrimination of any kind.
ex1_zh: 我厌恶任何一种歧视。
remmethod: ab(表加强) + hor(发抖) → 令人发抖 → 憎恨， 厌恶

en: a bird, such as a chicken, that is kept for its meat and eggs, or the meat of this type of bird
ex1_en: Carve the fowl into 8 pieces.
ex1_zh: 将这只家禽切成8块。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 家禽；禽肉

en: a ruddy face looks pink and healthy
ex1_en: a ruddy complexion
ex1_zh: 红润的脸色
remmethod: 整天同泥土 (muddy) 打交道的孩子， 身体健康， 脸色红润 (ruddy)

zh: 肆无忌惮的；寡廉鲜耻的；不讲道德的
en: behaving in an unfair or dishonest way
ex1_en: unscrupulous employers
ex1_zh: 无耻的雇主
remmethod: un(表否定) + scrupulous(小心的) → 不讲道德的

zh: 恶毒的；有恶意的；坏心肠的
en: a malevolent person wants to harm other people
ex1_en: Her stare was malevolent, her mouth a thin line.
ex1_zh: 她目光狠毒，嘴唇紧闭。
remmethod: male(恶) + vol(意念) + ent → 有恶意的； 恶毒的

en: to make an unpleasant feeling less painful or severe
ex1_en: Nothing could assuage his guilt.
ex1_zh: 什么都不能减轻他的内疚。
remmethod: ass (驴子) + u + age (年龄) → 驴子上了年纪， 应该减轻负担 → 减轻

ex1_en: small iridescent blue flies
ex1_zh: 色彩变幻的蓝色小苍蝇
remmethod: irid(=iris彩虹) + escent(开始…的) → 闪着彩虹般的光的 → 色彩斑斓的

en: said or done without a good reason, in a way that offends someone
ex1_en: children’s books which include gratuitous violence
ex1_zh: 包含无谓暴力内容的儿童书籍
remmethod: 来自gratuity(n. 小费)； 付小费严格说不是义务， 所以有“无缘无故”之意

en: if a particular period of time elapses, it passes
ex1_en: Several months elapsed before his case was brought to trial.
ex1_zh: 过了几个月他的案子才开审。
remmethod: e(出) ＋ lapse(滑) → 滑出 → (时间)消逝， 过去

en: a male teacher who is in charge of a school
ex1_en: This headmaster is very modest.
ex1_zh: 这位校长很谦虚。
remmethod: head(头；首) + master(主人；教师) → 校长
本词(自身词根) → 爱好；兴致

en: showing that you think someone or something deserves no respect
ex1_en: a contemptuous glance
ex1_zh: 轻蔑的一瞥
remmethod: 注意contemptible和contemptuous都来自contempt； contemptible是指做的事令人轻视， 而contemptuous是指人轻视的态度

en: unpleasant or morally offensive
ex1_en: What follows is John’s story. Parts of it may seem distasteful, even shocking.
ex1_zh: 接下来是约翰的叙述，其中有些部分也许令人不快，甚至令人震惊。
remmethod: dis(不) + tasteful(好吃的) → 不好吃的 → 讨厌的

en: a feeling of being annoyed or upset, especially because someone has ignored you or insulted you
ex1_en: He stormed out in a fit of pique .
ex1_zh: 他气呼呼地冲了出去。
remmethod: piqu(刺激) + e → 因受刺激而不悦 → 激怒

zh: 不适宜的, 不合适的
en: not having the right qualities for a particular person, purpose, or situation
ex1_en: unsuitable housing
ex1_zh: 不合适的住房
remmethod: un(不) + suit(适合) + able(能…的) → 不适宜的；不合适的

zh: 相称的；同量的；同样大小的
en: matching something in size, quality, or length of time
ex1_en: Employees are paid salaries commensurate with those of teachers.
ex1_zh: 发给雇员的薪水与发给教师的薪水相当。
remmethod: com(共同) + mensur(测量) + ate(…的) → 测量相同 → 相称的

zh: 排斥的；防水的；弹回的；令人讨厌的
en: very unpleasant
ex1_en: She found him physically repellent.
ex1_zh: 她觉得他的长相很讨厌。
remmethod: 来自repel (v. 使厌恶)

zh: 崇高的， 高贵的， 显赫的
en: having a very high rank and highly respected
ex1_en: I felt shy in such exalted company.
ex1_zh: 我与如此显贵的人在一起觉得拘束。
remmethod: ex + alt(高的) + ed → 崇高的

en: a large open vehicle with no wheels that is used for travelling over snow and is pulled along by animals
ex1_en: In front of us stood Santa's sleigh.
ex1_zh: 在我们前面的是圣诞老人的雪橇。
remmethod: sleigh(自身词根) → 雪车，雪橇

ex1_en: Now I fully recognize that I’m sitting here, a nobody myself, spouting off in what could be considered a hypocritical tirade, guilty of the same thing Ms. Barr is.
ex1_zh: 现在，我完全意识到我正坐在这儿，只有我自己，进行着一次被认为是伪善的长篇演讲，对同巴尔遇到的同样的事儿感到内疚。
remmethod: tir(拉)+ade → 拉长的话 → 长篇的攻击性演说

en: a list of special words and explanations of their meanings, often at the end of a book
ex1_en: A glossary of terms is included for the reader's convenience.
ex1_zh: 为了方便读者，还收录了术语汇编。
remmethod: gloss(舌头， 语言) + ary → 词汇表

en: to go on a walk in the countryside for pleasure
ex1_en: There’s plenty to discover as you ramble around this little island.
ex1_zh: 漫步这个小岛，你会有很多新发现。
remmethod: 和amble (v. 缓行) 一起记

en: different from what you expected to find
ex1_en: a highly anomalous situation
ex1_zh: 极其反常的形势
remmethod: a(不) + nomal(看做normal， 正常的) + ous → 异常的； 不规则的

zh: 有感情的；有感觉力的；意识到的
en: able to experience things through your senses
ex1_en: Man is a sentient being.
ex1_zh: 人是有感知力的生命。
remmethod: sent(感觉) + ient → 有感觉能力的

ex1_en: We never think of this legume unless it's in our soup.
ex1_zh: 我们从想不到这种豆类，除非它们放在汤里。
remmethod: leg(采集) + ume(名词后缀) → 豆类；豆荚

en: to continue to exist or be effective for a longer time than something else
ex1_en: Smith outlasted his rivals in the council to become leader in 1996.
ex1_zh: 史密斯比对手坚持得更久，于1996年成了委员会的领导人。
remmethod: out(超越) + last(坚持) → 比…持久

en: boring because of always being the same
ex1_en: a monotonous diet
ex1_zh: 单调的饮食
remmethod: mono(单个)+ton(声音)+ous→一个声音的→单调的

en: the act of scraping
ex1_en: I can't bear the sound of chalk scraping on a blackboard.
ex1_zh: 我忍受不了粉笔在黑板上的刮擦声。
remmethod: scrap(刮；擦) + ing(名词后缀) → 刮，擦

en: A humanistic idea, condition, or practice relates to humanism
ex1_en: Religious values can often differ greatly from humanistic morals.
ex1_zh: 宗教价值观常常和人文主义道德观相去甚远。
remmethod: human(人) + ist(表人；主义) + ic(形容词后缀) → 人文的

en: a deep wide hole, usually filled with water, dug around a castle as a defence
ex1_en: Certainly no one in the media would deny the attraction of living behind a deep moat, even if it is filled with sharks.
ex1_zh: 当然，在媒体业，没有人会否认围在深深的护城河里面过日子的吸引力，即使那河里满是鲨鱼在游来游去。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 护城河

en: the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees
ex1_en: The town lies at longitude 12˚ east.
ex1_zh: 这个镇位于东经12度。
remmethod: long(长的)+i+tude→连接南北两极的长线叫经线→经度

en: someone who puts money in a bank or other financial organization
ex1_en: Notice that the St. Louis memo tiptoes around the question of telling a depositor that he has a demand deposit while telling the rest of the country that he has a time deposit.
ex1_zh: 请注意，圣路易斯储备银行的备忘录一直在一个问题上遮遮掩掩，那就是把存款人的活期存款说成定期存款，欺骗国人。
remmethod: deposit(存放) + or(表人) → 存款人；存放者

zh: 清晰地发音； 表达， 阐明
en: to express an idea clearly and exactly
ex1_en: ideas that he was to enunciate decades later
ex1_zh: 他将于数十年后清晰阐述的想法
remmethod: e(出) + nunci(说) + ate → 说出来 → 清晰地发音； 表达

en: annoying
ex1_en: Those pesky kids!
ex1_zh: 那些讨厌的孩子！
remmethod: pesk(烦扰) + y(形容词后缀) → 讨厌的；烦人的

en: the babies of animals or plants
remmethod: pro(前) + gen(产生) + y → 前人所生下的 → 后代

en: a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, such as ‘he’ instead of ‘Peter’ or ‘the man’
ex1_en: Here you should use plural pronoun.
ex1_zh: 这里你应该用复数代词。
remmethod: pro(在…前) ＋ noun(名词) → 代替名词使用 → 代词

en: if two things are interwoven, they are closely related or combined in a complicated way
ex1_en: For these people, land is inextricably interwoven with life itself.
ex1_zh: 对那些人来说，土地和生活本身紧密交织在一起。
remmethod: inter(在中间) + weave(编织) → 交织， 编结

en: a delay before something bad happens or continues to happen
ex1_en: Fourteen people, waiting to be hanged for the murder of a former prime minister, have been reprieved.
ex1_zh: 因谋杀前总理而等受绞刑的十四个人获得缓刑。
remmethod: re(后)+priev(＝prehend 抓住) → 抓住放在后面 → 暂不执行死刑 → 缓刑

zh: （海等）波浪起伏的, (指风)不断改变方向的
en: choppy water has a lot of waves and is not smooth to sail on
ex1_en: The small boat bobbed about on the choppy water.
ex1_zh: 小船在波浪起伏的水面上颠簸。
remmethod: chop(切；劈) + p + y(多…的) → 波浪起伏的；风向多变的

en: the upper level of soil in which most plants have their roots
ex1_en: Dump the topsoil here.
ex1_zh: 把表土倒在这里。
remmethod: top(顶部) + soil(土壤) → 表层土

zh: 明智的；头脑精明的；判断正确的
en: done in a sensible and careful way
ex1_en: a judicious choice
ex1_zh: 审慎而明智的选择
remmethod: judic (判断) + ious → 判断力强的 → 明智的

en: a symbiotic relationship is one in which the people, organizations, or living things involved depend on each other
remmethod: sym(共同) + bio(生命) + tic → 享有共同的生命 → 共生的

en: cruel and showing no kindness or forgiveness
ex1_en: a merciless attack
ex1_zh: 无情的攻击
remmethod: merci(怜悯) + less(无) → 无怜悯的 → 残忍的；无情的

en: a very large South American  vulture (= a bird that eats dead animals )
ex1_en: Just like this California condor, which—though teetering on the edge of extinction—still soars near the Grand Canyon in Arizona and in the state it was named after.
ex1_zh: 就像加利福利亚秃鹫，虽然依旧翱翔于亚利桑那和加利福利亚的大峡谷附近，但已在灭绝的悬崖边摇摇欲坠。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 秃鹰；秃鹫

zh: 着火的， 燃烧的； 闪耀的； 情绪激动的
en: burning strongly with a lot of flames
ex1_en: Within minutes the whole house was ablaze.
ex1_zh: 几分钟内，整座房子就成了一片火海。
remmethod: a + blaze(火焰) → 火焰般的 → 燃烧的

en: a word with the same meaning as another word in the same language
ex1_en: The term "industrial democracy" is often used as a synonym for worker participation.
ex1_zh: “工业民主”这一词语常被用作“工人参与”的同义词。
remmethod: syn(共同) + onym(字， 词) → 同义词

en: when you learn something by repeating it many times, without thinking about it carefully or without understanding it
ex1_en: In old-fashioned schools, much learning was by rote .
ex1_zh: 在旧式学校里，很多学习都是靠死记硬背。
remmethod: rot(转) + e → 摇头晃脑地转着背 → 死记硬背

en: to twist two things together or to wind one thing around another
ex1_en: They walked together with their arms entwined.
ex1_zh: 他们挽着胳膊一起走。
remmethod: en(使) + twine(缠绕) → 使缠绕

en: When people or things regress, they return to an earlier and less advanced stage of development
ex1_en: If your child regresses to babyish behaviour, all you know for certain is that the child is under stress.
ex1_zh: 如果你的孩子退步到幼稚的行为，你可以肯定的是孩子正处在压力之下。
remmethod: re(向后) + gress(行走) → 向后走 → 倒退， 复归， 逆行

zh: 夷为平地；破坏；消除；拆毁
en: to completely destroy a town or building
ex1_en: In 1162 Milan was razed to the ground by imperial troops.
ex1_zh: 1162年米兰被帝国军队夷为平地。
remmethod: 彻底破坏 (raze) 一个种族 (race)

zh: 乐观的；满怀希望的；面色红润的
en: happy and hopeful about the future
ex1_en: a sanguine view
ex1_zh: 乐观的态度
remmethod: sangui(血) + ne → 有血色的 → 红润的

ex1_en: These have focused on simplifying the development, automation, and optimization of applications.
ex1_zh: 这主要集中在简化应用程序的开发、自动化和优化方面。
remmethod: optim(最佳) + ization(名词后缀) → 最佳化

en: to limit power, rights, or abilities
ex1_en: The President’s power is circumscribed by Congress and the Supreme Court.
ex1_zh: 总统的权力受到国会和最高法院的制约。
remmethod: circum(绕圈) + scribe(画) → 画地为牢 → 限制

en: someone who lives alone and has a simple way of life, usually for religious reasons
ex1_en: I've spent the past ten years living like a hermit.
ex1_zh: 我过去10年里过着隐士般的生活。
remmethod: 不permit (允许) hermit (隐士) 的存在是很荒谬的

en: a short board with two small wheels at each end, which you can stand on and ride for fun or as a sport
ex1_en: He has long hair.He has a black skateboard.Who is he?
ex1_zh: 他有长头发.他有一黑色溜冰板.他是谁？
remmethod: skate(滑冰) + board(板) → 滑板

en: something that you compare another thing with, in order to judge how good or successful it is
ex1_en: The book gives a yardstick for measuring assets.
ex1_zh: 该书为评估资产提供了一种标准。
remmethod: yard(码) + stick(棍；尺) → 码尺 → 准绳

en: one of a pair of very long pointed teeth, that stick out of the mouth of animals such as  elephants
ex1_en: A huge tusk decorated the wall of his study.
ex1_zh: 他书房的墙上装饰着一支巨大的象牙。
remmethod: 保护好自己的长牙(tusk)是大象们的重要任务(task)之一

ex1_en: However, that method comes with a disclaimer: Do not use it unless you are sure of the result.
ex1_zh: 然而，那个方法却有一个放弃声明：不要使用它除非您能确定这个结果。
remmethod: disclaim(否认；放弃) + er(表物) → 免责声明；弃权声明

zh: 谬误， 虚假； 谎言， 说谎
en: a statement that is untrue
ex1_en: Saunders is deliberately telling a falsehood.
ex1_zh: 桑德斯在故意说假话。
remmethod: false(虚伪的) + hood(名词后缀) → 谎言

en: a powder or liquid, such as salt or  ketchup  , that you use to give a special taste to food
ex1_en: Friendship is not only the condiment but also the anodyne of life.
ex1_zh: 友谊是人生的调味品，也是人生的止痛药。
remmethod: con(一起) + di(放) + ment(名词后缀) → 放在一起 → 调味品

en: an explosive substance used in bombs and  fireworks
remmethod: gun(枪炮) + powder(粉末) → 火药

zh: 重新计划， 重订…的时间表
en: to arrange for something to happen at a different time from the one that was previously planned
ex1_en: Since I'll be away, I'd like to reschedule the meeting.
ex1_zh: 既然我将要离开，我想重新安排一下这次会议的时间。
remmethod: re(重新) + schedule(计划) → 重新计划，重订…的时间表

en: something that you use to join something together, such as a button on a piece of clothing
ex1_en: shoes with velcro fasteners
ex1_zh: 带维可牢搭链的鞋
remmethod: fasten(扣紧；系牢) + er(表物) → 扣件；钮扣；揿钮

en: If you are loath to do something, you do not want to do it
ex1_en: Sensing he held the advantage, Mr. Danbar was loath to change the subject.
ex1_zh: 丹巴先生觉得占有优势，不愿改变话题。
remmethod: loath(厌恶，不愿意) → 不愿意的

zh: 被日光照射了的, 阳光照射的
en: made brighter by light from the sun
ex1_en: a sunlit garden
ex1_zh: 阳光灿烂的花园
remmethod: sun(太阳) + lit(light的过去式， 照亮) → 阳光照射的

en: so interested in something that you do not notice anything else
ex1_en: They listened with rapt attention .
ex1_zh: 他们全神贯注地听着。
remmethod: rap(抓取) + t → 夺去了所有注意力 → 入迷的

en: if something impels you to do something, it makes you feel very strongly that you must do it
remmethod: im(在…里面) + pel(推) → 推进

en: to organize the control of a country, organization, or system so that everything is done or decided in one place
ex1_en: plans to centralize the company’s U.S. activities
ex1_zh: 公司对在美国的业务活动进行统一管理的计划
remmethod: central(中央的) + ize(使) → 集中于中央

en: to cut off someone’s arm, leg, finger etc during a medical operation
ex1_en: Two of her toes were amputated because of frostbite.
ex1_zh: 她的两个脚趾因为冻伤被截掉了。
remmethod: am (看作arm) + put (切除) + ate (做) → 切除 (手臂、 腿等)

en: used to address a woman in a polite way, especially a customer in a shop
ex1_en: Are you being served, Madam?
ex1_zh: 有人接待您吗，夫人？
remmethod: ma(我的) + dam(女士) → 夫人；女士

ex1_en: a debatable point
ex1_zh: 有争议的地方
remmethod: 来自debate(v. 辩论)

ex1_en: In areas where river deltas inject organic material and dissolved trace elements into the sea, for instance, it’s not clear how all of the intricately related processes will affect water chemistry.
ex1_zh: 例如，在有些地区，河流三角洲将有机物质和溶解的微量元素注入海洋，目前还不清楚所有这些错综复杂的相关进程将如何影响水的化学性能。
remmethod: in(在内) + tric(纠缠；琐碎) + ate(动词/形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 杂乱地；复杂地
supreme(至高的) + ly(副词后缀) → 无上地

ex1_en: Campbell summed up by saying that nutrition is holistic, a concept which is “anathema” to most scientists’ method.
ex1_zh: 坎贝尔总结说，营养是全面的，这个概念是对大多数科学家的方法的“诅咒”。
remmethod: ana(错误) + them(他们) + a → 他们做错了所以被诅咒 → 被诅咒的人

ex1_en: Forgive them inasmuch as they are young.
ex1_zh: 原谅他们吧，因为他们还年轻。
remmethod: in(在) + as(如) + much(多) → 因为；由于

en: a metal tool with a sharp edge, used to cut wood or stone
ex1_en: He is chipping away at a block marble with a chisel.
ex1_zh: 他正在用凿子在大理石上不停地凿。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 凿子，錾子；凿，雕

en: continuing for ever, even after someone has died
ex1_en: everlasting fame
ex1_zh: 永久的名声
remmethod: ever(永远)＋lasting(持续) → 永久的

en: If a group of people practise cannibalism, they eat the flesh of other people
ex1_en: They were forced to practise cannibalism in order to survive.
ex1_zh: 为了生存，他们被迫同类相食。
remmethod: 来自cannibal(n. 食人者， 食同类的动物)

en: a science studied in the Middle Ages, that involved trying to change ordinary metals into gold
ex1_en: Invest early, and it will grow as if by alchemy.
ex1_zh: 早点投资，它会像点金术一样的增长的。
remmethod: al + chemy (化学) → 起化学反应来炼金 → 炼金术

zh: 腼腆的；忸怩作态的；怕羞的
en: shy or pretending to be shy in order to attract people’s interest
ex1_en: She gave him a coy smile.
ex1_zh: 她对他含羞一笑。
remmethod: 和boy及toy一起记； a coy boy plays toys(害羞男孩玩玩具)

zh: 难信的, 似乎不合情理的
en: difficult to believe and therefore unlikely to be true
ex1_en: It’s not entirely implausible that a galaxy could be identical to our own.
ex1_zh: 某个星系和我们这个星系完全相同并非完全不可能。
remmethod: im(不) + plausible(可信的) → 难以置信的

en: to make someone extremely angry
ex1_en: He was the calmest guy I ever knew – nothing ever riled him.
ex1_zh: 他是我认识的最冷静的人——没有什么事能让他生气。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 激怒；搅浑

zh: 自大的；浮夸的；华而不实的；爱炫耀的
en: someone who is pompous thinks that they are important, and shows this by being very formal and using long words – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: He seems rather pompous.
ex1_zh: 他看上去相当自负。
remmethod: pomp (壮丽) + ous → 无论多么壮丽美观的烟花都会很快消失 → 华而不实的

zh: 昏昏欲睡的； 催眠的
en: tired and almost asleep
ex1_en: The drug can make you drowsy.
ex1_zh: 这种药会让人昏昏欲睡。
remmethod: 来自drowse(v. 打瞌睡)

ex1_en: She rocked the baby to and fro.
ex1_zh: 她来回摇动着婴儿。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 往，去，回，向后

en: a man’s tie
ex1_en: Really? I should untie the necktie right now.
ex1_zh: 真的吗？那我还是赶紧把领带解了。
remmethod: neck(颈) + tie(系；带) → 系在颈部的带子 → 领带

en: a very thin  candle
ex1_en: small boys holding lighted tapers
ex1_zh: 拿着点燃的细蜡烛的小男孩
remmethod: taper(自身词根) → 锥形；锥度

en: to make someone very annoyed by continuing to do something that upsets them
ex1_en: It exasperates me to hear comments like that.
ex1_zh: 听到那样的评论令我恼怒。
remmethod: ex + asper(粗鲁的) + ate → 显出粗鲁 → 激怒

zh: 赦免； 免除； 宽恕
en: If a report or investigation absolves someone of blame or responsibility, it formally states that he or she is not guilty or is not to blame
ex1_en: A police investigation yesterday absolved the police of all blame in the incident.
ex1_zh: 警方昨天的调查为其开脱了在这件事故中所有的责任。
remmethod: ab(脱离) + solv (放开) + e → 放开使脱离罪责 → 赦免， 免除

en: someone who is studying at a university to get a  master’s degree  or a  phd
ex1_en: "Given the level of competition in law, I definitely think that my postgraduate degree helped to distinguish me from the crowd, " he says.
ex1_zh: 他说，“考虑到在法律行业的竞争水平，我确实认为我的研究生学位让我从众人中脱颖而出”。
remmethod: post(后) + graduate(毕业) → 毕业后继续学习的 → 研究生

en: relating to, forming, or characteristic of an axis
ex1_en: Angular momentum is an axial vector quantity.
ex1_zh: 角动量是一种轴矢量。
remmethod: ax(轴) + ial(形容词后缀) → 轴的；轴向的

en: to make something lose its effect or value
ex1_en: Recent inflation could nullify the economic growth of the last several years.
ex1_zh: 最近的通货膨胀可能会抵消过去数年的经济增长。
remmethod: null(无) + ify → 使无效

en: speech or writing that is didactic is intended to teach people a moral lesson
ex1_en: His novel has a didactic tone.
ex1_zh: 他的小说有一种道德说教的口吻。
remmethod: did(做) + act(行动) + ic → 教人如何做或行动 → 教诲的

zh: 英勇的，勇敢的；华丽的；雄伟的
en: brave
ex1_en: a gallant attempt to save lives
ex1_zh: 救人的勇敢之举
remmethod: gall(胆) + ant → 有胆量的 → 勇敢的， 英勇的

en: a poet
ex1_en: Gnomeo and Juliet is directed and co-written by animation veteran Kelly Asbury, who makes no apologies to William Shakespeare or to the bard's, perhaps, most malleable tale.
ex1_zh: 《格诺米欧和朱丽叶》的导演兼编剧是动漫老手凯利.阿斯博瑞，他对莎翁和古代的吟游诗人没有一丝愧疚之情，这大概是最具改编潜力的故事了。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 吟游诗人

en: to argue about something unimportant
ex1_en: Then, seemingly on the spur of the moment, Morty started a squabble.

en: inflexible rules, arrangements etc are impossible to change

en: serious trouble or a serious problem

en: feeling or looking shocked by something you have seen or just found out
ex1_en: Hank looked at her aghast.
ex1_zh: 汉克惊恐地望着她。

zh: [微]青霉素（一种抗菌素，音译名为盘尼西林）

ex1_zh: 他对青霉素的反应良好。

en: one of two poles which you can stand on and walk high above the ground

ex1_zh: 他们居住在建在水中木桩上的芦苇草屋里。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 高跷

en: balmy air, weather etc is warm and pleasant
ex1_en: a balmy summer night
ex1_zh: 一个宜人的夏夜

en: to make someone feel less afraid, worried etc
ex1_en: The president made a statement to allay public anxiety.
ex1_zh: 总统发表了一项声明以缓解公众的忧虑。

en: friendly and preferring to be with other people

remmethod: auto(自己) + mat(动) + e → 自己动 → 自动化

en: Enmity is a feeling of hatred toward someone that lasts for a long time

en: a statement, especially in mathematics, that you can prove by showing that it has been correctly developed from facts

ex1_zh: 数学定理

en: a chemical substance that is used to prevent things from decaying, for example food or wood

ex1_zh: 很多化学反应都是可逆的。

ex1_zh: 她试过以情相迫，不让他离开。

zh: 亮度， 发光度； 光明
en: The luminosity of a star or sun is how bright it is
ex1_en: For a few years its luminosity flared up to about 10,000 times the present-day luminosity of the Sun.
ex1_zh: 有几年它的亮度一度达到了现在的太阳亮度的一万倍左右。
remmethod: lumin(光) + osity → 发光度

en: a contract, ticket, claim etc that is invalid is not legally or officially acceptable
ex1_en: Without the right date stamped on it, your ticket will be invalid.
ex1_zh: 票上若没有加盖正确日期就是废票。
remmethod: in(无)+val(强壮的)+id→不强壮的→有病的

en: a wooden hammer with a large end
ex1_en: I even have a wooden mallet that was used by a judge over 300 years ago during condemnation proceedings in Salem.
ex1_zh: 我甚至还有一把300多年前的木槌。
remmethod: mall(锤) + et(指小) → 槌棒

en: the piece of thread in a candle, that burns when you light it
ex1_en: A tallow candle with a rush stem as the wick.
ex1_zh: 一种以灯芯草茎为灯芯的动物脂肪作成的蜡烛。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 灯芯；蜡烛心

en: to put something or someone in danger
ex1_en: Tax increases now might imperil economic recovery.
ex1_zh: 目前提高税收可能会危及经济的复苏。
remmethod: im(进入) + peril(危险)  → 使陷于危险

en: to make a bad situation better or less harmful
ex1_en: It is not clear what can be done to ameliorate the situation.
ex1_zh: 可以采取什么办法来改善局面并不明确。
remmethod: a + melior(=better更好) + ate → 改善， 改良

en: made up of sections that can be put together or taken apart
ex1_en: a sectional sofa
ex1_zh: 组合沙发
remmethod: sect(切) + ion(名词) + al(…的) → 各部分组成的，各阶层或不同部分的

en: the ability to be careful about what you say or do, so that you do not upset or embarrass other people
ex1_en: With great tact, Clive persuaded her to apologize.
ex1_zh: 克莱夫十分巧妙地说服了她去道歉。
remmethod: t + act (行动) → 善于行动 → 圆滑， 机敏， 老练

en: not consisting of anything that is living
ex1_en: inorganic matter
ex1_zh: 无机物
remmethod: in(非) + organ(器官；有机) + ic(形容词后缀) → 无机的；非自然生长的

en: to remove or get rid of something, especially by cutting it out
ex1_en: The tumour was excised.
ex1_zh: 肿瘤被切除了。
remmethod: ex(出) + cis(切) + e → 切除

ex1_en: We still lack a pair of chopsticks.
ex1_zh: 还少一双筷子。
remmethod: chop(砍) +sticks(棍) →砍成两半的棍子→筷子

en: damaging or harmful
ex1_en: the deleterious effects of smoking
ex1_zh: 吸烟的害处
remmethod: delete(删除) + rious → 要删除的东西 → 有害的

en: a piece of equipment for changing electricity from one  voltage  to another
ex1_en: By using a transformer, he translated the codes into translation he could read.
ex1_zh: 通过运用一个变压器，他将密码翻译成他读得懂的译文。
remmethod: trans(转变) + form(形式) + er(表物/人) → 变压器；促使变化的人

en: an unexplored place has not been examined or put on a map
ex1_en: unexplored planets
ex1_zh: 未经探索的行星
remmethod: un(未) + ex(出) + plor(探索) + ed(表被动) → 未勘查过的

ex1_en: He now repents of his past misdeeds.
ex1_zh: 他现在对自己过去犯下的种种恶行感到懊悔。
remmethod: mis (坏) + deed (行为) → 坏行为 → 罪行， 犯罪

en: a woman who rents a room, building, or piece of land to someone
ex1_en: There was a note under the door from my landlady.
ex1_zh: 门下有我女房东的一张便条。
remmethod: land(地产) + lady(女士) → 女房东

en: a small mark, especially a mark on someone’s skin or on the surface of an object, that spoils its appearance
ex1_en: Every piece is closely scrutinized, and if there is the slightest blemish on it, it is rejected.
ex1_zh: 每一件都经过仔细检查，如果上面有哪怕最微小的瑕疵，都会被拒绝。
remmethod: blem(弄伤) + ish → 把…弄伤 → 损害； 玷污

en: to be next to or joined to sth
ex1_en: A vacant plot of land adjoins his house.
ex1_zh: 有一块空地紧挨着他家。
remmethod: ad(附近， 向) ＋ join(连接) → 贴近

zh: 外来的；没有关联的；来自体外的
en: coming from outside
ex1_en: extraneous noises
ex1_zh: 外面传来的噪声
remmethod: extran(外面) + eous → 外来的

ex1_en: These days, her bandanna is usually red.
ex1_zh: 这些天，她的印花大手帕通常是红色的。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 大手帕

en: a round wire kitchen tool with a lot of small holes, used for separating solid food from liquid or small pieces of food from large pieces
ex1_en: We can separate the stones out with a sieve.
ex1_zh: 我们可以用一个筛子把石头分离出来。
remmethod: 用筛子(sieve)过一下是为了保留(save)精华

en: A preamble is an introduction that comes before something you say or write
ex1_en: The controversy has arisen over the text of the preamble to the unification treaty.
ex1_zh: 就统一条约的序文措词出现了争论。
remmethod: pre(在…之前) + amble(缓行， 漫步) → 走在前面 → 前言

ex1_en: The path zigzagged down the hillside.
ex1_zh: 小路沿着山坡蜿蜒而下。
remmethod: zig+zag(急转)→两个“Z”像中文的“之”字， 两个“Z”字急转→之字形

en: to make someone breathe again or become conscious after they have almost died
ex1_en: Doctors managed to resuscitate him.
ex1_zh: 医生把他抢救了过来。
remmethod: re + sus(在下面) + cit(引起) + ate → 再次从下面唤起来 → 使复活

en: tending to think deeply about your own thoughts, feelings, or behaviour
ex1_en: a shy and introspective person
ex1_zh: 一个腼腆自省的人
remmethod: 来自introspect(v. 内省， 反省)

en: to change into a vapour, or to make something, especially a liquid, do this
ex1_en: The benzene vaporized and formed a huge cloud of gas.
ex1_zh: 苯蒸发形成了一大团气体。
remmethod: 来自vapore (n. 蒸汽； 水蒸气)

en: to run easily with long steps
ex1_en: He was loping across the sand toward Nancy.
ex1_zh: 他正穿过沙滩轻快地向南希跑去。
remmethod: 注意不要和lobe(n. 耳垂)相混

en: behaving in a stupid and offensive way which shows that you do not understand or care about other people’s feelings
ex1_en: a crass remark
ex1_zh: 粗鲁的言语
remmethod: 和class(n. 班级； 课)一起记

en: to shout in a loud voice
ex1_en: ‘Tickets, please!’ bawled the conductor.
ex1_zh: “请大家买票！”售票员大声叫着。
remmethod: 不小心打破碗 (bowl) ， 不禁大叫 (bawl)一声

en: if insects, rats etc infest a place, there are a lot of them and they usually cause damage
remmethod: in(进入) + fest(集会) → 拥挤着参加集会 → 大批滋生

en: being kind to people and forgiving them rather than punishing them or being cruel
ex1_en: Merciful God, save us.
ex1_zh: 仁慈的上帝，救救我们吧。
remmethod: mercy(仁慈) + ful(充满…的) → 仁慈的；慈悲的

zh: 严厉的；顽强的；阴沉的；不爱讲话的
en: serious, never smiling, and unfriendly
remmethod: dour(自身词根；严厉) → 严厉的；阴沉的

zh: 揭穿；拆穿…的假面具；暴露
ex1_en: Historian Michael Beschloss debunks a few myths.
ex1_zh: 历史学家迈克尔·贝斯切罗斯揭露了一些神话的真相。
remmethod: de + bunk(看作bank， 岸) → 去掉河岸 → 暴露

en: if a country or state secedes from another country, it officially stops being part of it and becomes independent
ex1_en: Singapore seceded from the Federation of Malaysia and became an independent sovereign state.
ex1_zh: 新加坡脱离马来西亚联邦成为一个独立的主权国家。
remmethod: se(分开) + ced(走) + e → 走开， 脱离 → 正式脱离

en: to kill large numbers of people or animals of a particular type so that they no longer exist
ex1_en: Staff use the poison to exterminate moles and rabbits.
ex1_zh: 员工用毒药来消灭鼹鼠和野兔。
remmethod: ex(出) + termin(界限) + ate → 超出生存的界限 → 消除

en: a small attractive  cave
ex1_en: Water trickles through an underground grotto.
ex1_zh: 水流经一个地下岩洞。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 洞穴；岩穴；人工洞室

en: a building where lights on a curved ceiling show the movements of planets and stars
ex1_en: The motions of the stars can be approximated in a planetarium.
ex1_zh: 星星的运动可在天文馆里模拟。
remmethod: planet(行星) + arium(场所) → 天文馆

en: to make someone feel annoyed or worried
ex1_en: It vexed me to think of others gossiping behind my back.
ex1_zh: 想到别人在我背后说闲话让我很恼火。
remmethod: 惹恼 (vex) 公牛 (ox) 麻烦大

ex1_en: With regard to hardness, the diamond is in a class by itself.
ex1_zh: 讲硬度， 金刚钻是独一无二的。
remmethod: hard(硬) + ness(名词后缀) → 硬度

zh: ad/ 区别地, 特殊地
remmethod: distinct(不同的) + ive(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 区别地；特殊地

en: a brown sweet  soft drink  , or a bottle, can, or glass of this drink
ex1_en: a can of cola
ex1_zh: 一罐可乐
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 可乐饮料

zh: 无情的；不屈不挠的；不可阻挡的；无法改变的
en: an inexorable process cannot be stopped
ex1_en: the inexorable decline of Britain’s manufacturing industry
ex1_zh: 英国制造业无可挽回的衰落
remmethod: in(不) + ex(出) + or(说) + able → 不可被说服的 → 不为所动的

en: the main idea and meaning of what someone has said or written
ex1_en: Don’t worry about all the details as long as you get the gist (= understand the main meaning ) of it.
ex1_zh: 不要去管各个细节，只要理解主要意思就行了。
remmethod: 和list(v. 列出)一起记： list(列出)the gists(要点)

en: food - used especially when talking about the business of producing or selling food
ex1_en: a shortage of basic foodstuffs
ex1_zh: 基本食品短缺
remmethod: food(食物) + stuff(东西) → 食品

en: if fruit, beer, wine etc ferments, or if it is fermented, the sugar in it changes to alcohol
ex1_en: fermented fruit juice
ex1_zh: 发酵果汁
remmethod: ferm(=ferv热) + ent → 生热 → 发酵

en: advice about how to behave that is often unwanted
remmethod: hom ( = human， 人) + ily → 一群人在一起听说教 → 说教

ex1_en: Since the Greek language in which John wrote had no exclamation marks, he used an amplification technique that is common in Scriptures.
ex1_zh: 后来约翰用希腊语写作没有惊叹的标志，他在经文中普片的使用用一种放大的手法。
remmethod: ampl(大) + ific(做) + ation(名词后缀) → 扩大

en: a very small cut made on the edge or surface of something
ex1_en: The barbed wire had left only the tiniest nick just below my right eye.
ex1_zh: 这带刺的铁丝在我右眼正下方只留下了极小的划痕。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 刻痕；缺口

en: a chemical by which a nerve cell communicates with another nerve cell or with a muscle
ex1_en: All drugs of abuse stimulate the release of the neurotransmitter dopamine.
ex1_zh: 所有的药物滥用都刺激了神经递质多巴胺的释放。
remmethod: neuro(神经) + trans(跨越) + mit(送) + t + er(表物) → 神经递质

en: a strange feeling that something, especially something bad, is going to happen
ex1_en: He had an unshakable premonition that he would die.
ex1_zh: 他有一种强烈的预感：他就要死了。
remmethod: pre(预先) + mon(警告) + it + ion → 预先给出的警告 → 预感， 预兆

zh: 使…敌对；使…对抗；对…起反作用
en: to annoy someone very much by doing something that they do not like
ex1_en: Do not antagonize your customers.
ex1_zh: 不要惹恼顾客。
remmethod: antagon (看作antagonism， 对抗) + ize (表示动词) → 对抗

ex1_en: Riskier investments tend to be counterbalanced by high rewards.
ex1_zh: 较高风险的投资往往报以高回报。
remmethod: counter(相反的) + balance(平衡) → 相反的两边保持平衡 → 使平衡

en: A celibate is someone who is celibate
remmethod: celib(独身) + ate → 独身者

en: someone or something that existed before something similar that developed or came later
remmethod: fore(在前面) + runner(跑步者) → 跑在前面的人 → 先驱者

en: food or drink that is tasteless is unpleasant because it has no particular taste
ex1_en: a tasteless outfit
ex1_zh: 一套没有品位的衣服
remmethod: taste(味道) + less(无) → 无味的

en: to learn about something so that you understand it, or to teach someone else about something so that they understand it
ex1_en: Employees must familiarize themselves with the health and safety manual.
ex1_zh: 雇员必须熟悉健康和安全手册。
remmethod: 来自familiar(a. 熟悉的)

ex1_en: This is an exponential function.
ex1_zh: 因为这里是指数函数。
remmethod: ex(出) + pon(放置) + ential(…的) → 指数(的)

en: if something irks you, it makes you feel annoyed
ex1_en: The rehearsal process also irked him increasingly.
ex1_zh: 排练过程也更加让他厌烦。
remmethod: “饿渴” → 又饿又渴， 当然苦恼厌烦

en: the production by a green plant of special substances like sugar that it uses as food, caused by the action of sunlight on  chlorophyll (= the green substance in leaves )
ex1_en: It has at least one gene necessary for photosynthesis—so far it’s the only animal known with this ability.
ex1_zh: 它有至少一个基因是光合作用所必需的——到目前为止这是唯一被发现具有此项能力的动物。
remmethod: photo(光) + synthesis(综合) → 光合作用

en: an attitude that shows you have too high an opinion of your own abilities or importance
ex1_en: The conceit of the woman!
ex1_zh: 这个自负的女人！
remmethod: con(表加强) + ceit(拿) → 全部拿到 → 自负

en: a feeling of strong dislike towards someone or something
remmethod: anti + pathy(感情) → 反感

en: good enough for a particular purpose
ex1_en: Her disappearance has never been satisfactorily explained.
ex1_zh: 她的失踪一直没有得到令人信服的解释。
remmethod: satis(足够) + fact(做) + ory(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 做得足够好地 → 圆满地

en: the physical force that makes two metal objects pull towards each other or push each other apart
ex1_en: his personal magnetism
ex1_zh: 他的个人魅力
remmethod: magnet(磁) + ism(性质/学说) → 磁力；磁学

en: a small axe with a short handle
ex1_en: Would I feel better if I took a hatchet to her, just to end this nightmare?
ex1_zh: 如果我向她举起一把短柄斧，结束这场噩梦，我会感觉好一些吗？
remmethod: hatch(钩；砍) + et(小) → 短柄斧

zh: 贫瘠的, 不能生育的
en: unable to have babies
ex1_en: infertile couples
ex1_zh: 不孕的夫妇
remmethod: in(不) + fer(结果实；携带) + tile(形容词后缀) → 不结果实的 → 不肥沃的；贫瘠的

en: to get used to a new situation, job, or way of life
ex1_en: It takes time to readjust after a divorce.
ex1_zh: 离婚后需要时间重新适应。
remmethod: re (重新) + adjust (调整) → 重新调整

zh: 使隐退, 扣押, 没收
en: to sequestrate
ex1_en: The jury were sequestered during the trial.
ex1_zh: 审判期间，陪审团被隔离开来。
remmethod: 注意不要和sequestrate(v. 扣押)相混

ex1_en: The nettles stung their legs.
ex1_zh: 荨麻刺痛了他们的腿。
remmethod: 用nettle(荨麻)织网(net)

en: a part inside a plant or animal that is shaped like a bag and contains liquid or air
ex1_en: The lungs consist of millions of tiny air sacs.
ex1_zh: 肺包含数百万个小肺泡。
remmethod: sacred(神圣的)中去了red(红色)， 只剩下实质的囊(sac)

en: a prohibitive rule prevents people from doing things
ex1_en: prohibitive regulations
ex1_zh: 禁律
remmethod: 来自prohibit (禁止) + ive → 抑制的

en: the ability to think quickly and make good judgments
ex1_en: His business acumen helped him to succeed where others had failed.
ex1_zh: 他在商业上的敏锐帮他在其他人失败的地方获得成功。
remmethod: acu(尖的， 锐利的) + men → 敏锐

en: Intoxication is the state of being drunk
ex1_en: Intoxication interferes with memory and thinking, speech and coordination.
ex1_zh: 醉酒影响记忆、思考，讲话和协调性。
remmethod: 来自intoxicate(vt. 使醉)； in(里) + tox(毒) + ic + ate(使…) → 使毒进入身体 → 使醉

en: feeling unhappy because you are a long way from your home
ex1_en: She's feeling a little homesick.
ex1_zh: 她感到有些想家了。
remmethod: home(家) ＋ sick(病的) → 想家想到生病 → 思乡的

en: reprehensible behaviour is very bad and deserves criticism
ex1_en: I find their behaviour morally reprehensible .
ex1_zh: 我认为他们的行为应该受到道德谴责。
remmethod: re(回；反对) + prehens(抓住) + ible(可…的) → 可被抓回来责备的 → 应斥责的

ex1_en: Adgantole was a sour-smelling, dusty village beside the Awash River floodplain.
ex1_zh: 阿甘图尔一处闻起来有些酸臭到处都是灰尘的村庄，就坐落在阿瓦什河的泛滥平原上。
remmethod: flood(洪水) + plain(平原) → 洪水形成的平原 → 泛洪平原

en: to fasten a ship or boat to the land or to the bottom of the sea using ropes or an anchor
ex1_en: Two or three fishing boats were moored alongside the pier.
ex1_zh: 有两三艘渔船停泊在码头边。
remmethod: 月光(moon)下， 那个可怜的(poor)老人走在旷野(moor)中

en: a structure where  bee s  are kept for producing  honey
ex1_en: If they wanted to eat something sweet, they had tolocate a beehive, smoke out the bees and retrieve the honey, often byclimbing up a tree or chopping it down.
ex1_zh: 如果他们想吃某些甜东西，就必须找到一个蜂箱，用烟把蜜蜂熏出来，取出蜂蜜，往往还要爬上树或把蜂窝砍下来。
remmethod: bee(蜜蜂) + hive(蜂房， 蜂箱) → 蜂窝； 蜂箱

zh: 幸灾乐祸；心满意足地注视
en: to show in an annoying way that you are proud of your own success or happy about someone else’s failure
ex1_en: Anti-abortionists are gloating over the court's decision.
ex1_zh: 反堕胎主义者对法庭的裁决沾沾自喜。
remmethod: 有了替罪羊 (goat)， 幸灾乐祸 (gloat)

en: a dark reddish purple colour
ex1_en: Its colors are green, magenta, orange and blue.
ex1_zh: 它的颜色是绿色，品红色，橙色以及蓝色。
remmethod: 源自意大利城市Magenta

zh: 悲怅；痛苦；同情；哀婉动人的词句
ex1_en: the pathos of the woman trying to keep her lover
ex1_zh: 那个女人试图留住爱侣的哀婉之情
remmethod: path (感情) + os → 痛苦， 感伤

en: a formal statement of the beliefs of a particular person, group, religion etc
ex1_en: American Express is emphasizing its ‘the customer is first’ credo.
ex1_zh: 美国运通公司强调其“客户至上”的信条。
remmethod: cred(相信， 信任) + o → 信条

zh: 怪癖， 癖性； 过分的独特风格
en: Someone's mannerisms are the gestures or ways of speaking that are very characteristic of them, and which they often use
ex1_en: His mannerisms are more those of a preoccupied maths professor.
ex1_zh: 他的言谈举止更像是一个全神贯注的数学教授。
remmethod: manner(风格， 方式) + ism(表风格、 特征) → 个人独有的言行 → 怪癖

en: the scientific study of the chemistry of living things
remmethod: bio(生命， 生物)+chemistry(化学)→生物化学

en: money or property that you arrange to give to someone after your death
ex1_en: a bequest of $5,000
ex1_zh: 五千美元的遗产
remmethod: be(使) + quest(寻求；要求) → 遗赠；遗产

en: behaving as if you want to keep something secret
ex1_en: There was something furtive about his actions.
ex1_zh: 他的行为有点鬼鬼祟祟。
remmethod: fur (毛皮) ＋tive → 偷猎者为获得毛皮在保护区鬼鬼祟祟的 → 鬼鬼祟祟的

en: to spoil or reduce the value of something that was perfect
ex1_en: a scandal that sullied his reputation
ex1_zh: 玷污了他名誉的丑闻
remmethod: 横行霸道的人 (bully) 常常玷污 (sully) 他人的名声 →玷污
