zh: 大火；快速燃烧；突发；冲突
en: a very large fire that destroys a lot of buildings, forests etc
ex1_en: Behind the gray walls there are human sparks, and yet never a conflagration.
ex1_zh: 灰色的大墙后面仍有人性的火花，只是永远也不会燃成大火了。
remmethod: con + flagr(烧) + ation → 大火

en: on or relating to the back of an animal or fish
ex1_en: a shark’s dorsal fin
ex1_zh: 鲨鱼的背鳍
remmethod: dors(背) + al(形容词后缀) → 背部的

en: very dirty and unpleasant because of a lack of care or money
ex1_en: How can anyone live in such squalid conditions?
ex1_zh: 一个人怎么能住在这样肮脏的环境中？
remmethod: squ + alid (看作valid， 正当的) → 卑劣的小人不会干正当的事 → 卑劣的

en: to influence someone so that they begin to think or behave in an immoral way
ex1_en: TV violence perverts the minds of young children.
ex1_zh: 电视暴力腐蚀了孩子们的心灵。
remmethod: per(远离) ＋ vert(转) → 越转越远离正途 → 使堕落

ex1_en: He has no rancor at heart against you .
ex1_zh: 他心中对你并无怨恨。
remmethod: ran (跑) + c + or (人) → 四处奔走找仇人 → 深仇， 怨恨

en: something which is undifferentiated is not split into parts, or has different parts but you cannot tell the difference between them
ex1_en: shows aimed at large undifferentiated groups of people
ex1_zh: 针对不加以细分的大众的节目
remmethod: un(无) + different(不同) + i + ated(形容词后缀) → 无差别的；一致的

en: if someone or something is impaled, a sharp pointed object goes through them
ex1_en: Researchers observed one bird impale a rodent on a cactus.
ex1_zh: 研究人员观察到，一只鸟把一个啮齿动物钉到了一棵仙人掌上。
remmethod: im + pale(苍白的) → 被针刺到， 脸色苍白 → 刺入

en: an exponent of an idea, belief etc tries to explain it and persuade others that it is good or useful
ex1_en: The Alvin Ailey American Dance Theatre was formed in the 1950s and quickly established itself as a leading exponent of progressive choreography and contemporary dance.
ex1_zh: 阿尔文·艾利美国舞蹈剧形成于20世纪50年代，并很快树立自己为激进舞蹈艺术和现代舞蹈的最主要的典范。
remmethod: ex(出) + pon(放) + ent → 将内心想法放出的人 → 解释者

en: to tell a story again, often in a different way or in a different language
ex1_en: Lucilla often asks her sisters to retell the story.
ex1_zh: 陆希拉经常叫她的姐姐们重讲那个故事。
remmethod: re(再) + tell(讲述) → 再讲；复述

en: the empty shell of a small sea creature
ex1_en: jewelry made out of seashells
ex1_zh: 用贝壳做的首饰
remmethod: sea(海) + shell(壳) → 海贝，贝壳

zh: 多顾虑的， 谨慎的； 一丝不苟的， 严谨的； 审慎正直的， 恪守道德规范的
en: very careful to be completely honest and fair
ex1_en: Not all lawyers are as scrupulous as she is.
ex1_zh: 并不是所有的律师都像她那样正直。
remmethod: 来自scruple(n./vi. 顾忌， 顾虑)

en: an expression that describes something by comparing it with something else, using the words ‘as’ or ‘like’, for example ‘as white as snow’
ex1_en: This is the simile of what I have just given to you.
ex1_zh: 不过这是我已经给予你们的明喻。
remmethod: simil (相类似的) + e → 把相类似的事物做比较 → 明喻

en: a chemical  compound  that exists naturally as sand,  quartz  , and  flint  , used in making glass
ex1_en: While her team is confident that coal burning is causing the high rates of cancer, they are not certain it is due to silica.
ex1_zh: 她的团队相信，煤的燃烧导致了肺癌的高发病率，但是他们不能确定这是二氧化硅引起的。
remmethod: silic(燧石；硅) + a(名词后缀) → [化]硅石

zh: 下意识的， 潜意识的
en: affecting your mind in a way that you are not conscious of
ex1_en: a subliminal message
ex1_zh: 潜在的含义
remmethod: sub(在…下面) + limin(=limen最小限度的神经刺激) + al → 下意识的， 潜意识的

en: If someone regales you with stories or jokes, they tell you a lot of them, whether you want to hear them or not
ex1_en: He was constantly regaled with tales of woe.
ex1_zh: 别人老是给他讲些倒霉事儿来逗他开心。
remmethod: re(使) + gale(高兴) → 使客人高兴 → 款待

zh: 象蜡的,苍白的, 柔软的,
en: like wax, or made of wax
ex1_en: the waxy blossoms of the water lily
ex1_zh: 睡莲那如蜡一般的花朵
remmethod: wax(蜡) + y(多…的) → 象蜡的；苍白的；柔软的

en: very formal and careful in the way you speak and behave, and easily shocked by anything rude
ex1_en: She looked prim and nervous in her best hat and coat.
ex1_zh: 她戴着最好的帽子并穿着最好的外套，显得拘谨不安。
remmethod: prim(整洁；端庄) → 整洁的

zh: 无人居住的,杳无人迹的
en: an uninhabited place does not have anyone living there
ex1_en: an uninhabited island
ex1_zh: 杳无人迹的荒岛
remmethod: un(无) + in(在) + habit(居住) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无人居住的

ex1_en: Lawmakers spent the day quibbling over the final wording of the resolution.
ex1_zh: 立法者们花了一天争辩决议的最后措词。
remmethod: 来自quib (嘲讽) + ble → 吹毛求疵的反对意见

en: without unnecessary or special features or decorations
ex1_en: They liked their churches to be unadorned.
ex1_zh: 他们希望他们的教堂朴素无华。
remmethod: un(不) + adorn(装饰) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未装饰的；朴素的

en: to say unpleasant things about someone that are untrue
ex1_en: She had seen herself repeatedly maligned in the newspapers.
ex1_zh: 她看到自己在报纸上一再受到诽谤。
remmethod: mal (坏) + ign (看作sign， 记号) → 冠以恶名 → 诽谤

en: not having sex with anyone, or not with anyone except your husband or wife
ex1_en: She led a chaste decent life.
ex1_zh: 她过着贞洁正派的生活。
remmethod: 贞洁的(chaste)姑娘被追逐(chase)

ex1_en: Heart rate tracking for three of the Alaska bears showed a drop from 55 beats per minute on average before hibernation to 14 erratic ones per minute in winter.
ex1_zh: 对三头阿拉斯加的黑熊的心率追踪显示出它们在冬眠前的平均每分钟 55 下降低到了冬天里每分钟飘忽不定的 14 下。
remmethod: 来自hibernate(vi. 冬眠)； hibern(冬天) + ation → 冬眠

zh: 不可改变的；不能取消的；不能挽回的
en: an irrevocable decision, action etc cannot be changed or stopped
ex1_en: Think about the situation carefully before you take an irrevocable step.
ex1_zh: 在你踏出不能回头的一步之前要三思。
remmethod: ir(不) + revocable(可取消的) → 无法取消的

en: A trumpeter is someone who plays a trumpet
remmethod: trumpet(喇叭) + er(表人) → 喇叭手

en: with many smooth twists and turns
ex1_en: They followed the sinuous trail deep into the mountains.
ex1_zh: 他们沿着弯弯曲曲的小径进入深山。
remmethod: sinu(曲线) + ous → 弯曲的 → 蜿蜒的

en: Reclamation is the process of changing land that is unsuitable for farming or building into land that can be used
remmethod: re(回；再) + clam(喊；要求) + ation(名词后缀) → 再要求回来 → 收回；开垦

en: Piecemeal is also an adverb
ex1_en: It was built piecemeal over some 130 years.
ex1_zh: 它是在大约一百三十年间一点一点建造起来的。
remmethod: piece (片) + meal (进食) → 面包要一片片地吃 → 逐渐的

ex1_en: The repetition of symbols was to be enough, without trauma, as well, perhaps, to attenuate it, or even jar it altogether loose from her memory.
ex1_zh: 象征的重复快要足够，即便没有可能的从她记忆中流出的创伤，去减弱它去刺激它。
remmethod: at(加强) + ten(薄) + uate → 变薄

zh: 措辞, 用语, 言语
en: the choice and use of words and phrases to express meaning, especially in literature
remmethod: dict(说话) + ion → 措辞， 用语

en: to say what will happen in the future, especially by using special magical powers
ex1_en: the birth of Christ, foretold by prophets
ex1_zh: 先知们所预言的基督的诞生
remmethod: fore (在之前) + tell (告诉) → 在之前告诉结果 → 预言

en: If you flout something such as a law, an order, or an accepted way of behaving, you deliberately do not obey it or follow it
remmethod: fl(=fly， 飞) + out(出去) → 飞出去 → 不再服从命令 → 违抗

en: a toilet or the room a toilet is in
remmethod: lav(洗)+at+ory(表地点)→盥洗室

ex1_en: This solution is politically expedient but may well cause long-term problems.
ex1_zh: 这种解决方法是政治上的权宜之计，但会引起长远的问题。
remmethod: ex(外) + ped(脚) + ient → 将脚向外迈 → 权宜之计

en: a sound or way of speaking or singing that continues on the same note without getting any louder or softer, and therefore sounds very boring
ex1_en: He answered all the lawyer’s questions in a dull monotone.
ex1_zh: 他用单调的语气回答了律师所有的问题。
remmethod: mono (单) + tone (音调) → 单调

en: a small amount of something, especially a good quality
ex1_en: a modicum of common sense
ex1_zh: 一点常识
remmethod: modic(适度) + um(名词后缀) → 少量

en: an animal with long sharp parts growing all over its back and sides
ex1_en: In Maine, the most commonly counted roadkill species is the North American porcupine.
ex1_zh: 在缅因州，公路交通事故中杀死的动物种类是北美箭猪。
remmethod: porc(猪) + spine(刺) → 豪猪；箭猪

en: to make the edge of a blade sharp
remmethod: 磨刀霍霍(whet the knife)向猪羊

zh: 精神错乱， 神志失常
ex1_en: Before she died she had fits of delirium.
ex1_zh: 去世前她一阵阵地胡言乱语。
remmethod: de(偏离) + lir(犁沟；轨道) + ium(名词后缀) → 偏离轨道 → 精神错乱；谵妄

en: concerned with trade
ex1_en: mercantile law
ex1_zh: 商法
remmethod: merc(贸易) + ant + ile → 贸易的， 商业的

ex1_en: More exercises can avoid atrophy of cartilage.
ex1_zh: 多加锻炼可以避免软骨萎缩。
remmethod: a(无) + troph(营养) + y → 没有营养， 无法生长 → 萎缩(症)

zh: 不合作的, 不配合的
en: not willing to work with or help someone
ex1_en: She became uncooperative: unwilling to do her homework or help with any household chores.
ex1_zh: 她变得不合作起来：不愿做作业或是帮助分担家务。
remmethod: un(不) + co(共同) + oper(工作) + ative(…的) → 不合作的

zh: 易怒的；倔强的，难以对待的
en: someone who is fractious becomes angry very easily
ex1_en: Children become fractious when they are tired.
ex1_zh: 小孩子累了就容易发脾气。
remmethod: fract(碎裂) + ious(易…的) → 脾气易碎 → (脾气)易怒的

ex1_en: His comments still rankled.
ex1_zh: 他的言论仍令人耿耿于怀。
remmethod: 阶级 (rank) 矛盾引起人民的怨恨 (rankle)

en: written or printed clearly enough for you to read
ex1_en: Her handwriting was so tiny it was barely legible.
ex1_zh: 她的字写得这么小，简直都看不清楚。
remmethod: leg(读) + ible(可…的) → 易读的

en: (of a liquid 液体) thick and sticky; not flowing freely
ex1_en: As the liquid cools, it becomes viscous.
ex1_zh: 这液体冷却后会变黏稠。
remmethod: visc(粘) + ous(形容词后缀) → 粘性的；胶粘的

en: a short piece of writing on the stone over someone’s grave(= place in the ground where someone is buried )
ex1_en: His epitaph for himself would have well suited man as he wanted him to be.
ex1_zh: 他为自己写的墓志铭非常适合像他所期望成为的那种人。
remmethod: epi (在…上) + taph ( = tomb， 墓) → 在墓碑上刻的字 → 墓志铭

en: a wide pile of earth or a stone wall built to protect a castle or city in the past
remmethod: rampart(自身词根) → 垒；壁垒；城墙

en: If you describe someone's behaviour or their actions as atrocious, you mean that it is unacceptable because it is extremely violent or cruel
ex1_en: The judge said he had committed atrocious crimes against women.
ex1_zh: 该法官称他对妇女犯下了残暴的罪行。
remmethod: atroc(阴沉， 凶残) + ious → 残忍的

en: Earthenware objects are referred to as earthenware
remmethod: earth(土) + en(…制的) + ware(器皿) → 土器,陶器

zh: 不调和的, 不适宜的
en: the fact that something is strange, unusual, or unsuitable in a particular situation
ex1_en: The incongruity of her situation struck Gina with unpleasant force.
ex1_zh: 吉娜猛然意识到自己处境尴尬，心里很不舒服。
remmethod: in(不) + congruity(一致， 和谐) → 不和谐， 不相称

zh: 自明之理；老生常谈；老套；众所周知；真实性
en: a statement that is clearly true, so that there is no need to say it
ex1_en: His speech was just a collection of clichés and truisms.
ex1_zh: 他的演说就是一堆陈词滥调和自明之理。
remmethod: tru ( = truth， 真理) + ism → 真理

en: someone who looks haggard has lines on their face and dark marks around their eyes, especially because they are ill, worried, or tired
ex1_en: Sam looked tired and haggard.
ex1_zh: 萨姆看起来疲惫而憔悴。
remmethod: hag(巫婆) + gard → 像巫婆一样 → 形容枯槁的 → 消瘦的

zh: 有毒的， 分泌毒液的； 恶意的， 狠毒的
en: full of hatred or anger
ex1_en: Lisa shot him a venomous glance.
ex1_zh: 莉萨恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼。
remmethod: 来自venom(n. 毒液)

en: hot melted rock below the surface of the Earth
ex1_en: The volcano threw new showers of magma and ash into the air.
ex1_zh: 这座火山向空气中喷发了新的岩浆和火山灰。
remmethod: magma(自身词根) → 岩浆；糊剂

zh: 不可分割的；不可剥夺的；不能让与的
en: an inalienable right, power etc cannot be taken from you
ex1_en: inalienable human rights
ex1_zh: 不可剥夺的人权
remmethod: in(不) + alien(转让) + able → 不能转让的

en: a state in which you cannot think, speak, see, or hear clearly, usually because you have drunk too much alcohol or taken drugs
ex1_en: We found him lying at the bottom of the stairs in a drunken stupor .
ex1_zh: 我们发现他躺在楼梯口，醉得不省人事。
remmethod: stup (看作stop， 停止) + or → 停止活动 → 昏迷

en: too ready to believe what other people tell you, so that you are easily tricked
ex1_en: Plastic replicas of the Greek pottery are sold to gullible tourists.
ex1_zh: 仿古希腊陶器的塑料复制品被卖给易受骗的游客。
remmethod: 来自gull(v. 欺骗)

en: a sudden change in the direction that sth is moving in, usually after it has hit sth; the act of causing sth to change direction
ex1_en: the deflection of the missile away from its target
ex1_zh: 使导弹偏离目标
remmethod: de(离开) + flect(弯曲) + ion(名词后缀) → 偏斜；偏转；偏差

zh: 冷漠的；无动于衷的，缺乏兴趣的
en: not interested in something, and not willing to make any effort to change or improve things
ex1_en: She felt too apathetic even to move.
ex1_zh: 她毫无兴趣，甚至连动都不想动。
remmethod: a (无) + path (感觉) + e + tic (…的) → 对一件事情没有感觉 → 缺乏兴趣的

zh: 未损坏的, 未宠坏的
en: an unspoiled place is beautiful because it has not changed for a long time and does not have a lot of new buildings
ex1_en: unspoiled countryside
ex1_zh: 未遭到破坏的乡村
remmethod: un(不) + spoil(损坏) + ed → 未损坏的

en: spending money, wasting time etc in a careless way
ex1_en: a prodigal lifestyle
ex1_zh: 奢侈的生活方式
remmethod: prodig(巨大， 浪费) + al(…的) → 挥霍的

en: disagreement among a group of people
ex1_en: The Labour Party was torn by internal dissensions .
ex1_zh: 工党因内部纷争产生分裂。
remmethod: dis (不) + sens (感觉) + ion (表示名词) → 不同的感觉 → 意见分歧

en: the quality of being always the same, which makes something boring, especially someone’s life or work
ex1_en: A night on the town may help to break the monotony of the week.
ex1_zh: 去城里待一晚也许有助改变一周工作生活的单调。
remmethod: mono(单个) + ton(声音) + y → 一个声音 → 单调， 千篇一律

en: to put a lubricant on something in order to make it move more smoothly
ex1_en: Lubricate all moving parts with grease.
ex1_zh: 给所有活动部件加润滑油。
remmethod: lubr(光滑)+ic+ate(使…)→使光滑→加润滑油于

zh: 不愉快的；厌恶的；不为人喜的；难相处的；脾气坏的
en: not at all enjoyable or pleasant
ex1_en: a disagreeable job
ex1_zh: 不称心的工作
remmethod: dis(不) + agree(同意；合意) + able(可…的) → 不合意的 → 不愉快的

en: the condition of being dirty and unpleasant because of a lack of care or money
ex1_en: We lived in squalor for a year and a half.
ex1_zh: 我们在肮脏的环境里住了一年半。
remmethod: “四筐烂儿” → 四筐破烂儿 → 污秽

en: very sad
ex1_en: a sorrowful expression
ex1_zh: 悲伤的表情
remmethod: sorrow(悲伤) + ful(充满…的) → 悲伤的；使人伤心的

zh: 美学的， 审美的； 悦目的， 雅致的
remmethod: esthet(感觉；审美) + ic(形容词后缀) → 美学的，审美的

zh: 吉兆的， 吉利的； 幸运的
en: showing that something is likely to be successful
ex1_en: On the reverse the same inscription is repeated, besides a row of five Swastikas as auspicious symbols signifying security and good luck.
ex1_zh: 倒转的同样碑刻是重复的，此外一排五个纳粹党所用的十字记号如幸运的符号表示安全和好运。
remmethod: 来自auspice (n. 前兆)

en: a large road for fast traffic that drivers have to pay to use
ex1_en: the New Jersey Turnpike
ex1_zh: 新泽西付费高速公路
remmethod: turn(转动) + pike(横杆) → 转动收费杆 → 收费公路

en: opposite in amount or position to sth else
ex1_en: We regard health as inversely related to social class.
ex1_zh: 我们认为健康状况与社会地位成相反关系。
remmethod: in(相反) + vers(转) + e + ly(副词后缀) → 相反地

en: a small tree that produces nuts
ex1_en: Then on to our old haunt, the hazel grove.
ex1_zh: 接着，到我们经常去的小榛树林。
remmethod: hazel(榛树；淡褐色) → 榛子；淡褐色的

ex1_en: She was without her own volition.
ex1_zh: 她没有自主选择权。
remmethod: vol(意志)+ition → 意志， 决断力

zh: 朦胧的；星云的，星云状的
en: a shape that is nebulous is unclear and has no definite edges
ex1_en: a nebulous ghostly figure
ex1_zh: 幽灵般朦胧的身影
remmethod: nebul (云) + ous → 云雾状的

zh: 端庄的；娴静的；严肃的；假装正直的
en: quiet, serious, and well-behaved – used especially about women in the past
ex1_en: Old photos of Maggie show her young and demure.
ex1_zh: 老照片上的玛吉显得年轻而又端庄娴静。
remmethod: 她纯洁 (pure) 又端庄 (demure)

ex1_en: If there are aspects of your life that displease you make you feel regret, this is an opportunity to change direction.
ex1_zh: 如果你生活中那些使你不愉快的方面让你觉得懊悔，那么这正是你改变方向的时机。
remmethod: dis(不；相反) + please(使高兴) → 使不愉快，使生气

zh: 替代的；代理的；发同感的
ex1_en: She invents fantasy lives for her own vicarious pleasure.
ex1_zh: 她幻想过着各种奇妙的生活，从这种想象中获得乐趣。
remmethod: 来自vicar(n. 教区牧师)

zh: 用词不当；误称；写错姓名
en: a wrong or unsuitable name
ex1_en: ‘Silent movie’ is a misnomer since the movies usually had a musical accompaniment.
ex1_zh: “无声电影”这一名称不恰当，因为这类电影一般都有配乐。
remmethod: mis(错) + nom(名字) + er → 名称的误用

ex1_zh: 驿马快信要比当时的公共马车快多了。
remmethod: stage(驿站) + coach(马车) → 驿站马车， 公共马车

zh: 专心的；专一的；未分开的；完整的
en: complete
ex1_en: I’ll give the matter my undivided attention.
ex1_zh: 我会全力关注此事。
remmethod: un(不) + divid(分) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未分开的；专一的

en: If you say that one person is ogling another, you disapprove of them continually staring at that person in a way that indicates a strong sexual interest
ex1_en: All she did was hang around ogling the men in the factory.
ex1_zh: 她就只会在工厂里四处乱逛，朝男人抛媚眼。
remmethod: “偶 (我) 钩” → 用抛媚眼的方式钩我 → 抛媚眼

zh: 粗糙的事物, 严肃, 刺耳
remmethod: harsh(粗糙的；刺耳的) + ness(名词后缀) → 粗糙；刺耳

en: (of light or other electromagnetic radiation) having only one wavelength
ex1_en: However, if you want to wear a print, choose a print that's low in contrast and monochromatic in color.
ex1_zh: 然而，假如你实在想穿喷绘衣服，那就选择一件单色、低对比度的。
remmethod: mono(单一) + chrom(颜色) + atic → 单色的

en: to prevent or avoid a problem or the need to do something
ex1_en: The new treatment obviates the need for surgery.
ex1_zh: 新的疗法免除了手术的必要。
remmethod: ob(反) + vi(路) + ate → 使障碍等离开道路 → 排除， 消除

en: a printed picture produced by lithography
remmethod: litho(石) + graph(写；画) → 石版画；平版印刷

en: the part in your throat where your voice is produced
ex1_en: The larynx, or voice box, sits lower in the throat in humans than in chimps, one of several .
ex1_zh: 人类的喉（亦称音箱），其在咽部的位置要低于黑猩猩，这是人们能说话的原因之一。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 喉

en: to cut a body into pieces or tear it apart
ex1_en: She then dismembered him, hiding parts of his body in the cellar.
ex1_zh: 她接着将他的尸体肢解，把几块碎尸藏进了地窖。
remmethod: dis(分离) + member(肢体) → 肢解

en: a false spoken statement about someone, intended to damage the good opinion that people have of that person
ex1_en: a vicious slander on the company's good name
ex1_zh: 对那家公司良好声誉的恶意诽谤
remmethod: sland(=scandal障碍物) + er → 设障碍物， 使人绊倒 → 诽谤， 诋毁

en: very beautiful, bright, and impressive in appearance
ex1_en: Bessie, resplendent in royal blue velvet, was hovering beside the table.
ex1_zh: 身穿华丽的深蓝色天鹅绒衣服的贝茜正在桌旁徘徊。
remmethod: re(反复) + splend(发光) + ent → 不断发光的 → 光辉的

zh: 肉体的， 身体的； 物质的； 实体的
en: relating to the body, rather than to the mind, feelings, or spirit
ex1_en: corporeal desires
ex1_zh: 肉欲
remmethod: corpor(身体) + eal(看作real， 真的) → 真身 → 肉体的

en: a room for children to play in
ex1_en: The playroom is designed for recreational purpose.
ex1_zh: 这游戏室计划用于娱乐活动。
remmethod: play(玩) + room(房间) → 游戏室；娱乐室

zh: 近视的； 缺乏远见的
en: unwilling or unable to think about the future, especially about the possible results of a particular action – used in order to show disapproval
ex1_en: the government’s myopic attitude to environmental issues
ex1_zh: 政府对环境问题所持的短视态度
remmethod: my(闭上) + op(眼睛) + ic → 闭上眼睛的 → 缺乏远见的

en: food that is perishable is likely to decay quickly
ex1_en: perishable goods such as butter, milk, fruit and fish
ex1_zh: 黄油、牛奶、水果和鱼等易变质的商品
remmethod: 来自perish(v. 腐烂)

zh: 不谙世故的, 不复杂的
en: unsophisticated tools, methods, or processes are simple and do not have all the features of more modern ones
ex1_en: an unsophisticated audience
ex1_zh: 老土的观众
remmethod: un(不) + soph(智慧) + ist(表人) + ic(形) + ated(形) → 不谙世故的；不复杂的

en: If you are circumspect, you are cautious in what you do and say and do not take risks
ex1_en: The banks should have been more circumspect in their dealings.
ex1_zh: 银行在交易时应更加谨慎。
remmethod: circum(环绕) + spect(看) → 绕着看 → 谨慎的

en: the custom of being married to only one husband or wife
ex1_en: People still opt for monogamy and marriage.
ex1_zh: 人们还是选择单一配偶制和婚姻。
remmethod: mono(单个) + gam(婚姻) + y → 一夫一妻制

en: to defeat a person or group and make them obey you
ex1_en: The native population was subjugated and exploited.
ex1_zh: 土著人被征服，并遭受剥削。
remmethod: sub(在…下面) + jug(捆绑) + ate → 在下面捆绑 → 征服

en: someone or something that is extremely big or extremely important
ex1_en: an intellectual colossus like Leonardo
ex1_zh: 像列奥纳多这样的智慧巨人
remmethod: coloss(巨大) + us(名词后缀) → 巨像；巨人

en: A belief or action that is heretical is one that most people think is wrong because it disagrees with beliefs that are generally accepted
ex1_en: I made the then heretical suggestion that it might be cheaper to design new machines.
ex1_zh: 我提出了当时被当做旁门左道的建议，说设计新机器或许更省钱。
remmethod: here(异) + tical → 异端的， 异教的

ex1_en: Please give him my regards.
ex1_zh: 请转达我对他的问候。
remmethod: regard(看；考虑) + s(复数) → 致意；问候

zh: 奉献；使神圣；供神用；献身于
ex1_en: The bones will be reburied in consecrated ground .
ex1_zh: 尸骨将被重新安葬在圣地里。
remmethod: con + secr(神圣) + ate → 献给神 → 奉献

en: the small round part at one end of a pin
ex1_en: It may even be possible to make computers the size of a pinhead one day.
ex1_zh: 有一天，甚至有可能把计算机做得象针头一样小。
remmethod: pin(针) + head(头) → 针头；小东西

zh: 苍白的；暗淡的；无生气的
en: very pale, especially in a way that looks weak or unhealthy
ex1_en: pallid cheeks
ex1_zh: 苍白的脸颊
remmethod: pall(=pale苍白) + id → 苍白的， 没血色的

en: a chemical substance that contains water
remmethod: hydr(水) + ate → 水合

en: a structure like a bridge that allows one road to go over another road
ex1_en: Two cargo trains slammed together at a rail intersection southwest of Cape Girardeau, derailing cars that then struck the support columns of a highway overpass.
ex1_zh: 两辆货运火车在开普吉拉多西南部的铁路交叉口发生碰撞，部分车厢脱轨，并撞毁了高速公路天桥的支撑柱。
remmethod: over(在…上)+pass(通过)→从街道上面通过的→过街天桥

en: unpleasant or bad
ex1_en: There’s been a frightful accident.
ex1_zh: 发生了一起可怕的意外。
remmethod: fright(惊恐) + ful(充满…的) → 充满惊恐的 → 可怕的

ex1_en: The cat became lethargic and had trouble breathing.
ex1_zh: 这只猫整天昏睡而且呼吸困难。
remmethod: letharg(昏睡；无生气) + ic(形容词后缀) → 昏睡的

en: a small hard piece of something
ex1_en: coffee granules
ex1_zh: 咖啡颗粒
remmethod: gran(=grain颗粒)＋ule → 小粒， 微粒

zh: 装载过多, 负担过多
en: to give an organization, person, or system more work or problems than they can deal with
ex1_en: Health services have been overburdened and are unable to care for many older people.
ex1_zh: 公共医疗保健服务已经负担过重，无法顾及许多老年人。
remmethod: over(过度) + burden(负担) → 负担过多

en: the act of shrinking, or the amount that something shrinks
ex1_en: Pollution led to a shrinkage of grasslands.
ex1_zh: 污染导致草原面积缩小。
remmethod: 来自shrink (收缩) + age → 收缩

en: a flat sea animal that has five arms forming the shape of a star
ex1_en: She lays a kindly hand like a tiny starfish on my knee.
ex1_zh: 她和善地伸出手，像小海星一样放在我的膝盖上。
remmethod: star(星) + fish(鱼) → 海星

en: when someone makes a formal decision to no longer believe in something, live in a particular way etc
ex1_en: The talks were dependent on a renunciation of terrorism.
ex1_zh: 会谈以放弃恐怖主义为前提。
remmethod: re + nun (尼姑) + ciation → 看破红尘做尼姑， 抛开一切 → 放弃

zh: [贸易] 女售货员；[贸易] 女店员
en: a woman whose job is selling things
remmethod: sales(销售) + woman(女性) → 女售货员；女店员

en: a tortuous path, stream, road etc has a lot of bends in it and is therefore difficult to travel along
ex1_en: a tortuous path over the mountains to Kandahar
ex1_zh: 翻山越岭通往坎大哈的一条蜿蜒小径
remmethod: tort(扭曲) + u + ous(形容词后缀) → 令人身心扭曲的 → 折磨人的

en: a strong beam, made of iron or steel, that supports a floor, roof, or bridge
ex1_en: Listen, when you start to feel weak, just tell yourself, ‘I’m as strong as a girder’ .
ex1_zh: 听着，当你开始觉得虚弱的时候，就对自己说：‘我像 钢梁 一样强壮’。
remmethod: gird(束， 捆) + er → 支撑物 → 大梁

zh: 狭隘道德观的, 说教的
en: with very strong beliefs about what is right and wrong, especially when this makes you judge other people’s behaviour
ex1_en: It’s difficult to talk to teenagers about drugs without sounding too moralistic.
ex1_zh: 跟青少年谈论毒品，又不能有太重的说教味道，这是很难的。
remmethod: 来自moral(n. 道德)

zh: 陈腐的；平庸的；老一套的
en: a trite remark, idea etc is boring, not new, and insincere
ex1_en: Her remarks sounded trite and ill-informed.
ex1_zh: 她的话听起来没有新意，信息匮乏。
remmethod: t (看作too， 太) + rite (仪式) → 太注重仪式是陈腐的做法 → 陈腐的

en: the relationship between different living things that depend on each other
remmethod: sym(共同) + bio(生命) + sis → 共生(关系)

zh: 若无其事的, 不关心的, 冷淡的
en: behaving calmly and not seeming interested in anything or worried about anything
ex1_en: ‘Has he got a girlfriend?’ Jill asked, trying to sound nonchalant.
ex1_zh: “他有女朋友吗？”吉尔装出无所谓的样子问道。
remmethod: 他冷淡地 (nonchalant) 对她说： 你没机会 (no chance) 了

en: infantile behaviour seems silly in an adult because it is typical of a child
ex1_en: infantile jokes
ex1_zh: 幼稚的玩笑
remmethod: 来自infant(n. 婴儿)

en: a long and complicated argument
ex1_en: Don't wrangle with others over trifles.
ex1_zh: 别为一些琐事与别人争吵。
remmethod: wr + angle (追逐) → 追逐打闹 → 争吵

en: deeply felt remorse; penitence
ex1_en: Blankfein was clearly trying to placate the locals and show some kind of contrition.
ex1_zh: 布兰克费恩显然在尽力抚慰德国人，并表现出一定的悔悟。
remmethod: 来自contrite(adj. 痛悔的)

en: to do something that is against the rules of social behaviour or against a moral principle
ex1_en: Orton’s plays transgress accepted social norms.
ex1_zh: 奥顿的戏剧违背了公认的社会准则。
remmethod: trans(横向) + gress(走) → 横着走 → 冒犯

en: in Roman Catholic belief, a place where the souls of dead people suffer until they are pure enough to enter heaven
ex1_en: Prayers were said for souls in purgatory.
ex1_zh: 为炼狱中的亡灵做的祷告。
remmethod: 来自purg (e) (清洗) + atory → 清洗灵魂 → 炼狱

zh: 迂曲的；绕行的；迂回线路的
en: going from one place to another in a way that is longer than the most direct way
ex1_en: a hard circuitous hike
ex1_zh: 一次艰难曲折的徒步旅行
remmethod: circu(绕圈) + it(走) + ous → 迂回的； circuit本身是个单词， 意为“圆， 电路”

zh: 纤维素,（植物的）细胞膜质
en: the material that the cell walls of plants are made of and that is used to make plastics, paper etc
ex1_en: Development of celluloses that are stable outside the cells of microorganisms enables the culturing of fungi and with yeasts on cellulose hydrolyzates.
ex1_zh: 开发在微生物细胞外部能稳定存在的纤维素酶使真菌和酵母在纤维素水解产物上培养有了可能。
remmethod: cellul(小细胞) + ose(碳水化合物) → 纤维素

en: a watch used for measuring the exact time it takes to do something, especially to finish a race
remmethod: stop(停止) + watch(表) → 能停的表 → 码表；跑表

en: If you say that someone dotes on a person or a thing, you mean that they love or care about them very much and ignore any faults they may have
ex1_en: He dotes on his nine-year-old son.
ex1_zh: 他对自己9岁的儿子十分溺爱。
remmethod: 溺爱(dote)就是集万千宠爱于一点(dot)， 而不顾其他

en: able to bend without breaking or cracking
ex1_en: a shoe made of soft pliable leather
ex1_zh: 柔韧的皮革做成的鞋子
remmethod: pli(=ply弯， 折) + able → 易弯曲的

en: to clean something with a chemical that destroys  bacteria
ex1_en: First use some iodine to disinfect the wound.
ex1_zh: 先用碘酒给伤口消毒。
remmethod: dis (分离) + infect (感染) → 消毒

en: An aqueduct is a large pipe or canal that carries a water supply to a city or a farming area
remmethod: aque ( = aqu， 水) + duct (引导) → 导水管

en: a piece of paper, leather etc that you put in a book to show you the last page you have read
ex1_en: This makes it extremely simple to save what you find with an electronic bookmark so you can return to it later.
ex1_zh: 用一个电子书签保存找到的内容使以后再次访问变得非常简单。
remmethod: book(书) + mark(标记) → 书签

en: if two or more things are synchronous, they happen at the same time or work at the same speed
ex1_en: Transitions within states should normally be synchronous, since there is no change of owner.
ex1_zh: 状态间的转换通常应该是同步的，因为所有者没有改变。
remmethod: syn (相同的) + chron (时间) + ous (…的) → 相同时间的 → 同时的

en: lying or placed across something
ex1_en: a transverse beam
ex1_zh: 横梁
remmethod: trans (横向) + vers (转) + e → 横向转的 → 横向的

zh: 切断，毁坏；使…残缺不全；使…支离破碎
en: to severely and violently damage someone’s body, especially by cutting or removing part of it
ex1_en: The prisoners had been tortured and mutilated.
ex1_zh: 犯人遭受了酷刑并被殴打致残。
remmethod: mutil (砍掉) + ate → 毁伤

en: the station or stop at the end of a railway or bus line
ex1_en: What time does the train reach the terminus?
ex1_zh: 火车什么时间到达终点站?。
remmethod: termin(边界) + us → 终点站

en: fish eggs eaten as a food
remmethod: “肉” → 鱼卵也是鱼妈妈身上的一块肉 → 鱼卵

zh: 高龄的；老衰的；高龄所致的
en: If old people become senile, they become confused, can no longer remember things, and are unable to take care of themselves
ex1_en: a senile old man
ex1_zh: 一个年老糊涂的老人
remmethod: sen(老)+ile → 衰老的

en: a large town on or near a coast, with a harbour that big ships can use
remmethod: sea(海) + port(港口) → 海港；港口都市

zh: 口是心非；表里不一；不诚实
ex1_en: Malcolm believed he was guilty of duplicity in his private dealings.
ex1_zh: 马尔科姆相信他在为其私底下行为的奸诈内疚着。
remmethod: du(二) + plic(重叠) + ity → 有两种(态度) → 口是心非

zh: 斯巴达的；斯巴达式的；（生活方式）简朴的，清苦的。
en: spartan conditions or ways of living are simple and without any comfort
ex1_en: spartan accommodation
ex1_zh: 简朴的住处
remmethod: 来自Sparta(斯巴达)， 希腊城邦， 该地区的人以简朴刻苦著称

zh: 恳求，哀求；乞求，急切地要求得到
en: to eagerly and anxiously ask someone for something
ex1_en: She beseeched him to cut out his drinking and his smoking.
ex1_zh: 她央求他戒酒戒烟。
remmethod: be + seech(=seek寻求) → 寻求 → 恳求

en: someone who chooses to live alone, and does not like seeing or talking to other people
ex1_en: She became a recluse after her two sons were murdered.
ex1_zh: 两个儿子被杀后，她就一直离群索居。
remmethod: re + cluse(关闭) → 重新把门关上 → 隐居的

en: if soldiers pillage a place in a war, they steal a lot of things and do a lot of damage
ex1_en: Soldiers went on a rampage, pillaging stores and shooting.
ex1_zh: 士兵狂暴地掠夺商店，不停地扫射。
remmethod: 来自pill(v. 抢劫)

ex1_en: New mothers often complain of lethargy and mild depression.
ex1_zh: 初为人母者经常抱怨说身体疲倦乏力，有轻微的抑郁。
remmethod: leth(死) + argy → 像死了一样 → 死气沉沉

ex1_en: Rural medics get an average stipend of $65 a year, leading some to overcharge their patients.
ex1_zh: 这些医生每年仅得到65美元，这导致他们向病人高收费。
remmethod: over(过度) + charge(收费) → 索价过高

ex1_en: Cut out the tedium of converting your photos manually by using automation features in your photo editing software.
ex1_zh: 使用照片编辑软件中的自动控制功能可以免去手工转换照片的沉闷。
remmethod: 媒体(medium)的节目都很乏味(tedium)

en: a shop that sells books
ex1_en: His friends live above the bookshop.
ex1_zh: 他的朋友们住在书店的楼上。
remmethod: book(书) + shop(店) → 书店

en: unhappy, disappointed, or sad
ex1_en: The unemployed stood at street corners, dejected.
ex1_zh: 失业者沮丧地站在街角。
remmethod: 来自deject (v. 使沮丧， 使灰心)

en: If something nauseates you, it makes you feel as if you are going to vomit
ex1_en: The smell of frying nauseated her.
ex1_zh: 油炸味道让她恶心。
remmethod: nau (船) + se + ate (使…) → 晕船使人作呕 → 作呕

en: someone who works in a factory, putting things into containers
ex1_en: Norma Jones worked as a packer in a local chemical factory.
ex1_zh: 诺玛·琼斯在本地一家化工厂作包装工。
remmethod: pack(打包) + er(表人/物) → 包装工人；包装机

en: the use of tricks to deceive or cheat people
ex1_en: No steel rods, no magnets, no computer trickery.
ex1_zh: 那里没有钢条、没有磁铁也没有电脑欺骗。
remmethod: 来自trick (v. 欺骗)

zh: 彬彬有礼的，温文尔雅的；都市化的
en: behaving in a relaxed and confident way in social situations
ex1_en: Neil was urbane, witty, direct, and honest.
ex1_zh: 尼尔文雅机智，坦率诚实。
remmethod: urban (城里的) + e → 城里的人一般较懂礼貌 → 有礼貌的

en: a member of an official organization which encourages the development of literature, art, science etc
ex1_en: I'm the first academician in our family.
ex1_zh: 我是我们家第一个大学生。
remmethod: academic (学院的) + ian (…的人) → 在学院里的人 → 院士

ex1_en: God, said, ‘Let the waters teem with countless living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth across the vault of heaven.
ex1_zh: 上帝说：“水中要有万种游鱼，地上要有无数飞鸟”于是上帝创造出种类繁多的大小鱼类及飞鸟。
remmethod: 和team(n. 群， 队)一起记

zh: 非常华丽的；廉价而俗丽的
en: If you describe something such as clothes or decorations as tawdry, you mean that they are cheap and show a lack of taste
remmethod: taw (看作raw， 生的) + dry (干的) → 仔细推敲有些华丽的辞藻， 会发现它们很干巴、 生硬 → 俗丽的

en: to burn the surface of something slightly, or to be burned slightly
ex1_en: The flames had singed her hair.
ex1_zh: 火焰燎了她的头发。
remmethod: sing(唱， 唱歌) ＋ e → 烧焦了还唱 → 烧焦

ex1_en: Convinced of his own righteousness, he was the perfect impersonation of a man of rectitude.

en: a musical instrument like a trumpet, that is used in the army to call soldiers

en: a magic bird that is born from a fire, according to ancient stories

ex1_zh: 让你们的灵魂以理性引导热情的方向，这样你们的热情才会经历每日的复活，宛若凤凰从自己的灰烬中再生。

remmethod: combus(燃烧) + t + ible(能…的) → 可燃的

en: a picture made by pressing a shaped piece of wood and a colouring substance onto paper

ex1_zh: 这里有张图片，是出自艺术家爱德华•华兹华斯的《鹿特丹》，是《爆炸》杂志中的一幅木刻图片。

en: the process of taking a number or amount from a larger number or amount

en: a plant with blue flowers, used for making cloth and oil

ex1_zh: 那天天气闷热又潮湿，阴沉沉的。

ex1_zh: 贝卢斯科尼于上周六辞职，成千上万罗马民众走上街头庆祝。意大利近日深陷大规模债务危机。

en: someone who buys and sells goods or services, especially in a shop

ex1_zh: 当地的店主们反对在城郊新建大型购物中心的计划。

ex1_zh: 十四天的假期

en: calmness in the way that you react to things, which means that you do not become upset or annoyed
ex1_en: He received the news with surprising equanimity.
ex1_zh: 他得到消息时显得异常镇静。

ex1_zh: 《奥赛罗》的注释本

zh: 指责，非难；抨击；反驳；对…表示怀疑
en: to express doubts about someone’s honesty, courage, ability etc
ex1_en: I did not mean to impugn her professional abilities.
ex1_zh: 我并不是怀疑她的专业能力。
remmethod: im(进入) + pugn(打斗) → 马上就要进入打斗状态 → 提出异议

ex1_zh: 他继续在这些护士们面前指责我。

en: a system of government in which one person or group has unlimited power
ex1_en: Many poor countries are abandoning autocracy.
ex1_zh: 很多贫穷国家都在推翻独裁统治。
remmethod: auto(自己) + cracy(统治) → 自己一个人统治 → 独裁政府

en: an ability or quality that could develop in the future

ex1_zh: 所有这些都是有益的品种，其潜力尚未被认识到。
remmethod: potential(潜在的) + ity(名词后缀) → 潜能；可能性

ex1_zh: 情绪变化的男人更可能进入爬虫类动物模式，进行口头攻击或变得咄咄逼人。
remmethod: reptil(爬虫) + ian(形) → 象爬虫的

en: a large heavy African or Asian animal with thick skin and either one or two horns on its nose

ex1_zh: 在这个岛上还能找到犀牛，一种比大象小一点的动物，可是比水牛大。
remmethod: rhino(鼻) + ceros(角) → 鼻上有角 → 犀牛

en: movement or the ability to move
ex1_en: Flight is the form of locomotion that puts the greatest demands on muscles.
ex1_zh: 飞行是对肌肉要求最高的运动形式。
remmethod: loco(地方) + mot(移动) + ion → 从一地方移到另一地方 → 移位

ex1_en: Jacobs was a stout, florid man.
ex1_zh: 雅各布斯是个身材结实，脸色红润的男人。
remmethod: flor(花) + id → 像花一样的 → 华丽的

ex1_zh: 此外，他开始使用缩写词。
remmethod: ab(表加强) + brev(短的) + i + ate(使…) → 使变短 → 缩略， 缩写

en: a common light yellow chemical substance that burns with a very strong unpleasant smell, and is used in drugs, explosives, and industry. It is a chemical element :symbol S

ex1_zh: 燃烧的硫磺会产生有毒烟雾。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 硫

en: to continue to change your opinions, decisions, ideas etc
ex1_en: She vacillates between men twice her age and men younger than she.
ex1_zh: 她在两个男人之间摇摆不定，一个年龄比她大一倍，一个比她小。
remmethod: vacill(摇摆) + ate → 游移不定

en: to pay out money, especially from a large sum that is available for a special purpose
ex1_en: The aid will not be disbursed until next year.
ex1_zh: 援助款项到明年才能拨出。
remmethod: 他前妻经常打扰 (disturb) 他， 要他付 (disburse) 生活费

ex1_zh: 我的地方政府和全体工作人员与种族歧视水火不容。
remmethod: abhorren (看作abhorrence， 憎恶) + (en)t (…的) → 憎恶的 → 可恶的

ex1_en: If you buy a drier, look for one with a sensor which switches off when clothes are dry.
ex1_zh: 你若要买烘干机，找一台带感应器的，可以在衣服干的时候自动断电。

remmethod: for (禁止) + bear (忍受) + ance → 自己要忍受诱惑， 禁止做错误的事情 → 自制

ex1_zh: 他们被指控煽动叛乱。

ex1_zh: 一场未遂的军事政变

ex1_en: They were made welcome with the usual pantomime of exaggerated smiles and gestures.
ex1_zh: 他们以那种具有夸张的微笑和动作的一般闹剧受到欢迎。

ex1_zh: 他得了一个“叛逆牧师”的称号。

ex1_zh: 他们愿为祖国牺牲生命。

en: When a country industrializes or is industrialized, it develops a lot of industries
ex1_en: Energy consumption rises as countries industrialize.
ex1_zh: 能源消耗随着各国工业化而增加。

en: one of the two imaginary lines around the world, either the Tropic of Cancer which is 23.5˚ north of the  equator  , or the Tropic of Capricorn which is 23.5˚ south of the equator
ex1_en: the Tropic of Capricorn/the Tropic of Cancer
ex1_zh: 南/北回归线
remmethod: trop(转)+ic→太阳来回转→回归线

zh: 迅速消失的, 短暂的
en: something that is evanescent does not last very long
remmethod: e + van(空) + escent(开始…的) → 一出现就空了的 → 短暂的

en: a long tube with mirrors fitted in it, used to look over the top of something, especially to see out of a  submarine
ex1_en: Submarines are most vulnerable to detection when the submarine commander uses a periscope to assess the situation on the surface.
ex1_zh: 当潜艇指挥官使用潜望镜对海面态势进行评估的时候最容易被探测到也最容易被攻击。
remmethod: peri(周围) + scop(看) + e → 看周围 → 潜望镜

en: a hackneyed phrase is boring and does not have much meaning because it has been used so often
ex1_en: Power corrupts and absolute power corrupts absolutely. That's the old hackneyed phrase, but it's true.
ex1_zh: 权力导致腐败，绝对权力导致绝对腐败。这虽是老生常谈，但无半点虚言。
remmethod: 来自Hackney(n. 伦敦近郊城镇)， 以养马闻名， hack的意思是“出租的老马”， 引申为“陈腐的”

en: not developing or doing anything, especially when this is only a temporary state
remmethod: qui(平静的) + esc + ent → 平静的状态 → 静止的

zh: 过度；饮食过度；恶心（由于饮食过度所引起）
en: A surfeit of something is an amount which is too large
ex1_en: Rationing had put an end to a surfeit of biscuits long ago.
ex1_zh: 定量供应很久以前就结束了饼干过剩的情况。
remmethod: sur(过分)+feit(做) → 做过了头 → 过度

zh: 使惊慌， 使不安； 使困惑
en: to make someone feel slightly confused, embarrassed, or worried
ex1_en: His compliments disconcerted her a little.
ex1_zh: 他的恭维让她有点儿尴尬。
remmethod: dis(不) + concert(一致) → 不一致 → 使惊慌

zh: 响亮的；作响的；能发出响亮声音的
en: having a pleasantly deep loud sound
ex1_en: a sonorous voice
ex1_zh: 洪亮的嗓音
remmethod: son(声音)＋orous → (声音)洪亮的

zh: 提出（异议等）；使插入；使干涉
en: to put yourself or something else between two other things
ex1_en: She interposed herself between the general and his wife.
ex1_zh: 她挡在将军和他妻子之间。
remmethod: inter + pos(放) + e → 放入中间 → 置于…之间

en: someone who watches students in an examination to make sure that they do not cheat
ex1_en: One student who arrived four minutes late in 2007 was turned away, even though she and her mother knelt before the exam proctor, begging for leniency.
ex1_zh: 2007年高考中，一位考生迟到了四分钟就被拒绝入场。 虽然她和妈妈在监考老师面前下跪哀求，最终也未能进入考场。
remmethod: 学监 (proctor) 是学校纪律的保护者 (protector)

en: the study of words and of the way words and languages develop
ex1_en: I don't know the philology side, I don't know what disables to metaphysical questions.
ex1_zh: 我不知道者从语言学上来说对不对，我也不懂从形而上学角度看,有什么问题。
remmethod: phil(爱) + o + log(说话) + y → 语文学

en: an old person who is sprightly is still active and full of energy – used to show approval
remmethod: spr (看作spring) + ightly (看作brightly， 明亮地) → 春姑娘的眼睛明亮、 脚步轻快 → 轻快的

ex1_en: He had been caught in a vortex and was being whirled on with a velocity of advance and gyration that made him giddy and sick.
ex1_zh: 一个巨大的漩涡紧紧地抓住了他，他的身体随着漩涡快速前进，快速旋转；他眼花缭乱，头晕目眩，想要呕吐出来。 转眼间他被狠狠地摔在左岸下方的砂砾上。
remmethod: gyr(旋转) + ation(名词后缀) → 旋回；回转

en: to get rid of waste matter from your  bowel s
ex1_en: Fills me with the urge to defecate!
ex1_zh: 让我充满了要澄清一切的欲望！
remmethod: de(向下) + fec(做) + ate(动词后缀) → 向下做 → 排便

zh: 使不活泼, 阻止活动
en: to render inactive
remmethod: in(不) + activate(使活动) → 使不活动

en: to deliberately make something unclear or difficult to understand
ex1_en: They are obfuscating the issue, as only insurance companies can.
ex1_zh: 他们在这个问题上混淆视听，也只有保险公司才做得出这种事。
remmethod: ob(在…之上) + fusc(黑暗的) + ate → 使变成全黑 → 使困惑， 使迷惑

en: expressing anger, hatred, or a wish to harm someone
ex1_en: a baleful look
ex1_zh: 恶狠狠的目光
remmethod: 来自bale (灾难) + ful → 带来灾难的 → 有害的

en: behaving in a kind and nice way to someone who is younger, rather like an uncle
ex1_en: an avuncular pat on the shoulder
ex1_zh: 慈爱地拍拍肩膀
remmethod: av (女方) + uncul (叔， 伯) + ar → 女方的叔伯 → 伯 (叔) 父的

en: to give facts or reasons in order to prove that something is true
ex1_en: Let me adduce more evidence.
ex1_zh: 让我举出更多的证据。
remmethod: ad(向) + duc (引导) + e → 引导出 → 举出

en: to make someone ill and weak
ex1_en: He was debilitated by his illness.
ex1_zh: 他由于生病身体虚弱。
remmethod: de(使) + bil(弱) + itate(动词后缀) → 使变弱 → 使衰弱

en: the science of designing and flying planes
ex1_en: Although it was a great hobby for her, she wanted to study aeronautics or astronomy as a career.
ex1_zh: 不过这只是她一大爱好，她本想学习航空或天文作为职业。
remmethod: aero(空气) + naut(航行) + ics(…学) → 航空学

zh: 不可侵犯的；神圣的；不可亵渎的
en: an inviolable right, law, principle etc is extremely important and should be treated with respect and not broken or removed
ex1_en: The game had a single inviolable rule: obstacles were to be overcome, not circumvented.
ex1_zh: 这个游戏有一个单一的不可违反的规则：困难是被克服的，不是被回避的。
remmethod: in(不) + viol(违反， 冒犯) + able(能…的) → 不可侵犯的

en: completely evil or morally unacceptable
ex1_en: a killer’s depraved mind
ex1_zh: 凶手邪恶的内心世界
remmethod: 来自deprave(v. 使堕落)

en: peaceful and loving or wanting peace
ex1_en: a normally pacific community
ex1_zh: 平日里静悄悄的社区
remmethod: pac(和平) + ific(产生…的) → 和平的；太平洋

en: a word or phrase used at the beginning of a letter or speech, such as ‘Dear Mr Smith’
ex1_en: Jackson nodded a salutation.
ex1_zh: 杰克逊点头打了个招呼。
remmethod: 来自salute (v. 敬礼)

zh: 好交际的, 愉快而随和的
en: friendly and pleasantly cheerful
ex1_en: a convivial atmosphere
ex1_zh: 欢快友好的气氛
remmethod: con + viv(活) + ial → 一起活跃 → 欢乐的

zh: 偶像破坏者；提倡打破旧习的人
remmethod: icono (圣像) + clast (打破…的人) → 打破圣像的人 → 攻击传统观念或风俗的人 → 提倡打破旧习的人

en: very eager to argue or fight with people
ex1_en: The professor had been pugnacious and irritable.
ex1_zh: 那位教授好斗而易怒。
remmethod: pugn(打斗) + acious(多…的) → 好斗的

en: to hide your true feelings, thoughts etc
ex1_en: Henry was not slow to dissemble when it served his purposes.
ex1_zh: 形势一对他有利，亨利就马上开始隐瞒。
remmethod: dis(不) + semble(相同) → 不和(本来面目)相同 → 掩饰

zh: 缩短， 删节， 节略， 精简
remmethod: a + bridge(桥) → 桥缩短了两地之间的距离 → 缩短， 删节

en: a flat shape with three or more sides
ex1_en: The color is used for the area covered by a (multi-)polygon or the line of a (multi-)linestring.
ex1_zh: 颜色用于显示一个（多）多边形所覆盖的区域或一个（多）行字符串的行。
remmethod: poly(多的) + gon(角) → 多角形， 多边形

en: If something or someone enraptures you, you think they are wonderful or fascinating
ex1_en: The place at once enraptured me.
ex1_zh: 这个地方立刻把我迷住了。
remmethod: en + rapture(狂喜) → 使狂喜

ex1_en: These refugees are very grateful to the government's succor.
ex1_zh: 这些难民非常感激政府的救援。
remmethod: succ (看作success， 成功) + or (人) → 救援人员成功救助受伤人 → 救援

en: a large  cage  where birds are kept
ex1_en: Already he had begun to forget them, and Shepperton soon became an extraordinary aviary, filled with birds of every species.
ex1_zh: 他已经把那些邻居们给忘记了，谢伯顿不久就变成了一个特别的鸟类饲养场，拥有各类品种的鸟。
remmethod: avi (鸟) + ary (场所) → 大型鸟舍

zh: 生殖力旺盛的, 多产的
en: able to produce many children, young animals, or crops
ex1_en: It has now become clear how extraordinarily fecund a decade was the 1890s.
ex1_zh: 十九世纪九十年代被当今视为创造力旺盛的十年。
remmethod: “翻垦” → 可翻垦的土地 → 肥沃的

zh: 友好；亲善关系；友好关系
en: friendship, especially between countries
ex1_en: a spirit of perfect amity
ex1_zh: 亲善无间的精神
remmethod: am(爱， 友爱) + ity → 友好关系

zh: 懒惰的， 懒散的； 不活跃的
en: lazy
ex1_en: The former investment banker has not been indolent: his department has been a factory for acronyms since the crisis began.
ex1_zh: 这位前投资银行家并非懒惰，自危机开始以来，他的部门已成为加工厂的代称。
remmethod: in(不) + dol(悲痛) + ent → 连悲痛也感受不到的 → 懒惰的， 倦怠的

zh: 无趣味的；无生气的；索然乏味的
en: If you describe someone or something as vapid, you are critical of them because they are dull and uninteresting
ex1_en: She made a vapid comment about the weather.
ex1_zh: 她对天气作了一番枯燥的评论。
remmethod: 水蒸气 (vapor) 是索然无味的 → 索然无味的

zh: 充气；让空气进入；使暴露于空气中
en: to put a gas or air into a liquid or into soil
ex1_en: Aerate your lawn to allow it to breathe and absorb water better.
ex1_zh: 给草坪通气，使它能够多吸收空气和水分。
remmethod: aer(空气) + ate(表动作) → 充气

zh: 任性，反复无常；随想曲，怪想
en: a sudden and unreasonable change of mind or behaviour
ex1_en: the caprices of a spoilt child
ex1_zh: 一个被宠坏的孩子的任性行为
remmethod: cap(帽子) + rice(米饭) → 戴上帽子才吃米饭 → 任性

en: to make someone very poor
ex1_en: Falling coffee prices have impoverished many developing economies.
ex1_zh: 咖啡价格下跌使很多发展中的经济面临困境。
remmethod: im(进入) + pover(贫困) + ish(使…) → 使进入贫困 → 使贫困

en: to cause to accept or become hardened to; habituate
remmethod: in (不) + ure (看作cure， 治愈) → 疾病久治不愈， 已经习以为常 → 使习惯于

en: not allowing liquids or gases to pass through
ex1_en: No paint is impermeable to water vapour.
ex1_zh: 没有哪种涂料是不透水汽的。
remmethod: im(不) + permeable(可渗透的) → 不可渗透的

zh: 否认，拒绝；放弃，弃权；拒绝承认
en: to state, especially officially, that you are not responsible for something, that you do not know about it, or that you are not involved with it
ex1_en: She disclaims any knowledge of her husband's business.
ex1_zh: 她声称自己对她丈夫的生意一无所知。
remmethod: dis(不) + claim(要求) → 不再要求 → 放弃权利

en: dirty air or a thick unpleasant mist that smells bad
ex1_en: He looked up at me through a miasma of cigarette smoke.
ex1_zh: 他在香烟烟雾中抬头看着我。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 毒气；沼气

en: a situation in which people no longer admire or trust someone or something
ex1_en: He faces six charges of bringing the game into disrepute .
ex1_zh: 他面临六项破坏这项运动声誉的指控。
remmethod: dis(不) + repute(名声) → 不好的名声 → 坏名声

zh: 盐水的, 咸的, 海水的
en: briny water is water that contains a lot of salt
ex1_en: All of it is growing alarmingly acidic, as the carbon dioxide spewed out by modern activities finds its way into the briny.
ex1_zh: 现代生产中喷涌而出的二氧化碳最终会融入了海水，海洋整体的酸化也令人担忧。
remmethod: 来自brine(n. 盐水)

en: behaving in an honest way, without trying to hide anything or deceive people
ex1_en: Joanne was so guileless that Claire had no option but to believe her.
ex1_zh: 乔安妮如此诚实，所以克莱尔除了相信她以外没有别的选择。
remmethod: 没犯过罪 (guiltless) ， 所以很坦率 (guileless)

en: the way that someone stands and walks
ex1_en: lessons in manners and deportment
ex1_zh: 礼仪课程
remmethod: 部门 (department) 的行为 (deportment) 代表着公司的形象

en: a picture or symbol representing an object, concept, or sound
ex1_en: The Inca had no system of hieroglyphic writing, as the Maya did, and any portraits that Inca artists may have made of their rulers were lost.
ex1_zh: 和玛雅人一样，印加人也没有象形文字书写系统，而且印加艺术家们所绘制的统治者肖像业已失传。
remmethod: hiero(神圣) + glyph(雕刻) + ic(形容词后缀) → 神圣雕刻的 → 象形文字的

ex1_en: Rakae Jamil, a musicologist with the Sanjan Nagar Institute of Philosophy and Arts in Lahore, says there is no doubt that Michael Jackson influenced the pop scene in Pakistan.
ex1_zh: 拉齐.贾米尔是拉合尔的桑贾恩.纳加尔哲学和艺术研究所的音乐理论家。 他说，迈克尔.杰克逊影响了巴基斯坦的流行歌坛，这点是毫无疑问的。
remmethod: music(音乐) + olog(学科) + ist(表人) → 音乐学者

en: making you feel ashamed or embarrassed
ex1_en: an ignominious end to his career
ex1_zh: 他职业生涯不光彩的终结
remmethod: 来自ignomin (y) (耻辱) + ious → 可耻的

zh: 迅速而有效的， 迅速完成的
en: Expeditious means quick and efficient
ex1_en: The judge said that arbitration was a fair and expeditious decision-making process.
ex1_zh: 法官说仲裁是一个公正且迅速有效率的决定过程。
remmethod: 来自expedite(v. 使加速， 促进)

zh: 愚笨的；昏庸的；发呆的；自满的
en: very silly or stupid
ex1_en: fatuous questions
ex1_zh: 愚昧的问题
remmethod: fat (胖的) + uous → 四肢发达 (引申为fat) ， 头脑简单 → 愚昧的

ex1_en: Wherefore, I strongly advise you, my lords, to put aside all care and solicitude and to receive readily the most holy Body and Blood of our Lord Jesus Christ in holy commemoration of Him.
ex1_zh: 为此，我强烈地建议你们，大人，把（对此世的）关心和渴望放到一边并接受我们的主基督在祂神圣的纪念仪式中已经是最神圣的身体和血。
remmethod: solicit(恳求；牵挂) + (t)ude(名词后缀) → 焦虑；渴望；担心

zh: （主张等）站得住脚的；可维持的
en: a belief, argument etc that is tenable is reasonable and can be defended successfully
ex1_en: an idea which is no longer tenable
ex1_zh: 不再成立的观点
remmethod: ten(维持， 保持) + able → 能够维持的 → 站得住脚的

zh: 给…上颈手枷；使…惹人嘲笑
ex1_en: The education secretary was pilloried by the press for his latest proposals.
ex1_zh: 教育部长因其最近的提案而受到新闻界批评。
remmethod: 著名戏曲《苏三起解》中苏三戴着的刑具就是pillory (颈手枷)

en: a large amount of something
ex1_en: a plenitude of wealth
ex1_zh: 大量的财富
remmethod: plen(满) + itude → 大量

en: a desire to have a lot of money that is considered to be too strong
ex1_en: He paid a month's rent in advance, just enough to satisfy the landlord's avarice.
ex1_zh: 他预交了一个月的房租，正好满足了房东的贪心。
remmethod: avar (渴望) + ice → 贪婪

en: a female teacher who is in charge of a school
ex1_en: "We've got life-size cutouts of William and Kate, " boasts one headmistress, claiming: "The children are really excited."
ex1_zh: “我们制作了真人大小的威廉和凯特的人像，”一名女校长沾沾自喜地炫耀着：“孩子们可兴奋了。”
remmethod: head(头；首) + mistress(女主人；女教师) → 女校长

en: the scientific study of metals and their uses
ex1_en: He studied metallurgy as a mature student, having spent ten years working in a foundry.
ex1_zh: 在一家铸造厂工作了10年以后,他成为成人学生学习冶金专业。
remmethod: metall(金属) + urgy(加工术) → 冶金；冶金术

en: a type of telephone that allows you to see the person you are talking to on a screen
ex1_en: Perhaps as soon as 2007, these assistants will hover over an astronaut's shoulder, serving as an all-in-one PDA, videophone, and air monitor.
ex1_zh: 最快到2007年，这类助理型机器人就会出现在宇航员的箭头，它能用做PDA、可视电话并监测空气。
remmethod: video (视频) +phone (电话) →可视电话

en: a man with a high rank in the past who was trained to fight while riding a horse
ex1_en: knights in armour
ex1_zh: 身披盔甲的骑士
remmethod: knight(自身词根) → 骑士；授以爵位
本词(自身词根) → 好哇，万岁，乌拉

en: someone who is not generous and does not like spending money
ex1_en: I'm married to a miser.
ex1_zh: 我嫁了个守财奴。
remmethod: 守财奴 (miser) 实际上很痛苦 (misery)

zh: 丰富的；很多的；慷慨的；浪费的
en: produced or existing in large quantities
ex1_en: He made profuse apologies .
ex1_zh: 他不住地道歉。
remmethod: pro(许多) + fus(流) + e → 多得向外流 → 丰富的

zh: 下流的；说话粗鄙恶劣的；无礼的
ex1_en: a scurrilous attack on his integrity
ex1_zh: 对他正直人格的恶意诋毁
remmethod: 来自scurril (恶语诽谤的) + ous → 说话粗鄙恶劣的

en: a man who is effeminate looks or behaves like a woman
remmethod: ef + femin(女) + ate → 露出女人气 → 柔弱的

en: to mix together, or to make different things do this
ex1_en: Many towns allow recyclable items to be commingled for collection in a single container.
ex1_zh: 在许多城镇，可回收物品可以混放在一个容器里统一收走。
remmethod: com(共同) + mingle(结合， 混合) → 掺和， 混合

en: to tear or break something violently into pieces
remmethod: 因为被撕碎(rend)了， 所以要修补(mend)

zh: 使复员, 使退伍, 遣散
en: to send home the members of an army, navy etc, especially at the end of a war
ex1_en: programmes to help demobilized soldiers fit into civilian life
ex1_zh: 帮助复员军人适应平民生活的方案
remmethod: de(分离) + mob(移动) + ilize → 向不同的方向移动 → 遣散

en: looking disappointed and upset
ex1_en: He came back looking crestfallen .
ex1_zh: 他回来时看上去垂头丧气的。
remmethod: crest(鸡冠) + fallen → 鸡冠下垂 → 斗败了的 → 挫败的

zh: 以符号表示， 把…写成记号
en: to write (esp music) in notation
remmethod: not(知道) + ate(使…) → (通过标识)使人知道 → 以符号表示

en: to block or stop up (a passage or opening); obstruct
remmethod: oc + clude (关闭) → 关闭通路 → 使闭塞

zh: 无与伦比的；出类拔萃的；无比的
en: better than any other
ex1_en: the peerless blues musician B.B. King
ex1_zh: 举世无双的蓝调音乐家比比金
remmethod: peer(同等的人) + less(无) → 无可匹敌的

zh: 承认；公开宣称；坦率承认
en: to make a public statement about something you believe in
ex1_en: He avowed his commitment to Marxist ideals.
ex1_zh: 他宣称对马克思主义理想矢志不渝。
remmethod: a(来) + vow(誓言) → 发誓 → 承认

en: a feeling that you should not do something because it is bad or wrong
ex1_en: They used their tanks against the leftists without compunction .
ex1_zh: 他们肆无忌惮地使用坦克来对付左派人士。
remmethod: com＋punct(刺， 点)＋ion → (心)不断被刺 → 良心不安

zh: 年轻而无经验的；羽毛未丰的
en: A callow young person has very little experience or knowledge of the way they should behave as an adult
remmethod: 未长羽毛的 (callow) 鸟叫声 (call) 低 (low)

en: a piece of equipment that changes a gas into a liquid
ex1_en: You take that gas phase mixture, and you condense it in your condenser.
ex1_zh: 然后用这新得到的气相混合物，在冷凝器中冷凝。
remmethod: condens(e)(冷凝；压缩) + er(表物) → 冷凝器；电容器

en: the property of a system that enables it to store electric charge
remmethod: capacit(y)(容量；电容) + ance(名词后缀) → 电容，电容量

en: Eclecticism is the principle or practice of choosing or involving objects, ideas, and beliefs from many different sources
remmethod: ec(出) + lect(选) + ic(形容词后缀) + ism(主义) → 折衷主义

ex1_en: He looked down at the recumbent figure.
ex1_zh: 他向下看着躺着的身影。
remmethod: re + cumb(躺) + ent → 斜靠的

zh: 诙谐的；爱开玩笑的；滑稽的；(尤指在不合适的时候)开玩笑的
en: saying things that are intended to be clever and funny but are really silly and annoying
ex1_en: Don’t be so facetious!
ex1_zh: 别这么乱开玩笑！
remmethod: face(脸) + tious → 做鬼脸 → 好开玩笑的

en: if someone is hypersensitive to a drug, substance etc, their body reacts very badly to it
ex1_en: Student teachers were hypersensitive to any criticism of their performance.
ex1_zh: 实习教师对任何针对他们表现的批评意见都异常敏感。
remmethod: hyper(过度) + sens(感觉) + itive(形容词后缀) → 过度感觉的 → 非常敏感的
来自forage(v. 搜寻)

en: leather that is in its natural state
ex1_en: At his belt he carried a rawhide whip.
ex1_zh: 他腰间别着一根生牛皮制作的鞭子。
remmethod: raw(生的) + hide(兽皮) → 生牛皮

zh: 象形文字, 图画文字
en: a picture or symbol used to represent a word or part of a word, especially in the ancient Egyptian writing system
ex1_en: Initially the patterns I used were hieroglyph like symbols.
ex1_zh: 我所采用的图案是类似符号的象形文字。
remmethod: hier(神圣的) + o + glyph(写， 刻) → 神写的字 → 神秘符号

en: a movement or an attack that is intended to deceive an opponent, especially in  boxing
ex1_en: I feinted to the left, then to the right.
ex1_zh: 我佯装要攻到左方，然后再到右方。
remmethod: 注意不要和faint(adj. 虚弱的)相混

en: to make it difficult for you to do something or for something to happen
ex1_en: He died in 1874, heavily encumbered by debt.
ex1_zh: 他于1874年去世，负债累累。
remmethod: en (使) + cumber (阻碍) → 阻碍

ex1_en: Even babies soon become aware of the transience of human ties.
ex1_zh: 连婴儿也会很快意识到人际关系的短暂无常。
remmethod: 来自transient (a. 短暂的)

zh: 没有骨气的；无脊椎的；懦弱的
en: lacking courage and determination – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: a bunch of spineless politicians
ex1_zh: 一群怯弱的政客
remmethod: 来自spine (脊椎； 刺) + less → 无脊椎的

en: to ask someone, in a very emotional way, to do something for you
ex1_en: His friends entreated him not to go.
ex1_zh: 他的朋友们恳求他不要去。
remmethod: en(进入) + treat(处理) → 要求进入处理 → 恳求

zh: 自负的, 过于自信的
en: excessively confident
ex1_en: God warns us never to get cocky and overconfident; that is the recipe for disaster.
ex1_zh: 神警告我们绝不可自高过于自信，那是招致灾难的处方。
remmethod: over(过度) + confident(自信的) → 过于自信的；自负的

zh: 羞怯的；缺乏自信的；谦虚谨慎的
en: shy and not wanting to make people notice you or talk about you
ex1_en: John was as bouncy and ebullient as Helen was diffident and reserved.
ex1_zh: 约翰活泼、热情；而海伦却羞怯、矜持。
remmethod: di (看作de， 否定) + ffident (看作confident， 自信的) → 不自信的 → 缺乏自信的

en: copying someone or something, especially in a way that shows you do not have any ideas of your own
ex1_en: Young people might be provoked into imitative crime by the exploits they see on TV.
ex1_zh: 年轻人可能会从电视上看到的“英勇行为”中受到启发而仿效电视主人公实施犯罪。
remmethod: 来自imitate(v. 模仿； 仿造)

zh: 文雅, 出身高贵, 有教养
en: the quality of being polite, gentle, or graceful, and of seeming to belong to a high social class
ex1_en: The hotel had an air of discreet gentility.
ex1_zh: 这家酒店有一种不露痕迹的典雅气派。
remmethod: gent(le)(温和的， 文雅的) + ility → 有教养， 文雅

en: to improve a society so that it is more organized and developed, and often more fair or comfortable
ex1_en: Ellis was credited with civilizing the Texas prison system.
ex1_zh: 据信是埃利斯改良了得克萨斯州的监狱制度。
remmethod: civil(公民；文明) + ize(使…化) → 使文明；教育

zh: 共生, 附着, 增加
en: to grow or cause to grow together; be or become fused
ex1_en: Over time, an implementation will accrete complexity as code is revisited for bug fixes and feature enhancements.
ex1_zh: 随着时间的迁移，系统实现与复杂度将共存，因为修改问题和添加新功能将会增加代码量。
remmethod: ac(加强) + cre(增长)＋te → 逐渐增长

en: someone who makes pots, dishes etc out of clay
remmethod: pott(罐) + er(表人) → 制陶工人；闲混

zh: 脾气坏的人，乖戾的人；吝啬鬼；存心不良的人
en: someone who is often annoyed or angry, especially an old person
remmethod: cur (跑) + mud (泥) + geon → 跑到泥巴里去发脾气 → 脾气坏的人 (尤指老人)

en: a word that is used before a noun,  pronoun  , or  gerund  to show place, time, direction etc. In the phrase ‘the trees in the park’, ‘in’ is a preposition.
ex1_en: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
ex1_zh: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。
remmethod: pre(…前的)+position(地点， 位置)→介词通常都是加在方位之前→介词

en: to stem the flow of (a liquid, esp blood) or (of a liquid) to stop flowing
ex1_en: Try, for a moment, to stanch the flow of desire.
ex1_zh: 你可以尝试着在一段时期内止住你的欲望之流。
remmethod: stan (站) + ch → 血停下来不再流 → 止 (血)

en: to escape from a place where you are being kept
ex1_en: He was ordered to appear the following day, but absconded.
ex1_zh: 他被传唤于第二天出庭，却逃跑了。
remmethod: abs(脱离) + cond(藏起来) → 潜逃

ex1_en: Automatic logoff feature helps alleviate such risks by automatically disabling the session using recommended time-out values for dormancy.
ex1_zh: 自动下线特性通过对休眠使用推荐的超时值，可以帮助降低此类风险。
remmethod: dorm(睡眠) + ancy → 在睡眠状态 → 休眠状态

zh: 外向；外倾者；性格外向者（等于extravert）
en: someone who is active and confident, and who enjoys spending time with other people
ex1_en: Her sister was always more of an extrovert.
ex1_zh: 她妹妹总是更外向些。
remmethod: extro(外) + vert(转) → 向外转的人 → 性格外向者

en: Torpor is the state of being completely inactive mentally or physically, for example, because of illness or laziness
ex1_en: He had slumped into a state of torpor from which nothing could rouse him.
ex1_zh: 他陷入了一种麻木状态，什么事都不能唤起他的兴趣。
remmethod: 他真可以说是最 (top) 迟钝的 (torpor) 一个人了

zh: 懒散的；不整洁的；马虎的
en: lazy, untidy, and careless
ex1_en: slovenly habits
ex1_zh: 邋里邋遢的习惯
remmethod: 来自sloven (不整洁的人， 懒鬼) + ly → 不修边幅的

zh: 爱发号施令的， 爱指手画脚的
en: too eager to tell people what to do – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: an officious traffic warden
ex1_zh: 一名爱发号施令的交通督导员
remmethod: of(在路上) + fic(做) + ious → 挡在路上 → 爱指手画脚的

en: ribald remarks or jokes are humorous, rude, and about sex
ex1_en: a ribald remark
ex1_zh: 粗俗的言论
remmethod: ri(拼音： 日) ＋ bald(光秃的) → 白天光着身子 → 下流的

en: to put facts, numbers, ideas etc into a particular order
ex1_en: This basic plugin is undoubtedly one of the important plugins to systematize the archives.
ex1_zh: 这个插件无疑是系统化归档的重要插件之一。
remmethod: sy(=syn一起) + st(站立) + emat + ize(使…) → 使站在一起 → 使系统化

zh: 谬误的；骗人的；靠不住的；不合理的
en: containing or based on false ideas
ex1_en: Such an argument is misleading, if not wholly fallacious.
ex1_zh: 这种论点即使不完全是谬误，也是误导人的。
remmethod: fall(错误) + aci + ous(多…的) → 谬误的

zh: 没有希望的(结果未必良好的)
en: If you describe something as unpromising, you think that it is unlikely to be successful or produce anything good in the future
ex1_en: In fact, his business career had distinctly unpromising beginnings.
ex1_zh: 事实上，他的职业生涯开始时看起来非常没有前途。
remmethod: 不要和uncompromising(adj. 不妥协的)相混

zh: 面包车（等于microbus）；小型公共汽车；中客车
en: a small bus with seats for six to twelve people
ex1_en: He was then taken by minibus to the military base.
ex1_zh: 接着他被小型公共汽车带到了军事基地。
remmethod: mini(微型的) ＋ bus(公共汽车) → 小型公共汽车

zh: 业余爱好者；一知半解者
ex1_en: He tolerated the presence of an amateur, idler and dilettante and proved a perfect teacher and matchless travel companion.
ex1_zh: 他能够容忍我这个业余爱好者的浅薄与无知，当之无愧是一个好老师和一个无与伦比的好伙伴。
remmethod: dilet ( = delect， 愉快) + tante → 为了找乐而做事的人 → 爱好者

en: someone who makes jewellery and other things out of silver
ex1_en: The son of a Huguenot silversmith, Apollos Rivoire, and Deborah Hitchbourn, Revere received a rudimentary "writing-school" education before turning to his father's trade.
ex1_zh: 他是胡格诺派银匠阿波罗·里维尔和黛博拉·赫奇博的儿子，他还没读到他父亲的程度就获得了基本的写作结业证书。
remmethod: silver(银) + smith(工匠) → 银器匠

en: a loud horn on a ship, used in fog to warn other ships of its position
remmethod: fog(雾) + horn(号角) → 雾角

en: Destitution is the state of having no money or possessions
ex1_en: Though the meekest of men, he was full of fire which flamed its fiercest in his patriotism, as though to burn to ashes the shortcomings and destitution of his country.
ex1_zh: 虽然他是个极其温和的人，在爱国主义上他却充满了最炽热的火焰，仿佛要把他自己国家的缺点和贫困烧成灰烬。
remmethod: 来自destitute(adj. 贫困的)

zh: 健谈的；缠绕的；易旋转的
en: If you say that someone is voluble, you mean that they talk a lot with great energy and enthusiasm
ex1_en: She was voluble with excitement.
ex1_zh: 她因为激动而变得很健谈。
remmethod: volu (看作volume， 音量) + ble → 谈话中音量一直没变 → 健谈的

zh: 通晓数种语言的人；用通晓数种语言记载的书
en: A polyglot is a person who speaks or understands many languages
ex1_en: a polyglot population
ex1_zh: 多语种人口
remmethod: poly (多) + glot (声门； 语言) → 多种语言的

zh: 贪污的；用金钱买得的；贿赂的；贪赃枉法的
en: willing to use power and influence in a dishonest way in return for money
ex1_en: our venal politicians
ex1_zh: 我们腐败的政客
remmethod: ven (来) + al (看作all) → 贪官污吏对金钱来者不拒 → 贪污的

en: when someone suddenly stops believing in a religion or supporting a political party
remmethod: apo (远) + stas (站) + y → 大难来临， 靠边站 → 变节
soph(智慧) + ist(表人) + icate(动词) → 使有智慧 → 使世故；精通者

en: a favourable report, opinion, or reaction shows that you think that someone or something is good or that you agree with them
ex1_en: favourable film reviews
ex1_zh: 正面的影评
remmethod: 来自favour(n./vt. 赞同)

zh: 不光彩的；卑鄙的；卑贱的
en: ignoble thoughts, feelings, or actions are ones that you should feel ashamed or embarrassed about
ex1_en: ignoble feelings of intense jealousy
ex1_zh: 可耻的极度妒忌感
remmethod: ig (不) + noble (高贵) → 不高贵的， 下流的 → 不光彩的

en: to be used to something or gradually become used to it
ex1_en: Over the centuries, these animals have become habituated to living in a dry environment.
ex1_zh: 几百年下来，这些动物已经习惯于生活在干燥的环境里。
remmethod: habit(住； 习惯) + uate → 使习惯于

en: A halcyon time is a time in the past that was peaceful or happy
ex1_en: It was all a far cry from those halcyon days in 1990, when he won three tournaments on the European tour.
ex1_zh: 这和1990年的那些美好时光迥然不同，当时他在欧洲巡回赛中赢了三场锦标赛。
remmethod: 原指传说中一种能平息风浪的“神翠鸟(halcyon)”

en: a record player
remmethod: gramo(写；记录) + phone(声音) → 留声机

zh: 白天的；每日的，一日间的
en: happening or active in the daytime
ex1_en: Kangaroos are diurnal animals.
ex1_zh: 袋鼠是昼出动物。
remmethod: di(白天) + urnal(…的) → 白天的

en: relating to the spring
ex1_en: the vernal equinox
ex1_zh: 春分
remmethod: vern (看作verse， 诗) + al (的) → 春天就像一首无字的诗 → 春天的

en: the best and highest level of something
ex1_en: the acme of perfection
ex1_zh: 尽善尽美
remmethod: 超越自我 (me)， 必将达到人生成功的顶点 (acme)

zh: 尖刻的；锐利的；苛刻的；锋利的（名词trenchancy，副词trenchantly）
en: expressed very strongly, effectively, and directly without worrying about offending people
ex1_en: Stockman became one of the President’s most trenchant critics.
ex1_zh: 斯托克曼成了总统最尖锐的批评者之一。
remmethod: trench(沟) + ant → 说话像挖沟， 入木三分 → 犀利的

en: a sudden expression of strong feeling that you cannot control
ex1_en: He exploded in a paroxysm of rage.
ex1_zh: 他突然勃然大怒。
remmethod: par (变) + oxy (尖利) + sm → 突发疾病， 浑身刺痛 → 突发

en: conversation which is fast and full of intelligent and amusing remarks and replies
ex1_en: witty repartee
ex1_zh: 机智的应答
remmethod: re(反) + part(部分) + ee → 拿出部分作为回答 → 机敏的应答

zh: 非常高兴的；欢跃的；狂喜的；欢欣鼓舞的
en: very happy or proud, especially because you have succeeded in doing something
ex1_en: an exultant mood
ex1_zh: 得意的心情
remmethod: 来自exult(v. 欢腾， 喜悦)

en: the place where someone lives
ex1_en: Military service entails frequent changes of domicile.
ex1_zh: 服兵役需要频繁更换住所。
remmethod: dom(家) + icile → 住处， 住所

en: support, approval, or agreement for something such as a plan, idea, or system
ex1_en: In Sweden and other countries, nuclear power has lost favor .
ex1_zh: 在瑞典等国家，核能已不受欢迎。
remmethod: “飞吻” → 姑娘对那个小伙子很有好感， 于是给了他一个飞吻 → 好感

en: official praise or approval
remmethod: ap(表加强) + prob(=prove证实) + ation → 证实是好的 → 赞成

en: one of a group of common solid mineral substances that exist naturally in the Earth
ex1_en: Beryl is a beryllium-aluminum silicate, and its color comes from small amounts of chromium.
ex1_zh: 绿宝石其实是一种铍铝硅酸盐，而它的颜色则来自于微量的铬元素。
remmethod: silic(硅) + ate(酸盐) → 硅酸盐

ex1_en: When spring is coming all trees begin to burgeon .
ex1_zh: 当春天到来的时候，所有树开始发芽。
remmethod: burg(=bud花蕾) + eon → 迅速成长； burg本身是单词， 意为“城， 镇” → 成长的地方 → 发展

ex1_en: It is an important improvement in the survivability of the crew while maintaining the dynamics and payload of the aircrafts.
ex1_zh: 这对同时保持飞机的动力、负重以及生存性上是一个重要的提升。
remmethod: surviv(e)(幸存) + ability(能力；性质) → 残存性；生存能力

en: a loquacious person likes to talk a lot
ex1_en: He said that despite older adults being less “loquacious” or talkative than their younger adult counterparts, they elicit much more vocal responses when calling.
ex1_zh: 他说，不管老人不太“饶舌”还是比年轻同伴更多话，他们呼叫时都能激发更多的语音回应。
remmethod: loqu (说话) + aci + ous (…的) → 老说话的 → 多话的

en: a place where water flows, for example a river or canal
ex1_en: chemicals that pollute the local watercourse
ex1_zh: 污染当地河道的化学品
remmethod: water(水) + course(路线) → 水道

en: a large container outside your house, used for holding waste until it is taken away
ex1_en: A bomb planted in a dustbin exploded early today.
ex1_zh: 一枚安置在一个垃圾桶内的炸弹今天清早爆炸了。
remmethod: dust(灰尘)+bin(箱子)→装灰尘的箱子→垃圾箱

zh: 斜面；伪善之言；黑话；角落
en: insincere talk about moral or religious principles by someone who is pretending to be better than they really are
ex1_en: thieves’ cant
ex1_zh: 小偷的黑话
remmethod: 不能 (can't) 说的话 → 黑话 (cant)

en: to officially judge how an argument between two opposing sides should be settled
ex1_en: He arbitrates between investors and members of the association.
ex1_zh: 他在投资者与该协会成员之间做仲裁。
remmethod: arbitr (判断， 裁决) + ate (使) → 使公平裁决 → 做出公断

zh: 动力的， 电动的；有生气的
ex1_en: This article studies the dynamical action of a predator-prey system with age structure .
ex1_zh: 摘要研究了一类捕食者具有年龄结构的捕食系统的动力学行为。
remmethod: dynam(力量)+ic→动力的

en: If you besmirch someone or their reputation, you say that they are a bad person or that they have done something wrong, usually when this is not true
ex1_en: He has accused local people of trying to besmirch his reputation.
ex1_zh: 他指责当地人企图败坏他的名誉。
remmethod: be + smirch (污点； 弄脏) → 被弄上污点 → 弄污

zh: 衰老的；疲惫的；（土地）贫瘠的；（动植物）不育的
ex1_en: effete intellectuals
ex1_zh: 软弱的知识分子
remmethod: ef(没有) + fet(生产性的) + e → 无生产力的

en: to improve someone’s mind or character by teaching them something
ex1_en: A sermon, especially one intended to edify a congregation on a practical matter and not intended to be a theological discourse.
ex1_zh: 布道一次讲道，尤其是旨在于实际问题上启发会众，而不在于成为神学讲演。
remmethod: 他编 (edit) 了本可以启发 (edify) 思维的书 → 启发

en: to start doing the bad things that you used to do, after having improved your behaviour
ex1_en: But if you backslide, Hiram says, “Start over.
ex1_zh: 但假如你倒退了，海勒姆说，“那就重新开始。
remmethod: back(向后) + slide(滑动) → 往后滑 → 故态复萌

en: Datum is the singular form of data
remmethod: dat(给予) + um(名词后缀) → 被给出的东西 → 数据

zh: 连贯， 一致； 黏合； 齐心协力， 团结一致
en: if ideas, arguments, beliefs, statements etc cohere, they are connected in a clear and reasonable way
ex1_en: All the details are there and are correct but they don’t cohere.
ex1_zh: 所有的细节都摆在那里，而且都正确，但是它们并不一致。
remmethod: co(共同) + her(黏附) + e → 黏在一起 → 连贯， 一致

en: a substance that forms a chemical salt when combined with an acid
ex1_en: The extremely salty, alkali lake holds little life, but its waters are a favorite spot for wading birds.
ex1_zh: 其味极咸，碱湖保存了湖中的小生命，但其水域仍为涉水鸟所喜欢的地方。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 碱

zh: 使变形；使改观；美化；理想化
en: to change the way someone or something looks, especially so that they become more beautiful
ex1_en: Her face was transfigured with joy.
ex1_zh: 她高兴得容光焕发。
remmethod: trans (改变) + figure (形象) → 改变形象 → 美化

en: complete honesty
ex1_en: I have always found Bentner to be a model of probity in our dealings.
ex1_zh: 在我们的交往中，我一贯认为班特纳是诚实的典范。
remmethod: 来自prob (e) (检查) + ity → 真金不怕火炼， 正直的人经得起考验 → 正直

en: to drink a lot, be noisy, and have fun
ex1_en: They told him to stay home with his wife instead of going out and carousing with friends.
ex1_zh: 他们告诉他与他的妻子在一起呆在家里，不要出去和朋友们一起痛饮狂欢。
remmethod: car +(r)ouse (唤起) → 在汽车里狂饮欢闹以至于惊动了警察 → 狂饮欢闹

zh: 刺耳的；不谐和的；不调和的
en: discordant; cacophonous
ex1_en: The final movement, a robust and often dissonant fugue, is a precursor to Beethoven’s startling, gritty “Grosse Fuge,” composed as the final movement of his Opus 130 String Quartet.
ex1_zh: 不协调的和音、爆裂刺耳的强音复调表现曲式是贝多芬大赋格曲的序奏部分。 他在弦乐四重奏作品130号也以此风格作为最后一个乐章。
remmethod: dis(分开) + son(声音) + ant → 声音分散的 → 不和谐的

zh: 屈尊；俯就；（对某人）表现出优越感
en: to behave as if you think you are better, more intelligent, or more important than other people – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: When he condescended to speak, he contradicted himself three or four times in the space of half an hour.
ex1_zh: 当他屈尊讲话时，半小时内有三四次前后矛盾。
remmethod: con + descend (降下， 降落) → 屈尊， 俯就

en: to make someone go deaf
ex1_en: He was deafened by the noise from the gun.
ex1_zh: 枪声把他震聋了。
remmethod: deaf(聋的) + en(动词后缀，使…) → 使聋

en: fat
remmethod: corp (躯体) + ulent (多…的) → 肥胖的

en: a traditional Christmas song
ex1_en: The singing of Christmas carols is a custom derived from early dance routines of pagan origin.
ex1_zh: 唱圣诞歌这一传统源自异教早期的舞蹈仪式。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 圣诞节颂歌

ex1_en: If she gets the nod, Kagan says she will consider every case impartially and with commitment to principle.
ex1_zh: Kagan 说如果她能通过，她将公平地处理每个案子并忠于原则办事。
remmethod: im(不) + partial(偏袒的) + ly(副词后缀) → 不偏袒地 → 公平地

zh: 夺取， 掠夺； 蹂躏
en: to steal from a place or people using force, especially in a war
remmethod: 溺爱 (spoil) 孩子有时会剥夺 (despoil) 他的自由

zh: 津贴， 利益； 特权
remmethod: per(每) + quisite(看作quite， 完全) → 所有的都是“特权” → 特权

zh: 作伪证；使发伪誓；使破坏誓言
en: to tell a lie after promising to tell the truth in a court of law
ex1_en: Witnesses lied and perjured themselves.
ex1_zh: 证人撒谎作伪证。
remmethod: per(假地， 错地) ＋ jur(发誓) + e → 虚假地发誓 → 使作伪证， 发假誓

zh: 懒洋洋的；无精打采的；伤感的
en: not showing enough interest in something or not putting enough effort into it
ex1_en: David has a rather lackadaisical approach to his work.
ex1_zh: 戴维的工作态度有点懒散。
remmethod: lackadais(y)(感叹词，表倦怠) + ical(形容词后缀) → 懒洋洋的

en: to rub something so hard that the surface becomes damaged
ex1_en: My skin was abraded and very tender.
ex1_zh: 我的皮肤被擦伤了，非常敏感。
remmethod: ab(脱离) + rade(磨擦) → 摩擦掉 → 磨损

en: If you describe someone as a profiteer, you are critical of them because they make large profits by charging high prices for goods that are hard to get
remmethod: 来自profit (利润) + eer (人) → 只追求利益之人 → 奸商

zh: 民族学， 文化人类学
en: the scientific study and comparison of different races of people
ex1_en: The pattern of the Reindeer Industry in West Siberian of Russia is an important issue for ethnology.
ex1_zh: 西西伯利亚的养鹿业类型学研究是俄罗斯民族学的一个重要课题。
remmethod: ethn(民族， 种族) + ology(…学) → 民族学

zh: 卷笔刀；[机] 磨具；研磨者
en: A sharpener is a tool or machine used for sharpening pencils or knives
remmethod: sharp(尖；敏锐) + en(使动) + er(表工具/人) → 使变尖的工具 → 卷笔刀；磨具

zh: 统治者，君主；有权势的人
en: a ruler in the past, who had great power over his people
ex1_en: People rose up against the despotic rule of their potentate .
ex1_zh: 人们起来反抗君主的专制统治。
remmethod: 来自potent (力量) + ate → 有力量的人 → 统治者

zh: 大合唱；（意）清唱剧；康塔塔（一种声乐套曲）
en: a piece of religious music for singers and instruments
remmethod: cant (唱) + ata (表示音乐类作品) → 清唱剧

ex1_en: Blood vessels in the lungs are filled and distend. Capillary changes have been observed in the animal model of simulated microgravity.
ex1_zh: 肺血管充盈、扩张，并在模拟微重力动物模型中观察到肺微血管损伤。
remmethod: dis (分开) + tend (拉) → 向四面拉 → 扩大； 膨胀

en: an area of slight darkness
ex1_en: In the outer part of that shadow, the penumbra, part of the Sun, is blocked.
ex1_zh: 而影子外面部分的半影，被太阳的一部分挡住。
remmethod: pen(几乎) + umbra(阴影) → 半影

en: unlikely to offend or upset anyone
ex1_en: Her husband was a small, inoffensive-looking man.
ex1_zh: 她丈夫个子不高，看上去很随和。
remmethod: in(不) + offensive(冒犯的) → 不冒犯人的；无害的

zh: 冗词， 赘言， 废话
en: speech or writing that has many unnecessary words in it
ex1_en: meaningless verbiage
ex1_zh: 不知所云的冗词
remmethod: verb(词语) + i + age(年龄) → 一个词说了一辈子 → 冗词， 赘言

en: full and swollen with liquid or air
ex1_en: a turgid Social Science textbook
ex1_zh: 一本枯燥乏味的社会科学教科书
remmethod: “特肿的” → 肿的

en: typical of the natural way in which someone speaks or writes when they are using their own language
ex1_en: He had the ability to write fluent and idiomatic English.
ex1_zh: 他能够写出流利地道的英语。
remmethod: idiom(习语；成语) + atic(形容词后缀) → 地道的；成语的

en: a piece of farm equipment used to turn over the earth so that seeds can be planted
ex1_en: There are new tractors and new ploughs in the machinery lot.
ex1_zh: 机器设备场里有新拖拉机和新耕犁。
remmethod: pl + ough(看作tough坚硬的) → 在坚硬的土地上犁 → 犁； 费力穿过

en: very eager to please or agree with people who are powerful – used in order to show disapproval
ex1_en: an obsequious smile
ex1_zh: 谄媚的微笑
remmethod: ob(在…后面) + sequ(跟随) + ious → 跟在后面的 → 逢迎的， 谄媚的

zh: 奴隶的, 盲从的, 专横的
en: obeying, supporting, or copying someone completely – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: a slavish adherence to the rules
ex1_zh: 对规章的盲目遵从
remmethod: slav(e)(奴隶) + ish(形容词后缀， 表属性) → 奴性的 → 卑屈的

zh: 苦恼；恼怒；令人烦恼的事
en: when you feel worried or annoyed by something
ex1_en: He kicked the broken machine in vexation.
ex1_zh: 他懊恼得踢了这台坏机器一脚。
remmethod: 来自vex (v. 烦恼； 恼怒)

en: if a government or organization retrenches, it spends less money
ex1_en: Shortly afterwards, cuts in defence spending forced the aerospace industry to retrench.
ex1_zh: 此后不久，国防开支的削减迫使航空航天业紧缩开支。
remmethod: re(回) + trench(切掉) → 把开支再切掉 → 节省， 紧缩开支

zh: 无忧无虑；漫不经心；满不在乎
en: a cheerful feeling of not caring or worrying about anything
ex1_en: an air of insouciance
ex1_zh: 无忧无虑的神态
remmethod: 消息来源 (source) 很多， 所以他漫不经心 (insouciance)

en: the use of clever plans or actions to deceive people
ex1_en: Clearly there is some chicanery going on.
ex1_zh: 这里面显然有诈。
remmethod: chic(聪明) + anery → 耍聪明 → 欺诈

en: a substance that shows that another substance in a  compound  exists, by causing a chemical  reaction
ex1_en: This is another organic chemistry reagent, it's also used extensively in the pharmaceutical industry.
ex1_zh: 这也是一个有机化学试剂，而且还在制药业中广泛应用。
remmethod: re(相反；再) + ag(做；驱动) + ent(表物) → 起反应的物质 → 试剂

ex1_en: One of these gene machines, a social and bipedal ape, began to imitate.
ex1_zh: 这些“基因机器”其中的一个，一个群居的两足人猿开始了模仿。
remmethod: bi(两) + ped(足) + al(的) → 两足的

zh: 令人厌烦的，讨厌的；令人厌恶的
en: annoying
ex1_en: an irksome journey
ex1_zh: 一次恼人的旅行
remmethod: 来自irk(v. 使苦恼)

en: a shape with six sides
ex1_en: He presses the bolt against a small hexagon tattooed on his forearm. The sizes match.
ex1_zh: 他将螺钉与他前臂的一个小六边形纹身比了比，尺寸是一样的。
remmethod: hexa(六) + gon(角) → 六角形；六边形

en: a recessive  gene  is passed to children from their parents only if both parents have the gene
ex1_en: In normal seedlings the deleterious recessive genes are not expressed.
ex1_zh: 有害的隐性基因在正常菌木中不表现出来。
remmethod: re(向后) + cess(走) + ive(形容词后缀) → 向后走的 → 隐性的

en: towards the outside or away from the centre of something
ex1_en: The door opens outwards.
ex1_zh: 这门是朝外开的。
remmethod: out(外) + wards(表方向) → 向外地

zh: 油质的；虚情假意的；油腔滑调的
en: If you describe someone as unctuous, you are critical of them because they seem to be full of praise, kindness, or interest, but are obviously insincere
remmethod: unct (油) + uous → 油脂的； 油腔滑调的

ex1_en: Day and day I take pains to enquire myself my reason for doing so, in no time will I stoop so low as to beg you sympathy, though I can feel your scoff all the time.
ex1_zh: 日复一日，我不厌其详地询问我自己，我在任何时候都这样低俯恳求你同情，但我能感受到你对这一切一切嗤之以鼻。
remmethod: en+quir(问)+e→询问

en: of, relating to, like, or involving gymnastics
ex1_en: On our return from school our drawing and gymnastic masters would be ready for us.
ex1_zh: 放学回来，我们的图画和体操老师已在家里恭候多时了。
remmethod: gymn(裸体；训练) + astic(形容词后缀) → 体操的；体育的
fortuitous(偶然的) + ly(副词后缀) → 偶然地

zh: 开动（机器等）；促使，驱使；激励（人等）
en: to make a piece of machinery start to operate
ex1_en: He was actuated by violent jealousy.
ex1_zh: 强烈的忌妒心驱使着他。
remmethod: act(行动) + uate(动词后缀) → 使行动起来 → 促使
com(共同) + pact(压紧) + ion(名词后缀) → 压紧，紧束之状态

zh: 以对话体写的文章；谈话，会话
en: a conversation
ex1_en: Powell did not know why it was he had resolved to keep his own counsel as to his colloquy with Mr Smith.
ex1_zh: 鲍威尔不知道为什么决定要把他跟史密斯先生的谈话保守秘密。
remmethod: col (共同) + loqu (说) + y → 谈话， 会话

zh: 天真的；坦白的；正直的；朴实的
en: an ingenuous person is simple, trusting, and honest, especially because they have not had much experience of life
ex1_en: He seemed too ingenuous for a reporter.
ex1_zh: 他好像太天真诚实，不适合做记者。
remmethod: 来自拉丁语ingenuus， 意为“天真， 诚实”

zh: 寂寞的；悲哀的；阴沉的；忧郁的
en: very sad
ex1_en: a doleful song about lost love
ex1_zh: 一首关于逝去的爱情的哀歌
remmethod: dole(悲哀) + ful → 悲哀的

en: the system by which waste material and used water are carried away in sewers and then treated to stop it being harmful
remmethod: sewer(下水道；污水) + age(名词后缀) → 排水设备；污水

zh: 无赖；流氓；（纸牌中的）杰克
ex1_en: the knave of hearts
ex1_zh: 红桃杰克
remmethod: 流氓 (knave) 江湖飘， 哪有不带刀 (knive) → 流氓

en: a pain in your back
ex1_en: Many workers go home from their first day on the job with either a bad headache or a backache—undoubtedly the result of nervous tension.
ex1_zh: 许多员工在第一天上班的时候会带着头痛或背痛回家，这无疑就是紧张情绪造成的结果。
remmethod: back(背) + ache(痛) → 背痛

en: with beautiful language or music
ex1_en: He lyrically described the countryside around his home.
ex1_zh: 他以抒情的笔调描绘了住宅周围的乡村景致。
remmethod: lyr(抒情诗；里拉琴) + ical(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 抒情地；狂热地

en: to remove from contact with others
remmethod: se(分离) + clud(关闭) + e → 脱离， 过着封闭的生活 → 使隔离， 使孤立

zh: 偷懒的；无计谋的；无能的
ex1_en: In retrospect, I was a sad little boy and a standard-issue, shiftless, egotistical, dejected teen-ager.
ex1_zh: 回顾往事，我曾是一个悲哀的小男孩，一个无能的、任性的、沮丧的标准问题少年。
remmethod: 来自shift (移动) + less → 不移动的 → 偷懒的

en: if a liquid coagulates, or something coagulates it, it becomes thick and almost solid
ex1_en: The blood had not coagulated.
ex1_zh: 血未凝结。
remmethod: co(一起) + ag(做) + ulate → 做到一起 → 使凝结

en: to satisfy a desire or need for something such as food or sex, especially so that you feel you have had too much
ex1_en: The dinner was enough to satiate the gourmets.
ex1_zh: 这顿饭足够让美食家们吃个够。
remmethod: 来自sat (e) (厌腻) + iate (使) → 使厌腻

en: to steal something small or not very valuable
ex1_en: He filched a bottle of wine from the cellar.
ex1_zh: 他从地窖里偷了一瓶酒。
remmethod: fil (看作file， 文件) + ch → 窃取文件 → 偷窃
plaud(鼓掌) + it → 鼓掌， 喝彩

en: Bombast is trying to impress people by saying things that sound impressive but have little meaning
ex1_en: There was no bombast or conceit in his speech.
ex1_zh: 他的发言里没有浮夸或自负。
remmethod: bomb(空洞的声音； 炸弹) + ast → 像炮弹声 → 高调

en: behaving in a way that shows you think you are better than other people because you are from a higher social class or know more than they do
ex1_en: Her family seems snobbish.
ex1_zh: 她家里人好像挺势利的。
remmethod: 来自snob(n. 势利小人)

en: containing or relating to iron
ex1_en: ferrous metals
ex1_zh: 含铁[黑色]金属
remmethod: ferr(铁) + ous → 含铁的

zh: 中止，停顿；归属待定，暂搁
en: something such as a custom, rule, or system that is in abeyance is not being used at the present time
remmethod: a (看作at， 在) + bey (等待) + ance (表示名词) → 中止了， 在等待结果 → 中止

en: a soft gentle wind
ex1_en: There was silence now except for the distant sea, a slight zephyr stirring the trees.
ex1_zh: 现在，除了遥远的海浪以外，一片寂静，一阵微风摇曳着树林。
remmethod: 来自希腊神话中的西风之神Zephyros

en: the visible surface of the sun, several hundred kilometres thick
ex1_en: The photosphere is the lowest layer of the sun's atmosphere, and emits the light we see.
ex1_zh: 光球是太阳大气的最底层，我们看到的光线就是从它发出的。
remmethod: photo(光) + sphere(球) → 光球

en: waste resulting from something being spoiled
ex1_en: Nutrition education can help with some problems and may prevent improper storage or spoilage.
ex1_zh: 营养教育可以解决一些问题，并能防止不当的贮存或腐坏发生。
remmethod: 来自spoil(v. 损坏)

en: an official document giving you permission to own or do something for a period of time
ex1_en: The dealers applied for an export licence.
ex1_zh: 经销商申请了出口许可证。
remmethod: licen(允许)+se→许可证

en: to read through something that is written or printed in order to correct any mistakes in it
ex1_en: I didn't even have the chance to proofread my own report.
ex1_zh: 我甚至没有机会校对自己的报告。
remmethod: proof(验证) + read(阅读) → 一边读一边验证 → 校对

zh: 煽动性的；扰乱治安的；参与煽动的
en: A seditious act, speech, or piece of writing encourages people to fight against or oppose the government
ex1_en: He fell under suspicion for distributing seditious pamphlets.
ex1_zh: 他因分发反政府传单而受到怀疑。
remmethod: 来自sedition (n. 煽动)

zh: 驴的；愚蠢的，固执的；驴子似的
en: extremely stupid or silly
ex1_en: What an asinine remark!
ex1_zh: 多么愚蠢的话！
remmethod: as(看作ass, 驴子) + in + in + e → 笨得像驴 → 愚笨的

en: someone who trains falcons to hunt
remmethod: falcon(猎鹰) + er(表人) → 养鹰者；以鹰狩猎者

en: relating to trees, or living in trees
remmethod: arbor(树) + eal → 树木的

zh: 精华；典范；第五元素（被视为地、水、火、风以外之构成宇宙的元素）
en: a perfect example of something
ex1_en: John is the quintessence of good manners.
ex1_zh: 约翰彬彬有礼，堪称典范。
remmethod: quint (五) + essence (精华) → 组成世界的五大精华物质 → 精华

ex1_en: There is always a clamorous din when I go to visit my father.
ex1_zh: 每当我去看视父亲的的时候，总有一个声音在那里大喊大叫。
remmethod: 来自clamor (n. 喧闹)

en: unnecessarily complicated and difficult to understand
ex1_en: Maths is a mix of abstruse theory and detailed calculations.
ex1_zh: 数学既有深奥的理论，又有精密的计算。
remmethod: abs + trus(走， 推) + e → 走不进去 → 难懂的

zh: 有骑士精神的； 彬彬有礼的， 殷勤的
en: a man who is chivalrous behaves in a polite, kind, generous, and honourable way, especially towards women
ex1_en: He was handsome, upright, and chivalrous.
ex1_zh: 他英俊、正直、对女士彬彬有礼。
remmethod: chival(=caval骑马) + rous → 骑马的 → 骑士精神的

en: If you inveigh against something, you criticize it strongly
ex1_en: A lot of his writings inveigh against luxury and riches.
ex1_zh: 他的许多作品猛烈抨击了奢侈和富有。
remmethod: in(进入) + veigh(看作weigh， 重量) → 重重地骂 → 痛骂

en: to tell someone angrily that they have done something wrong
ex1_en: His mother summoned him, upbraided him, wept and prayed.
ex1_zh: 他母亲把他叫来，责骂了他。然后母亲哭着做了祷告。
remmethod: up(向上)+braid(辫子) → 被揪辫子 → 责骂

zh: 放荡的， 放纵的， 道德沦丧的
en: having an immoral way of life, for example drinking too much alcohol or having sex with many people
