ex1_en: Wright grew frustrated with American provincialism.
ex1_zh: 赖特对美国的地方偏狭观念愈发感到沮丧。
remmethod: province(省；地方) + ial(形容词后缀) + ism(特性；风尚) → 地方风尚

en: Regimentation is very strict control over the way a group of people behave or the way something is done
ex1_en: Democracy is incompatible with excessive, bureaucratic regimentation of social life.
ex1_zh: 民主与受到过度的、官僚化的管制的社会生活是不相容的。
remmethod: regiment(团；编制) + ation(名词后缀) → 管辖

zh: 努力， 尽力； 力图
en: to try very hard
ex1_en: They are endeavouring to protect trade union rights.
ex1_zh: 他们正在努力保护工会权利。
remmethod: end(尽头) + eav(看作eager， 热情) + our(我们的) → 用尽了我们的热情 → 努力， 尽力

en: using an electrical current that is controlled by light
ex1_en: Advanced imported photoelectric supervision system is used.
ex1_zh: 采用先进的进口光电眼监控系统。
remmethod: photo(光) + electr(电) + ic(形容词后缀) → 光电的

en: a long piece of music in which a large group of people sing
ex1_en: Its peaks are the symphony and the oratorio.
ex1_zh: 其顶峰为交响乐和清唱剧。
remmethod: or(说) + at + orio(表音乐类) → 配以说话的音乐 → 清唱剧

ex1_en: The food had been adulterated to increase its weight.
ex1_zh: 这种食物被掺了假以增加其重量。
remmethod: 奉承 (adulate) 话里都掺杂 (adulterate) 着谎话

zh: 拖拉的；缓慢的，不慌不忙的
en: slow in doing something
ex1_en: You might expect politicians to smooth things out when civil servants are being dilatory.
ex1_zh: 当公务员办事拖拉时，你可能期望政治家们能够把事情顺利解决。
remmethod: di + lat(搬运) + ory → 分开搬运 → 慢吞吞的

zh: 目空一切的，高傲的；傲慢的，自大的
en: behaving as if you think that other people are less important than you – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: supercilious wine waiters
ex1_zh: 傲慢的侍酒师
remmethod: super(超过) + cili(眉毛) + ous → 超过眉毛 → 目中无人的

zh: 纯正的；英币的；纯银制的
ex1_en: Ella has done some sterling work.
ex1_zh: 埃拉做了一些出色的工作。
remmethod: “斯大林”纯正的 (sterling) 思想让世人吃惊 (startling)

en: the alleged power of perceiving things beyond the natural range of the senses
ex1_en: The military initially focused on 'remote viewing', the scientific term for clairvoyance and extrasensory perception (or ESP).
ex1_zh: 军方最初致力于开发“遥视”能力，这是千里眼和超感知觉的科学术语（或称ESP）。
remmethod: clair(看作clear， 清楚) + voy(看) + ance → 看得很清楚 → 超人的洞察力

zh: 教师的, 教育学的, 教授法的
ex1_en: The Educational category groups the educational and pedagogic characteristics of the learning object.
ex1_zh: 教育（Educational）范畴包括学习对象的教育性和教育学特征。
remmethod: ped(= child 儿童) + agog(引导) + ic → 教育学的

zh: 晒黑的；有晒斑的；日炙的
ex1_en: Ground zero is The Thatch, the village pub joined, via its beer garden, to the even rowdier Billy Budds, rammed to the rafters with sunburnt revellers living the dream.
ex1_zh: Thatch酒吧，这家乡村酒馆通过自己的啤酒花园，加入到了吵闹的比利巴德的行列，晒得黝黑、活在梦中的狂欢者的喧哗声充满着整个酒吧。
remmethod: sun(太阳)+burnt(烧伤的)→被太阳灼伤的→晒黑的， 晒伤的

en: an instrument that measures and records the movement of the earth during an  earthquake
ex1_en: On the right waist have a seismograph, it tender prior to the earthquake forecast the earthquake.
ex1_zh: 在右腰上有一个地震仪，它嫩在地震前预报地震。
remmethod: seism(震动) + o + graph(写； 图) → 能描绘地震情况的(仪器) → 地震仪

zh: 迟钝的，迟缓的；不活泼的；麻痹的；[生物] 蛰伏的
en: not active because you are lazy or sleepy
ex1_en: a torpid mind
ex1_zh: 迟钝的头脑
remmethod: torp(麻木；迟钝) + id(形容词后缀) → 麻痹的；迟缓的

en: A storey of a building is one of its different levels, which is situated above or below other levels
ex1_en: A staircase leads to the upper storey .
ex1_zh: 有一段楼梯通往上面一层。
remmethod: 可与store ( n. 商店)一起记

en: the respect that you, your family, your country etc receive from other people, which makes you feel proud
ex1_en: He was showered with honours – among them an Oscar.
ex1_zh: 他获得了很多荣誉–其中包括奥斯卡奖。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 荣誉；尊敬

en: A rhythmic movement or sound is repeated at regular intervals, forming a regular pattern or beat
ex1_en: Good breathing is slow, rhythmic and deep.
ex1_zh: 良好的呼吸缓慢、有节奏并且深沉。
remmethod: rhythm(节奏) + ical(形容词后缀) → 节奏的

en: a very young bird that cannot leave its nest because it is not yet able to fly
remmethod: nest(巢) + ling(小称) → 巢中小鸟 → 雏鸟

ex1_en: He was charmed by her vivacity and high spirits.
ex1_zh: 她的活泼与兴高采烈的情绪把他迷住了。
remmethod: viv (生命) + acity → 活泼

en: the tendency to use one hand more skilfully or in preference to the other
ex1_en: An important factor that the researchers took note of was the participants' handedness.
ex1_zh: 研究人员考察的一个重要因素是参与者的用手习惯。
remmethod: hand(手) + ed(有…的) + ness(名词后缀) → 用手习惯

zh: 始终如一的， 不变的； 恒定的
en: always happening in the same way, at the same time etc
ex1_en: His invariable answer was ‘Wait and see.’
ex1_zh: 他的回答总是那句话:“等着瞧吧。”
remmethod: in(无)+var(变化)+i+able→不变的

zh: 奔放；兴高采烈；沸腾；冒泡
ex1_en: She burst into the room with her usual ebullience.
ex1_zh: 她像往常一样兴高采烈地冲进了房间。
remmethod: e + bull(公牛) + ience → 像公牛一样出来 → 兴高采烈

en: a musical instrument like a small  trumpet
remmethod: corn(角) + et(指小) → 小角 → 短号；圆锥形纸袋

ex1_en: Newspapers have been fulsome in their praise of the former president.
ex1_zh: 报界对前任总统的赞扬过于恭维了。
remmethod: ful(l)(满) + some(带有…的) → 充足的

zh: 吵闹的，喧嚣的；难驾驭的
en: If you say that someone is obstreperous, you think that they are noisy and difficult to control
ex1_en: You know I have no intention of being awkward and obstreperous.
ex1_zh: 你知道我无意存心作对。
remmethod: ob + streper (喧闹) + ous → 喧嚣的

ex1_en: The stability of any foam ultimately relies on the hindrance of bubble coalescence.
ex1_zh: 任何泡沫的稳定性归根到底都依赖于阻止泡泡们的合并。
remmethod: 来自coalesce (v. 联合， 合并)

zh: 鸟笼；鸟笼状物；信号灯；宿舍
en: A birdcage is a cage in which birds are kept
remmethod: bird(鸟) + cage(笼) → 鸟笼

ex1_en: If necessary, we can use aluminium instead of steel.
ex1_zh: 如果必要，我们可用铝代钢。
remmethod: 金属铝的化学符号是Al； 参考： 铁iron； 金gold； 银silver； 铅lead； 锡tin； 铜copper

en: to give a specific name to; designate
ex1_en: So after that, I decided to use this word to denominate my band.
ex1_zh: 因此在那之后我决定用这个词命名乐队。
remmethod: de + nomin (名字) + ate (表示动词) → 给名字 → 命名

en: the state of being very poor
ex1_en: He died in penury in 1644.
ex1_zh: 1644年他穷困潦倒而死。
remmethod: pen (笔) + ury → 靠笔生活的人一般很贫困 → 贫困

en: almost starting to sleep
ex1_en: He lay quiet, somnolent after the day’s exertions.
ex1_zh: 他静静地躺着，劳累了一天之后感到十分困倦。
remmethod: somn(睡) ＋ olent → 想睡的

en: someone whose work needs physical strength, for example building work
ex1_en: a farm labourer
ex1_zh: 农场工人
remmethod: labour(劳动) + er(表人) → 劳动者；劳工

ex1_en: “Please don’t gibe me,” Lydia said.
ex1_zh: “请不要嘲笑我，”利迪娅说。
remmethod: 也写作jibe， 但jibe还有另一个意思“与…一致”， 是GRE常考的释义
prude(过分规矩的人) + ish(形容词后缀) → 过分规矩的 → 装正经的

en: very noisy, because a lot of people are laughing or shouting
ex1_en: an uproarious party
ex1_zh: 喧闹的聚会
remmethod: up (上) + roar (吼叫) + ious → 楼上半夜有人吼叫， 引起人们骚动 → 骚动的

en: to say that something is not true, or to disagree with someone
ex1_en: No one dared to gainsay him.
ex1_zh: 没有人敢反驳他。
remmethod: gain(=against反) + say(说) → 反着说 → 否认

en: to remove disease,  bacteria  , insects etc from somewhere using chemicals, smoke, or gas
ex1_en: Also good for seed's long-term preservation. 7. There is a top dosage limit for AITC to fumigate different crop seeds.
ex1_zh: 辣根精油活性成分AITC对不同的作物种子熏蒸时，其使用浓度有一定的限制。
remmethod: fum(烟) + ig(开动) + ate → 烟熏

en: the part of a  battery  that collects  electrons  , often a wire or piece of metal with the sign (+)
ex1_en: A red wire is often attached to the anode.
ex1_zh: 红色电线通常与阳极相联。
remmethod: an(向上；正) + ode(路；电极) → 阳极；正极

ex1_en: She would preside over the innocent repasts of the young heir, with ineffable satisfaction, almost with an air of joint proprietorship with Richards in the entertainment.
ex1_zh: 她会怀着难以形容的满意心情主持这位年轻继承人的天真的用餐，那副神态就几乎像在这个款待中她跟理查兹共同享有所有权似的。
remmethod: proprietor(所有者) + ship(身份；状态) → 所有权

en: a message sent or received by telex
ex1_en: He sent a telex to the British High Commission in Delhi.
ex1_zh: 他给德里的英国高级专员公署发了份电传。
remmethod: tele(远) + x(缩写；交换) → 远距离交换 → 用户电报；电传

en: a long flat  worm  that lives in the  bowels  of humans and other animals and can make them ill
ex1_en: The stomach contained a fish hook, bits of digested fish skull and some tapeworm.
ex1_zh: 胃里面有个钓鱼钩，少量消化之后残留的鱼骸和一些绦虫。
remmethod: tape(带子) + worm(虫) → 绦虫

en: to pretend to like an important person and do things for them, so that they will help you – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: Hypocrite and toady and inebriate!
ex1_zh: 伪君子谄媚者和醉鬼。
remmethod: 今天(today)遇见一个马屁精(toady)

en: to strongly disapprove of or criticize something
ex1_en: He deprecated the low quality of entrants to the profession.
ex1_zh: 他抨击了行业中的滥竽充数。
remmethod: de(去除) + prec(=preci 价值) + ate → 去掉价值 → 藐视

en: to deprive of strength or vitality; weaken physically or mentally; debilitate
ex1_en: The hot sun enervated her to the point of collapse.
ex1_zh: 热辣辣的太阳把她晒得快要晕过去了。
remmethod: e + nerv(力量； 神经) + ate → 力量出去 → 使无力

zh: 清爽的；气候有益健康的
ex1_en: the less salubrious area near the docks
ex1_zh: 码头附近环境较差的地区
remmethod: sal(健康) + ubrious → 健康的 → 有益健康的

ex1_en: The taxi driver, a phlegmatic man in middle age, showed no surprise at this request.
ex1_zh: 出租车司机是个冷静的中年人，对这一要求毫不惊讶。
remmethod: 来自phlegm(痰)， 西方人认为痰多的人不易动感情

zh: 侵略主义；沙文主义；武力外交政策
en: a strong belief that your own country is better than others – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: a mood of warlike jingoism
ex1_zh: 好战的沙文主义情绪
remmethod: 来自jingo(n. 沙文主义者)

en: relating to ordinary people and what they like, rather than to people from a high social class – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: a man with plebeian tastes
ex1_zh: 趣味庸俗的男人
remmethod: 来自plebe (古罗马平民) + ian → 平民的

en: a type of potassium used especially in farming to make the soil better
remmethod: pot(锅) + ash(灰) → 锅灰 → 碳酸钾,苛性钾

en: someone whose job is to care for cattle
ex1_en: A cowhand herds cattle past a petroleum processing plant.
ex1_zh: 一个牧牛人赶着一群牛在一家石油加工厂附近经过。
remmethod: cow(牛) + hand(人手) → 牧牛工

en: believing or feeling something too strongly
ex1_en: And one more: Migrating animals maintain a fervid attentiveness to the greater mission, which keeps them undistracted by temptations and undeterred by challenges that would turn other animals aside.
ex1_zh: 还有一点：迁徙动物热切关注更大的使命，因而不为诱惑所动，不受吓退其它动物的挑战所阻。
remmethod: ferv(沸腾) + id → 炽热的； 热情的
fulmin(闪电， 雷声) + ate → 像雷电一样 → 严厉谴责

en: not truthful
ex1_en: mendacious propaganda
ex1_zh: 虚假的宣传
remmethod: mend(修改) + acious → 过度修改 → 不真实的

zh: 最坏， 最差， 最糟
en: worse than anything or anyone else
ex1_en: This is the worst recession for fifty years.
ex1_zh: 这是50年来最严重的一次经济衰退。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 最坏的；最差的

zh: 矾土，[矿物] 铁铝氧石；[矿物] 铝土矿
en: a soft substance that  aluminium  is obtained from
ex1_en: The plant makes alumina -- a derivative of the metal ore bauxite that is used to make aluminum.
ex1_zh: 这家工厂生产矾土。 矾土是金属矿石铝土矿的衍生品，用来制造金属铝。
remmethod: baux(地名Les Baux) + ite(矿物) → 矾土；铁铝氧石

en: when someone says things like this
ex1_en: He was the victim of calumny.
ex1_zh: 他曾是诽谤的受害者。
remmethod: calumn(=beguile欺诈) + y → 欺诈性的话 → 诽谤

en: an honourable action or activity deserves respect and admiration
ex1_en: My father didn’t think acting was an honorable profession.
ex1_zh: 我父亲认为当演员不是受人尊敬的职业。
remmethod: 来自honour(n. 敬意； 光荣)

ex1_en: Google Earth has given scientists a way to scout terrain and cheaply reconnoiter habitats likely to produce new finds.
ex1_zh: 谷歌地球（Google Earth）使科学家能够廉价地侦察地形，探索那些有可能出现新物种的栖息地。
remmethod: re + connoiter(观察， 源自法语) → 侦察， 勘察

en: a small animal like a monkey, with long arms and no tail, that lives in trees in Asia
ex1_en: Beverly: Why else would you grow a pancreas in a teenaged gibbon?
ex1_zh: 要不然在年轻长臂猿体内培育人类胰腺干什么?
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 长臂猿

en: cognate words or languages have the same origin
ex1_en: This one branch is the Liberty of Thought: from which it is impossible to separate the cognate liberty of speaking and of writing.
ex1_zh: 这条支线就是思想的自由。 把同源的言语的自由与写作的自由和思想的自由分开是不可能的。
remmethod: cogn (认识) + ate → 认识的 → 同类的

en: existing or happening at the same place or time
ex1_en: Their aims are coincident with ours.
ex1_zh: 他们的目标和我们的一致。
remmethod: co(共同) + in(在…上) + cid(落) + ent(形容词后缀) → 共同落在…上 → 一致的

en: to treat a wound or a growth on your body by burning it with hot metal, a  laser  , or a chemical
ex1_en: He cauterized the wound with a piece of red-hot iron.
ex1_zh: 他用一块烧红的烙铁来给伤口进行烧灼治疗。
remmethod: cauter(烧灼) + ize(动词后缀) → 烧灼；腐蚀；使麻木

en: A statement that is conjectural is based on information that is not certain or complete
ex1_en: There is something undeniably conjectural about such claims.
ex1_zh: 此类声明中绝对有推测的成分。
remmethod: con(共同) + ject(投；推测) + ur(e)(名词后缀) + al(形容词后缀) → 推测的

zh: 无畏的；勇敢的；不屈不挠的
en: confident and not easily frightened
ex1_en: dauntless optimism
ex1_zh: 无所畏惧的乐观
remmethod: 来自daunt (沮丧) + less (没有) → 没有能让人沮丧的事情 → 不屈不挠的
fruit(果实) + ful(充满) + ness(名词后缀) → 多产；肥沃

ex1_en: An alternative to monetary damages is an injunction prohibiting publication of the allegedly libelous material.
ex1_zh: 除经济赔偿之外的另一种做法是颁布禁令，禁止发表被指称诽谤的材料。
remmethod: libel(诽谤) + ous(形容词后缀) → 诽谤的

zh: 烹饪法，美食法；享乐主义
en: the art and science of cooking and eating good food
ex1_en: Burgundy has always been considered a major centre of gastronomy.
ex1_zh: 勃艮第常被看作主要的美食中心。
remmethod: gastr (胃， 引申为食物) + onom (名字) + y → 熟知各种食物的名字 → 美食法

ex1_en: In Lavengro (or is it Romany Rye?) there is an impossible character, a victim of insomnia, who finds that a volume of Wordsworth's poems is the only sure soporific; but that was Borrow s malice.
ex1_zh: 在《拉文格罗》（或者是《吉卜赛男人》）一书中有一个无可救药的人，患有失眠症，他发现华尔华斯的一卷诗集是惟一有效的催眠剂，但那只不过是伯罗的恶作剧而已。
remmethod: sopor(昏睡) + ific → 催眠的

en: small things that you wear for decoration, such as rings or necklaces
ex1_en: She wears a lot of gold jewelry.
ex1_zh: 她戴了许多金首饰。
remmethod: jewel(珠宝) + ery(总称) → [总称]珠宝

en: willing to take risks
remmethod: venture(冒险) + some(充满…的) → 敢于冒险的

en: someone who is always talking too proudly about what they own or have done
ex1_en: Her father was an old unmarried professor of mathematics, a brutal man and a braggart, who went out to give lessons in spite of his age.
ex1_zh: 她的父亲是个性情粗暴、爱吹牛的老数学教师，从没正式结过婚，虽然上了年纪，却还靠替人补课度日。
remmethod: brag (吹牛) + gart → 吹牛者

en: a piece of metal or other material that is in the process of being worked on or made or has actually been cut or shaped by a hand tool or machine
ex1_en: The workpiece is already on the lathe.
ex1_zh: 工件已经上了车床。
remmethod: work(工作) + piece(件) → 工（作）件

zh: 冒称；霸占；没来由地将…归属于
en: to claim that you have a particular right, position etc, without having the legal right to it
remmethod: 狐假虎威： 狐狸冒称 (arrogate) 有老虎撑腰变得傲慢 (arrogant) 无理 → 冒称

zh: 倒退的；退化的；次序颠倒的
en: involving a return to an earlier and worse situation
ex1_en: The closure of the factories is seen as a retrograde step .
ex1_zh: 工厂的关闭被认为是一个退步。
remmethod: retro (向后) + grade (步伐； 走) → 向后走 → 倒退的

zh: 好斗的；野蛮的；言词刻毒的
en: If you say that someone is truculent, you mean that they are bad-tempered and aggressive
ex1_en: a truculent attitude
ex1_zh: 凶狠的态度
remmethod: truc(凶猛) + ulent → 残暴的， 凶狠的

ex1_en: He suffers a thousandfold more from his so-called freedom than from his imprisonment in natural existence.

ex1_zh: 匆忙中人们抛下了房子，任何东西都不可以带走。在空无一人的地方看着这些家具、生活用品和照片，感觉是如此诡异。
remmethod: house(家) + wares(器皿) → 家用器皿

en: any American ericaceous shrub of the genus Gaylussacia, having edible dark blue berries with large seeds
ex1_en: Groves of stunted red spruce, huckleberry, blueberry, mountain laurel, mountain holly, speckled alder, and cranberry bogs, show combinations of colors throughout the year.
ex1_zh: 发育不良云杉的小树林、黑果木、蓝莓、山月桂、山冬青，斑点桤木和种越橘的沼泽地，显示着全年各种颜色的组合。
remmethod: huckle(越橘类植物) + berry(浆果) → 越橘类
huge(巨大) + ly(副词后缀) → 巨大地；非常地

ex1_en: In terms of career advice, the most obvious message is: Focus on jobs and areas of expertise that appear to require humanlike general intelligence.
ex1_zh: 从职业建议上将，最明显的一点是：关注与那些需要人类总体智能的工作或专业领域。
remmethod: human(人) + like(像…的) → 似人类的

ex1_en: I now ask you to recognize the Christ within, and to return to me my humanness.
ex1_zh: 现在我要求你们发现自己的内在基督，把我的人性还给我。
remmethod: human(人) + ness(名词后缀) → 人性

en: insincere or dishonest words or behaviour
ex1_en: He dismissed the prime minister’s comments as ‘pure humbug’.
ex1_zh: 他对首相的评论不屑一顾，认为是“纯粹的假道学”。
remmethod: hum (嗡嗡声) + bug (小虫) → 小虫嗡嗡叫， 欺骗少不了 → 欺骗

ex1_en: He answered humorously, "The UFO has diplomatic immunity.
ex1_zh: 他幽默地回答说："UFO有外交豁免权。"
remmethod: humor(幽默) + ous(形容词) + ly(副词) → 幽默地

en: the ability or tendency to think that things are funny, or funny things you say that show you have this ability
ex1_en: his humour and charm
ex1_zh: 他的幽默感和魅力
remmethod: “幽默”

ex1_en: The eminent writers duly propose a huge (nay, hundredfold) boost in funding to help the poor cope with a shifting climate—through drought-resistant crops, for example.
ex1_zh: 许多著名的作家适时地提出了一个大量（不仅如此，百倍的）增加资金帮助那些穷人应对一个正在转变的气候——例如，通过抗旱作物。
remmethod: hundred(百) + fold(倍) → 百倍的
hur(飓风；拟声/缩写) → 飓风

en: if something, especially something big or heavy, hurtles somewhere, it moves or falls very fast
ex1_en: All of a sudden, a car came hurtling round the corner.
ex1_zh: 突然，一辆汽车从拐角处冲了出来。
remmethod: 和turtle(n. 海龟)一起记

zh: [希神]九头怪蛇, 难以根除之祸害, [动]水螅
en: a snake in ancient Greek stories with many heads that grow again when they are cut off
remmethod: hydr(水) + a → 水螅；九头怪蛇；难以根除之祸害

ex1_en: The team believes one of the most important factors is hydration - the way skin collects and retains moisture.
ex1_zh: 科研人员称，其中最重要的因素是水合，指皮肤吸收水分、保持湿度的过程。
remmethod: hydr(水) + ation(名词后缀) → 水合作用

en: of or concerned with the mechanical properties of fluids
ex1_en: A second type of thermal escape is far more dramatic. This form of thermal escape is called hydrodynamic escape or, more evocatively, the planetary wind.
ex1_zh: 热逸过程的第二种情形更为奇特，可称为流体力学逃逸（hydrodynamic escape），用通俗一些的话说，叫做“行星风”（以便和“太阳风”呼应）。
remmethod: hydro(水) + dynam(力) + ic(形容词后缀) → 水力的

en: using water power to produce electricity
ex1_en: a huge hydroelectric power station
ex1_zh: 大型水力发电站
remmethod: hydro(水) + electr(电) + ic(形容词后缀) → 水与电的 → 水力电气的

zh: 水道测量数的,水道学的
remmethod: hydro(水) + graph(写；记录) + ic(形容词后缀) → 记录水体的 → 水道学的

ex1_en: While evaporation from the oceans is the primary vehicle for driving the surface-to-atmosphere portion of the hydrologic cycle, transpiration is also significant.
ex1_zh: 海洋的蒸发作用是水文循环中的主要方式，它使得水从地球表面进入大气层中，蒸腾作用也具有举足轻重的地位。
remmethod: hydro(水) + log(学；论) + ic(形容词后缀) → 水文的

ex1_en: The theme addresses the role of forests and trees outside forests to help moderate soil, hydrological and aquatic systems.
ex1_zh: 本主题处理森林及森林外树木帮助调节土壤、水文以及水生系统的作用。
remmethod: hydro(水) + log(学科) + ical(形容词后缀) → 水文学的

ex1_en: And for those who prefer a healthier diet there is also a hydroponic greenhouse where fresh vegetables will grow all year round.
ex1_zh: 还为那些注意健康饮食者建造了温室，温室内熟菜用溶液培养，新鲜绿色食品一年四季络绎不绝。
remmethod: hydro(水) + pon(放) + ic → 放置在水中让其生长的 → 溶液培养的
hydro(水) + pon(放置) + ically(副词后缀) → 水耕法地

en: hydroelectric power
ex1_en: If we do it ourselves, only cheap energy from hydropower will do.
ex1_zh: 如果靠自力更生，只有靠水电站带来的廉价能源了。
remmethod: hydro(水) + power(力；能量) → 水力发出的电力

en: the watery part of the earth's surface, including oceans, lakes, water vapour in the atmosphere, etc
ex1_en: Geosphere, hydrosphere and atmosphere are fluids in motion; their main difference is their viscosity.
ex1_zh: 地圈，水圈和大气是流体；他们的主要差别是他们的黏性。
remmethod: hydro(水) + sphere(球；圈) → 水圈；水气

ex1_en: Banpo antimony deposit is a typical fracture - controlling and hydrothermal fluid filling deposit.
ex1_zh: 半坡锑矿床是典型的断裂控矿，热液充填型矿床。
remmethod: hydro(水) + therm(热) + al → 热液的

en: a chemical  compound  that contains an oxygen atom combined with a  hydrogen  atom
ex1_en: Treated with methanol and potassium hydroxide, also known as lye, the vegetable oil molecules break down.
ex1_zh: 植物油分子经过甲醇和钾的氢氧化物、也被称作灰汁的处理后就被分解。
remmethod: hydr(水) + ox(氧) + ide(化合物后缀) → 氢氧化物

ex1_en: Manufacturing the screws out of the hydroxyapatite composite also simplifies production.
ex1_zh: 制造羟基磷灰石复合螺钉可以简化生产。
remmethod: hydr(水) + oxy(氧) + apatite(磷灰石) → 羟磷灰石

zh: 希克索斯王朝(古埃及王朝之一)
en: a member of a nomadic Asian people, probably Semites, who controlled Egypt from 1720 bc until 1560 bc
remmethod: hyksos(自身词根) → 希克索斯王朝

en: extremely excited or nervous about something
ex1_en: No, don’t give Luke any candy - it’ll make him hyper.
ex1_zh: 不，别给卢克糖果，不然他会起劲折腾的。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 亢奋的,高度紧张的

en: too eager to criticize other people and things, especially about small details
ex1_en: He's as big a geek as Zuckerberg, but of a different type: the hypercritical, even sometimes nasty type.
ex1_zh: 他与扎克伯格一样，是个超级极客，只不过是另一种类型的：他吹毛求疵，有时甚至令人讨厌。
remmethod: hyper (过分地) + crit (判断) + ical (…的) → 过分地讲求判断 → 吹毛求疵的

en: a way of writing computer documents that makes it possible to move from one document to another by  clicking  on words or pictures, especially on the Internet
remmethod: hyper(高于) + text(文本) → 超文本

en: any of the filaments that constitute the body (mycelium) of a fungus
ex1_en: The state in certain fungi in which each compartment of a hypha contains two nuclei, each derived from a different parent.
ex1_zh: 双核某种真菌中的状态，在这种真菌中，每个菌丝体都含有两个核，而每个核都是从不同的母体上衍生的。
remmethod: hypha(自身词根) → 菌丝

en: The hypothalamus is the part of the brain that controls functions such as hunger and thirst
ex1_en: The stress response is controlled by the hypothalamus.
ex1_zh: 反应激烈是由丘脑下部控制的。
remmethod: hypo(下) + thalam(丘脑) + us(名词后缀) → 下丘脑

en: a wild goat that lives in the mountains of Europe, Asia, and North Africa
ex1_en: Other common forms of synecdoche include two concentric circles or triangles (used as eyes in horse and bison paintings), ibex horns and the hump of a mammoth.
ex1_zh: 其他普通的提喻形式包括两个同心圆或者三角形（在壁画上马和犀牛的眼睛里也有使用），野生山羊的羊角和长毛象弓起的背部。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 野生山羊
ice(冰) + box(箱) → 冰柜；冷藏库
icon(肖像) + o + graphy(画法) → 肖像

zh: 空想家，理想主义者；唯心主义者
en: someone who tries to live according to high standards or principles, especially in a way that is not practical or possible
ex1_en: This is a heated debate which involves materialist as opposed to idealist views.
ex1_zh: 这是一场唯物主义与唯心主义的大论战。
remmethod: ideal(理想) + ist(表人) → 追求理想的人 → 理想主义者

zh: 理想主义的, 空想的
en: believing that you should live according to high standards and principles, even if they cannot really be achieved, or showing this belief
ex1_en: idealistic young doctors
ex1_zh: 充满理想主义的年轻医生
remmethod: ideal(理想) + ist(表人) + ic(形容词后缀) → 理想主义的

zh: 理想化, 理想化的事物
en: the representation of something as ideal
ex1_en: Others — cosmology, for example — make hypotheses that are more remote from everyday causes, and involve a high level of mathematical abstraction and idealization.
ex1_zh: 另外一些——比如说宇宙学——则对远离日常生活的一些事情做出假设，然后通过很高级的数学技巧加以抽象和理想化。
remmethod: ideal(理想) + iz(e)(使成) + ation(名词后缀) → 理想化

en: to imagine or represent something or someone as being perfect or better than they really are
ex1_en: Society continues to idealize the two-parent family.
ex1_zh: 社会依然把双亲家庭视为理想家庭。
remmethod: 来自ideal(n. 理想 a. 理想的)
ideo(观念；思想) + log(学科；词) + ical(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 意识形态上地

en: designating automatic muscular movements stimulated by ideas, as in absent-minded acts
remmethod: ideo(观念) + motor(运动) → 观念运动的

zh: 偶像崇拜；盲目崇拜；邪神崇拜
en: the practice of worshipping idols
ex1_en: Their affection for her soon increased almost to idolatry.
ex1_zh: 他们对她的喜爱几乎发展成了盲目崇拜。
remmethod: idol (偶像) + a + try (尝试) → 尝试将其作为偶像 → 偶像崇拜

en: Igloos are dome-shaped houses built from blocks of snow by the Inuit people
ex1_en: Defining the town center of Râmnicu Vâlcea is a towering shopping mall that looks like a giant glass igloo.
ex1_zh: 沃尔恰市中心的地标性建筑是一座高耸的购物商场，它看上去就像是一座巨型的玻璃圆顶建筑。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 圆顶建筑

en: the electrical part of a vehicle’s engine that makes it start working
ex1_en: The device automatically disconnects the ignition.
ex1_zh: 那个装置自动断开了点火器。
remmethod: ignit(火) + ion(名词后缀) → 点火；着火

zh: 作为例证的； 用做说明的； 解释性的
en: helping to explain the meaning of something
ex1_en: graphics and other illustrative material
ex1_zh: 图表和其他图解材料
remmethod: il(向内) + lus(光) + trative → 向心灵投入光的 → 解释性的

en: someone who draws pictures, especially for books
ex1_en: Called up for military service, Mr. Marokvia spent the war as an illustrator for the Wehrmacht, applying brush and pencil in Ukraine, Italy, Finland and Yugoslavia.
ex1_zh: 玛洛克维亚先生被征召入伍，他作为一名德国国防军的插图画家，在乌克兰、意大利、芬兰和南斯拉夫留下了自己的墨迹。
remmethod: illustr(照亮；说明) + ator(表人) → 插图画家；说明者

ex1_en: Much subsequent poetry in england was influenced by imagist lord and practice .
ex1_zh: 后来的英国诗歌中有许多诗受到了意象主义的箴言和实践的影响。
remmethod: imag(e)(意象) + ist(表人/流派) → 意象派者(的)

en: An imitator is someone who copies what someone else does, or copies the way they speak or behave
ex1_en: He doesn't take chances; that's why he's survived and most of his imitators haven't.
ex1_zh: 他不去碰运气；这就是为什么他得以幸存下来，而他的大部分仿效者却没有。
remmethod: imit(模仿) + ator(表人) → 模仿者

zh: 不成熟的, 未完全发展的
en: someone who is immature behaves or thinks in a way that is typical of someone much younger – used to show disapproval
ex1_en: He forgave his son’s immature behaviour.
ex1_zh: 他原谅了儿子的幼稚行为。
remmethod: im(不) + mature(成熟的) → 未成熟的

en: Immaturity is the state of being not yet completely grown or fully developed
ex1_en: Photographs of the boy showed his physical immaturity.
ex1_zh: 该男孩的那些照片显示了他生理上的不成熟。
remmethod: im(不) + matur(成熟) + ity(名词后缀) → 不成熟

en: used to emphasize that something is too big or too extreme to be measured
ex1_en: The refugee problem has now reached immeasurable proportions.
ex1_zh: 难民问题现在已经到了无法估量的程度。
remmethod: im(不) + meas(测量) + ur(e)(名词后缀) + able(可…的) → 无法估量的

zh: 无法计量地, 无限地
en: You use immeasurably to emphasize the degree or extent of a process or quality
ex1_en: They have improved immeasurably since their arrival.
ex1_zh: 从他们抵达以来，他们已极大程度地改进了。
remmethod: im(不) + measur(测量) + ably(可…地) → 无法计量地

en: very much
ex1_en: Champagne wines became immensely popular in the 18th century.
ex1_zh: 香槟酒在18世纪十分流行。
remmethod: im(不；入) + mens(测量) + e + ly(副词后缀) → 无法测量地 → 非常，极大地

en: the fact of being completely involved in something you are doing
remmethod: im(进入) + mers(沉) + ion(名词后缀) → 沉入 → 沉浸
immers(e)(沉浸) + ive(形容词后缀) → 沉浸的，身临其境的

zh: 无节制的，过度的；不适中的
en: not within reasonable and sensible limits
ex1_en: immoderate drinking
ex1_zh: 酗酒
remmethod: im (不) + moderate (适中的) → 无节制的

zh: 不道德的；邪恶的；淫荡的
en: morally wrong
ex1_en: Deliberately making people suffer is immoral.
ex1_zh: 故意使人吃苦头是不道德的。
remmethod: im (不) + moral (道德的) → 不道德的

en: never changing or impossible to change
ex1_en: This decision should not be seen as immutable.
ex1_zh: 不该把这个决定看成是不可改变的。
remmethod: im(不) + mut(变化) + able(能…的) → 不可改变的， 永恒不变的

en: (esp of something threatening) to be about to happen; be imminent
ex1_en: This very recklessness makes me feel that these costly operations may be only the prelude to far larger events which impend on land.
ex1_zh: 这种孤注一掷的作法，使我感到这些代价重大的战役，也许正是陆上即将发生。
remmethod: im ＋ pend(悬挂) → 事情挂在眼前 → 即将发生

zh: 顽固的人；不知悔改的人
ex1_en: Endless, of the impenitent and unbelieving.
ex1_zh: 无止境的，对不知悔改的和不信。
remmethod: im(不) + penitent(悔过的) → 死不悔改的 → 不知悔悟的

en: not completely correct or perfect
ex1_en: the imperfect world we live in
ex1_zh: 我们生活于其中的不完美的世界
remmethod: im(不) + per(完全) + fect(做) → 未做完全 → 有缺点的

ex1_en: So why then do we reject the impermanence of the ever-changing universe when it comes to our own lives?
ex1_zh: 所以，为什么我们要拒绝这千变万化的宇宙中的无常，当它来到我们身边时？
remmethod: im(不) + perman(持久) + ence(名词后缀) → 不持久 → 暂时；无常
im(不) + per(贯穿) + man(停留) + ency(名词后缀) → 不停留 → 非永久性

ex1_en: They do, however, greatly affect the implementation of those patterns.
ex1_zh: 然而，它们的确对那些模式的 实现影响很大。
remmethod: 来自implement(v. 实施； 实现)
im(在内) + plic(折叠) + it + ly(副词后缀) → 折叠在内地 → 暗示地；含蓄地

en: the act of bringing something new or different to a place where it did not previously exist, or something that arrives in this way
ex1_en: We should stop the importation of these birds which are sold as commodities and endure lives of boredom in cages.
ex1_zh: 这种作为商品出售的鸟被关在笼子里忍耐着无聊的生活，我们应当停止它的进口。
remmethod: im(入) + port(运) + ation(名词后缀) → 运入 → 进口

en: a person, company, or country that buys goods from other countries so they can be sold in their own country
ex1_en: Japan is the biggest importer of U.S. beef.
ex1_zh: 日本是美国牛肉的最大进口国。
remmethod: im(入) + port(运；载) + er(表人) → 输入者；进口商

en: continuously asking for things in an annoying or unreasonable way
ex1_en: importunate demands
ex1_zh: 无理的要求
remmethod: important → 因为十分重要， 所以一再要求 → 不断要求的
im(使…) ＋ pos(放置) ＋ ition → 强行放置 → 强加

zh: 无力的；无效的；虚弱的；阳萎的
en: unable to take effective action because you do not have enough power, strength, or control
ex1_en: Emergency services seem impotent in the face of such a disaster.
ex1_zh: 面对这种灾难，应急服务机构似乎无能为力。
remmethod: im (不) + potent (有力的) → 无力的

en: not sensible or possible for practical reasons
ex1_en: The road toll scheme was dismissed as impractical.
ex1_zh: 公路收费计划由于不切实际而遭到否定。
remmethod: im(不) + practic(实践) + al(形容词后缀) → 不切实际的

zh: 使怀孕, 使受精 a怀孕的, 充满的
en: to make a woman or female animal pregnant
ex1_en: Undercover officers found drug-making equipment used to impregnate paper with LSD.
ex1_zh: 卧底警官发现了用于使迷幻药渗入纸张的毒品制造设备。
remmethod: im(入；使) + pregn(怀孕) + ate(使动) → 使怀孕；使充满

ex1_en: impressionist painters
ex1_zh: 印象派画家
remmethod: impress(印；留下印象) + ion(名词后缀) + ist(表人) → 印象主义者

zh: 印象派的,给人深刻印象的
en: An impressionistic work of art or piece of writing shows the artist's or writer's impressions of something rather than giving clear details
ex1_en: His paintings had become more impressionistic as his eyesight dimmed.
ex1_zh: 随着他的视力减弱，他的画变得越来越富有印象派风格。
remmethod: impression(印象) + ist(表人/流派) + ic(形容词后缀) → 印象派的

zh: 令人难忘地,  令人印象深刻地
remmethod: im(入) + press(压) + ive(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 压入印象 → 令人印象深刻地

ex1_en: It was the improvisation of the ebullition.
ex1_zh: 它是激情迸发的即兴创作。 哟！
remmethod: im(不) + pro(前) + vis(看) + ation(名词) → 不预先看 → 即席创作

en: If you refer to someone's inaction, you disapprove of the fact that they are doing nothing
ex1_en: He is bitter about the inaction of the other political parties.
ex1_zh: 他为其他政党的不作为感到愤愤不平。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 不作为

en: not doing anything, not working, or not moving
ex1_en: The brain cells are inactive during sleep.
ex1_zh: 在睡觉时脑细胞不活跃。
remmethod: in(不) + act(行动) + ive(表形容词) → 不行动的 → 不活跃的，停滞的

en: the state of not doing anything, not moving, or not working
ex1_en: Don’t suddenly take up violent exercise after years of inactivity.
ex1_zh: 多年没锻炼不要突然进行剧烈运动。
remmethod: in(不) + act(行动) + ivity(名词后缀) → 不活动；迟钝

en: a feeling that you are not as good, clever, skilled etc as other people
ex1_en: Unemployment can cause feelings of inadequacy and low self-esteem.
ex1_zh: 失业会使人缺乏自信，产生自卑感。
remmethod: in(不) + ad(向) + equ(相等) + acy(名词后缀) → 不足
in(不) + ad(向) + equ(相等) + ate(动/形) + ly(副) → 不相等地 → 不够地；不够好

zh: 疏忽的；不注意的（副词inadvertently）；无意中做的
en: An inadvertent action is one that you do without realizing what you are doing
ex1_en: The government has said it was an inadvertent error.
ex1_zh: 政府声称那是无意的过失。
remmethod: 与inattentive (不注意的) 形近， 一起记

ex1_en: Attempting to drown herself in inanity, she marries Peter Keating, only to leave him for newspaper tycoon Gail Wynand, publisher of the Banner, where Toohey's column appears.
ex1_zh: 为了把自己淹没在空虚之中，她先嫁给了彼特·基廷，然后仅仅是为了离开他而选择了报业大亨盖尔·威纳德。 威纳德是巴纳出版社的老板，也就是图希的专栏出现的地方。
remmethod: in(无) + an(气息) + ity(名词) → 无气息 → 空虚；愚蠢

zh: 不可估量的，无法计算的
en: too great to be calculated
ex1_en: Her contribution to our work is incalculable.
ex1_zh: 她对我们工作的贡献极大。
remmethod: in(不) + calcul(计算) + able(可…的) → 不可估量的，无法计算的

en: If something incapacitates you, it weakens you in some way, so that you cannot do certain things
ex1_en: A serious fall incapacitated the 68-year-old congressman.
ex1_zh: 一次严重跌伤使这位68岁的国会议员丧失了行动能力。
remmethod: in(无) + capac(=cap握住) + it + ate(使…) → 使无力握住 → 使无资格； 使失去能力

ex1_en: And it can be frustrating to watch a beloved pet scratch incessantly—especially after you’ve tried everything to get rid of the pests.
ex1_zh: 看着自己心爱的宠物不停地挠啊挠相当令人烦躁——尤其是在你费尽心思除去那些害虫的时候。
remmethod: in(不) + cess(停止) + ant(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 不间断地

ex1_en: The adorable inchworm is really the caterpillar of the geometer moth.
ex1_zh: 可爱的尺蠖就是尺蠖毛虫。
remmethod: inch(英寸) + worm(虫) → 尺蠖

en: happening or existing in connection with something else that is more important
ex1_en: Increased motivation is more than an incidental benefit of reward schemes.
ex1_zh: 积极性提高不仅仅是奖励计划附带的益处。
remmethod: incident(事件；附带) + al(形容词后缀) → 附带的

zh: 险恶的；气候严酷的；狂风暴雨的
en: inclement weather is unpleasantly cold, wet etc
ex1_en: Confrontation between the two sides ensued for 3 hours as a result, eventually with the Vietnamese Navy retreating due to inclement weather.
ex1_zh: 双方的对抗持续了3小时，最终越南海军由于险恶的天气而撤退。
remmethod: in(不) + clement(仁慈的) → 不仁慈的 → 严酷的； 严厉的

zh: 改名的；微行的；隐姓埋名的
en: Someone who is incognito is using a false name or wearing a disguise, in order not to be recognized or identified
ex1_en: Hotel inspectors have to travel incognito.
ex1_zh: 酒店检查员巡查时必须隐瞒真实身份。
remmethod: in(不) + cognit(知道) + o → 不让人知道身份地 → 隐名埋姓地；化名地

en: insufficiently spacious; cramped
ex1_en: I awoke with stiff and cramped muscles from having slept long on the incommodious seat of a day coach.
ex1_zh: 由于在座席客车不舒服的座位上睡了太久，我肌肉僵硬麻痹的醒来。
remmethod: in(不) + commod(方便；宽敞) + ious(形容词后缀) → 不方便的 → 狭窄的

en: extremely good, beautiful etc, and much better than others
ex1_en: an incomparable view of San Marco
ex1_zh: 圣马科美妙绝伦的景色
remmethod: in(不) + com(共同) + par(相等) + able(可…的) → 不可比的 → 无比的，无可匹敌的

ex1_en: A standardized programming model should be introduced to avoid technology incompatibility problems.
ex1_zh: 应该引入标准化编程模型来避免技术不兼容性问题。
remmethod: in(不) + compat(相容) + ibility(名词后缀) → 不兼容

en: If you refer to someone's incompetence, you are criticizing them because they are unable to do their job or a task properly
ex1_en: The incompetence of government officials is appalling.
ex1_zh: 政府官员的无能令人吃惊。
remmethod: in(不) + com(共同) + pet(追求；能力) + ence(名词后缀) → 没有能力 → 无能

ex1_en: Carbon monoxide is released when carbon in fuel—both plants and fossil fuels like gasoline—burns incompletely.
ex1_zh: 当作为燃料的碳——包括植物和化石燃料比如汽油——不完全燃烧时，就会产生一氧化碳。
remmethod: in(不) + com(完全) + plet(填满) + e + ly(副词后缀) → 不完全地

en: a situation in which two statements are different and cannot both be true
ex1_en: There were several glaring inconsistencies (= very noticeable differences ) in his report.
ex1_zh: 他的报告中有几个明显的前后矛盾之处。
remmethod: in(不) + con(共同) + sist(站立) + ency(名词后缀) → 不能站在一起 → 矛盾；不一致

zh: 不显眼的,不引人注意的
en: not easily seen or noticed

ex1_zh: 一家不起眼的小饭店

zh: 难以觉察地, 不显著地

in(不) + cor(共同) + rect(正) + ly(副词后缀) → 不正确 → 错误地

en: unable or unwilling to believe something
ex1_en: ‘You sold the car?’ she asked, incredulous.
ex1_zh: “你把车卖了？”她难以置信地问道。
remmethod: in(不) + cred(相信) + ul + ous(形容词后缀) → 怀疑的

ex1_zh: 在这里的每种情况下，其中一个模型独立于另一个模型而发展。

en: very difficult to see, hear, or notice

ex1_zh: 迷雾中小路依稀难辨。
remmethod: in(不) + discern(辨别) + ible(可…的) → 难识别的

en: careless about what you say or do, especially by talking about things which should be kept secret
ex1_en: It was very indiscreet of Colin to tell them about our plan.
ex1_zh: 科林把我们的计划告诉了他们，太不谨慎了。
remmethod: in(不) + dis(分开) + creet(辨别；判断) → 不辨别的 → 不慎重的

ex1_zh: 化肥的滥用
remmethod: in(不) + discriminate(区别) → 不加区别的

zh: 明白的；无争论之余地的

ex1_en: It is indisputable that birds are harbouring this illness.
ex1_zh: 无可争辩的是，鸟类携带着这种疾病。
remmethod: in (不， 无) + disputable (有争议的) → 毫无争议的， 不可争辩的

en: a rare soft silvery metallic element associated with zinc ores: used in alloys, electronics, and electroplating

ex1_zh: 光伏电池依赖于非晶态或晶态的硅，碲化镉或者硒化、硫化铜铟。
remmethod: ind(靛蓝) + ium(金属元素后缀) → 铟

ex1_zh: 大多数艺术家都非常我行我素。
remmethod: individual(个人) + ist(表人/…主义) + ic(…的) → 个人主义的

zh: 个性,(通常用复数)个人的嗜好
en: the qualities that make someone or something different from other things or people
ex1_en: We like our staff to show their individuality rather than wear a uniform.
ex1_zh: 我们喜欢员工穿出个性，而不是穿制服。
remmethod: individual(个人的) + ity(名词后缀) → 个性

en: separately, not together in a group

ex1_zh: 新郎向他们一一道谢。

remmethod: in(入) + duc(引导) + ible(可…的) → 可诱导的；可导致的

en: willing to allow someone, especially a child, to do or have whatever they want, even if this is not good for them

en: to make drunk; intoxicate

ex1_en: The meat was so burnt that it was inedible.
ex1_zh: 肉烧得那么焦，不能吃了。
remmethod: in(不) + ed(吃) + ible(可…的) → 不能吃的

en: something that is ineffective does not achieve what it is intended to achieve
ex1_en: an ineffective marketing campaign
ex1_zh: 一场毫无成效的营销活动

en: an unfair situation, in which some groups in society have more money, opportunities, power etc than others

ex1_zh: 人们对腐败和社会不公感到担忧。

en: too much or too great to be calculated

ex1_zh: 一幅价值连城的画
remmethod: in(不) + estim(估价) + able(可…的) → 不可估价的 → 无价的

zh: 不可原谅的；没法辩解的；不可宽恕的
en: inexcusable behaviour is too bad to be excused

ex1_zh: 不可饶恕的侵略行为

ex1_zh: 随着我们的向前推进，您对他们的军事渗入有何看法？

ex1_zh: 这也许并不起眼，尤其是考虑到质子极小的尺寸。

ex1_zh: 汽油高度易燃。
remmethod: in + flamm(燃烧) + able(能…的) → 容易着火的 → 易燃的

en: the way in which a word changes its form to show a difference in its meaning or use

in(不) + flex(弯曲) + ibly(可…地) → 不弯曲地

en: the movement of people, money, goods etc into a place
ex1_en: The Swiss wanted to discourage an inflow of foreign money.
ex1_zh: 瑞士人想要阻止外资流入。
remmethod: in(入) + flow(流) → 流入

en: someone who secretly gives the police, the army etc information about someone else
ex1_en: One of the witnesses was a paid informant for the FBI.
ex1_zh: 目击者之一是联邦调查局出钱雇用的线人。
remmethod: inform(通知) + ant(表人) → 通知者；告密者

en: not happening often
ex1_en: They would make infrequent visits to the house.
ex1_zh: 他们偶尔去看一看那所房子。
remmethod: in(不) + frequent(频繁的) → 不频发的；不常见的

en: not often
ex1_en: Jeremy does play cricket, but very infrequently.
ex1_zh: 杰里米确实玩板球，但次数很少。
remmethod: in(不) + frequent(频繁的) + ly(副词后缀) → 罕见地；稀少地

en: coming or going in; entering
ex1_en: The outer firewall has ports open that allow ingoing and outgoing HTTP requests.
ex1_zh: 外部的防火墙仅仅允许进出的 HTTP 请求。

in(入) + got(浇铸) → 浇铸成块 → 锭铁；工业纯铁

en: very cruel or without any normal feelings of pity

ex1_zh: 难民遭受了侮辱性和非人的待遇。
remmethod: in (无) + human (人性的) → 野蛮的

en: someone who owns or manages an inn

en: someone who introduces changes and new ideas

ex1_zh: 他是这个领域的革新者。
remmethod: in(进入) + nov(新) + ator(表人) → 革新者

en: a job, investment etc that is insecure does not give you a feeling of safety, because it might be taken away or lost at any time
ex1_en: Many of them work in low-paid insecure jobs.
ex1_zh: 他们当中的许多人都做着薪水低、不稳定的工作。
remmethod: in(不) + secure(安全的) → 不安全的

ex1_zh: 但它的不敏感性意味着偏移小到几乎无法测量和计算复杂到无法计算。
remmethod: in(不) + sens(感觉) + itive(…的) + ity(名词) → 不灵敏性

ex1_zh: 父母与孩子之间的关系是本能的，源于人类的本性。
remmethod: instinct(本能) + ual(形容词后缀) → 本能的

en: providing instruction
remmethod: instruct(教导) + ion(名词后缀) + al(形容词后缀) → 指导的，教育的

en: a person or company that provides insurance
ex1_en: This alternative would have to operate as any other insurer, on the basis of the premiums it collects.
ex1_zh: 这个选项如同其他的保险公司一样，依靠它收取的保费生存。
remmethod: in(使) + sur(确定；安全) + er(表人；机构) → 保险公司；承保人

en: without making much noise

ex1_zh: 罗莎悄悄关上门。

ex1_en: I was disappointed by the turn-out for our home match.
ex1_zh: 我对我们主场比赛的观众到场人数感到失望。
remmethod: turn(转) + out(出) → 转出来 → 产量；出席者；出动

en: two
remmethod: 本词(自身词根：二) → 两；双；二

ex1_en: On a clear night, I could see stars twinkling in the sky.
ex1_zh: 在晴朗的夜晚，我可以看见星星在天空闪烁。
remmethod: twinkl(e)(闪烁) + ing(…的；表状态) → 闪光的；瞬间，一眨眼

zh: 排印；[印刷] 活版印刷术；印刷格式
en: the work of preparing written material for printing
ex1_en: Jobs developed an appreciation for typography, the style and arrangement of printed characters.
ex1_zh: 乔布斯渐渐喜欢上排印术——打印字符的版面设计与安排。
remmethod: typo (印刷工) + graph (写； 图) + y → 排版， 排印

ex1_en: He saw a dagger sticking in his car's tyre.
ex1_zh: 他看到一把匕首插在他汽车的轮胎上。
remmethod: 轮胎(tyre)半途爆了， 又累(tire)又饿

zh: 不能接受的, 不受欢迎的
en: something that is unacceptable is so wrong or bad that you think it should not be allowed
ex1_en: I found her attitude totally unacceptable.
ex1_zh: 我觉得她的态度让人完全不能接受。
remmethod: un(不) + accept(接受) + able(能…的) → 不能接受的

zh: 无责任的；莫名其妙的；不可理解的
en: very surprising and difficult to explain
ex1_en: the unaccountable shyness she always felt in Louise’s presence
ex1_zh: 她在路易丝面前总是感到的莫名羞涩
remmethod: un (无) + accountable (a. 可解释的) → 无法解释的

ex1_en: You have to become awfully large to be unaffordable -- there's lots of cash, lots of capital out there for acquisitions.
ex1_zh: 制药业者坐拥很多现金,进行收购的资本雄厚,你必须变成让人买不起的超大公司.
remmethod: un(不) + afford(负担) + able(能…的) → 买不起的

en: Something that remains unaltered has not changed or been changed
ex1_en: The rest of the apartment had fortunately remained unaltered since that time.
ex1_zh: 从那时起公寓的其余部分就幸运地未曾改变过。
remmethod: un(未) + alter(改变) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未被改变的

en: an unanswered question has not been answered
ex1_en: Many other questions remain unanswered.
ex1_zh: 还有许多其他问题没有得到解答。
remmethod: un(不) + answer(回答) + ed(的) → 未答复的

en: an unanticipated event or result is one that you did not expect
ex1_en: an unanticipated increase in inflation
ex1_zh: 通货膨胀率意想不到的上升
remmethod: un(非) + anticipate(预料) + d(…的) → 非意料的 → 意料之外的

zh: 无魅力的, 无吸引力的
en: not attractive, pretty, or pleasant to look at
ex1_en: an unattractive man
ex1_zh: 没有魅力的男子
remmethod: un(不) + attract(吸引) + ive(形容词后缀) → 无吸引力的；无魅力的

en: not able to be obtained
ex1_en: Funding for the new school is unavailable.
ex1_zh: 这座新学校没有经费。
remmethod: un(不) + avail(有用) + able(能) → 不能利用的

ex1_en: The conflict of the class interests results in the pitiless class-struggle that unavoidably leads to the victory of the most numerous and most wronged class, the proletariat.
ex1_zh: 阶级利益的冲突导致了无情的阶级斗争，从而不可避免地导致了最广大的、最受虐待的阶级，即无产阶级的胜利。
remmethod: un(不) + avoid(避免) + able(可…的) + ly(副词后缀) → 不可避免地

zh: 不知道的, 没觉察到的
en: not noticing or realizing what is happening
ex1_en: Many people are unaware of just how much food and drink they consume.
ex1_zh: 许多人不知道自己到底消耗掉多少食物和饮料。
remmethod: un(不， 没有) + aware(意识到的) → 未意识到的

zh: 不知不觉地；出其不意地；不料
en: without noticing
ex1_en: We had walked unawares over the border.
ex1_zh: 我们无意中越过了边界。
remmethod: un (无) + aware (意识到的) + s → 没有意识到的 → 吃惊的； 不知不觉的

zh: 使失衡,使精神紊乱n失衡
en: to make someone slightly crazy
ex1_en: He banged against the cupboard, unbalancing a pile of books.
ex1_zh: 他砰的一声撞到橱柜上，撞翻了一堆书。
remmethod: un(不) + balance(平衡) → 使失衡；失衡

en: If you unbind something or someone, you take off a piece of cloth, string, or rope that has been tied around them
ex1_en: She unbound her hair and let it flow loose in the wind.
ex1_zh: 她解开头绳，让头发在风里自由地飘。
remmethod: un(不；相反) + bind(绑) → 解开；解放

zh: 不易破碎的, 牢不可破的
en: not able to be broken
ex1_en: unbreakable glass
ex1_zh: 不碎玻璃
remmethod: un(不) + break(打破) + able(可…的) → 不易破碎的；牢不可破的

ex1_en: One day, a man named He Shi of the State of Chu got a piece of uncarved jade in a hill. He quickly went to present it to King Li of the State of Chu.
ex1_zh: 一天，有个叫“和氏”的楚国人，在一座山里得到一块没有雕琢过得玉石，连忙拿去献给楚厉王。
remmethod: un(未) + carv(刻) + ed(形容词) → 未雕刻的

en: Uncertainty is a state of doubt about the future or about what is the right thing to do
remmethod: un(不) + certain(确定) + ty(名词后缀) → 不确定；无常

en: Something that is unchangeable cannot be changed at all
ex1_en: The doctrine is unchangeable.
ex1_zh: 这条教义是不可改变的。
remmethod: un(不) + change(改变) + able(可…的) → 不可改变的

en: always staying the same
remmethod: un(不) + chang(变) + ing(形容词后缀) → 不变的

en: difficult to understand or be sure about, so that there is doubt or confusion
ex1_en: The terms of the contract are very unclear.
ex1_zh: 合同的条款非常含糊。
remmethod: un(不) + clear(清楚) → 不清楚的

en: rare or unusual
ex1_en: Violent crimes against the elderly are fortunately very uncommon.
ex1_zh: 幸好针对老年人的暴力犯罪非常罕见。
remmethod: un(不) + common(普通) → 不凡的

en: not able or willing to compete
remmethod: un(非) + com(共同) + pet(追求) + itive(形容词后缀) → 非竞争性的

ex1_en: He unconsciously switched a tree with his cane when he talked to her.
ex1_zh: 在和她讲话时，他无意识地用手里的鞭子抽打着一棵树。
remmethod: un(不) + con(共同) + sci(知道) + ous(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 无意识地；不觉察地

ex1_en: A series of defects exist in the cup circulation pack sand control tools and slip filling sand control tools currently used in Binnan unconsolidated sandstone reservoir.
ex1_zh: 针对滨南采油厂疏松砂岩出砂油藏所用皮碗式循环充填防砂工具和卡瓦式充填防砂工具存在的一系列弊端，研制应用了新型无卡瓦胶筒式循环充填工具。
remmethod: un(不) + con(共同) + solid(坚固) + ated(…的) → 松散的

zh: 无争论的, 无异议的
en: an uncontested action or statement is one that no one opposes or disagrees with
ex1_en: After an uncontested divorce, Peggy married Charlie.
ex1_zh: 和平离婚之后，佩姬嫁给了查利。
remmethod: un(无) + contest(争论) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无争论的；无异议的

zh: 无法管束的, 控制不住的
ex1_en: This means your blood does not clot and you will bleed uncontrollably.
ex1_zh: 这意味着你的血液不会凝固，你会控制不住地出血。
remmethod: un(不) + control(控制) + ably(可…地) → 无法控制地

en: food that is uncooked has not been cooked
ex1_en: Always wash your hands after handling uncooked meat.
ex1_zh: 碰过生肉后一定要洗手。
remmethod: un(未) + cook(煮) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未煮过的

ex1_en: We filmed there this summer, and it is deeply touching to see that Collins not only ran a rare, uncorrupt and democratic camp, but had put up a schoolhouse, a library and a meeting hall.
ex1_zh: 今年夏天我们在那里拍摄时，激动地发现，科林斯不仅管理着一个少见的、廉洁民主的营地，并且建设了校舍、图书馆和大会堂。
remmethod: un(不) + corrupt(腐败) → 不腐败的；廉洁的

en: unable to be counted; innumerable
ex1_en: This arrangement is no different from one where the voter casts a symbolic vote, a vote that remains uncounted, with the outcome already determined by the whims of the tyrant.
ex1_zh: 民主制度的这种安排与独裁者的独断专行基本无异，选民只是象征性的投了一票，但是这一票背后的民意却很少有人关心。
remmethod: un(不) + count(数) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无数的；没有数过的

zh: 无批判力的,不加批判的
en: unable or unwilling to see faults in something or someone – used to show disapproval
remmethod: un(不) + critical(批判的) → 不加批判的

zh: 去掉…的皱纹,使回复到平整状态
remmethod: un(去除) + crumple(弄皱) → 去掉皱纹；使回复到平整状态

en: not having made a decision about something important
ex1_en: After college she was still undecided as to what career she wanted to pursue.
ex1_zh: 大学毕业后她仍无法决定自己要追求什么事业。
remmethod: un(不) + decid(决定) + ed(形容词后缀) → 不确定的

zh: 不可否认的, 无可辩驳的
en: definitely true or certain
ex1_en: undeniable proof
ex1_zh: 确证
remmethod: un(不) + deny(否认) + able(可…的) → 不可否认的；无可辩驳的

zh: 充电不足；索价低于常价；弹药装填不足
en: to charge too little (for)
remmethod: under(低于) + charge(费用) → 少算价钱

en: under your feet where you are walking
remmethod: under(在下面) + foot(脚) → 在脚下面；踩着地

en: a project, organization etc that is underfunded has not been given enough money to be effective
ex1_en: For years we have argued that the FDA is underfunded.
ex1_zh: 数年来我们一直在讲食品及药物管理局经费不足。
remmethod: under(不足) + fund(资金) + ed(形容词后缀) → 资金不足的

zh: 位于之下, 成为的基础
ex1_en: Try to figure out what feeling underlies your anger.
ex1_zh: 设法找出什么情绪是你生气的原因。
remmethod: under(在下面) + lies(躺) → 位于之下；成为…的基础

ex1_en: Does this mean that all GM foods are fated never to solve the undernutrition of the poor?
ex1_zh: 这是否意味着所有的转基因食品注定永远不会解决穷人的营养不足？
remmethod: under(不足) + nutrition(营养) → 营养不良
under(不足) + represent(代表) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未被充分代表的

en: to sell goods at a lower price than someone else
ex1_en: I think he undersold himself at the interview.
ex1_zh: 我认为他在面试时过于自谦了。
remmethod: under(低于) + sell(卖) → 以低于市价售出

en: understandable behaviour, reactions etc seem normal and reasonable because of the situation you are in
ex1_en: It is understandable that parents are angry, and looking for someone to blame.
ex1_zh: 父母生气了想找个人出气，这是可以理解的。
remmethod: understand(理解) + able(可…的) → 可理解的

ex1_en: Some parents, understandably, have a very hard time with this one. They may feel that anything their kids do is their business.
ex1_zh: 可以理解，有些家长要做到这一条不太容易，他们可能觉得任何孩子的事都是他们的事。
remmethod: understand(理解) + ably(可…地) → 可理解地

ex1_en: Wild sarsaparilla, wild oats, Solomon's seal and a host of understory plants die off;
ex1_zh: 野生撒尔沙、野生燕麦、玉竹和大量的林下叶层植物相继死光；
remmethod: under(下) + story(层) → 林下叶层

en: to think that someone or something is less important or valuable than they really are
ex1_en: Society undervalues staying at home and looking after children.
ex1_zh: 社会低估了待在家里照看孩子的意义。
remmethod: under(低于) + value(价值) → 低估

zh: 后翅, 后翅色彩瑰丽的蛾
en: the hind wing of an insect, esp when covered by the forewing
remmethod: under(下面) + wing(翅) → 后翅

en: the criminals in a particular place and the criminal activities they are involved in
ex1_en: New York’s criminal underworld
ex1_zh: 纽约的黑社会
remmethod: under(下面) + world(世界) → 下面的世界 → 黑社会

zh: 不发达的, 未开发的
en: used in order to describe land which has not yet been used for building, farming etc
ex1_en: an undeveloped stretch of coastline
ex1_zh: 一段未开发的海岸线
remmethod: un(未) + develop(发展) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未开发的

en: Something that is undiscovered has not been discovered or noticed
ex1_en: The name Vulcan was given to the undiscovered planet.
ex1_zh: “伏尔坎”这个名字被用来给未被发现的星体命名。
remmethod: un(未) + dis(去除) + cover(覆盖) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未被揭开覆盖的 → 未被发现的

en: known to be definitely true
ex1_en: Doctors found undisputed evidence of nerve damage.
ex1_zh: 医生发现了神经受损的确凿证据。
remmethod: un(不) + dis(否定) + put(思考) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无可置辩的

ex1_en: The place is rife with smugglers, dealers, undocumented immigrants, and slaves.
ex1_zh: 这里到处都是走私者、交易商、无证移民甚至奴隶。
remmethod: un(不) + document(文件) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无证明的

zh: 过度地；不适当地；不正当地
en: more than is normal or reasonable
ex1_en: It didn’t trouble me unduly.
ex1_zh: 这事并没有让我太烦恼。
remmethod: un (不) + duly (适当， 合适，适度) → 不适当地， 过分地， 过度地

en: not deserved
ex1_en: The abolition of incomes unearned by work.
ex1_zh: 第十一条，取缔不劳而获的收入。
remmethod: un(不) + earn(赚得) + ed(形容词后缀) → 不劳而获的

en: not educated to the usual level, or showing that someone is not well educated
ex1_en: a largely uneducated workforce
ex1_zh: 大部分人都没受过教育的劳动力
remmethod: un(未) + educate(教育) + (e)d(形容词后缀) → 没受教育的；文盲的

zh: 不断的, 不断重复的
en: something, especially something bad, that is unending seems as if it will continue for ever
ex1_en: an unending stream of people
ex1_zh: 源源不断的人流
remmethod: un(不) + end(结束) + ing(形容词后缀) → 不结束的 → 不断的

zh: 不同的， 不相等的； 不平等的， 不相称的； 不胜任的
en: used to describe a situation or a social system which is unfair because some groups or people have more power than others
ex1_en: an unequal contest
ex1_zh: 不公平的竞赛
remmethod: un(不) + equ(相等) + al(形容词) → 不相等的；不平等的

en: completely clear and without any possibility of doubt
ex1_en: His answer was an unequivocal ‘No.’
ex1_zh: 他的回答是毫不含糊的“不”。
remmethod: un (不) + equi (相等) + voc (说) + al → 不说中立的话 → 明确的

en: morally unacceptable
ex1_en: unethical medical practices
ex1_zh: 不道德的医疗行为
remmethod: un(不) + ethical(道德的) → 不道德的
un(未) + expect(预期) + ed(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 意外地
un(不) + fail(失败) + ing(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 不失败地 → 可靠地

ex1_en: And that's going to require some very hard choices. And we're going to have to do that in a way that does not add unfairly to the burdens that the average American already faces.
ex1_zh: 他还称,"这就需要作出一些十分困难的选择.我们达到此目的所采取的方式,将不会向普通美国人已面临的负担中,增加不公平的累赘."
remmethod: un(不) + fair(公平) + ly(副词后缀) → 不公平地

en: not known to you
ex1_en: a crowd of unfamiliar faces
ex1_zh: 一群陌生的面孔
remmethod: un(不)+familiar(熟悉的)→不熟悉的
un(不) + favor(善意；赞成) + ably(可…地) → 不利地

en: not dealing with or paying attention to the most important ideas, causes etc
ex1_en: The discussion was becom­ing unfocused.
ex1_zh: 讨论的焦点越来越分散。
remmethod: un(未) + focus(焦点) + ed(形容词) → 未聚焦的

en: an unforeseen situation is one that you did not expect to happen
ex1_en: Radiation may damage cells in a way that was previously unforeseen.
ex1_zh: 辐射也许会以以前未预见的方式损坏细胞。
remmethod: un(不) + fore(预先) + seen(看见) → 无法预料的

en: not kind or friendly
ex1_en: The old man looked cross and unfriendly.
ex1_zh: 老人看上去生气了，很不友好。
remmethod: un(不)+friendly(友好的)→不友好的

zh: 无阻的, 不受阻碍的
en: without hindrance
ex1_en: he could proceed unhindered
remmethod: un(不) + hinder(阻碍) + ed(形容词后缀) → 无阻的；不受阻碍的

en: created from more than one part, group etc
ex1_en: a unified approach
ex1_zh: 统一的方法
remmethod: uni(单一) ＋ fy(使…) → 统一

en: the concept that the earth's surface was shaped in the past by gradual processes, such as erosion, and by small sudden changes, such as earthquakes, of the type acting today rather than by the sudden divine acts, such as the flood survived by Noah (Genesis 6
remmethod: uni(单一) + form(形式) + arian(表人/主张者) + ism(主义) → 均变论
un(未) + in(入) + corpor(团体) + ated(形容词后缀) → 未合并的

en: not having enough knowledge or information
ex1_en: Parents were left anxious, uninformed, and isolated.
ex1_zh: 家长们忧心忡忡，不知道情况到底如何，感到孤立无援。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 无知的，未受过教育的

en: if a place is uninhabitable, it is impossible to live in
ex1_en: Much of the country is uninhabitable because it is desert.
ex1_zh: 由于地处沙漠，这个国家的许多地区不适宜居住。
remmethod: un(不) + in(内) + habit(居住) + able(可…的) → 不适宜居住的

en: Unintended results were not planned to happen, although they happened
remmethod: un(不) + in(入) + tend(伸展) + ed(形容词后缀) → 未伸向 → 意想不到的

ex1_en: I brushed up against him unintentionally.
ex1_zh: 我无意中碰了他一下。
remmethod: 本词(自身词根) → 无意地

en: If you describe something or someone as uninteresting, you mean they have no special or exciting qualities
ex1_en: Their media have earned the reputation for being rather dull and uninteresting.
ex1_zh: 他们的媒体得到的名声是乏味无聊。
remmethod: un(不) + interest(兴趣) + ing(…的) → 无趣味的

en: continuous
ex1_en: uninterrupted sleep
ex1_zh: 不间断的睡眠
remmethod: un(不) + interrupt(打断) + ed(形容词后缀) → 不停的；连续的

ex1_en: During the past 40 years, the fraction of unionized civilian workers fell steeply-and not only in the United States- while the unionization of government workers fell only a little.
ex1_zh: 在过去40年里，非政府工人在联合会的比例大幅度下降——这种现象不止发生在美国——而政府员工在联合会的比例仅小幅度下降。
remmethod: union(联合；工会) + ization(…化) → 工会化；联合
uni(单一) + que(形容词后缀) + ly(副词后缀) → 独特地；唯一地

en: the state or quality of being universal
ex1_en: Secondly, the relationship between universality and specificity.
ex1_zh: 第二，普遍性与特殊性的关系。
remmethod: universal(普遍的) + ity(名词后缀) → 普遍性

en: not realizing what you are doing or what is happening
ex1_en: Some governments have been victims and perhaps unknowing accomplices in the bank's activities.
ex1_zh: 有些政府曾是银行行为的受害者或不知情的同谋。
remmethod: un(不) + know(知道) + ing(表状态) → 不知道的；无知的

zh: 难处理的, 难控制的
en: difficult to control or deal with
ex1_en: People were visiting the house every day, sometimes in unmanageable numbers.
ex1_zh: 每天都有人来参观这座房子，有时人数多得难以管理。
remmethod: un(不) + manage(管理) + able(可…的) → 难处理的

en: easy to recognize
ex1_en: the unmistakable sound of gunfire
ex1_zh: 清清楚楚的枪炮声

en: impossible to get

ex1_zh: 不赢利的企业

zh: 无保护的, 未做防护措施的

zh: 未经证明的, 未经检验的

ex1_zh: 未经证实的指控

remmethod: un(不) + real(真实) → 不真实的

en: unrealistic ideas or hopes are not reasonable or sensible

remmethod: un(未) + suspect(怀疑) + ed(…的) → 未被怀疑的；未知的
